Conservation groups have united in protest against the planned new road.  环境保育组织联合起来，抗议计划建造的新公路。
They protested bitterly to their employers, but to no avail.  他们向老板表达强烈抗议，但一点用也没有。

Eighteen craft (= boats) set out in the race.  比赛出发时有18艘船。
These bracelets were crafted by native Americans.  这些手镯是美洲印第安人制作的。

words.meaning: n.(国与国之间的)条约；(人与人之间的)协议
words.example: a peace treaty  和平条约

This latest episode in the fraud scandal has shocked a lot of people.  诈骗丑闻最新爆出的事件让很多人瞠目结舌。
The drugs, the divorce and the depression - it's an episode in his life that he wants to forget.  吸毒、离婚和抑郁——这是他人生中不堪回首的一段经历。UK noun countable

She's been leading throughout the race, but it now looks as if she's tiring.  她在整个赛跑中一路领先，但现在看上去似乎累了。
Even doing the garden tires me these days.  最近，我连在花园里整理花草都会感到累。verb intransitive or transitive UK   Phrasal Verbs   tire of sth/sb  ADVANCED
This is the kind of toy that children will soon tire of.  这种玩具小孩会很快玩腻的。

It's not my fault she didn't come!  她没来不是我的错！
She believes it was the doctor's fault that Peter died.  她认为彼得的死医生需要负责。
The fault was/lay with the organizers, who failed to make the necessary arrangements for dealing with so many people.  是组织者的过错，他们没有做好必要的安排来接待这么多人。
The fire caused considerable damage to the church.  那场火灾令教堂造成了重大损失。

words.meaning: a.智力的，理智的；n.知识分子
words.example:
Looking after a baby at home all day is nice but it doesn't provide much intellectual stimulation.  整天在家照顾婴儿虽然不错，但让人不怎么动脑筋。
She was too much of an intellectual to find popular films interesting.  她太书卷气了，认为流行电影没甚么意思。

He was charged with sexual assault.  他被指控性侵犯。
They launched an assault on the capital yesterday.  昨天他们进攻首都。
Women's groups have demanded a nationwide assault on sexism in the workplace.  妇女团体已经要求在全国范围内发动一场反对工作场所性别歧视的硬仗。

words.meaning: n.掩蔽处；掩蔽；v.提供庇护，保护
words.example:
They opened a shelter to provide temporary housing for the city's homeless.  他们开设了一个收容所，为该市的无家可归者提供临时的住宿。
The trees gave/provided some shelter from the rain.  这些树遮了一些雨。
We took shelter for the night in an abandoned house.  我们在一栋废弃的房子里躲了一夜。UK verb

There are two entrances - one at the front and one round the back.  入口有两个，一个在前面，另一个在后面。    Compare exit
He makes a spectacular entrance in act two draped in a gold sheet.  在第二幕，他身披金袍上场，光彩炫目。
The management reserve the right to refuse entrance.  管理部门保留拒绝他人入内的权利。UK verb transitive literary

If you hang your clothes out in the bright sun, they will fade.  衣服挂在光线强的地方晾晒会褪色。
My suntan is already fading.  我晒黑的肤色已经开始变浅了。
They arrived home just as the light was fading (= as it was going dark).  夕阳西下时，他们到家了。

The pilot averted a tragedy when he succeeded in preventing the plane from crashing.  飞行员成功阻止飞机的坠毁，从而避免了一场悲剧。
Hitler's invasion of Poland led to the tragedy of the Second World War.  希特勒入侵波兰，引发第二次世界大战这场浩劫。
His life was touched by hardship and personal tragedy.  他的一生充满了艰辛和不幸。

Bright colours and bold strokes characterize his early paintings.  明亮的色彩和大胆的笔触是他早期绘画作品的特征。
In her essay, she characterizes the whole era as a period of radical change.  她在文章中将整个时代的特征归纳为一个急剧变化的时期。

We've had to alter some of our plans.  我们不得不对一些计划作出改动。
Although long-distance phone calls are going up, the charge for local calls will not alter.  尽管长途电话费涨价，本地电话费将不会有变动。
Giving up our car has radically altered our lifestyle.  弃车不用使我们的生活方式发生了根本性的变化。

This latest defeat constitutes a major setback for the government.  最近的这次失败是对政府的一次重挫。UK verb
Women constitute about 10% of Parliament.  女性在议会中约占10%。
The under-18s constitute nearly 25% of the town's population.  18岁以下的人口占该城镇人口的近25%。

Cut the lemon in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl.  把柠檬对切，将汁挤到碗里。
As she waited to go into the exam, he squeezed her hand (= pressed it affectionately with his hand) and wished her good luck.  在她等待应考时，他捏了捏她的手，祝她好运。
Once he had finished cleaning the floor, he squeezed the cloth out.  他擦完地板之后，把抹布拧干。

The bank robbers wore masks throughout the raid.  劫匪抢劫银行时一直戴着面罩。UK noun countable
The newspaper revealed the sordid truth behind his mask of respectability.  报纸揭露了他体面外表下龌龊肮脏的真实嘴脸。UK noun countable
I've put some flowers in there to mask the smell.  我在那里放了一些花来掩盖那种气味。

words.meaning: v.使改变(信仰等)；n.改变信仰的人
words.example:
Could we convert the small bedroom into a second bathroom?  我们能把这间小睡房改建成第二间浴室吗？
What's the formula for converting pounds into kilos?  把磅换算成千克的公式是甚么？
He converted to (= started believing in) Catholicism when he got married.  他婚后信奉了天主教。

We offer you a comprehensive training in all aspects of the business.  我们向你提供这个行业各方面的综合培训。
Is this list comprehensive or are there some names missing?  这份名单是完整的还是遗漏了一些名字？
He has written a fully comprehensive guide to Rome.  他写了一本内容详尽的罗马旅游指南。

The government should be playing a more prominent role in promoting human rights.  政府应该在促进人权方面发挥更重要的作用。UK adjective
She has a rather prominent chin/nose.  她的下巴翘得厉害／鼻子很高。
New books are displayed in a prominent position on tables at the front of the shop.  新书陈列在商店前方桌上的一个显眼位置。

The speaker gave an interesting presentation on urban transport.  演讲者针对城市交通发表了有趣的谈话。
The presentation of prizes and certificates will take place in the main hall.  奖品和证书的颁发仪式将在大厅举行。noun
Presentation is important if you want people to buy your products.  如果想要人们购买你的产品，包装非常重要。

words.meaning: v.假装；装扮(尤指儿童在游戏中)
words.example:
The children pretended (that) they were dinosaurs.  孩子们装扮成恐龙。
She's not really hurt - she's only pretending.  她并不是真的受了伤——她只是在装。
Of course I was angry - I can't pretend otherwise.  我当然生气了——怎么可能会是假装的。

The prize was split between Susan and Kate.  这笔奖金被苏珊和凯特平分了。
Split the aubergines in half and cover with breadcrumbs.  把茄子切成两半，裹上面包屑。
The teacher split the children (up) into three groups.  老师把孩子们分成三组。

They were charged with violating federal law.  他们被控违犯了联邦法律。
It seems that the planes deliberately violated the cease-fire agreement.  那些飞机似乎是故意违反停火协议。
The doctor has been accused of violating professional ethics.  那名医生被控违反了职业道德。

words.meaning: a.极其重要的；充满活力的
words.example:
She had found out some information of vital importance.  她已经查出了一些极为重要的资讯。
The kidney plays a vital role/part in the removal of waste products from the blood.  肾脏对于排除血液中的废物起着至关重要的作用。
He had never felt so vital and full of life.  他从来没有像现在一样感到如此精神焕发，充满活力。

There's a clear distinction between the dialects spoken in the two regions.  这两个地区的方言有着明显的不同。
This company makes no distinction between the sexes.  这间公司男女平等。noun
She has the distinction of being one of the few people to have an honorary degree conferred on her by the university this year.  今年，只有几个人被授予了大学荣誉学位，她有幸成为其中之一。

The salad was decorated with segments of orange.  沙拉上点缀了橙瓣。
People over the age of 85 make up the fastest-growing population segment.  85岁以上者成为人口增长最快的部分。verb intransitive or transitive UK US     specialized
City Insurance segmented the market into three by issuing three types of policy.  城市保险公司透过推出三种保单把市场分割为三个部分。

He was known as a radical reformer/thinker/politician.  他是个著名的激进改革者／思想家／政治家。
These people have very radical views.  这些人观点很偏激。adjective
We need to make some radical changes to our operating procedures.  我们需要对操作流程进行一些根本性的变革。

Many software companies have adapted popular programs to the new operating system.  许多软体公司已经改编了常用的程式以适应新的作业系统。
The recipe here is a pork roast adapted from Caroline O'Neill's book 'Louisiana Kitchen'.  这道菜是根据卡洛琳•奥尼尔《路易斯安那厨房》一书中烤猪肉的做法改进而来的。
The play had been adapted for (= changed to make it suitable for) children.  这个剧本已被改编成儿童剧。
I'm a terrible correspondent - I never seem to get the time to write.  我很少写信——我好像从来就没空写信。

The remains of some Roman earthenware vessels were found during the dig.  挖掘过程中发现了一些古罗马人的陶瓷器皿的残片。noun countable
As a young and spirited politician, he seems a worthy vessel for the nation's hopes.  他是位充满活力的年轻政治家，似乎是可以寄托国家希望的人。noun countable

The books will be distributed free to local schools.  这些书将免费发放给当地学校。
Several people were arrested for distributing racist leaflets/pamphlets (to the spectators).  有数人因为（向观众）散发宣扬种族主义的小册子而被捕。
The company aims eventually to distribute (= supply for sale) its products throughout the European Union.  公司计划最终让产品行销欧盟国家。

It is on economic policy that the government is most vulnerable.  政府最易受人诟病的是经济政策。
Tourists are more vulnerable to attack, because they do not know which areas of the city to avoid.  游客更容易受到攻击，因为他们不知道城里哪些地方不该去。

Steve's favourite fantasy was to own a big house and a flashy car.  史蒂夫最爱幻想拥有一座大房子和一辆豪华轿车。
She retreated into a fantasy world , where she could be anything she wanted.  她遁入了幻想世界，在那里她想要成为甚么都可以。

words.meaning: n.(戏剧、小说)情节；阴谋，策划
words.example:
The film has a very simple plot.  这部电影情节很简单。
The plots of his books are basically all the same.  他的书情节基本上都一样。UK noun countable
The plot was discovered before it was carried out.  这项阴谋还未得逞就暴露了。

The prisoner raised his fist in a gesture of defiance as he was led out of the courtroom.  犯人被带出法庭时，举起拳头以示抗议。
She made a rude gesture at the other driver.  她对另一个司机做了个粗鲁的手势。UK noun countable
The Government donated £500 000 as a gesture of goodwill.  该政府捐助了50万英镑以示友善。
She studied psychology at Harvard.  她在哈佛大学攻读心理学。

I've got a slight headache.  我头有点痛。
Like most long-distance runners she is very slight.  和大多数长跑运动员一样，她十分苗条。verb transitive

The economy looks set to sustain its growth into next year.  看来经济增长会持续到明年。
He seems to find it difficult to sustain relationships with women.  他似乎觉得和女人维持关系并不容易。
The soil in this part of the world is not rich enough to sustain a large population.  这里的土地不够肥沃，无法供养大量人口。verb transitive
You have a legal obligation to (= The law says you must) ensure your child receives a proper education.  法律规定你有义务确保自己的孩子接受合理的教育。

words.meaning: n.阴谋；计划，方案；(作品等)体系，结构
words.example:
There's a new scheme in our town for recycling plastic bottles.  我们镇上有一个回收利用塑胶瓶的新计划。
Class sizes will increase under the new scheme.  按照新的设计，班级规模将扩大。
He's got a hare-brained/crazy/daft scheme for getting rich before he's 20.  他有一个轻率的／疯狂的／愚蠢的计划，好让自己在20岁前致富。noun countable

words.meaning: n.爆裂声；裂缝；v.裂开；破解，破译
words.example:
The walls cracked and the roof collapsed in the earthquake.  地震中墙壁开裂，屋顶坍塌。
Stress and overwork are causing teachers to crack (up).  压力和过度劳累使老师们身心疲惫。
Their relationship began to crack (up) after their child died.  孩子夭折后，他们的关系开始出现问题。

Complaints about the frequency of trains rose by 201% in the last year.  去年对火车发车频率的投诉增长了201%。
It's not the duration of his absences from work so much as the frequency that worries me.  与他的旷工时日相比，他旷工的频繁程度更让我担忧。noun
The human ear cannot hear very high-frequency sounds.  人耳听不到极高频率的声音。
Present tonight at the long-awaited opening of this film are a whole galaxy of stars from the acting and musical professions.  人们期待已久的电影首映礼今晚举行，一大批影星歌星前来捧场。

Her silence was taken as an admission of guilt/defeat.  她的沉默被认为是承认自己有罪／失败。
By/On his own admission (= as he has said) he has achieved little since he took over the company.  据他自己说，自从接手公司以来，他几乎一事无成。noun
Admission to the exhibition will be by invitation only.  只有持请帖者才可进入展览会场。

Jenny is a top-year infant now.  珍妮现在是一所幼儿学校的大班生。
Andrew's still in the infants.  安德鲁还在上幼儿学校。adjective UK

Photographs show him wearing the scruffy T-shirt and jeans that were the student's uniform of the time.  照片上的他穿着当时的校服，就是那种脏兮兮的T恤和牛仔裤。UK adjective
As in so many offices that you see, the walls and furniture are a uniform grey.  和你看到的很多办公室一样，墙壁和家俱一律都是灰色的。
Small businesses are demanding that they receive uniform treatment from the banks.  小企业要求银行给予它们一视同仁的待遇。
a rock formation  一块岩石的结构

words.meaning: n.丑闻；恶意的诽谤，流言蜚语
words.example:
Their affair caused/created a scandal in the office.  他们的风流韵事在办公室里成了丑闻。
The scandal broke (= became public knowledge) right at the beginning of the Conservative Party Conference.  就在保守党大会开幕的那一刻，丑闻爆了出来。
If there is the slightest suggestion/hint of scandal, the public will no longer trust us.  只要有哪怕一丝丑闻，民众就再也不会信任我们。

Unhappiness was woven into the natural fabric of people's lives.  苦恼忧愁原是人们日常生活的一部分。
We must invest in the fabric of our hospitals and start rebuilding them.  我们必须对医院建筑进行投资并开始重建工作。

words.meaning: v.竞争；对„表示质疑，对„提出异议
words.example:
She's won a lot of beauty contests.  她多次在选美大赛中获胜。noun countable UK ATTEMPT  努力
The contest for deputy leadership of the party is gathering speed.  该党副领袖职务的竞选争夺正在加剧。verb transitive /kənˈtest/
We will certainly contest any claims made against the safety of our products.  我们肯定会驳斥任何批评我们产品安全性的说法。verb transitive /kənˈtest/

The safe had been rifled and the diamonds were gone.  保险柜被洗劫了，钻石不翼而飞。
He rifled through the papers on the desk, but couldn't find the photographs.  他把桌上的一堆档翻了个遍，但是没有找到照片。

Old houses need a lot of maintenance.  老房子需要大量保养。
There are thorough maintenance checks on each plane before take-off.  每架飞机起飞前都要经过彻底的维修检查。
The magazine offers tips on cutting your house maintenance costs.  这本杂志教你一些降低房屋维修花费的妙计。noun uncountable

As it was her first conviction for stealing, she was given a less severe sentence.  由于她是初次犯盗窃罪，对她的量刑不是很重。
He has a long record of previous convictions for similar offences.  他有多次类似罪行的犯罪记录。
The conviction of the three demonstrators has caused public outrage locally.  三个示威者被判有罪，这激起了当地民众的愤怒。    Compare acquittalnoun

words.meaning: a.老于世故的；(仪器)精密的
words.example:
She was slim, svelte and sophisticated.  她身材苗条，体态娇美，处事练达。
He was older than me and from London and I thought him very sophisticated.  他比我大，而且来自伦敦，我觉得他为人很老练。
These are among the most sophisticated weapons in the world.  这些属于世界上最尖端的武器。

You stupid cow!  你这个蠢婆娘！noun
It's been a cow of a day.  真是令人难受的一天。noun
The protesters refused to be cowed into submission by the army.  抗议者拒绝向军队低头。

words.meaning: n.勇气；神经；v.给予力量或勇气
words.example:
It takes a lot of nerve to be a bomb disposal expert.  当拆弹专家需要极大勇气。
She was a bundle of nerves (= very nervous) before the audition.  她试演之前非常紧张。
We really got on each other's nerves when we were living together.  我们住在一起时确实闹得不可开交。

words.meaning: a.引起或可能引起争论的
words.example: The book was very controversial.  这本书很有争议。

The situation is desperate - we have no food, very little water and no medical supplies.  形势非常严峻——我们没有食物和药物，只有很少的水。
The earthquake survivors are in desperate need of help.  地震幸存者极需帮助。
He has a desperate desire to succeed.  他非常渴望成功。

This recipe should be sufficient for five people.  这份食谱应该足够五个人吃。
It was thought that he'd committed the crime but there wasn't sufficient evidence to convict him.  人们都认为他是犯罪凶手，但没有足够证据将他定罪。    Opposite insufficient
It's a moving narrative of wartime adventure.  这是对战时经历的感人描述。

words.meaning: a.谦虚的，谨慎的；（数量、体积等）适度的
words.example:
They live in a fairly modest house, considering their wealth.  就他们拥有的财富而言，他们的住所不大。
There has been a modest improvement/recovery in housing conditions for the poor.  穷人的居住条件有了些许改善。
The party made modest gains in the elections, but nothing like the huge gains that were predicted.  这个党派在选举中取得了一定成绩，但和人们预计的巨大收获相差甚远。

words.meaning: v.(用手)轻抚；n.击，打(球)；(钢笔，毛笔)一笔，笔画
words.example:
She suffered/had a stroke which left her unable to speak.  她中风了，不能开口说话。UK noun
With a few bold strokes, she signed her name.  她粗粗几笔签下名字。
Please complete form D7/8 (= 'D seven stroke eight').  请填写表格D7/8。UK noun

words.meaning: n.视野，眼界；(处理、研究食物的)范围
words.example:
I'm afraid that problem is beyond/outside the scope of my lecture.  恐怕那个问题超出了我的课程范围。
Oil painting does not come within the scope of a course of this kind.  油画不在这类课程范围内。
We would now like to broaden/widen the scope of the enquiry and look at more general matters.  我们现在要扩大调查的范围，多注意一些普遍情况。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.促使，激起；a.敏捷的，迅速的
words.example:
The bishop's speech has prompted an angry response from both political parties.  主教的发言激起了两大政党的愤怒回应。
Recent worries over the president's health have prompted speculation over his political future.  最近对总统健康状况的担忧引发了对其政治前途的猜测。
What prompted you to say that?  是甚么促使你那么说的？

Plants absorb carbon dioxide.  植物吸收二氧化碳。
In cold climates, houses need to have walls that will absorb heat.  在气候寒冷的地方，房屋的墙壁必须能吸收热量。
Towels absorb moisture.  毛巾吸收水汽。

Iraq's principal export is oil.  伊拉克最重要的出口商品是石油。
He was principal dancer at the Dance Theatre of Harlem.  他是哈莱姆舞剧院的头号舞伶。
That was my principal reason for moving.  那是我搬家最主要的原因。noun

Our hotel room overlooked the harbour.  从我们饭店的房间可眺望港口。
The house is surrounded by trees, so it's not overlooked at all (= it cannot be seen from any other buildings).  这栋房子四周绿树环绕，所以从其他建筑处根本看不到它。verb transitive UK NOT NOTICE  没注意
No one will be overlooked in the selection of the team.  在组队时不会忽略任何人。verb transitive UK FORGIVE  原谅

Throughout the Cold War, the Allies asserted their right to move freely between the two Berlins.  冷战期间，盟国自始至终坚持其在东西柏林之间自由来往的权利。
She very rarely asserts her authority over the children.  她很少摆出大人的权威来管教孩子。
a sword with a steel blade  钢剑

Supporters invaded (= ran onto) the pitch.  球迷都跑进了球场。noun
The piano and organ were tuned to the same pitch (= note).  钢琴和风琴被调校到同一音调上。
If you teach children and adults in the same class, it's difficult to get the pitch (= level of difficulty or interest) right.  如果你把孩子和成人放在同一个班里教，就很难完全找出适合学生的难度和他们的兴趣。

words.meaning: n.松树；v.(因疾病等)憔悴；渴望
words.example:
Pine is a softwood.  松木是一种软木。verb intransitive
Carter died in 1904 after an accident and Leno pined away and died in London six months later.  1904年卡特死于非命，莱诺日渐憔悴，六个月后死于伦敦。verb intransitive
He's still pining for his ex-girlfriend.  他还在苦苦思念着他的前女友。

words.meaning: a.绝对的，完全的; 无(条件)限制的
words.example:
There was no absolute proof of fraud.  没有确凿的证据能证明是诈骗行为。
He's an absolute idiot!  他是个十足的白痴！
That's absolute rubbish!  那完全是一派胡言！adjective

He is one of the top chefs in Britain.  他是英国的顶级厨师之一。
She is head- chef at the Waldorf-Astoria.  她是华道夫－阿斯多里亚餐厅的首席厨师。

This programme contains language that some viewers might find offensive.  这个节目使用了某些观众可能觉得不快的语言。
He told some really offensive sexist jokes.  他讲了一些极令人不快的性别歧视的笑话。    Opposite inoffensive
Since the other side had taken offensive action (= attacked) , we had no choice but to defend ourselves.  既然对方已经采取了攻势，我们除了自卫别无选择。

words.meaning: n.繁荣昌盛时期；v.发出深沉有回响的声音
words.example:
This year has seen a boom in book sales.  今年图书销售激增。
The insurance business suffered from a vicious cycle of boom and bust.  保险业经历了繁荣和萧条的恶性循环。
The cannons boomed (out) in the night.  大炮在晚上隆隆作响。

We've appointed three new teachers this year.  我们今年已经任用了三名新教师。
He's just been appointed (as) director of the publishing division.  他刚刚被任命为出版部主任。

words.meaning: a.(生)(遗传特征)显性的，优势的；最重要的，占支配地位的
words.example: Unemployment will be a dominant issue at the next election.  失业将成为下届选举中的主要辩论问题。

You must submit your application before January 1st.  申请须于1月1日前提交。
The developers submitted building plans to the council for approval.  开发商向市政会提交待批准的建筑规划。
In conclusion, I submit that the proposal will not work without some major changes.  最后，我认为这项提案必须进行重大修改方能实施。 (-tt-)

We don't anticipate any trouble.  我们不希望出现任何问题。
We had one or two difficulties along the way that we didn't anticipate.  在进行的过程中，我们遇到一两个没有预料到的难题。
Are you anticipating a lot of people at the party tonight?  你预计今晚的聚会会有很多人来吗？

An elderly cousin had left her a small legacy.  一位堂兄留给她一小笔遗产。
The Greeks have a rich legacy of literature.  希腊人有丰富的文学遗产。
The war has left a legacy of hatred.  那场战争给人们留下了仇恨。

"Where's Dad?" "How should I know?" replied my brother, shrugging.  “爸爸在哪里？”“我怎么知道？”哥哥耸了耸肩，答道。
He shrugged his shoulders as if to say that there was nothing he could do about it.  他耸了耸肩，好像在说他对此无能为力。
figurative Thousands of people are starving to death while the world shrugs its shoulders (= shows no interest or care).  成千上万的人濒于饿死，世人却无动于衷。verb intransitive or transitive (-gg-)

The army must give power back to the legitimate government.  军队必须将权力交还给合法政府。
He claimed that the restaurant bill was a legitimate business expense.  他声称饭店帐单是一笔合理的业务开支。

Have a look at the cluster of galaxies in this photograph.  看看这张照片上的星系群。
There was a cluster of fans around him, asking for autographs.  一大群仰慕者围着他，找他签名。

Her paintings depict the lives of ordinary people in the last century.  她的油画反映了上个世纪普通人的生活。
In the book, he depicts his father as a tyrant.  在那本书里，他把自己的父亲描写成了一个暴君。

Thousands of buildings collapsed in the earthquake.  数以千计的建筑物在地震中倒塌了。
The chair collapsed under her weight.  椅子承受不了她的重量散架了。
figurative He thought his whole world had collapsed when his wife died.  妻子去世后他觉得自己的整个世界都坍塌了。

words.meaning: n.抵押贷款；抵押证书；v.用„作抵押
words.example:
They took out a £40 000 mortgage (= They borrowed £40 000) to buy the house.  他们借了四万英镑的按揭贷款来买房子。
The house was mortgaged up to the hilt (= The full value of the house had been borrowed).  那所房子被完全抵押出去了。

Many nations have imposed sanctions on the country because of its attacks on its own people.  由于该国发生了对本国人民施暴，许多国家都对它进行制裁。
Trade/economic sanctions will only be lifted (= stopped) when the aggressor nation withdraws its troops.  只有侵略国撤军，贸易／经济制裁才会解除。
Without realistic sanctions, some teachers have difficulty keeping order in the classroom.  没有切实可行的处罚措施，有些教师难以维持课堂秩序。noun
The bomb killed four soldiers and three civilians.  炸弹炸死四名士兵及三名平民。
With so many areas of woodland being cut down, a lot of wildlife is losing its natural habitat.  大片林地被砍伐，很多野生动物在失去它们的天然栖息地。

Grain (= the crop from food plants like grasses) is one of the main exports of the American Midwest.  谷物是美国中西部地区主要的出口商品。
There wasn't a grain of truth in anything she said.  她无论说甚么都没有半句实话在里面。
Anyone with a grain of common sense would have known what to do.  稍微有一点常识的人都会知道应该做甚么。noun

If you drive a car all your life, the odds are that you'll have an accident at some point.  如果你一辈子开车的话，你有可能在某一时刻发生车祸。
There are heavy odds against people succeeding in such a bad economic climate.  在如此恶劣的经济环境下人们成功的可能性很小。
What are the odds on him being (= Do you think he will be) re-elected?  他再次当选的几率有多大？

words.meaning: n.媒介；(细菌等的)生存环境
words.example:
Would you like your steak rare, medium, or well-done?  你的牛排要嫩的、半熟的还是熟透的？noun countable
They told the story through the medium of dance.  他们用舞蹈的形式来讲述这个故事。noun countable

There's a distinct smell of cigarettes in here.  这里确实有一股烟味儿。adjective
The two concepts are quite distinct (from each other).  这两个概念（之间）有显著的差别。
There are two distinct factions within the one political party.  在同一政党内有两个不同的派系。
a discourse on/upon the nature of life after death  关于来世之实质的文章

Yesterday in town I saw the ugliest baby I've ever seen in my life.  昨天在城里我看见了有生以来见过的最丑的婴儿。
He was a really unpleasant man and as ugly as sin (= very ugly).  他是一个非常讨厌的人，而且丑得要命。adjective
There were ugly scenes outside the stadium.  体育场外发生了暴力事件。

The painting portrays a beautiful young woman in a blue dress.  这幅画描绘的是一位身穿蓝色连衣裙的美丽少妇。
The writer portrays life in a small village at the turn of the century.  作家描写了世纪之交一个小村庄的生活。
The father in the film is portrayed as a fairly unpleasant character.  影片中的父亲被塑造成一个很不讨人喜欢的角色。

The book discusses his illness and subsequent resignation from the government.  书中讲述了他患病及随后辞去政府职务的事。
Those explosions must have been subsequent to our departure, because we didn't hear anything.  那些爆炸一定是在我们离开后发生的，因为我们甚么也没听到。

The most frequent cause of death is heart attack.  最常见的死因是心脏病发作。
The attacks were increasingly frequent and serious.  攻击变得越来越频繁，越来越猛烈。verb transitive UK US     formal

The film was banned (= the government prevented it from being shown) in several countries.  有几个国家都禁止播放这部电影。
There should be a ban on talking loudly in cinemas.  戏院里应该禁止大声交谈。
We stood for a few moments, admiring the view.  我们驻足了一会儿，欣赏美丽的景色。
You've performed a miracle on this kitchen - I've never seen it so clean!  你真是创造了奇迹——我从没见过这个厨房如此干净过！

The final cost should not exceed $5000.  最终的费用不应超出5000美元。
The success of our campaign has exceeded our wildest expectations.  我们发起的运动获得了意想不到的成功。
She was found guilty on three charges of exceeding the speed limit.  她被指控三次超速驾驶，并被判有罪。

She does a lot of work for charity.  她做了很多慈善工作。
People tend to give to (= give money to) charity at Christmas time.  人们往往在圣诞节向慈善组织捐钱。
Proceeds from the sale of these cards will go to (= be given to) local charities.  卖这些贺卡所得的收益将捐献给地方慈善组织。

Bruce Robinson wrote the script for 'The Killing Fields'.  布鲁斯‧罗宾逊为《战火屠城》写了剧本。
The invitation was written in beautiful italic script.  邀请函是用漂亮的斜体字写成的。noun
These bomb attacks represent a change of tactics by the terrorists.  这些炸弹袭击事件表明恐怖分子改变了策略。

Have we got adequate food for twenty guests?  我们的食物够招待20位客人吗？
It's not by any means a brilliant salary but it's adequate for our needs.  薪资一点也谈不上优厚，但足以满足我们的需要了。
The council's provision for the elderly is barely adequate (= is not enough).  地方议会给长者提供的保障不足。

We're buying a new piano.  我们准备买一架新钢琴。
mainly US or specialized She used to play piano in a jazz band.  她以前在一支爵士乐队演奏钢琴。
The music was written for piano.  这首乐曲是为钢琴谱写的。

words.meaning: n.页边空白，边缘；差额；余地；利润
words.example:
The Senate approved the use of military force by a margin of 52 votes to 47.  参议院以52票对47票通过了使用武力的提议。
The poll shows that the government is leading by the narrowest of margins.  民意调查显示，政府以极其微弱的优势领先。UK noun countable
If I have any comments to make, I'll write them in the margin.  如果我有评语，就会写在页边的空白处。

Why did you concrete over that nice garden?  你为甚么把那个漂亮的花园铺上混凝土？UK adjective
They think she killed her husband, but they've no concrete evidence.  他们认为她杀死了自己的丈夫，但是他们没有确凿的证据。
We've got a general idea of what we want, but nothing concrete at the moment.  我们对需要甚么有个大致的想法，可是具体的东西目前还没有想好。

These drugs are only available on prescription (= with a prescription from a doctor).  这些药只能凭处方购买。
Prescription charges (= the standard amount of money you pay for any medicine prescribed by a doctor) are rising in June.  六月份处方药费在上涨。noun
So what is his prescription for success?  那么他认为成功的诀窍是甚么？

The police car was going so fast, it must have been chasing someone.  警车开得这么快，一定是在追捕甚么人。
She was chasing (after) a man who had snatched her bag.  她在追赶一个抢走她的手提包的男子。
She couldn't study with the children chasing around the house.  孩子在房子里跑来跑去，她没法温习。verb

Charities such as Oxfam are always trying to recruit volunteers to help in their work.  诸如牛津饥荒救济委员会这样的慈善组织总是在尽力吸收志愿者来帮助他们工作。
Even young boys are now being recruited into the army.  就连很小的男孩子都被征召入伍了。
Raw recruits (= completely new soldiers) were trained for six months and then sent to the war front.  刚入伍的新兵接受了六个月的训练后就被送往战争前线。

Our dog has a black patch on his back.  我们的狗背上有块黑斑。
The hotel walls were covered in damp patches.  饭店的墙壁上满是湿渍。
There were lots of icy patches on the road this morning.  今天早上路上有多处地方结了冰。

The general consensus in the office is that he's useless at his job.  办公室成员一致认为他在工作中碌碌无为。
Could we reach a consensus on this matter? Let's take a vote.  我们能在这件事上达成共识吗？我们来表决吧。

Annette gazed admiringly at Warren as he spoke.  沃伦说话时，安妮特一脸崇拜地注视着他。
He spends hours gazing out of the window when he should be working.  他在本应工作的时候一连几个小时盯着窗外发呆。noun only singular
literary As I looked out, my gaze fell on a small child by the road.  我看看窗外，目光落到了路边一个小孩身上。

She had a good seat at the President's swearing-in ceremony.  她在总统宣誓就职仪式上占了个好座位。UK US  (swore, sworn)
After years of addiction, he swore off drugs completely.  上瘾几年后，他发誓彻底戒毒。

The pockets on my jeans are reinforced with double stitching.  我牛仔裤的裤兜缝了两道线，很结实。
The final technical report into the accident reinforces the findings of initial investigations.  对事故作出的最终的技术性报告进一步证实了最初的调查结果。
His behaviour merely reinforced my dislike of him.  他的行为只能使我更讨厌他。

Would you like another slice of ham/beef?  要不要再来一片火腿／牛肉?
We agreed before we did the deal that we'd both take an equal slice of the profit.  成交前，我们说定双方各拿利润的一半。
The film presents us with a fascinating slice of history.  这部电影向我们展示了一个非常有趣的历史片段。

In the space marked 'occupation' she wrote 'police officer'.  在“职业”一栏里她写了“员警”。UK noun
It seems to me his favourite occupation is eating.  在我看来，他最喜爱的消遣就是吃。UK noun

This area is sacred to the Apaches.  对阿帕契人而言，这一个地区是神圣的。
His daily routine is absolutely sacred to him.  对他而言，每天的日常安排绝对是不容改变的。
humorous The cricketers wore blue, not their usual white - is nothing sacred?  板球队员们身穿蓝色队服，不是他们常穿的白色——难道这也是可以改的吗？

words.meaning: n.分子式；公式；套语，惯用语
words.example:
We have changed the formula of the washing powder.  我们已经更换了洗衣粉的配方。
We had to learn chemical formulae at school, but I can only remember H 2 O for water.  我们上学时都得学习化学分子式，但是我现在只记得 H2O 是代表水。
There's no magic formula for success.  成功没有窍门。UK noun (plural formulas or formulae)

The exact distance is 1.838 metres.  精确距离是1.838公尺。
The exact time of the accident was 2.43 pm.  事件发生的正确时间是下午两点四十三分。
The exact location of the factory has yet to be decided.  这工厂的正确位置还未定案。

Organizational ability is an essential attribute for a good manager.  组织能力是一个出色经理必备的素质。verb[əˈtrɪb.jʊt/    /-juːt]
The doctors have attributed the cause of the illness to an unknown virus.  医生们认为这种疾病是由一种未知的病毒引起。
To what do you attribute this delay?  你认为造成这次延误的原因是甚么？

words.meaning: v.舔着喝水；(水)轻拍，发出轻拍声；(用磨具)抛光、磨光
words.example:
Come and sit on my lap and I'll read you a story.  过来坐在我的腿上，我念故事给你听。noun
He recorded the fastest lap in last weekend's Hungarian Grand Prix.  在上周的匈牙利大奖赛中他创造了最快单圈成绩纪录。
After a strong start, she was passed by several runners in/on the final/last lap and finished ninth.  她在起跑阶段很有优势，但在最后一圈时被几名选手超出，最终获得了第九名。

He visits his mother's grave every Sunday.  他每个星期天都去母亲墓前拜祭。noun countable
Do you think there's life beyond the grave?  你认为人死后有来生吗？noun countable
She'd turn in her grave if she knew what he was spending his inheritance on.  如果得知他是如何挥霍她留下的遗产的，她在九泉之下也不得安宁。adjective
Bevan was the architect of the British National Health Service.  比万是英国国民保健制度的创立者。

I've been making inquiries about/into the cost of a round-the-world ticket.  我一直在打听环游世界的票价。
formal Inquiry into the matter is pointless - no one will tell you anything.  打听这件事没有用——没有人会告诉你。(UK also enquiry) UK noun
Citizens have demanded a full inquiry into the government's handling of the epidemic.  公众要求全面调查政府对这场传染病的处理是否得当。

words.meaning: n.栏杆，护栏；铁轨；v.咒骂，猛烈指责
words.example:
Environmentalists argue that more goods should be transported by rail.  环保主义者们主张应该充分利用铁路来运输货物。
Will spectators please stay behind the rail?  观众们请站在栏杆后面好吗？
Hold onto the rail so that you don't fall.  抓牢扶手，这样就不会摔倒了。
Several hypotheses for global warming have been suggested.  已经提出好几种全球变暖的假设。

Prokofiev started composing at the age of five.  普罗高菲夫五岁就开始作曲了。
The music was specially composed for the film.  这音乐是专门为该电影创作的。
He composed this poem for his wife.  他为妻子写了这首诗。

words.meaning: n.地图里的说明文字或图例；传奇
words.example:
The dance was based on several Hindu legends.  这个舞蹈是根据几个印度传说创作的。
She is writing a thesis on Irish legend and mythology.  她正在写一篇关于爱尔兰民间故事和神话的论文。
Legend has it (= People say) that he always wore his boots in bed.  传说他总是穿着靴子上床。
You can regulate the temperature in the house by adjusting the thermostat.  你可以透过调节恒温器来控制室温。
an adolescent boy  青春期的男孩
One child per family is fast becoming the norm in some countries.  每个家庭一个孩子在部分国家正迅速普遍起来。

There's a reward for whoever finishes first.  无论谁先完成都会得到一份奖赏。
The rewards of motherhood outweigh the anguish.  做母亲得到的回报大于经受的痛苦。
The police offered a reward for any information about the robbery.  警方悬赏征求有关劫案的任何线索。UK verb transitive

He's very gentle with his kids.  他对孩子们很温和。
You can actually accomplish a lot more by gentle persuasion.  和声细语耐心说服实际上会收效更大。
The path has a gentle slope/gradient.  这条小路上有个平缓的斜坡／有点平缓的坡度。

Coffee and the newspaper are part of my morning ritual.  喝咖啡和读报纸是我早晨必做的事情之一。
The birds were performing a complex mating ritual.  这些鸟在进行程式复杂的交配。

She tried to explain what had happened but he kept interrupting her.  她试图解释所发生的事情，但他不停地打断她。
We had to interrupt our trip when we heard John's mother was ill.  听说约翰的母亲病了，我们不得不中止旅行。

words.meaning: n.大麻哈鱼；鲜肉色，橙红色
words.example: fresh/smoked/tinned salmon  鲜／熏／罐头鲑鱼

There was fierce combat between the two sides.  双方展开了激烈的战斗。
No one knew how many troops had died in combat.  没有人知道在战斗中死了多少士兵。
The soldiers were engaged in hand-to-hand combat.  士兵展开了肉搏战。

words.meaning: n.(植物的)茎，叶柄；v.阻止，遏制(水流等)
words.example:
Champagne glasses usually have long stems.  香槟酒杯通常有长长的杯脚。noun countable
From the stem 'sav-' you get 'saves', 'saved', 'saving' and 'saver'.  由词干 sav- 可以衍生出 saves，saved，saving 和 saver。noun countable
We overhauled the car from stem to stern.  我们把车从头到尾彻底检修了一遍。verb transitive (-mm-)

words.meaning: n.外科医师；军医，船上的医生
n./v.日志，记录；n.一段大木头；圆木
words.example:
The forest has been so heavily logged that it is in danger of disappearing.  这片森林被过度砍伐，面临消失的危险。UK verb (-gg-)
The Police Complaints Authority has logged more than 90 complaints.  员警渎职投诉局已经记录下了90多宗投诉。
Log on using your name and password.  用你的名字和密码登录。UK verb (-gg-)

Salt is a compound of sodium and chlorine.  盐是钠和氯的化合物。
Many fertilizers contain nitrogen compounds.  许多化学肥料都含有含氮化合物。
Then there was his manner, a curious compound of humour and severity.  还有他的态度，那是一种幽默与严厉的奇异混合。

He seems to find it difficult to integrate socially.  他似乎觉得很难与别人打成一片。
Children are often very good at integrating into a new culture.  孩子通常很善于融入新的文化。
The aim, said the minister, was to integrate Britain both politically and economically into the European Community.  大臣说，目标是使英国在政治和经济上都与欧共体融为一体。

Don't walk around outside in your bare feet.  别赤脚在外面到处走。
There's no carpet in the room, just bare floorboards.  房间里地板裸露，没有铺上地毯。
There isn't much time, so I'll just give you the bare facts/details.  时间不多了，我只能给你提供一些最基本的事实／细节。

Rents here are ridiculously high/low.  这里的房租高／低得出奇。
There was a large rent in his parachute.  他的降落伞上裂了个大口子。verb
My Dad has a cottage which he rents (out) to tourists.  我爸爸有一处乡间小屋，他把它出租给游客们。

The room was painted a subtle shade of pink.  房间被刷成了淡粉色。
The play's message is perhaps too subtle to be understood by young children.  这部戏的内涵过于隐晦，小孩子可能难以理解。
There is a subtle difference between these two plans.  两个计划之间有一点细微的差别。

He was awarded a medal for bravery.  他因表现英勇而获授勋章。
She won three Olympic gold medals.  她获得了三块奥运金牌。verb intransitive (-ll- or -l-)
She's medalled in both the heptathlon and the long jump.  她在七项全能和跳远两个项目中都获得了奖牌。

No one doubted that the president was a man of the highest integrity.  没有人怀疑会长是个光明磊落的人。
Keen to preserve his artistic integrity, he refused several lucrative Hollywood offers.  他十分重视保持自己的艺德，几次拒绝了好莱坞报酬丰厚的演出邀请。UK noun uncountable

Being unemployed entitles you to free medical treatment.  失业时，你有权享受免费医疗。
Her latest novel, entitled 'The Forgotten Sex', is out this week.  她名为《被遗忘的性别》的最新小说将于本周出版。

Women are still excluded from the club.  这间俱乐部仍然不让女性进入。
Microbes must, as far as possible, be excluded from the room during an operation.  在手术过程中，要尽可能防止细菌进入手术室。
Tom has been excluded from school (= he is not allowed to go to school) for bad behaviour.  汤姆因为行为不正被学校开除了。    Compare include

The children had had a harsh upbringing.  孩子们的家教很严。
We thought the punishment was rather harsh for such a minor offence.  我们认为对这样的小错，这种惩罚太严酷了。
"There is no alternative, " she said in a harsh voice.  “没有选择的余地。”她用生硬的口气说道。

The President is closeted with (= having a private meeting with) his advisers.  总统与他的顾问在密谈。UK adjective [before noun]
Dole portrayed the president in campaign speeches as a 'closet liberal'.  杜尔在竞选演讲中将总统描绘为“藏而不露的自由主义者”。

The job is open to applicants with over two years' experience in retail.  这份工作面向有两年以上零售经验的求职者。
The clothing company has six retail outlets (= shops) in south-eastern Australia.  这间服装公司在澳大利亚东南部地区开设了六家零售店。
The company makes and retails moderately priced sportswear.  这间公司生产和零售价格适中的运动服。
an earthenware pitcher  陶罐

He had a neatly folded handkerchief in his jacket pocket.  他的上衣口袋里有一方叠得整整齐齐的手帕。
Will you help me to fold (up)the sheets?  你能帮我把床单叠起来吗？
She folded her baby in a blanket.  她把婴儿裹在一块毯子里。

She reversed the car into the parking space.  她把车倒进停车位。
The new manager hoped to reverse the decline in the company's fortunes.  新经理希望能够扭转公司江河日下的状况。
Now that you have a job and I don't, our situations are reversed.  你找到了工作，我倒没有工作了，我们的情况正好相反。

Her arm was bandaged from the elbow to the fingers.  她的手臂从肘部一直到手指全部缠上了绷带。
The sleeve of his shirt was torn at the elbow.  他衬衫的肘部被撕了个洞。UK noun countable
During the visit, the interpreter was always at her elbow.  在她参观的过程中，翻译始终紧随其后。UK noun countable

The label says to take one dose three times a day.  标签上写着每次一剂，每日三次。
Twenty or thirty of these pills would be a lethal dose (= enough to kill you).  二三十粒这样的药丸就会达到致命剂量。
The government received a hefty dose of bad news this week.  本周政府得到了许多坏消息。

He was on his knees, pleading for mercy/forgiveness.  他跪在地上，乞求宽恕／原谅。
She appeared on television to plead with the kidnappers.  她出现在电视上，向绑架者求情。
legal The defendant pleaded not guilty/innocent to robbery with violence.  被告不承认暴力抢劫。

words.meaning: v.发起，创始；接纳或介绍某人加入某团体等
words.example:
Who initiated the violence?  谁先使用暴力的？verb transitive /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.eɪt/
At the age of eleven, Harry was initiated into the art of golf by his father.  哈里11岁时，他的父亲教他高尔夫球基本技巧。
Each culture had a special ritual to initiate boys into manhood.  每种文化都有特殊的男孩成人礼。noun countable /ɪˈnɪʃ.i.ət/    formal

He's got a thick trunk.  他的躯干很结实。noun
Her husband's dismembered body was later discovered in the trunk of her car.  她丈夫被肢解的尸体后来在她汽车的行李箱中找到了。

My throat is so sore that it really hurts when I swallow.  我的喉咙很痛，吞咽起来很难受。
He put a grape into his mouth and swallowed it whole.  他把一颗葡萄放进嘴里，整个吞了下去。
An increasing amount of the countryside is being swallowed (up) by the town.  越来越多的乡村被城镇吞并。

words.meaning: v.呈递，表现；提供„作为报偿或交换
words.example:
New technology has rendered my old computer obsolete.  新技术发展太快，我的旧电脑已经过时了。
She is rendering the book into English from French.  她正在把这本书从法语译成英语。UK verb transitive
The singers rendered the song with enthusiasm.  歌手们热情洋溢地演唱了这首歌。

She wore a plain black dress.  她穿着一件朴素的黑色连身裙。
We've chosen a plain carpet (= one without a pattern) and patterned curtains.  我们挑了一张没有图案的地毯和带图案的窗帘。
He prefers plain food - nothing too fancy.  他喜欢清淡简单的食物——不喜欢太花巧讲究的。

He is fighting extradition to Hong Kong to face trial on fraud charges.  他正在力争免于被引渡到香港就诈骗指控接受审判。UK noun
She was a psychic who was later revealed to be a fraud.  她是一个通灵巫师，后来被发现是个骗子。

words.meaning: n.同伴，同伙；受雇的陪伴人
words.example:
The dog has been her constant companion these past ten years.  在过去的这十年里，这只狗一直与她形影不离。
I've still got one of the candlesticks but I've lost its companion.  我还拥有一个烛台，却把另一个配对的弄丢了。noun countable

There are three world-class tennis players contending for this title.  有三位世界顶级网球选手争夺这项冠军。
He's contending against someone with twice his experience.  他在和经验比他丰富一倍的人竞争。verb
The lawyer contended (that) her client had never been near the scene of the crime.  该律师声称她的委托人从未走近过犯罪现场。verb

There was a splendid array of food on the table.  满桌子都是美味佳肴。
They sat before an array of microphones and cameras.  他们坐在那里，面对着无数的麦克风和摄影机镜头。verb transitive usually passive
Arrayed (= Standing in a group) before him were 40 schoolchildren in purple and green.  40名身穿紫绿两色校服的小学生列队站在他面前。

We assembled in the meeting room after lunch.  午饭后我们在会议室集合。
At the staff meeting, the manager told the assembled company (= everyone there) that no one would lose their job.  在全体员工大会上，经理对所有与会者说他们谁也不会失业。verb

The biggest obstacle in our way was a tree trunk in the road.  我们路上最大的障碍是横在路上的一棵树。
This decision has removed the last obstacle to the hostages' release.  这个决定清除了释放人质的最后障碍。

The new ramp will facilitate the entry of wheelchairs.  新的坡道将可方便轮椅进入。
The current structure does not facilitate efficient work flow.  当前的体系不利于实施高效的工作流程。

His new trousers ripped when he bent down.  他弯腰时把新裤子撑开了线。
The wind ripped the flag to/into shreds (= into little pieces).  风把旗子刮成了一缕缕的破布条。
We ripped up the carpets and laid a new wooden floor.  我们拖走了地毯，铺了新木地板。 (-pp-)

words.meaning: n.经济萧条时期；撤回，退回
words.example: The country is sliding into the depths of (a) recession.  这个国家一步步滑入经济衰退的谷底。

words.meaning: n.关动物的围栏；监禁；母天鹅
words.example:
Don't write in (= using a) pen, or you won't be able to rub out any mistakes you make.  不要用钢笔写，否则写错就擦不掉了。noun countable
He served nine years in the state pen.  他在州立监狱服刑九年。noun countable
It's time you put pen to paper and replied to that letter from your mother.  该动笔给你妈妈回信了。verb transitive (-nn-)    formal

Being trapped underwater is my worst nightmare.  被困水下是我最害怕的事情。
The whole journey was a nightmare - we lost our luggage and we arrived two days late.  整个旅程就像一场噩梦——我们遗失了行李，而且迟了两天到达。

Her passport seemed legitimate, but on closer inspection, it was found to have been altered.  她的护照看似合法，但仔细检查，发现做过手脚。
She arrived to carry out/make a health and safety inspection of the building.  她来对大楼进行安全卫生检查。
After 30 years in the political arena, our local member of parliament is retiring next year.  我们当地选出的这位下议院议员已经在政治舞台上活跃了30年，明年他就要退休了。

Drain the pasta thoroughly.  把义大利面中的水完全沥干。
We drained the pond and filled it with fresh water.  我们把池塘中的水放干后重新注入清水。
Drain (off) any liquid that is left in the rice.  把大米彻底沥干。

Doctors guilty of neglect are liable to prosecution.  怠忽职守的医生很可能会被起诉。
His plea of guilty to manslaughter was not accepted by the prosecution.  他关于过失杀人罪的抗辩没有被原告律师接受。
The prosecution alleged that he lured the officer to his death by making an emergency call.  原告律师宣称他拨打报警电话，将那个警官诱入死地。UK noun

Healthcare should be a right, not a privilege.  医疗保健应该是权利，而非特权。
Senior management enjoy certain privileges, such as company cars and private healthcare.  高级管理阶层享受公司配车和私人医疗保健等特权。
It was a real privilege to meet her.  见到她真是莫大的荣幸。

words.meaning: a.没有明确目的、计划或者目标的；随机的
words.example:
We asked a random sample/selection of people what they thought.  我们随机挑选一些人，问了他们的想法。
The winning entry will be the first correct answer drawn at random.  从所有给出正确答案的参赛者中，随意抽出的第一个将获得大奖。

She treated the business as her private domain.  她把公司看作是自己的私人势力范围。
These documents are in the public domain (= available to everybody).  这些文件已向公众开放。UK noun countable

He suffered such feelings of guilt over leaving his children.  他因为抛弃了自己的孩子而备感愧疚。
She remembered with a pang of guilt that she hadn't called her mother.  她想起没有给妈妈打电话，感到一阵强烈的内疚。noun uncountable
Both suspects admitted their guilt to the police.  两名嫌疑人都向警方认了罪。
fiscal policy  财政政策

Take the road which skirts (round) the village, not the one which goes through it.  沿村边的那条路走，不要走穿过村庄的那条路。
Though the government has promised to deal with drug abuse, it has been accused of skirting round the issue.  虽然政府承诺要解决毒品滥用问题，但还是被指责在闪躲回避。

He was executed for murder.  他因犯谋杀罪被处死。verb transitive
The whole play was executed with great precision.  这出戏由头到尾都表演得丝丝入扣，有板有眼。

The accident victims mostly had injuries to their lower limbs (= legs).  事故受害者大多腿上都有伤。
She's going out on a limb in criticizing her own party leadership.  她对自己所在党的领导提出的批评并没有得到大多数人的赞同。

words.meaning: n.思想体系，思想意识，意识形态
words.example: The people are caught between two opposing ideologies.  民众被夹在两种对立的意识形态之间。

We had to endure a nine-hour delay at the airport.  航班延误，我们不得不在机场苦等了九个小时。
She's already had to endure three painful operations on her leg.  她已经承受了三次腿部手术的巨大痛苦。UK verb
The political system established in 1400 endured until about 1650.  建立于1400年的政治体系一直沿用到1650年前后。

The driver blew/sounded / informalhonked her horn.  那位司机按了喇叭。
He'll have to draw in his horns now he's lost his job.  由于失业，他将不得不减少开支。UK verb
She's always horning in on our conversations.  她总是在我们说话的时候插嘴。

There is a chronic shortage of teachers.  教师长期短缺。UK adjective
The acting was chronic.  表演很糟糕。
the latest innovations in computer technology  电脑科技最新的发展

He insisted that the book did not need amendment.  他坚持认为这本书无需修改。
I've made a few last-minute amendments to the article.  我对文章做了一些最后的修改。
Presidential power was reduced by a constitutional amendment in 1991.  1991年的宪法修正案削弱了总统的权力。

It's not clear who actually pulled the trigger.  不清楚究竟是谁扣动的扳机。UK noun
There are fears that the incident may be a trigger for further violence in the capital.  有人担心，这次事件可能在首都引发进一步的暴力活动。UK verb transitive
Some people find that certain foods trigger their headaches.  有些人发现某些食物导致他们头痛。

I'm so grateful (to you) for all that you've done.  你为我做了这一切，我（对你）真是感激不尽。
If you could get that report finished by Thursday I'd be very grateful.  如果你能在星期四之前完成那份报告，我将感激不尽。
After the earthquake we felt grateful to be alive.  地震后，我们大难不死，真是应该感谢上苍。

words.meaning: n.优美(尤指动作顺畅协调)
words.example:
Joanna has natural grace and elegance.  祖安娜举止自然优雅。noun
They accepted their defeat with good grace.  他们很有风度地认输了。
Ken is sadly lacking in social graces.  糟糕的是，肯在社交场合很没有风度。noun

words.meaning: a.实质上的，实际上的(但未获名义上或正式的承认)
words.example: Ten years of incompetent government had brought about the virtual collapse of the country's economy.  无能政府十年的执政已经把这个国家带到了崩溃的边缘。UK adjective
Australia and New Zealand are former British colonies.  澳大利亚和纽西兰从前是英国的殖民地。

Are there any species of frog indigenous to the area?  这个地区是否有本地品种的青蛙？
So who are the indigenous people of this land?  那么谁是这块土地的原住民？
He has twice been convicted of robbery/arson.  他两次被判犯有抢劫罪／纵火罪。    Compare acquitnoun countable UK US [ˈkɑːn-/

Instead of simply punishing them, the system encourages offenders to modify their behaviour.  这个制度并不是单单惩罚犯罪者，而是鼓励他们改正自己的行为。
The proposals were unpopular and were only accepted in a modified form.  这些建议不受欢迎，修改之后才得以接受。UK verb transitive
In the sentence 'She ran quickly', the adverb 'quickly' modifies the verb 'ran'.  在句子 She ran quickly 中，副词 quickly 修饰动词ran。

The theatre managed to boost its audiences by cutting ticket prices.  剧院设法透过降低票价来增加观众数量。
Share prices were boosted by reports of the President's recovery.  总统康复的报导导致股票价格上扬。
The lowering of interest rates will give a much-needed boost to the economy.  利率的下调将会给经济注入急需的推动力。

He was sitting alone by a window with a weird contraption on the bench in front of him.  他独自坐在窗边，面前的长椅上摆着个奇怪的装置。
Her boyfriend's a bit weird but she's all right.  她的男朋友有点怪，不过她倒很正常。
That's weird - I thought I'd left my keys on the table but they're not there.  真奇怪——我记得把锁匙放在桌子上，但现在却不见了。

The President has accused two cabinet ministers of working secretly to undermine his position/him.  总统指责有两位内阁部长在暗中算计他。
Criticism just undermines their confidence.  批评只是削弱了他们的信心。

Representatives were elected by ballot.  代表们是透过不记名投票选举出来的。
They decided to hold a ballot.  他们决定组织一次不记名投票。
The union decided to ballot its members on the issue.  工会决定让会员就这件事进行不记名投票。

How far the president will be able to translate his campaign rhetoric into action remains to be seen.  总统在大选中作出的冠冕堂皇的承诺能够兑现多少尚待观察。
In reply to the question, he just produced a lot of empty (= meaningless) rhetoric.  他对这个问题的回答只是一大堆空洞的浮夸之词。

New students may be accommodated in halls of residence.  新生可以住在学校宿舍里。
formal There wasn't enough space to accommodate the files.  没有足够的空间存放这些档案。UK verb transitive
The new policies fail to accommodate the disabled.  新政策没有照顾到残疾人士的利益。

At the forthcoming elections, the government will be seeking a fresh mandate from the people.  在即将举行的选举中，政府将向人民寻求新的支持。
The UN rush to mandate war totally ruled out any alternatives.  联合国匆匆授权开战，完全排除了其他选择。verb transitive

Snow and ice have caused chaos on the roads.  冰雪造成道路交通秩序混乱。
Ever since our secretary walked out, the office has been in a state of total/utter chaos.  自从我们的秘书离开后，办公室就陷入了极度混乱中。
We muddled up the name labels and chaos ensued (= resulted).  我们弄乱了姓名标签，结果一片混乱。

words.meaning: a.机械的，机械制造的；(人)机械似的，呆板的
words.example:
The company produces mechanical parts for airplane engines.  这家公司生产飞机引擎的机械零件。
The plane appeared to have crashed because of a mechanical problem.  这架飞机看来是因机械故障而坠毁的。adjective
These two canvases by Hockney would sell for £500 000.  这两幅霍克尼的油画能卖到50万英镑。
Small businesses have lobbied hard for/against changes in the tax laws.  小公司极力游说支援／反对修改税法。

words.meaning: a.深的，深刻的；渊博的，深奥的
words.example:
His mother's death when he was aged six had a very profound effect on him.  他六岁时母亲的过世对他的影响很大。
The invention of the contraceptive pill brought about profound changes in the lives of women.  避孕药的发明为女性的生活带来了重大变化。
Those two lines of poetry express perfectly the profound sadness of loss.  那两行诗贴切表达了失去亲人的深切悲痛。

His sense of humour is one of his better traits.  具有幽默感是他更讨人喜欢的特点之一。
Arrogance is a very unattractive personality/character trait.  傲慢是一种非常令人讨厌的性格特点。

words.meaning: n.储备(物)，储藏量；寡言，谨慎；v.保留，储备，预订(座位，住处)
words.example:
These seats are reserved for the elderly and women with babies.  这些座位是专留给老人和抱小孩的妇女的。
She keeps a little money in reserve (= for use if and when needed).  她留下了一些钱以备不时之需。
The librarian has put the book on reserve for me (= will keep it for me when it becomes available).  图书管理员已经替我预约了这本书。

We could just pick out the path in the weak beam of the UK usuallytorch/ USflashlight.  我们借着手电筒微弱的光线，仅能勉强认清路。
The rabbit stopped, mesmerized by the beam of the car's headlights.  兔子被汽车车前大灯射出的光束迷住了眼，停了下来。
The sitting room had exposed wooden beams.  客厅顶上的木梁露出来了。

Trains may be subject to delay on the northern line - we apologize for any inconvenience caused.  北线列车可能会延误，如果给您造成任何不便，我们在此谨致歉意。
She apologized profusely for having to leave at 3.30 p.m.  她必须在下午三点半离开，对此她再三表示歉意。
The president said he would not go against sound military doctrine.  总统说他不会反对行之有效的军事学说。

If it is a genuine Michelangelo drawing, it will sell for millions.  如果这幅画是米高安哲罗（米开朗基罗）的真迹，它的售价将会达数百万。
He's a very genuine person.  他为人很真诚。
Machiko looked at me in genuine surprise - "Are you really going?" she said.  町子真的很惊讶，她看着我问道：“你果真要走吗？”adjective

It is hoped that a compromise will be reached in today's talks.  希望今天的会谈能达成妥协。
In a compromise between management and unions, a 4% pay rise was agreed in return for an increase in productivity.  资方与工会达成和解，同意以加薪4%来作为提高生产力的回报。
The government has said that there will be no compromise with terrorists.  政府声称不会对恐怖分子让步。UK verb

This room is for the exclusive use of guests.  这间房是专供客人使用的。
Is the total exclusive of service charges?  总金额是不是不包括服务费？
Some people think that uncontrolled economic growth and environmental stability are mutually exclusive.  有些人认为，无节制的经济发展和生态环境的平衡稳定是互不相容的。noun countable

The protesters scattered at the sound of gunshots.  听到枪声后抗议者就鸟兽散了。
The soldiers came in and scattered the crowd.  士兵进来把人群驱散了。UK verb
Scatter the powder around the plants.  把这种药粉撒在植物周围。

His poetry conveys a great sense of religious devotion.  他的诗歌表达了献身宗教的强烈感情。
If you see James, do convey my apologies (to him).  要是你见到詹姆斯，一定要转达我（对他）的歉意。
You don't want to convey the impression that we're not interested.  你不想给人留下我们不感兴趣的印象吧。verb transitive

She had a nagging/sneaking suspicion that she might have sent the letter to the wrong address.  她心烦意乱地猜想／心里暗想自己可能把信寄错了地址。noun
He gave just a suspicion of a smile.  他只是微微一笑。
"I'm arresting you on suspicion of illegally possessing drugs," said the police officer.  警官说：“你涉嫌非法持有毒品，我将拘捕你。”

The ferry service has been suspended for the day because of bad weather.  因为天气恶劣，渡船已经停开。
The President has suspended the constitution and assumed total power.  总统废除宪法，独揽大权。
When you go to the theatre, you have to be willing to suspend disbelief (= to act as if you believe that what you are seeing is real or true, although you know that it is not).  去戏院看戏时，你得对剧情深信不疑。

They find it hard to live on their state pension.  他们觉得靠政府的养老金很难生活下去。
He won't be able to draw (= receive) his pension until he's 65.  他要等到65岁以后才能领取养老金。verb
Workers in the company are being pensioned off at 50.  该公司的工人到50岁时就要领养老金退休。verb

words.meaning: v.重新开始，(停顿后)继续进行
words.example:
Normal services will be resumed in the spring.  春天将恢复正常服务。
The talks are due to resume today.  会谈预定今天继续进行。
Please resume your seats, as the performance will continue in two minutes.  请大家回到自己的座位上去，两分钟后演出继续。
theoretical physics  理论物理

Peaches have delicate skins which are easily bruised.  桃子的表皮很娇嫩，容易碰伤。
Delicate plants need to be kept in a greenhouse during the winter.  娇贵的植物需要在温室里过冬。
Molly's health has always been delicate (= She becomes ill easily).  莫莉的身体一直都很娇弱。

This totem pole is carved from/out of a single tree trunk.  这根图腾柱是由一整根树干雕刻而成的。
He carved her name on a tree.  他将她的名字刻在树上。
Some of the tunnels in the cliff are natural, some were carved out (= cut into the rock) by soldiers for defensive purposes.  峭壁中的一些隧道是天然形成的，一些是士兵在石头上开凿出来用于防御的。

Here, your eyes are better than mine - could you thread (= put thread through) this needle for me?  来，你的眼睛比我好——帮我把线穿进这根针，好吗？
The needle on a compass always points to magnetic north.  指南针的指针总是指向磁北极。noun countable
It sounds like the needle on your record player needs to be replaced.  听上去像是唱机的唱针该换了。noun countable

Sudden noises scare her.  突然的响声把她吓了一跳。
She's very brave - she doesn't scare easily.  她很勇敢——她不会那么容易害怕的。
He scared me out of my wits (= made me extremely frightened) when he was driving so fast.  他开得那么快，把我吓得半死。

words.meaning: n.(皮制)文件夹，公事包；股份单
words.example: The Prime Minister offered her the foreign affairs portfolio.  总理邀请她出任外交部长。

To get across town, you can take the shuttle from Times Square to Grand Central.  要穿越市区，你可以乘坐从时代广场穿梭到中央车站的公车。
The American (space) shuttle can be used many times to put payloads in space.  美国的太空梭可以多次使用，向太空运送物品。UK noun countable

Each transaction at the foreign exchange counter seems to take forever.  外币兑换柜枱的每笔交易似乎都要花很长时间。
We need to monitor the transaction of smaller deals.  我们需要监控规模较小的交易。

words.meaning: n./v.解救；把„从法律监管下强行夺回，非法劫回
words.example:
The lifeboat rescued the sailors from the sinking boat.  救生艇将水手们从正在下沉的船上救起。
The government has refused to rescue the company from bankruptcy.  政府已经拒绝援助这间濒于破产的公司。noun countable or uncountable
Lifeboats carry out many rescues every month.  救生艇每月都会执行很多救援任务。

words.meaning: n.相对应或具有相同功能的人或物
words.example: The Prime Minister is to meet his European counterparts to discuss the war against drugs.  首相将会见欧洲各国首脑就打击毒品犯罪进行商讨。
One of the riders was thrown off his horse.  其中一位骑师被甩下马背。UK noun countable

The bunker's precise location is a closely guarded secret.  掩体的确切位置严格保密。
He caught me at the precise moment that I fainted.  他正好在我晕倒的那一刻抓住了我。
There was a good turnout for the meeting - twelve of us to be precise.  出席会议的人不少——确切地说有我们12个人。UK adjective

The specialist diagnosed cancer.  那位专家作出的诊断是癌症。
His condition was diagnosed as some sort of blood disorder.  他的病被诊断为某种血液病。
She was diagnosed with/as having diabetes.  她被查出患有糖尿病。

words.meaning: n.（言行上）过度随意，冒失；自主，自由
words.example:
For most citizens, liberty means the freedom to practise their religious or political beliefs.  对大多数公民而言，自由意味着可以不受限制地信奉自己的宗教或政治信仰。
Hundreds of political prisoners are to be given their liberty (= released from prison).  数百名政治犯将获得自由。
Of the ten men who escaped this morning from Dartmoor Prison, only two are still at liberty (= free or not yet caught).  今晨从达特摩尔监狱逃跑的十人当中，目前只有两人依然在逃。

The children put up posters on the classroom walls.  孩子们在教室的墙上张贴了海报。
We noticed a poster advertising a circus.  我们看到一张马戏演出的海报。
The determination of policy is not your business - your job is to implement it.  政策的决定与你无关——你的工作就是执行。UK noun
Thanks to a large gift from an anonymous donor, the charity was able to continue its work.  多亏得到了一位匿名人士的大笔捐助，该慈善机构才得以继续运转。

They sell televisions and radios and all that jazz.  他们经销电视、收音机之类的商品。verb
Jazz the dress up with some bright accessories.  用些鲜艳的饰物为连身裙增色。
He jazzed up the food with a spicy sauce.  他用辣酱使食物更美味。

He sold his equity in the company last year.  他去年卖掉了这家公司的股票。
The rights give holders the opportunity to purchase additional equity interests in the company at a big discount.  这些权利使得股票持有者有机会以很优惠的折扣价额外购买该公司股份。

words.meaning: a.适当的，可接受的；得体的
words.example:
Everyone should be entitled to a decent wage/standard of living.  人人都应该有权获得像样的工资／过着体面的生活。
It was very decent (= kind) of you to help.  你能帮忙，真是个大好人啊。
It made quite a decent-sized (= large) hole.  它弄出了一个很大的洞。

words.meaning: v.(支票)背面签字；公开赞同
words.example:
The National Executive is expected to endorse these recommendations.  预计全国执委会将赞同这些提议。
formal I fully endorse (= agree with) everything the Chairperson has said.  我完全赞同主席所说的一切。
They paid $2 million to the world champion to endorse their new aftershave.  他们付给这位世界冠军200万美元，请他为他们新生产的须后水做广告。UK verb transitive

Have you had any feedback from customers about the new soap?  有关新款肥皂你有没有收到顾客的回馈意见？
Jimi Hendrix loved to fling his guitar around to get weird and wonderful sounds from the feedback.  吉米‧罕醉克斯喜欢用力弹拨他的吉他，这样扬声器的啸声中就会传出一种怪诞奇妙的声音。
Feedback from the sensors ensures that the car engine runs smoothly.  侦测器的回馈能确保汽车引擎平稳运转。

The colours of the spectrum - red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet - can be seen in a rainbow.  光谱中的红、橙、黄、绿、蓝、靛、紫诸色可以在彩虹中见到。 (plural spectra or spectrums)
He has support from across the whole political spectrum.  他得到了所有政治派别的支援。
The group includes students from both ends of the social spectrum (= range of social classes).  这个团体包括了来自社会上、下两个阶层的学生。

We admired the expertise with which he prepared the meal.  我们很羡慕他那一手烹调绝技。
She has considerable expertise in French history.  她研究法国历史有很深的造诣。

Her interests are in the realm of practical politics.  她的兴趣在于那些需要采取具体行动去做的事情。noun countable
The matter was hotly debated in all the towns of the realm.  此事在该王国内的各个城镇都进行了激烈的讨论。noun countable

Peel, core and chop the apples.  把苹果去皮、去核并剁碎。verb
We peeled the wallpaper off the walls.  我们把壁纸从墙上撕了下来。
Peel off the backing strip and press the label down firmly.  撕下背垫条，将标签用力下压。

This latest cut in government spending will affect income support recipients and their families.  最近这次政府削减开支会影响到拿政府补助金的人及其家庭。
He was a recipient of the Civilian Service Award.  他被授予平民服务奖章。

When one side is done, flip the pancake (over) to cook the other side.  一面烤熟后，把烤饼迅速翻过来烤另一面。
You turn the television on by flipping (= operating) the switch at the side.  把边上的开关按一下，电视就打开了。
The captains flipped a coin into the air (= made it turn over in the air to see which side it landed on) to decide which side would bat first.  两队队长向空中抛出一枚硬币，决定哪一方先击球。verb intransitive or transitive [usually + adv/prep] (-pp-)

'The mind is an ocean' and 'the city is a jungle' are both metaphors.  “思维是海洋”和“城市是丛林”都是隐喻。
Metaphor and simile are the most commonly used figures of speech in everyday language.  隐喻和明喻是日常语言中最常用的修辞手法。UK noun countable or uncountable
The author uses disease as a metaphor for the corruption in society.  这位作家用疾病来比喻社会中的腐败。
the judicial system  司法制度

The museums work closely together, but are separate legal entities.  这些博物馆密切合作，但它们都是独立的法人实体。
He regarded the north of the country as a separate cultural entity.  他把这个国家的北部地区视为一个独立的文化实体。
Ask him nicely - be diplomatic.  好好向他提出请求——要委婉一些。

He confessed to sleeping /having slept through most of the film.  他承认看这出电影时，大部分时间都在睡觉。
He has confessed to the murder.  他供认了谋杀罪行。

The psychologist's attitude seemed far too casual, even brutal.  那个心理学家的态度似乎太过冷淡了，甚至有些冷酷。
Security around the conference hotel seemed almost casual.  举行会议的饭店周围的安全措施似乎不太严格。
Although close to tears, she tried to make her voice sound casual.  尽管都快掉眼泪了，可她还是尽力使自己的声音听起来满不在乎。adjective

words.meaning: n.严肃性，重要性，正经；引力，重力
words.example: the laws of gravity  万有引力定律UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.把„减至最低数量或程度
words.example:
We must minimize the risk of infection.  我们必须将感染的风险降到最低。
Environmentalists are doing everything within their power to minimize the impact of the oil spill.  环保人士正竭尽全力把石油外溢造成的影响减到最少。    Opposite maximize
She accused the government of minimizing the suffering of thousands of people.  她指责政府对成千上万的人所受的疾苦轻描淡写。

words.meaning: a.专心的，渴望的；n.目的，意向
words.example:
She had an intent look on her face.  她的面部表情非常专注。adjective
I've tried persuading her not to go but she's intent on it.  我试图劝她不要去，但她坚决要去。
He seems intent on upsetting everyone in the room!  他看来存心要惹恼屋子里的每个人！noun uncountable formal

words.meaning: v.孤立；将„从其种群中隔离
words.example:
He was isolated from all the other prisoners.  他被人从其他所有囚犯隔离开来。
They tried to isolate (= find) the cause of the problem.  他们试图找出问题的原因。
specialized Virus particles were eventually isolated from the tissue.  终于将病毒粒子与组织分离开了。
Our inventory of used cars is the best in town.  我们卖的二手车是城里最好的。
They don't seem to grasp the magnitude of the problem.  他们似乎没有领会到问题的重要性。

It's a steep climb to the top of the mountain, but the view is worth it.  爬上山顶的路非常陡，不过风景非常好，值得一爬。
The castle is set on a steep hill/hillside.  城堡坐落在陡峭的山／山坡上。
There has been a steep increase/rise in prices.  物价飞涨。adjective

She's young and dynamic and will be a great addition to the team.  她年轻活泼，会给团队增添不少活力。
We need a dynamic expansion of trade with other countries.  我们需要大力发展与其他国家的贸易。adjective

In the equation 3x - 3 = 15, x = 6.  在方程式 3x-3 = 15中，x = 6。
Managing the economy is a complex equation of controlling inflation and reducing unemployment.  经济管理包括控制通货膨胀、降低失业率等复杂的因素。noun
There is a tendency in films to make the equation between violence and excitement.  电影倾向把暴力和刺激画上等号。

Her sudden towering rages were terrifying.  她突然暴跳如雷，很吓人。
He flew into a fit of rage over the smallest mistake.  微不足道的小错误就会使他大发雷霆。noun
The party was a rage.  派对办得热闹极了。noun

words.meaning: v.提出(希望对方接受的意见等)；a.温柔的
words.example:
What you need is some tender loving care.  你需要的是体贴入微的关怀。UK adjective
My arm was very tender after the injection.  打针后，我的胳膊一碰就痛。UK adjective
My steak was beautifully tender.  我的牛排做得很嫩，好极了。
Their cheerfulness seemed rather strained and artificial.  他们的高兴表情看上去非常造作虚伪。

Truth and beauty are abstract concepts.  真和美都是抽象的概念。
This debate is becoming too abstract - let's have some hard facts!  这场辩论变得太空洞了——拿出一些具体的事实根据来吧！
So far we've only discussed the question in the abstract (= without referring to any real examples).  目前我们只是笼统地讨论过这个问题。adjective

The path descended steeply into the valley.  这条路很陡，一直通到山谷。
Jane descended the stairs.  简走下了楼梯。
Silence descended on the room/ over the countryside.  寂静笼罩着房间／田野。verb

words.meaning: adv.不迟疑地；迅速地，轻易地
words.example:
He readily agreed to help.  他乐意帮忙。
Larger sizes are readily available.  较大号随时都有货。

The two companies have cooperated in joint ventures for the past several years.  两家公司在过去几年中合作经营合资企业。
The Spanish authorities cooperated with the British police in finding the terrorists.  西班牙当局与英国警方相互配合搜捕恐怖分子。
the North American continent  北美大陆

They first met each other on the tennis circuit (= while at different tennis competitions).  他们在网球巡回赛上首次交锋。
He was a familiar figure on the lecture circuit.  他是巡回讲学中的座上常客。
The judge had served for many years on the Northeast Circuit.  这位法官多年来效力于东北部巡回法庭。

words.meaning: v. 细查，细看；浏览，扫描；分析韵律
words.example:
She anxiously scanned the faces of the men leaving the train.  她急切地盯着一张张走下火车的人的脸。
Doug scanned the horizon for any sign of the boat.  道格注视着海平面，搜寻着那只船。
Scan the newspaper article quickly and make a note of the main points.  把报上的那篇文章快速浏览一遍，记下要点。

Airport officials received a stream of verbal abuse from angry passengers whose flights had been delayed.  航班被延误，机场的官员们遭到了愤怒的乘客们的一顿臭骂。UK adjective
It can sometimes be difficult to give a verbal description of things like colours and sounds.  有时候可能很难用语言来描述颜色、声音之类的东西。

We import a large number of cars from Japan.  我们从日本进口大量的汽车。    Compare export
The fashion for wearing baseball hats was imported directly from the States.  戴棒球帽的潮流是直接从美国传进来的。
Whether it is to be a 'working' visit or an 'official' visit is of little/no import.  是“工作访问”还是“正式访问”，这并不重要。

The Ayatollah described the earthquake in Iran as a divine test.  那位阿亚图拉把伊朗发生的地震说成是神的一次考验。
Some fans seem to regard footballers as divine beings.  有些球迷似乎把球员神化了。
England have fallen so far behind in the championship that their only hope of victory is divine intervention (= help from God).  英格兰队在此次锦标赛中的名次已经远远落后了，他们获胜的唯一希望就是要靠神来帮忙了。

words.meaning: n.(对怜悯、怀旧等的)柔懦情感(尤与理智相对)
words.example:
Nationalist sentiment has increased in the area since the bombing.  爆炸案发生以来，该地区的民族主义情绪开始高涨。
His son was overwhelmed by the sentiments of love and support in the cards and letters he received.  他儿子陶醉在自己所收到卡片和信件所表达的爱意和支持之中。
The film is flawed by slightly treacly sentiment.  这部电影的缺点在于其有点过于伤感滥情。
As marketing manager, her job is to oversee all the company's advertising.  作为行销经理，她的工作是负责公司所有的广告业务。

The golden autumn light provided the inspiration for the painting.  秋天金色的阳光给这幅画的创作带来了灵感。
He went to church, perhaps seeking divine inspiration.  他去做礼拜，也许为的是寻找神的启示。
He had an inspiration - why not apply for some government money?  他突然想到一个好主意——为甚么不去申请一些政府资金呢？

We've been mates since our school days.  我们从学生时代起就是朋友。
She's my best mate.  她是我最好的朋友。
Have you got a light, mate?  有火吗，老兄？noun countable

She knew she couldn't afford it, so she didn't bid.  她知道买不起，所以没有出价。
The communications group has shown an interest in bidding for the company.  该通讯集团有意出价竞买这间公司。
The department is trying to ensure fairer competition among firms bidding for government contracts.  该部门正努力确保竞标政府合约的公司之间能更公平地竞争。

Nothing will stop them in their quest for truth.  没有甚么可以阻止他们对真理的追求。
She went to India on a spiritual quest.  她为了追求宗教而去印度。

Many women sacrifice interesting careers for their family.  许多女性为了家庭牺牲了自己感兴趣的工作。verb
Service and quality have been sacrificed on the altar of profit.  为了利润牺牲了服务和品质。noun countable or uncountable
We had to make sacrifices in order to pay for our children's education.  为了支付孩子们的教育费用，我们不得不作出牺牲。
We can predict changes with a surprising degree of accuracy.  我们可以出奇准确地预测变化。

During the war Wallas became a power broker in governmental circles.  战争期间华莱士成了政界的权力经纪人。UK verb transitive
The foreign ministers have failed in their attempts to broker a ceasefire.  外交部长们促成停火的尝试已告失败。

words.meaning: a.僵直的，不易变动的；严厉的
words.example:
His clothes were stiff with dried mud.  他衣服上的泥巴干了，硬邦邦的。
This hair spray has made my hair stiff.  这种发胶使我的头发变硬。
Mix the powder and water into a stiff paste.  把粉末和水混合成稠糊。
toxic waste/chemicals/effluent  有毒的废料／化学品／废水UK adjective

Her grief at her son's death was terrible.  丧子之痛使她肝肠寸断。
Newspapers should not intrude on people's private grief.  报纸不应再去侵扰那些正承受丧亲之痛的人们。
The Italian champion was in second position when he came to grief on the third lap.  跑到第三圈时，处在第二位置上的义大利卫冕冠军突然马失前蹄。

An anonymous businesswoman donated one million dollars to the charity.  一位女商人匿名向该慈善机构捐赠了100万美元。
Please donate generously.  请您慷慨解囊。
The appeal for people to donate blood was very successful.  这个献血号召非常有效。

words.meaning: v.处理；n.(吊重物用的)滑车，滑轮
words.example: There are many ways of tackling this problem.  处理这个问题有许多办法。

He is a man of dignity and calm determination.  他是个沉稳、冷静而果断的人。
She has a quiet dignity about her.  她身上有一种恬静端庄的气质。
He longs for a society in which the dignity of all people is recognized.  他渴望看到一个人人都有尊严的社会。

words.meaning: v. 起泡；n. 气泡，水泡
words.example:
As water begins to boil, bubbles rise ever faster to the surface.  水开了，气泡更快地升向水面。
He made millions before the dot.com bubble burst.  在纲际网路泡沫爆破之前他赚了几百万。verb intransitive
We could hear the porridge bubbling away (= bubbling strongly) in the pot.  我们能听见锅子里的粥咕嘟咕嘟的冒泡声。verb intransitive

The President is clearly in a dilemma about/over how to tackle the crisis.  对于如何化解危机总统明显处于两难境地。
She faces the dilemma of disobeying her father or losing the man she loves.  她面临着要么违抗父亲要么失去心上人的两难境地。
She's hired a lawyer who specializes in divorce cases.  她请了个专打离婚官司的律师。

He denies any liability for the damage caused.  他对造成的损失拒绝承担任何责任。
The business has liabilities of £2 million.  该公司负债达200万英镑。    Compare assetUK noun
After a certain age, a car's just a liability.  汽车在使用了一定年限后就会变成一个累赘。

There were portraits of his ancestors on the walls of the room.  房间墙壁上挂着他祖先的画像。    Compare descendant
This wooden instrument is the ancestor of the modern metal flute.  这种木制乐器是现在金属长笛的雏形。

The terrorist action has been condemned as an act of barbarism and cowardice.  人们谴责这一恐怖行径是野蛮和懦弱的行为。
The film was condemned for its sexism.  这出电影被指责带有性别歧视。verb transitive
She was condemned to death and executed two weeks later.  她被宣判死刑，两星期后被处决。

The butcher prepared a rack of pork.  那个屠夫准备了一块猪颈肉。
We're having rack of lamb for dinner.  我们今天晚餐会煮羊颈肉。noun
The whole farm was going to rack and ruin.  整个农场逐渐变得破败不堪。noun

Singers performing Mozart's operas often dress in /wear historical costume.  歌手们经常穿古装出演莫劄特的歌剧。
The dancers leading the procession were in colourful and elaborate costumes.  走在队伍前头的舞蹈演员身着色彩绚丽、制作考究的服装。
Our host was wearing a clown costume.  我们的主人穿着小丑服。

Studies show that if a working environment is pleasant, productivity increases.  研究显示如果工作环境舒适，生产效率会提高。
Productivity in the steel industry improved by 5% last year.  钢铁工业的生产率去年提高了5%。

He grinned at me from the doorway.  他在门口向我咧着嘴笑。
What are you grinning about?  你龇牙咧嘴笑甚么？verb intransitive (-nn-)

The President had a hostile reception in Ohio this morning.  总统今天早上在俄亥俄州受到了不友善的接待。
I'm not hostile to (= against) the idea of change as such.  我并不反对作这样的改变。UK adjective

He couldn't conceive of a time when he would have no job.  他不能想像有一天他会没有工作。
He conceived the plot for this film while he was still a student.  他还是个学生的时候就已经构想出了这部影片的情节。
The exhibition was conceived by the museum's director.  这次展览是由博物馆馆长构思设计的。
This vaccine protects against some kinds of the bacteria.  这种疫苗能抵抗这些细菌中的某几种。

In spite of his injury, Ricardo will play in Saturday's match.  尽管里卡多有伤在身，星期六的比赛他仍然会出场。
She started to laugh, in spite of herself.  她不由自主地笑了起来。noun
He's the sort of man who would let down the tyres on your car just out of/from spite.  他是那种会为了泄愤而让你车胎泄气的人。verb transitive

Shocking revelations about their private life appeared in the papers.  有关他们私生活的惊人内幕见诸报端。
This book came as a complete revelation to me.  这本书使我茅塞顿开。

The president is not expected to concede these reforms.  估计总统不会同意这些改革。
He is not willing to concede any of his power/authority.  他不愿交出自己的任何权力。
Britain conceded (= allowed) independence to India in 1947.  英国在1947年承认印度独立。

He scored a spectacular goal in the second half.  他在下半场攻进了漂亮的一球。
There was a spectacular sunset last night.  昨天的日落非常壮观。
We've had spectacular success with the product.  我们的产品取得了惊人的成功。UK noun countable

The suggestion is sheer nonsense.  这个建议纯粹是胡言乱语。
His success was due to sheer willpower/determination.  他的成功全靠自己的意志力／决心。
It was sheer coincidence that we met.  我们的相遇纯属巧合。UK adjective

Most people who've had chicken pox once are immune to it for the rest of their lives.  大多数出过水痘的人终生都对此病具有免疫力。
He seems to be immune to colds - he just never gets them.  他好像对感冒具有免疫力——他从不感冒。
The press had criticised her so often that in the end she had become immune (to it).  新闻界如此频繁地批评她，以至于到最后她都（对此）变得无动于衷了。
exotic flowers/food/designs  奇花异草／外国风味的食物／奇异的设计

The wires were fastened together with a plastic clip.  这些电线用一个塑胶夹子扣在一起。noun
I've seen a clip from the film.  我看过这部电影的一个片段。noun
We set off at a good clip, but we gradually slowed down.  我们出发时速度很快，可是后来渐渐慢了下来。noun
We live in an increasingly secular society, in which religion has less and less influence on our daily lives.  我们生活在一个日益世俗化的世界里，宗教对我们日常生活的影响越来越小。

The restaurant has a very intimate atmosphere.  这家餐厅的气氛很幽静。
He's become very intimate with an actress.  他和一名女演员的关系变得非常亲密。adjective UK EXPERT  精通的
She has an intimate knowledge of Tuscany, where she has lived for twenty years.  她在托斯卡纳住了20年，对那里非常熟悉。noun countable UK US     formal

My schedule is quite flexible - I could arrange to meet with you any day next week.  我的时间安排很灵活——下周任何一天我都可以安排与你见面。adjective
Rubber is a flexible substance.  橡胶是一种有弹性的物质。
Dancers and gymnasts need to be very flexible (= able to bend their bodies easily).  舞蹈演员和体操运动员的身体必须非常柔韧。
The three men are accused of conspiracy.  这三人被指控图谋不轨。

The train was derailed but there were no casualties, police said.  警方称，火车出轨了，但没有人员伤亡。
The rebels suffered heavy casualties.  叛乱分子伤亡惨重。noun
She lost her job in 1989, a casualty of the recession.  1989年她失业了，成了经济衰退的受害者。

words.meaning: a.起作用的，能运转的；实用的
words.example: Is the central heating functional yet?  中央暖气系统工作正常吗？

The jury reached/returned a unanimous verdict of (not) guilty.  陪审团一致判定有罪／无罪。
Voters gave their verdict on the government's economic record last night by voting overwhelmingly for the opposition.  昨晚选民们以压倒性的多数票支援反对党，由此可以看出他们对本届政府在经济上的作为的评判。

words.meaning: a.联营的，合作的；愿意协助的
words.example:
I've asked them not to play their music so loudly, but they're not being very cooperative.  我叫他们不要把音乐声放得这么大，可是他们不肯合作。    Opposite uncooperativeUK noun countable (ALSO UK also co-operative) (also abbreviation co-op)
The magazine is run by a cooperative.  这份杂志由一家合作企业出版。

Throughout her career she has very successfully manipulated the media.  她在整个职业生涯中非常成功地控制了媒体。
The opposition leader accused government ministers of manipulating the statistics to suit themselves.  反对派领导人指责政府部长篡改统计数据以满足自身利益。verb transitive
The wheelchair is designed so that it is easy to manipulate.  轮椅设计得很容易操纵。

words.meaning: n.开业者，实习者；(尤指医学或法律界)从业人员
words.example:
Elizabeth Quan is a London-based practitioner of traditional Chinese medicine.  伊莉莎白‧康是一位在伦敦执业的中医医师。
She was a medical practitioner (= a doctor) before she entered politics.  从政前她是个医生。

The tape ran in a continuous loop, repeating the same songs over and over.  这盒磁带处于回圈播放状态，反反复复地播放那几首歌曲。
You can tell she's in the loop. She always knows about policy decisions before the rest of us.  她很明显是圈内人。她总是比我们所有人都更早知道政策决定。
I've been out of the loop since I changed jobs. I didn't realize Wendy and Bob had got engaged.  我换工作之后一直消息闭塞。我还不知道温蒂和巴布已经订婚了呢。noun countable

words.meaning: n.蘑菇；v.雨后春笋般迅速发展
words.example:
For this recipe choose mushrooms with large caps (= top parts).  做这道菜要选菌盖大的蘑菇。
Unfortunately some poisonous mushrooms look like edible mushrooms.  遗憾的是，某些有毒蘑菇外表与可食用蘑菇相似。    Compare toadstoolverb intransitive
The number of computers in schools has mushroomed in recent years.  近年来，学校里电脑的数量迅速增长。

The company received a substantial government subsidy.  公司得到大笔政府津贴。
The government is planning to abolish subsidies to farmers.  政府正计划取消对农场主人的补贴。

words.meaning: v.冲突，抵触；(猛撞)震动；发刺耳声
words.example:
We often have a jar or two at the pub after work.  我们经常在下班后到酒吧喝一两杯啤酒。UK noun countable
With every jar of the carriage, the children shrieked with excitement.  车厢每剧烈震动一下，孩子就兴奋地尖叫。UK verb (-rr-)
The sudden movement jarred his injured ribs.  突然的一个动作震痛了他受伤的肋骨。UK verb (-rr-)
And what might be the underlying significance of these supposedly random acts?  这些看似偶然的行为，其暗含的意义可能是甚么呢？

Put on your shoes and socks.  穿上鞋袜。
The little boy was wearing odd/ US usuallymismatched socks (= socks of different colours).  小男孩穿着两只不成对的袜子。UK noun
I'm going to take you to a restaurant that'll knock your socks off.  我要带你去看一家餐厅去，你准会大吃一惊。UK noun
He was one of the entrepreneurs of the eighties who made their money in property.  他是80年代靠房地产生意赚钱起家的企业家之一。
It's a classic case of the bored-housewife syndrome - she's got nothing to do all day except drink and go shopping.  这是百无聊赖的家庭主妇的典型特征——整天除了喝酒、购物，就没有甚么事情可做了。
The vitamins come in a form that is easily utilized by the body.  把维生素制成易被人体吸收的产品。

Dissolve two spoons of powder in warm water.  将两勺粉末溶解在温水中。
Nitric acid will dissolve most animal tissue.  硝酸能溶解大部分动物组织。UK verb
Parliament has been dissolved.  议会已被解散。
He was drawn to the metropolitan glamour and excitement of Paris.  他为巴黎的大都会魅力与激情所吸引。
The new building has little aesthetic value/appeal.  新楼几乎没有甚么美学价值。

words.meaning: n.连续的一段时间；拼写；咒语
words.example:
"How do you spell 'receive'?" "R E C E I V E".  “receive 怎么拼？”“R-E-C-E-I-V-E。”
Shakespeare did not always spell his own name the same way.  莎士比亚并非总是用同样的拼法拼写自己的名字。
Our address is 1520 Main Street, Albuquerque - shall I spell that (out) (= say in the correct order the letters that form the word) for you?  我们的地址是阿尔布开克大街1520号——要我把它拼出来吗？
These magazines have too many annoying inserts (= extra loose pages) advertising various products.  这些杂志里令人讨厌的各类产品广告插页太多。
a crash helmet  防撞头盔

Panic spread through the crowd as the bullets started to fly.  子弹开始满天飞，人群惊慌起来。
Carmel was in a panic about her exam.  卡梅尔很害怕考试。
He got in(to)a panic that he would forget his lines on stage.  他慌张起来，怕自己在台上会忘记台词。verb intransitive or transitive (panicking, panicked, panicked)

words.meaning: n.考得(木材堆的体积单位，等于立方英尺，.立方米)；绳索
words.example:
Where's the cord that ties back the curtains?  系着窗帘的绳子在哪里？
Have you got some cord that I can tie this parcel up with?  你有能让我捆上这个包裹的绳子吗？

He had no illusions about his talents as a singer.  他对自己作为歌手的才华不抱幻想。
I'm under no illusions (= I understand the truth) about the man I married.  我对我所嫁的男人不抱幻想。
My boss is labouring under the illusion that (= wrongly believes that) the project will be completed on time.  我的老板还存有工程能按时完成的幻想。

The money was donated by an anonymous benefactor.  这笔钱来自一位不愿透露姓名的捐赠者。
Police said an anonymous caller warned that a bomb was about to go off.  警方说有人打来匿名电话，警告一枚炸弹即将爆炸。
An attempt to implant an embryo using an egg from an anonymous woman donor was unsuccessful.  用一位匿名女性捐赠的卵子来植入胚胎的尝试未获成功。

She scrambled up the steep hillside and over the rocks.  她爬上了陡峭的山坡，翻过岩石。
He scrambled into his clothes (= put them on quickly) and raced to fetch a doctor.  他匆匆套上衣服，跑去请医生。
As the burning plane landed, the terrified passengers scrambled for the door (= tried to reach the door quickly).  起火的飞机降落后，受惊的乘客奋力向舱门口跑去。

They decorated the wedding car with ribbons and flowers.  他们用丝带和鲜花装饰婚车。
We're going to decorate the kitchen next week.  我们下周要粉刷厨房。
They were decorated for their part in the rescue.  他们因在此次救援行动中的表现而受到嘉奖。

The child's pulse was strong/weak.  那个孩子的脉搏很有力／虚弱。
Exercise increases your pulse rate.  运动能加快你的脉搏。
The data, normally transmitted electronically, can be changed into pulses of light.  这一资料通常是电子传送的，现在可被改为光波脉冲。noun

She's doing the equivalent job in the new company but for more money.  她在新公司做同样的工作，但薪水比以前高。
Is $50 equivalent to about £30?  50美元是不是大约相当于30英镑？noun countable usually singular
There is no English equivalent for 'bon appetit' so we have adopted the French expression.  英语中没有和 bon appetit 相对应的词，所以我们就借用了法语的这个表达方式。
There was great sibling rivalry (= competition) between Peter and his brother.  彼得和他的弟弟之间斗争得很厉害。

words.meaning: n.反话；(有讽刺意味的)出人意料的事情或情况
words.example:
The irony (of it) is that the new tax system will burden those it was intended to help.  讽刺的是，新的税收制度反而将使该制度本来打算要帮助的人背上沉重负担。UK noun uncountable
Her voice heavy with irony, Simone said, "We're so pleased you were able to stay so long." (= Her voice made it obvious they were not pleased).  西蒙娜说：“你能留这么久，我们真高兴。”语气里明显带有讽刺。    Compare sarcasm

He beat his closest/nearest rival by 20 marks.  他以领先20分的成绩打败了和他水准最接近的对手。
The companies produce rival versions of the toy.  这些公司生产的玩具跟我们的产品争夺市场。verb transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
No computer can rival a human brain for/in complexity.  没有任何电脑比得上人脑复杂。

She gave him a punch UKon / USin the nose.  她朝着他的鼻子打了一拳。noun
Have you seen the hole punch anywhere?  你看到打孔器在哪里了吗？verb transitive
He punched him in the stomach.  他朝他的肚子上猛击了一拳。

Once you push it, it keeps going under its own momentum.  一旦你推动了它，它就会在自己的动量作用下持续运动。
The spacecraft will fly round the Earth to gain/gather momentum for its trip to Jupiter.  太空船将绕着地球飞行以获取飞向木星所需的动力。
The play loses momentum (= becomes less interesting, energetic, etc.) by its half-way stage.  这部戏演到一半时就没看头了。

words.meaning: v. 缩拢或撅起；n. 钱包
words.example:
Having a lot of people out of work places a large drain on the public purse.  大量人口失业使政府的财力消耗很大。UK noun
The players in the golf tournament are competing for a purse of £525 000.  参加本次高尔夫锦标赛的选手正在为52.5万英镑的奖金而展开争夺。UK noun

Psychotherapy helped him to shed some of his insecurity/inhibitions.  心理疗法帮助他摆脱了一些不安全感／自我压抑。
I'm going on a diet to see if I can shed (= become thinner by losing) a few kilos.  我要节食，看能不能甩掉几公斤。
The trees shed their leaves in autumn.  树木在秋天落叶。

Mercury is a liquid at room temperature.  水银在室温下为液体。adjective
She has very few liquid assets as most of her wealth is tied up in stocks and shares.  她的流动资金很少，大部分财产都投到了证券和股票上。adjective
Marilyn Monroe and James Dean are still icons for many young people.  玛丽莲‧梦露和詹姆斯‧狄恩仍是许多年轻人的偶像。UK noun countable

Would you consider fostering (a child) ?  你会考虑代养一个孩子吗？    Compare adoptUK verb
I'm trying to foster an interest in classical music in my children.  我正努力培养我的孩子们对古典音乐的兴趣。
They were discussing the best way to foster democracy and prosperity in the former communist countries.  他们正在讨论促进前共产主义国家民主和繁荣的最佳办法。UK adjective [before noun]

The wounds were gradually healing (up).  伤口在逐渐愈合。
The plaster cast helps to heal the broken bone.  石膏绷带有利于断骨的愈合。
Peace talks were held to try to heal the growing rift between the two sides.  双方举行了和谈以弥合日益扩大的裂痕。

Ozone is the Earth's primary filter for ultraviolet radiation.  臭氧层是地球上阻挡紫外线辐射的主要屏障。UK noun countable
News filtered down to us during the day.  白天的时候消息慢慢传到了我们这里。
Reports about an accident began to filter in.  有关一次意外的报道开始慢慢传开。

words.meaning: v.剥削；开发利用；n.英勇行为
words.example:
We need to make sure that we exploit our resources as fully as possible.  我们要确保尽可能充分利用资源。verb transitive /ɪkˈsplɔɪt/
Laws exist to stop companies exploiting their employees.  法律规定禁止公司剥削其员工。noun countable usually plural /ˈek.splɔɪt/
She was telling me about her exploits while travelling around Africa.  她跟我讲述了在非洲各地旅游时的奇遇。

The resort is easily accessible by road, rail and air.  这个旅游胜地交通便利，坐汽车、火车和飞机都可以到达。
The problem with some of these drugs is that they are so very accessible.  此类毒品的问题在于当中一些很容易获取。
Lea Anderson is a choreographer who believes in making dance accessible.  作为一个编舞者，利·安德森认为应该使舞蹈通俗易懂。
Amoebae and bacteria are single-celled organisms.  变形虫和细菌是单细胞生物。

The disease causes a loss of sensation in the fingers.  这种病会使手指失去知觉。
Their affair caused a sensation.  他们的暧昧关系引起了轰动。
The books have been a publishing sensation on both sides of the Atlantic.  这些书在大西洋两岸的出版界都引起了轰动。
