words.example:
You can't give away Granny's old bookcase - it's a valuable antique.  你不能把奶奶的旧书柜送人，那可是件值钱的古董啊。
My mother collects antiques.  我母亲收藏古玩。adjective

words.meaning: v.把„擦光亮，抛光；n.上光剂，擦光剂；(态度等)优雅
words.example:
Polish your shoes regularly to protect the leather.  定期擦拭你的鞋以保护皮革。UK verb transitive
He polished off the whole pie.  他风卷残云般地吃掉了一整块馅饼。
Arsenal polished off Chelsea 5-0 in Saturday's match.  阿森纳队在周六的比赛中以5：0干净俐落地击败了切尔西队。UK verb transitive

Her conversation sparkled with her own subtle blend of wit and charm.  她的谈话透着她特有的难以言传的风趣与魅力。
He was known for his dry / ready / sharp wit.  他以言辞尖刻而闻名。
Sydney Smith, a notable wit, once remarked that he never read a book before he reviewed it because it might prejudice his opinion of it.  悉尼‧史密斯，一个风趣出了名的家伙，曾说过他从来不在评论一部书之前去读它，因为这样会让他对这部书产生偏见。noun

words.meaning: a. 难以置信的；寓言里的
words.example:
She looked absolutely fabulous in her dress.  她穿着这条连身裙看起来漂亮极了。
They've got a fabulous apartment in the centre of Paris.  他们在巴黎市中心有一间极佳的公寓。
We had a fabulous time at the party.  我们在聚会上玩得很痛快。adjective

There have been calls for his resignation.  一直有人要求他辞职。
They received the news with resignation.  消息传来，他们听天由命接受了一切。

words.meaning: n.行为；(土地或建筑物的)转让契约、证书
words.example:
It seems to me that a lot of evil deeds are done in the name of religion.  在我看来，很多坏事都是打着宗教旗帜的。
She's always helping people and doing other good deeds.  她总是帮助别人，经常做好事。noun countable
The unions fought hard against the government's programme of pit closures.  工会奋力反对政府关闭煤矿的计划。

words.meaning: v.制定，创立(社团，规章)；n.学院，协会
words.example: She is threatening to institute legal proceedings against the hospital.  她威胁说要对该医院提出诉讼。

It's in pencil so you can just erase anything that's wrong.  这是用铅笔写的，这样你就可以把任何错误的地方擦掉。UK verb transitive
Tiger Woods is determined to erase the memory of a disappointing Cup debut two years ago.  老虎·伍兹决心要把两年前初次参加高球赛时令人失望的表现永远忘掉。
Taylor wants a convincing victory to erase doubts about his team's ability to reach the World Cup finals.  泰勒想要透过大比数获胜来消除人们对他的球队能否打入世界杯决赛的疑虑。

She has terminal cancer.  她患有末期癌症。
He has nothing to do all day and is suffering from terminal boredom.  他终日无所事事，极其无聊。
She claims that the shipbuilding industry is in terminal decline.  她声称造船业已经衰败到极点。UK noun countable

He was an amateur singer until the age of 40, when he turned professional.  40岁之前他一直是个业余歌手，之后才转为职业歌手。    Compare professional
This tennis tournament is open to both amateurs and professionals.  这次网球锦标赛业余运动员和职业运动员都可以参加。    Compare professional    disapproving

These mental exercises are designed to break linear thinking habits and encourage the creativity that is needed for innovation.  设计这些思维训练旨在打破线性思维习惯，激发革新所需的创造思维。
Is there a linear relationship between salaries and productivity?  薪水和生产效率有直接关系吗？

words.meaning: n.清真寺(伊斯兰教的寺庙)

words.example:
In the various regions of India, Hindus worship different gods and observe different religious festivals.  在印度的不同地区，印度教信徒敬奉不同的神灵，并庆祝不同的宗教节日。
They work for the same company, socialise together and worship in the same mosque.  他们为同一家公司工作，一同参加社交活动，并且在同一清真寺做礼拜。
The poll showed that over 40% of Americans worship on a weekly basis.  民意调查显示，超过40%的美国人每周都去做礼拜。UK verb (-pp- or US ALSO -p-)

words.meaning: n.正当理由，好的（正义的）原因；辨护
words.example:
There is no justification for treating people so badly.  没有理由如此恶劣地对待他人。
It can be said, with some justification, that she is one of the greatest actresses on the English stage today.  说她是当今英语戏剧界最杰出的女演员之一实在不无道理。

words.meaning: n. (放艺术品等的)壁龛；合适的位置
words.example:
Lloyd has carved/made a niche for himself as a professional tennis player.  劳埃德成为职业网球员，为自己找到了合适的发展方向。
an ecological niche.  生态龛；生态位UK noun countable

His helpfulness today has made me revise my original opinion /impression of him.  他今天所表现出的乐于助人的品质使我改变了对他的最初看法／印象。
His publishers made him revise his manuscript three times.  出版公司让他把手稿修改了三次。verb
We're revising (algebra) for the test tomorrow.  我们正在为明天的（代数）考试进行复习。

Don't let her frighten you, her bark is worse than her bite.  别被她吓倒了，她这人口直心快。UK verb
They heard a dog barking outside.  他们听见外面有狗吠声。
The sergeant barked (out) a succession of orders to the new recruits.  中士向那些新兵大声地下了一连串命令。UK verb

Science has always fascinated me.  科学一直令我着迷。
Anything to do with aeroplanes and flying fascinates him.  一切有关飞机和飞行的东西都令他着迷。

She was stabbed several times in the chest.  她胸口被捅了几刀。
He was jailed for fifteen years for stabbing his wife to death.  他因刺死妻子被判入狱15年。
As she spoke she stabbed the air with her finger.  她一边说一边用手指在空中比划着。
There have been quite a few incidences of bullying in the school this year.  今年该校发生了好几次欺凌弱小的事件。

She was sitting at the desk with her chin propped on her hands.  她双手托着下巴坐在书桌旁。
This window keeps on closing - I'll have to prop it open with something.  这扇窗老是开了又关——我得用甚么东西撑着不让它关上。UK verb transitive + adverb or preposition (-pp-)
He was sitting upright in his hospital bed, propped up by pillows.  他靠着枕头，直挺挺地坐在医院的病床上。

words.meaning: a.堕落的，腐败的；文体有错误的
words.example:
Both companies are under investigation for corrupt practices.  两家公司都在接受腐败行为调查。
The whole system was corrupt - every official she approached wanted money before helping her.  整个体系都腐败了——她接触的所有官员在帮她之前都索要钱财。
The study claimed that violence on television corrupts the minds of children.  研究称电视上的暴力镜头腐蚀了孩子们的思想。verb transitive

words.meaning: a.平行的；类似的；n.平行线；v.与„相似
words.example:
Draw a pair of parallel lines.  画两条平行线。
Hills Road is parallel to Mill Road.  希尔斯路和米尔路平行。UK adjective
Parallel experiments are being conducted in Rome, Paris and London.  类似的实验正在罗马、巴黎和伦敦同时进行。UK noun

words.meaning: a.虚弱的；病容的，(面色)苍白憔悴的

words.example:
At the age of 45, she finally fulfilled her ambition to run a marathon.  45岁时，她终于实现了跑马拉松的夙愿。
Zoos fulfil an important function in the protection of rare species.  动物园起着保护珍稀动物的重要功能。
He has failed to fulfil his duties as a father.  他没有尽到做父亲的责任。

He has a collection of rare insect specimens.  他收集了很多稀有昆虫的标本。
Museums will pay large amounts of money for good dinosaur fossil specimens.  博物馆愿意出大价钱购买完好的恐龙化石标本。
Astronauts brought back specimens of moon rock.  太空人带回了月球岩石的样本。

words.meaning: a.难理解的；不清楚的，不分明的；v.隐藏，使„模糊，使„不分明
words.example:
Official policy has changed, for reasons that remain obscure.  官方的政策已改变，原因尚不清楚。
His answers were obscure and confusing.  他的回答模糊不清，令人费解。UK verb transitive
Two new skyscrapers had sprung up, obscuring the view from her window.  两座新摩天大楼拔地而起，挡住了她窗外的风景。

She had a bout of flu over Christmas.  圣诞节期间她得了一场流感。
He suffered from periodic bouts of insanity.  他得过阵发性精神错乱。
He's a former heavyweight champion and is expected to win the bout easily.  他是前重量级冠军，估计会轻松拿下这场比赛。

Europe is remaking itself politically within the matrix of the European Community.  欧洲正在欧共体的氛围中重塑政治版图。noun (plural matrices or matrixes)
The fossils lie embedded in a matrix of shale and sandstone.  化石牢牢嵌在页岩与砂岩形成的基质中。
This task is designed to test the child's spatial awareness (= understanding of where things are in relation to other things).  这一个任务是为测试孩子的空间概念而设计的。
Part of the road had been coned off for repair work.  部分道路用锥形路标封闭起来以便维修。
We could stroll into town if you like.  如果你愿意的话，我们可以去城里走走逛逛。

Grow the bulbs in a transparent plastic box, so the children can see the roots growing.  把球茎种在透明的塑胶盒里，这样孩子就能看到根的生长。
Her blouse was practically transparent!  她的衬衫几乎是透明的！    Compare opaque ; translucent

words.meaning: a.构成整体所必需的；完整的
words.example:
He's an integral part of the team and we can't do without him.  他是球队不可或缺的一员，没有他我们可不行。
Bars and terrace cafés are integral to the social life of the city.  酒吧和露天咖啡座是这个城市社交生活中不可缺少的一部分。

Hot water circulates through the heating system.  热水在供暖系统中循环。
I've circulated a good luck card for everyone to sign.  我拿了一张好运卡传着让每个人都签名。

The weather forecast said it was going to rain later today.  天气预报说今天晚些时候有雨。UK verb transitive (forecast or forecasted, forecast or forecasted)
They forecast a large drop in unemployment over the next two years.  他们预测今后两年失业人口会大幅下降。
Snow has been forecast for tonight.  预报今晚有雪。

She thrust the money into his hand.  她把钱塞进他手中。
They thrust a microphone in front of me and fired questions at me.  他们把麦克风推到我面前，不断向我发问。
She thrust the papers at me (= towards me).  她把报纸塞给我。

What an absurd thing to say!  这话多荒唐啊！
Don't be so absurd! Of course I want you to come.  别说傻话了！我当然想让你来。
It's an absurd situation - neither of them will talk to the other.  这情形真是让人哭笑不得——他们谁也不愿意理谁。
He knew it was wrong to steal, but the money just lying there was too great a temptation.  他知道偷盗是不对的，但钱就摆在那里，对他的诱惑实在太大了。

He drew an analogy between the brain and a vast computer.  他把大脑比作一台庞大的电脑。
It is sometimes easier to illustrate an abstract concept by analogy with (= by comparing it with) something concrete.  有时用具体事物作比拟来阐释抽象概念会更容易些。
a city of 5 million inhabitants  拥有500万居民的城市
Fighting around the capital has intensified in the last few hours.  首都周围的战斗在过去的几小时里变得更加激烈。

words.meaning: v.摇动，摇摆；影响使改变观点；n.摇动
words.example:
The trees were swaying in the wind.  树在风中摇曳。
The movement of the ship caused the mast to sway from side to side/backwards and forwards.  桅杆随着船的行驶左右／前后摇摆。
Recent developments have swayed the balance of power in the region.  最近的发展使这个地区的实力均势产生了改变。verb
Some airlines have cancelled less popular routes in an effort to maximize profits.  一些航空公司取消了不太受欢迎的航线，以便把利润尽量提高。    Compare minimize

It's quite simple to upgrade the indexing software.  升级索引软体很简单。
Congratulations, I hear you've been upgraded to divisional manager.  祝贺你啊，听说你被提升为部门经理了。    Opposite downgradenoun countable /ˈʌp.greɪd/
The upgrade to version 5.0 costs $395.  升级到5.0版本要花费395美元。

words.meaning: a.显然的；n.旅客名单；载货清单
words.example:
The workers chose to manifest their dissatisfaction in a series of strikes.  工人决定藉一连串罢工来表达他们的不满。
The illness first manifested itself in/as severe stomach pains.  这种疾病最初表现为严重的胃痛。
Lack of confidence in the company manifested itself in a fall in the share price.  人们对公司缺乏信心，股价下跌正好显示此情况。 formal

She flushed with pleasure as she accepted the prize.  她领奖时高兴得红光满面。
The champagne had caused his face to flush.  香槟使他脸色发红。verb
My children never flush the loo/toilet after them.  我的孩子们用过马桶后从来不冲。

words.meaning: v.将某物排列在一条直线上；与某人结盟
words.example:
When you've aligned the notch on the gun with the target, fire!  当枪的标尺、准星和目标成一条直线时，开火！
Align the ruler and the middle of the paper and then cut it straight.  让尺子对齐纸的中线，然后沿尺子剪开。verb transitive
The party is under pressure to align itself more closely with industry.  该党受压力所迫，与企业界关系更近了。

In the next game they will face the mighty Redskins.  下一场比赛中他们将迎战实力强大的红人队。
They offered to raise salaries by 12% - that's a mighty generous deal.  他们表示愿意加薪12%，那可真是慷慨啊。
More specific and less subjective criteria should be used in selecting people for promotion within the company.  公司内部决定升职人选时，需要藉助更具体、更客观的标准。    Compare objective

The valve failed to open/close.  阀门打不开／关不上了。
It was a weak heart valve that caused her death.  是心瓣膜问题导致了她的死亡。

All R45 aircraft have been grounded, after a defect in the engine cooling system was discovered.  自从发现引擎冷却系统有缺陷之后，所有R45型飞机都已经停飞了。
There are so many defects in our education system.  我们的教育制度有太多缺陷了。
It's a character defect in her that she can't ever accept that she's in the wrong.  她在性格上有缺陷，因为她从来都不承认自己有责任。

She's filing a petition for divorce.  她将要递交离婚诉状。verb intransitive or transitive
They're petitioning for/about better facilities for disabled people on public transport.  他们正在请愿，希望当局能在大众交通工具上为残障人士安装更好的设施。
legal She is petitioning for a re-trial.  她将上诉要求重审。

Oil prices have remained static for the last few months.  过去几个月里油价保持稳定。UK noun uncountable
There's so much static on this radio I can't hear what they're saying.  收音机的静电干扰太大，我听不清他们在说甚么。
Hardening of the coronary arteries can lead to a heart attack.  冠状动脉硬化可能导致心脏病发作。UK noun countable

By gum, he's a big lad!  好家伙，他块头真大啊！verb transitive (-mm-)    slightly old-fashioned
The labels were already gummed to the envelopes.  标签已经黏贴在信封上了。verb transitive (-mm-)    slightly old-fashioned
When I woke up this morning my eyes were all gummed up.  今天早晨我醒来时，眼睛被眼屎给糊住了。
Their main thesis was that war was inevitable.  他们的主要论点是战争不可避免。

Tim is now a qualified architect.  提姆现在是一个合格的建筑师了。
What makes you think that you are qualified for this job?  甚么使你觉得自己有资格从事这份工作？
There seems to be qualified support for the idea.  对这个观点的认同似乎有所保留。
The earthquake was a disaster of cosmic proportions/scale.  这次地震是一场巨大的灾难。
She sat back for a minute to ponder her next move in the game.  她靠在椅背上坐了一会儿，思考下一步棋该怎么走。

It will only complicate the situation if we invite his old girlfriend as well.  如果我们同时也邀请他以前的女友，只会使事情更加复杂。
The rescue operation has been complicated by bad weather.  恶劣的天气使救援工作变得更加艰难。
These new rules have complicated the tax system even further.  这些新规定使税收制度更加复杂。

The government's economic policy has been denounced on all sides.  政府的经济政策受到了各方面的谴责。
We must denounce injustice and oppression.  我们必须对不公和压迫现象予以谴责。verb transitive
His former colleagues have denounced him as a spy.  他以前的同事告发他是间谍。

All the family were sitting in the lounge watching television.  全家人都坐在客厅里看电视。
We spent our days lounging around the pool.  我们整天在游泳池消磨时间。

They haven't produced any credible evidence for convicting him.  他们没有拿出任何可信的证据来给他定罪。
The story of what had happened to her was barely (= only just) credible.  关于她的遭遇的说法不大可信。

Draw a horizontal line across the bottom of the page.  在本页底部画一条水准线。
Keep the patient horizontal with the feet slightly raised.  让病人平躺，双脚略微抬高。    Compare verticalUK noun countable usually singular
Rotate it slowly from the horizontal into a vertical position.  慢慢将它从水准位置旋转到垂直位置。

Obviously what she did was wrong, but I don't think it warranted quite such severe punishment.  显然她做得不对，但我认为她不应该受到如此严厉的惩罚。
It's a relatively simple task that really doesn't warrant a great deal of time being spent on it.  这是一个相对来说比较简单的任务，不必在上面花费大量的时间。
Judge La Riva had issued an arrest warrant/a warrant for his arrest.  拉里瓦法官已经签署了一份逮捕状／逮捕他的令状。UK noun
The company has shown exceptional growth over the past two years.  过去两年里面，这间公司的发展业绩不俗。

words.meaning: a.渗透的，湿透的，饱和的；深颜色的
words.example: It's pouring down outside - I'm absolutely saturated!  外面下着倾盆大雨——我全身都湿透了！
I'm a bit wary of/about giving people my address when I don't know them very well.  如果不是太熟的话，我不会轻易告诉别人我的地址。
a linen jacket  亚麻上衣

Water dripped down the wall.  水顺着墙滴下来。
She dripped paint on the carpet.  她把油漆滴在了地毯上。
Watch out - the candle's dripping.  小心——蜡烛滴油了。verb (-pp-)

The screws holding the bed together had loosened.  床上的螺丝钉松了。verb
He loosened his tie.  他松开了领带。verb
He held my hand very tightly at first but gradually his grip loosened.  一开始他紧紧地握着我的手，但后来慢慢地松开了。verb

The platform was elevated by means of hydraulic legs.  平台由液压支架抬升起来。
They want to elevate the status of teachers.  他们想提高教师的社会地位。
These factors helped to elevate the town into the list of the ten most attractive in the country.  这些因素提高了该镇的声望，使之成为该国十大最具魅力城镇之一。
Education in England is something of a lottery.  在英格兰接受教育有点像碰运气。

words.meaning: n. 家务琐事；讨厌的工作
words.example: I'll go shopping when I've done my chores (= done the jobs in or around the house).  我把家务琐事做完后要去购物。
The river is fringed with wild flowers.  河两岸长满了野花。

She'd made some overseas investments as a hedge against rising inflation in this country.  她在海外有一些投资，可以抵消该国不断上升的通货膨胀所带来的损失。verb
We've got permission, but it's hedged about/around with strict conditions.  我们得到了许可，但却有严格的限制条件。
Stop hedging and tell me what you really think.  别再拐弯抹角了，告诉我你真正的想法。verb

The estate contains 300 new homes, about a third of which are leased to the council.  住宅区里有300所新房屋，其中约1／3租给了市政委员会。
He has the flat on a long lease.  他长期租用该公寓。
The lease runs out/expires in two years' time.  租借契约将在两年后到期。

We have a census in this country every ten years.  我们在这个国家每十年进行一次人口普查。
She was stopped in her car for a traffic census.  她被拦下来接受交通情况调查。

He was murmuring to him self.  他正喃喃自语。
humorous He murmured sweet nothings (= romantic talk) in her ear.  他在她耳边低声说着情话。UK verb
They were murmuring about the boss's nephew getting the job.  他们私下嘀咕着老板的侄子得到了那份工作的事。UK noun

words.meaning: n.标准规格(尤指宽度或厚度)；测量仪；v.测量
words.example:
Use a thermometer to gauge the temperature.  用温度计测量一下温度。
The fact that the play has transferred to New York is a gauge of its success.  该剧转往纽约演出，从这一点就可以判定它是很成功的。
These remote islands are inhabited only by birds.  这些偏僻的岛屿上只有鸟类栖息。

The country now has a quota on immigration.  该国目前对外来移民人数有限额。
figurative The class contains the usual quota (= number) of troublemakers.  班上也有那些捣乱的人。
An excerpt from her new thriller will appear in this weekend's magazine.  本周末出版的杂志将刊登她的最新惊悚小说的片段。

The West made impressive strides in improving energy efficiency after the huge rises in oil prices during the seventies.  20世纪70年代石油价格大幅上涨之后，西方国家在提高能源使用效率方面有了显著进步。
The group has made strides to expand internationally.  这个集团在拓展国际市场方面获得很大的进展。noun
She attributes her record-breaking speed to the length of her stride.  她认为她的速度之所以能打破纪录是因为步幅大。noun
He's made a model of our village, with all the buildings and roads in miniature.  他做了个我们村庄的模型，里面有所有建筑物和道路的缩微景观。
They claimed it was simply (an) oversight.  他们声称这不过是个疏忽。

On 31 May the two leaders signed a peace accord.  5月31日两位领导人签署了一项和平协议。
Before 1987, the accord between the Labour government and the unions was a simple affair.  1987年以前，工党政府和工会之间很容易达成一致。
The project is completely in accord with government policy.  该企划案完全符合政府政策。

He snatched the photos out of my hand before I had a chance to look at them.  我还没来得及看，他就一把抢走了我手里的照片。
figurative Running the best race of his career, Fletcher snatched (= only just won) the gold medal from the Canadian champion.  弗莱彻跑出了他职业生涯中的最好成绩，从加拿大冠军手中夺走了金牌。
The six-year-old girl was snatched from a playground and her body was found two days later.  那名六岁的女孩在游乐场被绑架了，两天后就有人发现她的尸体。

We perched on bar stools and had a beer.  我们坐在酒吧高凳上，喝了一杯啤酒。
The village is perched on top of a high hill.  村子坐落在一座高山的山顶上。UK noun
We watched the parade from our perch on the scaffolding.  我们从鹰架的高处观看游行。

The evening was very pleasant, albeit a little quiet.  那个夜晚过得非常愉快，尽管有点儿冷清。
He tried, albeit without success.  虽然没有成功，可他努力了。

Islam's most sacred shrine is at Mecca in Saudi Arabia.  伊斯兰教最神圣的圣殿位于沙乌地阿拉伯的麦加。
She's turned her bedroom into a shrine to the dead pop star and covered the walls with pictures of him.  她把自己的卧室变成了纪念那位已故流行歌星的地方，墙上贴满了他的照片。
humorous I'm a chocolate/shopping addict.  我是个吃巧克力成瘾的人／购物狂。

words.meaning: a.书页空白处的；不重要的，小的，少的
words.example:
The report suggests that there has only been a marginal improvement in women's pay over the past few years.  报告显示，过去几年间女性的工资只有轻微增长。
The marginal Tory constituency was held by 2200 votes in 1992.  1992年，保守党以2200票获得这个边缘选区。UK noun countable UK
Labour lost two of the key marginals in London.  工党失去了伦敦两个关键性的边缘选区。

words.meaning: v. 稳定增长或下降；n. 坡道，斜坡
words.example:
The company announced plans to ramp up production to 10 000 units per month.  这间公司宣布了每月生产一万件的增产计划。
To stay competitive, they'll have to ramp up product development as well as cutting prices.  为保持竞争力，他们除了降价以外，还将不得不加大产品开发的力度。
Announcement of the merger is expected to ramp up share prices over the next few days.  预计公司合并的消息发布后，接下来的几天里股票价格会上扬。

The Prime Minister was greeted with a hail of insults as she arrived at the students' union.  女首相来到学生会时遭到一阵辱骂。verb
Shall we hail a taxi?  我们要叫计程车吗？
She's being hailed as one of the best up-and-coming young dancers today.  她被誉为当今最有前途的年轻舞蹈家之一。

If you were to exert your influence they might change their decision.  如果你可以施加你的影响，他们或者会改变决定。
Some managers exert considerable pressure on their staff to work extra hours without being paid.  一些老板向员工施加巨大的压力迫使他们无薪加班。UK verb

She was very naive to believe that he'd stay with her.  她居然天真地相信他会和她在一起。
They make the naive assumption that because it's popular it must be good.  他们幼稚地认为，流行的就一定是好的。
It was a little naive of you to think that they would listen to your suggestions.  你以为他们会听从你的建议，你真是有点天真。
cereal crops  谷类作物

Polar bears live in the Arctic.  北极熊生活在北极地区。UK adjective
No trees grow in the Arctic regions.  北极地区不生长树木。
The North of England has been experiencing Arctic conditions these past few days.  过去的几天里，英格兰北部地方天气极其寒冷。

words.meaning: a.明智的，合理的；可感觉到的
words.example:
It would be sensible to take an umbrella.  带把伞是明智的。
It could be cold and wet so pack some sensible clothes.  天可能会又冷又湿，因此带些合适的衣服。adjective
He did not appear to be sensible of the difficulties that lay ahead.  他看起来并没有意识到前面的困难。

She fractured her skull in the accident.  她在事故中颅骨骨折。
Two of her ribs fractured when she was thrown from her horse.  她从马上摔下来，折断了两根肋骨。
Intense disagreement over economic policy risks fracturing the coalition government.  经济政策上的严重分歧使联合政府面临解体的危险。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.(政治或宗教内容的)传单；大片土地
words.example:
Have you read John Milton's tracts on divorce?  你读过约翰‧弥尔顿论离婚的小册子吗？noun countable
The house is surrounded by vast tracts of woodland.  这幢房子周围是大片林地。

words.meaning: a.（人）出身卑微的；谦虚的；v.使谦卑
words.example:
He's very humble about his success.  他对自己的成功十分谦虚。
formal Please accept our humble apologies for the error.  出现这样的差错，请接受我们真诚的道歉。
In my humble opinion (= I want to emphasize that I think that) we should never have bought the car in the first place.  依愚见，首先我们就不应该买这辆汽车。

He has no descendants.  他没有后代。
They claim to be descendants of a French duke.  他们自称是一位法国公爵的后代。
We owe it to our descendants (= people younger than us who will live after we have died) to leave them a clean world to live in.  给子孙后代留下一个清洁的生活环境是我们的职责。    Compare ancestor
a knitted/woollen/silk scarf  针织／羊毛／丝绸围巾UK verb transitive    US for

You don't want lumps in the sauce.  谁都不希望调料汁中出现结块。
I'll be getting the insurance money in two lumps.  我将获得的保险金有两大部分。noun countable
She found a lump in her breast.  她在胸部发现了一个肿块。noun countable
Humans, dogs, elephants and dolphins are all mammals, but birds, fish and crocodiles are not.  人、狗、大象和海豚都是哺乳动物，而鸟、鱼和鳄鱼则不是。

Students clashed with police after demonstrations at five universities.  学生在五所大学示威之后与员警发生了冲突。
The government and the opposition parties have clashed over the cuts in defence spending.  政府与反对党派在削减国防开支的问题上发生了激烈的争执。
This latest statement from the White House clashes with important aspects of US foreign policy.  白宫的最新声明与美国外交政策的重要方面相抵触。verb

In warm weather these germs multiply rapidly.  在温暖的天气里这些细菌会迅速繁殖。
If you multiply seven by 15 you get 105.  用15乘以7，结果是105。    Compare add ; divide ; subtract

disapproving The place was full of yanks.  这地方全是美国佬。
He tripped over the wire and yanked the plug out.  他绊到了电线，一下子把插头拽了出来。
She yanked open the cupboard and everything fell out.  她猛地打开橱柜，所有东西都掉了出来。
The company is notorious for paying its bills late.  该公司出了名地喜欢拖欠帐单。

Three minutes after the fire started, the house was full of lethal fumes.  起火三分钟后，房子里充满了致命的毒气。
In the car the police found guns, knives and other lethal weapons (= weapons which can kill).  员警在车里找到了枪支、刀具及其他一些凶器。
informal That combination of tiredness and alcohol is lethal (= has a very bad effect).  身体的疲劳加上酒精的作用会产生非常严重的后果。
Such a large investment inevitably entails some risk.  这样的钜额投资必然会有一定的风险。

Swirl a little oil around the frying pan.  在煎锅边儿刷一点点油。
The fog swirled thickly around us.  我们被浓雾重重包围。

The guest of honour was the Romanoff heir to the throne of all Russia.  这位贵宾是统治全俄罗斯的罗曼诺夫王朝的王位继承人。
Despite having a large family, they still had no son and heir.  尽管家庭成员众多，他们仍然没有儿子作为继承人。
The French finance minister is heir to a tradition of central control that goes back to Louis XIV's minister, Colbert.  法国的财政部长承袭了中央集权财政管理方式的传统，该传统可以追溯到路易十四时代的财政部长柯尔贝尔。

The extra cost of travelling to work is offset by the lower price of houses here.  这里低廉的房价抵消了因上班路途远而产生的额外费用。
We offset all our long-haul flights.  我们就所有长途运输机的排放所带来的损害都作出补偿。

words.meaning: a.正直的；易懂的；直截了当的
words.example:
Just follow the signs to Bradford - it's very straightforward.  顺着路标走就到布拉德福德了——非常简单。UK adjective
Roz is straightforward and let's you know what she's thinking.  罗兹很坦诚，会告诉你她的想法。

words.meaning: v.翻倒；推翻，使垮台(尤指政府)
words.example:
The car skidded off the road, hit a tree and overturned.  汽车滑出道路，撞到树上后翻了。
The burglars had overturned all the furniture in the house.  入屋爆窃的贼人翻了屋子里所有家俱。UK verb
The Court of Appeal overturned the earlier decision.  上诉法庭推翻了早前作出的裁决。

words.meaning: a.结实的；简洁明了的；n.合同，协议
words.example:
What a compact office! How did you fit so much into so little space?  多么小巧的办公室！你们是如何把这么多东西塞进这么小的空间的？noun countable UK CASE  盒子
Cars had compacted the snow until it was like ice.  汽车把雪碾得越来越结实，直到变得像冰一样。

She practises meditation.  她时常静坐冥想。
Let us spend a few moments in quiet meditation.  让我们花片刻时间静静思考一下。
The book is a meditation on the morality of art.  这本书探讨了艺术道德。

words.meaning: v.昌盛，兴旺；活跃而有影响
words.example:
My tomatoes are flourishing this summer - it must be the warm weather.  今年夏天我的番茄长势很好——这一定是天气暖和的原因。
Watercolour painting began to flourish in Britain around 1750.  1750年左右，水彩画开始在英国兴盛起来。UK verb
She came in smiling, flourishing her exam results.  她微笑着走进来，手里挥舞着她的考试成绩单。UK noun

words.meaning: v.流出；释放；解雇；履行义务
words.example:
Patients were discharged from hospital because the beds were needed by other people.  由于其他人需要床位，患者们便被允许出院了。
More than half of all prisoners discharged (= allowed to leave prison) are reconvicted within two years.  在获释的犯人中有一半多在两年内又被再次判刑。verb UK SEND OUT  发出
Large amounts of dangerous waste are discharged daily by the factory.  这个工厂每天排放大量危险的废物。
The first step in empowering the poorest sections of society is making sure they vote.  帮助社会最贫困阶层掌握自己命运的第一步就是要确保他们能够参加投票。

The situation raises important questions about solidarity among member states of the UN.  当前形势引发了联合国成员国能否团结一致的质疑。
The lecturers joined the protest march to show solidarity with their students.  演讲者加入抗议队伍，以示他们与学生们团结一致。
Early detection of the cancer improves the chances of successful treatment.  及早发现癌症能提高治愈的机率。

Street-fights are an everyday occurrence in this area of the city.  在该市的这一地区，街头斗殴每天都会发生。UK noun
The study compares the occurrence of heart disease in various countries.  该项研究比较了不同国家心脏病的发病率。

He swung himself into the saddle and rode off.  他跨上马鞍，骑马走了。
The chairman is back in the saddle after his heart attack.  心脏病愈之后，主席又重新掌权了。noun
She saddled (up) the horse for her friend.  她为朋友备好了马鞍。verb transitive
The audience was very partisan, and refused to listen to her speech.  听众的党派观念很强，拒绝听她的演讲。

I've always been prone to headaches.  我总是容易头痛。
He was prone to depressions even as a teenager.  甚至在青少年时期他就容易情绪抑郁。
She's prone to exaggerate, that's for sure.  她喜欢夸大其词，这一点是肯定的。UK adjective

Few observers believe that the treaty will bring a lasting peace to the region.  没有几个观察家认为该条约会给该地区带来持久的和平。
Did any of your teachers make a lasting impression on you?  有没有哪位老师给你留下了深刻的印象？
The tablets make you feel better for a while but the effect isn't (long-) lasting.  这种药片能让你感觉好一些，但药效不会持久。

There is abundant evidence that cars have a harmful effect on the environment.  有充分证据显示，汽车对环境有害。
Cheap consumer goods are abundant (= exist in large amounts) in this part of the world.  在这个地区，大量的低廉消费品充斥其间。

Can you hold this nail in position while I hammer it into the door?  你能托住这颗钉子，好让我把它钉进门里吗？
My car's got a dent, and I was hoping they'd be able to hammer it out (= remove it by hammering).  我的车上有一处凹痕，我希望他们能把它敲平。UK verb
He hammered the ball into the net, giving France a 3-2 win over Italy.  他将球劲射入网，使法国队以3比2战胜了义大利队。UK verb
a formidable obstacle/task  令人生畏的障碍／任务
We went back to Ireland for my uncle's burial.  我们回到爱尔兰参加叔叔的葬礼。

There has been vigorous opposition to the proposals for a new road.  修建一条新路的提议遭到了强烈的反对。
He takes plenty of vigorous exercise.  他做大量的剧烈运动。
Cutting the bush back in the autumn will help promote vigorous growth in the spring.  秋天将灌木丛剪短有利于它在春天茁壮生长。

They've been having marital problems , apparently.  显然他们的婚姻一直有问题。
humorous You can't expect to live in a state of marital bliss.  你别指望婚姻会一直美满。

words.meaning: v.使相等，使平衡；n.泰然自若，镇定
words.example:
He looked embarrassed for a moment, then quickly regained his poise.  他一时间显得尴尬，但很快又恢复了平静。
Her confidence and poise show that she is a top model.  她的自信与镇定显示她是一个十分优秀的模特儿。

The world is now producing large food surpluses.  世界上目前生产的食品大大过剩。
We are unlikely to produce any surplus this year.  我们今年不太可能有任何盈余。
The government has authorized the army to sell its surplus weapons.  政府已经授权军队出售多余的武器。

The police said that this was one of the most vicious attacks they'd ever seen.  警方说这是他们所见过的最为残暴的袭击之一。
He gave her a vicious look.  他恶狠狠地瞪了她一眼。
I've got a vicious headache.  我头痛得厉害。

The alarm emits infra-red rays which are used to detect any intruder.  警报器能发出红外线探测入侵者。
The machine emits a high-pitched sound when you press the button.  一按这个按钮，机器就会发出尖厉的鸣叫声。
the pharmaceutical industry  制药业
a prototype for/of a new car  新型轿车的原型

It was at the Taylors' party that I first made his acquaintance (= first met him).  我是在泰勒家的聚会上初次和他相识的。
Sadly, my acquaintance with Spanish literature is rather limited.  可惜，我对西班牙文学所知相当有限。noun
I'm afraid I have only a nodding acquaintance with his works.  恐怕我对他作品的了解只是皮毛而已。

At school she had complete contempt for all her teachers.  在学校读书时她对所有老师都不屑一顾。
You should treat those remarks with the contempt that they deserve.  你理应对那些话不屑一顾。
She's beneath contempt (= I have no respect for her) !  她为人所不齿！

You'll have ample opportunity to ask questions after the talk.  演讲结束后你们会有足够的时间提问。
There's ample evidence that the lawyer knew exactly what she was doing.  有充分的证据显示，该律师十分清楚她自己在做甚么。
They had ample warning of the factory closure.  对于工厂的倒闭，他们早就得到了大量警告。adjective
They recently ran a series of tests to measure the efficacy of the drug.  他们最近进行了一系列的试验来检测这种药的功效。

"Rubbish!" he exclaimed in disgust.  “废话！”他充满厌恶地大声说。
She exclaimed in delight upon hearing the news.  她听到这个消息高兴得大叫。
The kids are watching television in the den.  孩子们正在活动室里看电视。noun countable

The match has been cancelled due to adverse weather conditions.  由于天气恶劣，这场比赛已被取消。
They received a lot of adverse publicity/criticism about the changes.  这些变化为他们招致种种负面报导／非议。
So far the drug is thought not to have any adverse effects.  迄今为止，人们一直认为这种药物没有任何副作用。

Ann makes delicious pastry - you should try her apple pie.  安做的糕点很好吃——你应该尝尝她做的苹果派。
We were offered a selection of cakes and pastries with our tea.  我们喝茶时有几种蛋糕和茶点可以挑选。

words.meaning: a.(贬)偏狭的，守旧的，过时的
words.example: The majority of young professionals in the capital have moved there from provincial towns.  大多数在首都工作的年轻职业人口都来自外省城镇。

The threat of attack has been greatly exaggerated.  遭受袭击的威胁被过分夸大了。
Don't exaggerate - it wasn't that expensive.  不要言过其实——没有那么贵。
I'm not exaggerating - it was the worst meal I've ever eaten in my life.  我不是在夸大其词——那是我这辈子吃过最难吃的饭。

words.meaning: n.拱门，拱形   v.使成拱形
words.example:
In many churches the side aisles are separated from the central aisle by a row of arches.  很多教堂中，侧廊与主廊之间都有一排拱门相隔。
Passing through the arch, you enter an open courtyard.  穿过拱门，你就到了天井中。
She's got very high arches.  她足弓很高。UK verb intransitive or transitive
She was chuckling as she read the letter.  她一边看信一边偷笑。

words.meaning: n.沼泽；v.使陷入，使忙得不可开交；淹没
words.example:
The Everglades are an area of swamp in southern Florida.  佛罗里达大湿地是佛罗里达州南部的一片沼泽地区。UK verb
High tides have swamped the coast.  高涨的潮水淹没了海岸。
The boat was swamped by an enormous wave.  小船被巨浪吞没了。UK verb

words.meaning: v. 破坏；使受挫；使羞愧
words.example:
I've been dashing around all day.  我一整天都在东奔西跑。
The tidal wave dashed the ship against the rocks.  潮汐把那艘船抛向岩石。
Waves dashed against the cliffs.  海浪拍击悬崖。verb

They were digging up worms to use for bait.  他们在挖虫子制饵。
We put down some poisoned bait to kill the rats.  我们放了一些毒饵灭鼠。noun
Free holidays were offered as (a) bait to customers.  以免费渡假来吸引顾客。

words.meaning: a.深思熟虑的;故意的；v.慎重考虑
words.example:
We made a deliberate decision to live apart for a while.  经过慎重考虑，我们决定分开居住一段时间。
From her slow, deliberate speech I guessed she must be drunk.  她说话慢吞吞的，我猜她肯定喝醉了。verb intransitive or transitive /dɪˈlɪb.ə.reɪt/    formal
The jury took five days to deliberate on the case.  陪审团花了五天时间对此案进行了慎重讨论。

They have put an embargo on imports of clothing.  他们已经禁止进口服装。
The police asked for a news embargo while they tried to find the kidnapper.  员警要求在他们搜捕绑架者期间，停止相关的新闻报道。UK verb transitive
They are planning to embargo oil imports.  他们正在计划禁止石油进口。

The war memorial was erected in 1950.  这座战争纪念碑建于1950年。
The soldiers had erected barricades to protect themselves.  士兵们筑起了街垒用以自卫。verb transitive formal
They erected a marquee to accommodate 500 wedding guests.  他们搭起了一个大帐篷以接待参加婚礼的500位客人。adjective

Medieval knights took an oath of allegiance/loyalty to their lord.  中世纪骑士宣誓效忠于君主。
The witness placed her hand on the Bible and took the oath (= promised to tell the truth).  证人将手放在《圣经》上，起誓要讲真话。
The judge reminded the witness that she was under oath.  法官提醒证人她宣过誓要据实作证。UK noun countable

Pregnant women often suffer from iron deficiency.  孕妇常常缺铁。
Deficiencies in the education system have been much in the news.  新闻媒体对教育体制的种种不足进行了大量的报道。

words.meaning: v.发出眩目光芒；怒目而视
words.example:
She gave me a fierce glare.  她狠狠瞪了我一眼。UK noun
Tinted windows will cut down the glare/the sun's glare.  有色玻璃窗会遮挡刺眼的阳光。
This screen gives off a lot of glare.  这种萤幕发出的光太刺眼。UK noun

The owner's name and address is stored on a microchip and implanted in the dog's body.  主人的姓名和地址都储存在晶片中，然后植入犬只体内。    Compare transplantUK verb transitive
He implanted some very strange attitudes in his children.  他向他的孩子灌输了一些奇怪的看法。
There is much debate on the issue of "therapists" implanting false memories of sexual abuse in adults.  有些“治疗师”向成年人植入有关性虐待的虚假记忆，对此人们争论不休。UK noun countable UK US [-plænt/

words.meaning: n.模糊不清的事物；v.使„模糊
words.example:
If I don't wear my glasses, everything is just a blur.  如果不戴眼镜，我看任何东西都是模糊的。
It all happened so long ago that it's just a blur to me now.  这件事发生在很久以前，我现在记不清了。
The last few days seem to have gone by in a blur.  过去几天似乎是在恍恍惚惚中度过的。UK verb intransitive or transitive (-rr-)
organic fertilizer  有机肥料

This film is vintage (= has the best characteristics typical of films made by) Disney.  这是一部经典的迪士尼影片。
She loves buying vintage clothing.  她喜欢买高档时装。UK adjective
The 1983 vintage was one of the best.  1983年酿制的酒是最好的酒之一。

The sun was shining straight in her eyes which made her squint.  阳光刺眼，她不得不眯起了眼睛。noun countable
As a child she wore thick glasses and had a bad squint.  她小时候戴着厚厚的眼镜，还有严重的斜视。noun countable

We do not differentiate between our workers on the basis of their background or ethnic origin.  我们不会因工人的背景或种族不同而区别对待。verb
The slate roof differentiates this house from others in the area.  石板瓦屋顶使这座房子在该地区与众不同。

Two writers collaborated on the script for the film.  两位作家合写了这部电影的剧本。
The British and Italian police collaborated in catching the terrorists.  英国警方和义大利警方通力合作，抓住了恐怖分子。verb intransitive
Anyone who was suspected of collaborating with the occupying forces was arrested.  任何涉嫌与占领军勾结的人都被逮捕了。
the remnants of last night's meal  昨晚的剩饭

Dentists use cement to hold crowns and bridges in place.  牙医用黏固剂固定住齿冠和齿桥。verb transitive
The university's exchange scheme has cemented its links with many other academic institutions.  这所大学的交流计划加强了它与许多其他学术机构的联系。

We each have a separate bedroom but share a communal kitchen.  我们各有一间独立的卧室，但共用一个厨房。
Communal riots/disturbances have once again broken out between the two ethnic groups.  两个种族之间再次爆发了骚乱。
French cuisine  法式烹饪

She seems to regard any advice or help from me as interference.  她似乎把我的任何建议或帮助都看作是干涉。
The government's interference in the strike has been widely criticized.  政府对罢工的干预措施受到了广泛的批评。

How long does it take for the chicks to grow to maturity?  小鸡要多久才能长大？UK noun uncountable
The investment reaches maturity after ten years.  这项投资十年后开始获利。

words.meaning: v.损坏，破坏；溺爱(尤指儿童)
words.example:
He tried not to let the bad news spoil his evening.  他努力不让那个坏消息破坏他晚上的兴致。
The oil spill has spoilt the whole beautiful coastline.  溢出的石油破坏了整段漂亮的海岸线。
You'll spoil your appetite for dinner if you have a cake now.  你要是现在吃蛋糕的话，就没胃口吃晚饭了。

Sailors have special equipment to help them navigate.  船员们借助专门的仪器确定航向。
Even ancient ships were able to navigate large stretches of open water.  即使是古老的船只，也能在宽阔的大片水域中航行。
Some migrating birds can navigate by the moon (= using the moon as a guide).  有些迁徙的鸟类可以借助月亮确定方向。
He looks robust and healthy enough.  他看起来非常强壮健康。

They have added/deleted/amended a clause in the contract which says the company can make people redundant for economic reasons.  他们在合同中增加／删除／修改了一项条款，该条款称公司可以因为经济原因裁减人员。
Clause 4 of the constitution is thought to be the most important section.  宪法第四条被认为是最重要的部分。UK US  specialized
In the sentence 'I can't cook very well but I make quite good omelettes', both 'I can't cook very well' and 'I make quite good omelettes' are main/independent clauses (= they are of equal importance and could each exist as a separate sentence).  在 I can't cook very well but I make quite good omelettes（我菜烧得不太好，可是蛋饼煎得很不错）这句话中，I can't cook very well 和 I make quite good omelettes 都是主句／独立分句。

words.meaning: a.(对事业，本职工作等)尽忠的
words.example: We are committed to withdrawing our troops by the end of the year.  我们承诺将于年底前撤军。
She bitterly resented her father's new wife.  她对她父亲新娶的妻子恨之入骨。

The cherry tree is beginning to blossom.  樱桃树开始开花了。
She has really blossomed recently.  她近来确实变得惹人喜爱了。
She is suddenly blossoming into a very attractive woman.  她突然出落成了一位很有魅力的女子。

She has a real temper.  她很容易发脾气。
He's got a really bad temper.  他的脾气真坏。
The children behaved so badly that I lost my temper.  孩子们太不懂规矩，我不由得发了火。

She wore a green wool suit with matching accessories (= shoes, hat, bag, etc.).  她身穿一套绿色羊毛套装，全身的配饰都是跟它配套的。
Sunglasses are much more than a fashion accessory.  太阳镜不仅仅是时尚的装饰品。
Accessories for the top-of-the-range car include leather upholstery, a CD player, electric windows and a sunroof.  顶级轿车的配置包括真皮座椅、CD播放机、电动窗以及活动车顶。UK noun

words.meaning: a.琐碎的，不重要的；小心眼的，气量小的
words.example:
Prisoners complain that they are subjected to too many petty rules and restrictions.  犯人抱怨他们受到太多繁文缛节的管制。
Don't be so petty!  别这么小心眼！

Why are people so obsessed with money?  人们为甚么对金钱如此着迷？
As a society we're obsessed by sex.  性这一问题困扰着整个社会。
The new range of engines all had a generic problem with their fan blades.  这一新系列的引擎有一个通病，就是风机叶片有问题。

He ordered the massacre of 2, 000 women and children.  他下令屠杀了2000名妇女和儿童。
The changes to the team come after their 7-2 massacre in the final.  决赛中以2比7惨败后，球队作了些调整。UK verb transitive
Hundreds of civilians were massacred in the raid.  数百平民在那次袭击中惨遭杀戮。

Rising consumer sales have the effect of spurring the economy to faster growth.  消费的成长有刺激经济加速发展的作用。
Spurred (on) by her early success, she went on to write four more novels in rapid succession.  受到之前成功的鼓励，她紧接着又连续写了四部小说。UK verb transitive (-rr-)
The manager said that the team's win on Saturday would be a spur to even greater effort this season.  主教练说球队周六的胜利将会激励全队在本赛季中有更好的表现。UK noun countable
a prestigious literary award  颇具声望的文学奖
the trenches of World War I  第一次世界大战时的战壕

words.meaning: n.口哨，口哨声；汽笛声；v.吹口哨
words.example:
He whistled as he worked.  他一边工作一边吹口哨。
On the days when she wore a skirt the men on the building site would whistle at her.  那些天她穿了裙子，建筑工地的男人们一见到她就向她吹口哨。
Someone was whistling Beatles tunes outside my window.  有人在我窗外用口哨吹着甲壳虫乐队的曲子。

We found an old sheep skeleton up on the cliffs.  我们在悬崖上发现了一副老绵羊的骨架。
figurative Her long illness reduced her to a skeleton (= made her very thin).  长期的疾病使她瘦得只剩皮包骨了。
The skeleton of my book is written/My book is in skeleton form - now I just have to add the details.  我的书已经有了架构——现在我只需要添加细节了。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.(鱼等)卵子；v.大量生产；产卵
words.example:
disapproving She started screaming that I was a spawn of Satan because I was smoking a cigarette.  她开始尖叫着说，我是魔鬼之子，因为我抽烟。UK verb
The new economic freedom has spawned hundreds of new small businesses.  新的经济自由催生了上百家新的小企业。
Her death spawned countless films and books.  她的去世促成了无数电影和书籍面世。UK verb

words.meaning: n.(尤指军队)值班表，执勤人员名单
words.example: If you look on the duty roster, you'll see when you're working.  你看看勤务簿就知道甚么时候该你上班了。

These new bullets are capable of inflicting massive injuries.  这些新型子弹可以造成重创。
The suffering inflicted on these children was unimaginable.  这些孩子遭受的痛苦无法想像。

For the last ten years of his life he was clinically insane.  在生命的最后十年，他处于临床上的精神失常状态。
informal I sometimes think I'm going insane (= I feel very confused).  我有时觉得自己快要疯了。
In a fit of insane jealousy he tried to stab her.  在一阵疯狂的嫉妒中，他试图用刀捅她。plural noun

There was a marked improvement in my health when I gave up smoking.  戒烟后我的健康有了明显的改善。
Unemployment has fallen again, although the change is less marked than last month.  失业率再度下降，尽管降幅没有上个月般明显。
The president spoke with passion for an hour, in marked contrast to his subdued address to the parliament yesterday.  总统慷慨激昂地讲了一个小时，与昨天在议会上低声平和的发言形成了鲜明的对比。

words.meaning: a. 多泥的；浑浊的，不纯的
words.example:
Don't bring those muddy boots inside!  别把那双黏满烂泥的鞋子拿进来！
The sitting-room has been painted in muddy browns and greens.  客厅漆成灰暗的棕色和绿色。verb transitive
Industrial activity has muddied the river.  工业生产活动使这条河变得浑浊了。verb transitive

words.meaning: n.三重奏，三重唱；三人小组
words.example:
There was disappointment for our trio of 200 metre runners, all of whom failed to reach the final.  我们参加200米跑的三位选手都令人很失望，没有一个进入决赛。
Many jazz trios consist of a piano, guitar and double bass.  许多爵士三重奏均由钢琴、吉他和低音提琴组成。
The final item in today's programme is Beethoven's Trio in B flat, Opus 11.  今天的最后一个曲目是贝多芬的三重奏曲，降B调，作品第11号。

words.meaning: n. 渡船，渡口；v. 运送
words.example:
We're going across to France by / on the ferry.  我们正在坐渡船去法国。
We took the ferry to Calais.  我们乘渡船去了加莱。verb transitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: n. 杠杆作用；力量上的优势
words.example: If the United Nations had more troops in the area, it would have greater leverage.  如果联合国在该地区有更多的军队，就会有更大的影响力。UK noun uncountable

The floor's still sticky where I spilled the juice.  我把果汁洒到地上，现在那里还黏乎乎的。
The children's faces were sticky with chocolate.  孩子们的脸上沾满了巧克力，黏乎乎的。    Compare non-stick ; stuck
There were a few sticky moments during the meeting, but everything turned out all right in the end.  会议过程中有几处困难，但最后总算是一切顺利。adjective

The whole region is in turmoil.  整个地区一片混乱。
The country is in a state of political turmoil.  该国正处于政治动荡。
The Stock Exchange is in turmoil following a huge wave of selling.  经历了一场抛售狂潮后，股市正处于动荡之中。

The president's speech was greeted by sustained applause.  总统的演讲博得了久久不绝的掌声。
We must make a sustained effort to get this task finished this week.  我们必须坚持不懈，争取在本周完成这项任务。

words.meaning: a.上升的；v.确定方向；使熟悉情况

words.example: You have to go through an initiation rite before you become a full member.  你得完成入会仪式才能成为正式会员。

In the case of the guinea pig, the number of offspring varies between two and five.  以豚鼠为例，它一胎产2到5个幼仔。
Tom's sister came round on Saturday with her numerous offspring.  汤姆的姐姐星期六带着她的一大群子女过来串门。

These old photographs should go in the family archives.  这些老照片应收入家庭档案里。
I've been studying village records in the local archive.  我一直在当地的档案馆中研究村庄的史料。
This software helps firms archive and retrieve emails.  这种软体有助于公司更便捷地封存和检索电子邮件。

Mrs Maple is a pillar of the local church.  梅普尔夫人是当地教会的中坚分子。
Equality is one of the pillars of socialism.  平等是社会主义理论的重要组成部分之一。UK noun countable
My parents were always on the move and so my childhood was spent being dragged from pillar to post.  父母总是不停地搬家，所以我的童年是在四处迁移中度过的。

She adhered to her principles/ideals throughout her life.  她终生对自己的原则／理想忠贞不渝。
They failed to adhere to the terms of the agreement/treaty.  他们没有遵守协议／条约的条款。
The translator has obviously adhered very strictly to the original text.  显然，译者严格忠实于原文。

Make sure you are given a receipt for everything you buy.  买甚么东西都一定记着要发票。noun
Goods will be delivered on receipt of payment (= after the money is received).  款到即发货。
You have been in receipt of unemployment benefit for two months.  你领失业救济金已经两个月了。

Two influential senators have argued for the retention of the unpopular tax.  两位有影响的参议员主张保留这项不得人心的税收。
The retention of old technology has slowed the company's growth.  死守着旧技术不放减缓了这家公司的发展。
Naval gunfire and ground-based artillery are generally less accurate than many aircraft-borne weapons.  一般而言，许多空投武器都要比军舰炮火和地面炮火精确度高。

We chose some curtains with a flower motif.  我们选择了一些带花卉图案的窗帘。UK noun countable
The motif of betrayal is crucial in all these stories.  在所有这些故事中背叛是至关重要的主题。
They decided to postpone their holiday until next year.  他们决定将假期延后到来年。

There's a lot of contention about that issue - for every person firmly in favour, there's someone fiercely against it.  那个问题争议很多——有一人坚决支持，就有一人激烈反对。
The matter has been settled - it's no longer in contention.  这个问题已经解决——不再有争议。noun]kənˈtent.ʃən/
This decisive defeat puts them out of contention for this year's championship finals.  这次决定性的失利使他们无缘进入今年的冠军决赛。
What relevance does that point have to the discussion?  那一点和我们正在讨论的议题有甚么相关性吗？    Opposite irrelevance

Light travels at the highest achievable velocity in the universe.  光的传播速度是宇宙中物体所能达到的最高速度。
He always used high velocity lead bullets in his rifle.  他的步枪一直使用高速铅弹。

It is sometimes difficult to reconcile science and religion.  有时很难调和宗教和科学之间的矛盾。
It's difficult to reconcile such different points of view.  差别如此悬殊的观点是很难达成一致的。
How can you reconcile your fur coat and/with your love of animals?  如果你爱动物，那怎么还穿毛皮大衣呢？

The City of London is the hub of Britain's financial world.  伦敦城是英国金融业的中心。
The computer department is at the hub of the company's operations.  电脑部是这家公司运作的枢纽。noun countable
a first class compartment  头等包厢

words.meaning: n. 狂怒，狂暴，激烈；狂怒的人
words.example:
He could hardly contain his fury.  他几乎克制不住自己的愤怒。
She flew into a fury at the suggestion.  这个建议使她勃然大怒。UK noun [S or U]
I've been working like fury these past few days to catch up.  过去的这几天里我一直奋力工作以求赶上进度。

His jokes seemed spontaneous, but were in fact carefully prepared beforehand.  他讲的笑话看似即兴的，但实际上是事先精心准备好的。
approving She's such a spontaneous, lively woman.  她是个为人率直、充满活力的女子。
an asthma sufferer  哮喘病患者

She claimed that the rise in unemployment was just a further manifestation of the government's incompetence.  她声称失业率上升进一步表明了政府的无能。
Unlike acid rain or deforestation, global warming has no visible manifestation.  不同于酸雨和森林砍伐，全球暖化并没有明显可见的表像。

words.meaning: a.(外表)如死般僵硬的；完全的
words.example:
It was a stark room with its white walls, and a bed and chair as the only furniture.  这个房间很简陋，家徒四壁，仅有的家俱就是一张床和一把椅子。
The stark reality is that we are operating at a huge loss.  严酷的事实是我们的经营亏损非常严重。
In the suburbs the spacious houses stand in stark contrast to the slums of the city's poor.  郊区宽敞的大房子和城里的贫民窟形成了鲜明的对比。UK adverb
Protesters cut a hole in the perimeter fence.  抗议人士在周围的栅栏上破开了一个洞。

He was recently fitted with a brace for his bad back.  他最近因背部受伤戴了一个支撑架。
The side wall of the old house was braced with a wooden support.  老房子的边墙用木结构加固了。verb transitive
The passengers were told to brace themselves (= to press their bodies hard against something or hold them very stiff) for a crash landing.  乘客们被告知要做好紧急迫降准备。

The shepherd is bringing his flock down from the hills.  牧羊人正把他的羊群往山下赶。
The vicar invited all the members of his flock (= all the people who go to his church) to attend the special service.  牧师邀请教区的所有信徒参加这一特别仪式。UK noun
Hundreds of people flocked to the football match.  数百人蜂拥前来观看足球比赛。
He was found guilty of possessing an unlicensed firearm.  他被判犯了无证持枪罪。

There's such rivalry among/between my three sons.  我的三个儿子相互较劲，闹得不可开交。
There's fierce rivalry for the job/ to get the job.  很多人想要得到这份工作，竞争非常激烈。

Food and fuel prices are very volatile in a war situation.  战争时期食品和燃料的价格极易波动。
The situation was made more volatile by the fact that people had been drinking a lot of alcohol.  人们一直在大喝烈酒，这让情况变得更加不稳定。
He had a rather volatile temper and can't have been easy to live with.  他的脾气十分暴躁，别人很难与他相处。

The Reverend William Cronshaw delivered/preached the sermon.  威廉‧克朗肖牧师进行了布道。
Today's sermon was on the importance of compassion.  今天的布道是关于同情心的重要性。

He fell at the last hurdle.  他在最后一个跨栏处摔倒。
She cleared (= jumped over) all the hurdles easily and raced to the finishing line.  她轻松地跨过所有栏架到达终点。
Getting a work permit was the first hurdle to overcome.  取得工作许可证是要解决的第一个难题。
They put up a sturdy defence of their proposal.  他们坚定地为自己的提议辩护。

There are no definitive answers/solutions to this problem.  这个问题没有彻底的解决办法。
The police have no definitive proof of her guilt.  员警并未掌握她犯罪的确凿证据。
He's written the definitive (= best and most complete) guide to Britain's Lake District.  他写出了最完美的英国湖区指南。

The Kon-Tiki sailed across the Pacific Ocean propelled by wind power.  “太阳号”草船借助风力横渡了太平洋。
The film propelled him to international stardom.  这部电影使他成为了国际巨星。
My original statement has been completely distorted by the media.  我最初的说法被媒体彻底歪曲了。

words.meaning: n.小铲，勺子；v.(用勺子)取出，舀出
words.example:
Just one scoop of mashed potato for me, please.  请给我一球马铃薯泥就够了。noun countable
The paper managed to secure a major scoop and broke the scandal to the world.  这家报纸设法抢先报道了重要的独家新闻，把这件丑闻公诸于世。verb transitive
He scooped the sand into a bucket with his hands.  他用手把沙子舀进桶里。

The local police took swift action against the squatters.  当地警方对擅自占地者采取了迅速的行动。
Thank you for your swift reply.  感谢您的即时回覆。
The gazelle is one of the swiftest and most graceful of animals.  瞪羚是最敏捷、最优雅的动物之一。noun countable

words.meaning: v.隐伏跟踪，悄悄接近(猎物)
words.example:
She trimmed the stalks of the tulips before putting them in a vase.  她修剪了一下郁金香的花梗，然后把它们插进了花瓶。
The eyes of shrimps are on movable stalks.  虾的眼睛长在能够活动的肉柄上。UK noun countable
His eyes were out on stalks as he watched his neighbour drive past in a brand new Porsche.  看到邻居开着一辆崭新的保时捷经过时，他吃惊得瞪大了眼睛。UK verb
They were intimidated into accepting a pay cut by the threat of losing their jobs.  他们因为受到失去工作的威胁而被迫同意减薪。

They set up camp on the verge of the desert.  他们在沙漠边缘扎下了营地。
She left her car by the side of the road and walked along the grass verge to the emergency phone.  她把车停在公路旁，沿着长满草的路边走到了紧急电话亭。UK noun countable
Her husband's violent and abusive behaviour drove her to the verge of despair.  她丈夫的暴力和虐待行为将她逼到了近乎绝望的境地。UK verb

words.meaning: n.瘟疫；讨厌的人或物；v.烦扰(尤指一再询问或要求)
words.example:
Financial problems have been plaguing their new business partners.  财务问题一直困扰着他们的新业务伙伴。
My shoulder's been plaguing me all week.  我的肩膀整个星期都很难受。
The children plagued him with questions all through lunch.  吃午餐时孩子不停地问他问题，使他感到烦厌。

The cook brought in a fresh batch of homemade cakes.  那位厨师带来了一炉刚刚烤好的自制蛋糕。
We looked at the job applications in two batches.  我们把那些求职申请分两批浏览了一遍。

words.meaning: n.鞋带，系带；网眼花边，透孔织品
words.example:
Your shoe laces are undone.  你的鞋带没有系好。verb transitive
She can lace up her shoes and she's only five!  她才五岁就能自己系鞋带！

These measures are designed to deter an enemy attack.  这些措施旨在阻止敌人的进攻。
High prices are deterring many young people from buying houses.  高昂的价格让很多年轻人对于买房屋望而却步。

Our television license expires next month.  我们的电视下个月到期要缴费了。
The contract between the two companies will expire at the end of the year.  两间公司之间的合约将在年底到期。UK verb intransitive

They work in adjacent buildings.  他们在相邻的两座楼里工作。
They lived in a house adjacent to the railway.  他们家住在铁路旁边。

They were warned of the ecological catastrophe to come.  警告过他们生态灾难即将来临。
The emigration of scientists is a catastrophe for the country.  大量科学家移居国外对这个国家大为不利。

During the trial, the prosecution was accused of withholding crucial evidence from the defence.  审判期间，原告被指控对被告隐瞒了十分重要的证据。
Police are withholding the dead woman's name until her relatives have been informed.  在通知女性死者的亲属之前，警方拒绝透露她的名字。
She withheld her rent until the landlord agreed to have the repairs done.  她拒付房租，直到房东答应进行维修。
intricately carved ivory earrings  精雕细琢的象牙耳饰

If the heavy rain had coincided with an extreme high tide, serious flooding would have resulted.  如果暴雨来临时潮水汹涌，就会导致严重的水灾。
Our views coincide on a range of subjects.  我们在一系列问题上的观点不谋而合。
If our schedules coincide, we'll go to Spain together.  如果我们的排程一致，就能一起去西班牙。

The best films are those which transcend national or cultural barriers.  最优秀的影片是那些超越了民族或文化障碍的影片。
The underlying message of the film is that love transcends everything else.  这部电影内在的中心意旨是爱超越其他一切。
The merger proved to be very lucrative for both companies.  事实证明，这次兼并使两间公司都获利丰厚。

Several little boats escorted the sailing ship into the harbour.  在数只小船的护航下，帆船驶入海港。
Security guards escorted the intruders from the building.  保安把闯入者押送出了大楼。
The police escorted her to the airport, and made sure that she left the country.  员警将她押送到机场，确保其离境。

an old man dressed in rags.  衣衫褴褛的老人
Their clothes were in rags (= torn).  他们的衣服又破又旧。noun countable
He had his picture taken for some local rag.  他为一家地方小报拍了照片。noun countable

words.meaning: v.(因能量不足而)使停止，使延迟
words.example:
In the village market, the stalls are piled high with local vegetables.  村子市集的摊位上高高堆着当地产的蔬菜。UK noun
There was one bathroom with a shower stall in the corner.  有一个洗手间，角落里有个淋浴的小隔间。UK noun
She says she'll give me the money next week but I think she's just stalling (for time).  她说下周会把钱给我，但我认为她只不过是在拖时间。
The United States and Canada have signed a free-trade pact.  美国和加拿大签署了自由贸易协定。

Have you managed to elicit a response from them yet?  你设法得到他们的回覆了吗？
The questionnaire was intended to elicit information on eating habits.  该调查问卷旨在收集人们饮食习惯方面的资讯。
They were able to elicit the support of the public.  他们获得了大众的支持。

She always wore a long-sleeved thermal vest in winter.  她冬天总是穿一件长袖保暖内衣。
The cyclists were all dressed in tight lycra shorts and the official team vest.  自行车运动员全都穿着紧身弹力短裤和正式的运动队背心。
He wore a vest top and a pair of luminous shorts to the beach party.  他穿着背心和鲜艳的短裤去参加海滩聚会。

There was a bust of Mahler on his desk.  他书桌上有一尊马勒的半身像。noun countable
In their latest drugs bust police entered a warehouse where cocaine dealers were meeting.  在最近的毒品搜捕行动中，警方突袭了一个海洛因毒贩正在进行交易的仓库。verb transitive (bust or US busted, bust or US busted)
Oh no! I've bust his CD player.  噢，不好！我弄坏了他的CD唱机。verb transitive (bust or US busted, bust or US busted)

Nobody really knows what the marks on the ancient stones signify.  没人真正知道那些古老石头上的记号代表甚么含意。
She signified her agreement by nodding her head.  她点头表示同意。
Don't worry about being late - it doesn't signify.  别担心迟到——不要紧。

More money is needed to bolster the industry.  需要更多的钱来扶持该行业。
She tried to bolster my confidence/morale (= encourage me and make me feel stronger) by telling me that I had a special talent.  她说我有特别的才能，想要增强我的信心。
They need to do something to bolster their image.  他们需要设法改善他们的形象。UK noun countable

The law obliges companies to pay decent wages to their employees.  法律强制公司向其雇员支付适当的工资。
Sellers are not legally obliged to accept the highest offer.  法律没有强制卖主必须接受最高的出价。verb
We only went to the party to oblige some old friends who especially asked us to be there.  我们去参加这个聚会只是为了照顾一些老朋友的面子，他们特意要求我们到场。
We sat in the garden hulling strawberries.  我们坐在园子里摘除草莓蒂。

The company has gained international prestige.  该公司赢得了国际声誉。
Many people are attracted by the prestige of working for a top company.  在一家一流公司工作令人羡慕，很多人因此被吸引了。adjective [before noun]

The mountains form a dramatic backdrop to the little village.  群山如画，映衬着小山村。
Their love affair began against a backdrop of war.  他们的爱情故事在战争年代开始。

words.meaning: a.振动的；(颜色)鲜明的，明快的；生机勃勃的
words.example:
The hope is that this area will develop into a vibrant commercial centre.  希望这个地区会发展成为一个活跃的商业中心。
He always uses vibrant colours in his paintings.  他在画中经常运用鲜艳的色彩。
I'm particularly interested in the linguistic development of young children.  我对幼儿语言能力的发展尤其感兴趣。

Tomato sauce stains terribly - it's really difficult to get it out of clothes.  蕃茄酱一沾上就很麻烦——很难把它从衣服上洗掉。
While she was changing the wheel on her car, her coat had become stained with oil.  她帮汽车换轮胎时，外套沾上了油污。
This carpet is ideal for the kitchen because it doesn't stain easily.  这块地毯很适合在厨房里用，因为它很耐脏（不怕脏）。

words.meaning: a.(尤指不愉快的事)即将发生的，逼近的
words.example: imminent disaster/danger  迫在眉睫的灾难／危险

words.meaning: n.钝剑；箔，锡箔纸；v.阻止，挫败
words.example:
The older, cynical character in the play is the perfect foil for the innocent William.  剧中年迈、愤世嫉俗的人物角色正好衬托出威廉的天真单纯。noun
The prisoners' attempt to escape was foiled at the last minute when police received a tip-off.  由于警方收到密报，囚犯的越狱企图在最后一刻被挫败。

The road system was so complicated that we had to stop to get our bearings several times.  路线非常复杂，好几次使我们不得不停下来确定方位。
It takes a while to get your bearings when you start a new job.  刚开始做一份工作时，需要花上一段时间才能适应新环境。
They lost their bearings in the dark.  他们在黑暗中迷路了。

There was an extremely animated discussion on the subject.  这个话题引起了极其热烈的讨论。
They must have been having an interesting conversation - they both looked very animated.  他们一定是在进行甚么有趣的谈话，两人看上去都兴致勃勃的。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.路缘，(街道的)镶边石；马勒；v.控制
words.example:
The Government should act to curb tax evasion.  政府应该采取行动抑制逃税。UK noun countable
You must try to put a curb on your bad temper/spending habits.  你必须尽量控制你的坏脾气／挥霍无度的习惯。UK noun countable
She saw him coming and crouched (down) behind a bush.  看见他来了，她便蜷伏在一簇灌木丛后面。

The Spanish conquered the New World in the 16th century.  西班牙人在16世纪征服了新大陆。
The English were conquered by the Normans in 1066.  诺曼人于1066年征服了英格兰人。
He has finally conquered his fear of spiders.  他终于战胜了对蜘蛛的恐惧。
the enduring appeal of cartoons  卡通片历久不衰的魅力

He interpreted her comments as an implicit criticism of the government.  他将她的评论理解为对政府的含蓄批评。
Implicit in the poem's closing lines are the poet's own religious doubts.  在这首诗最后几行中隐含着诗人自己的宗教疑虑。    Compare explicitadjective
All her life she had implicit faith in socialism.  她一生都对社会主义坚信不疑。
My boss is a bit of a dictator.  我的老板是个有点独断专行的人。

She flung open the window and inhaled deeply.  她打开窗户，深深地吸了口气。
She became ill shortly after inhaling the fumes.  她吸入浓烟后不久就生病了。    Compare exhaleverb
Tony inhaled his burger.  托尼狼吞虎咽地吃汉堡。
Circulars and other junk mail go straight in the bin.  传单和其他的垃圾邮件直接扔进垃圾桶。
When the air raid siren went off people ran to their shelters.  空袭警报响起时，人们纷纷跑向掩蔽所。UK noun countable

words.meaning: a.疲劳的，令人厌倦的；v.厌烦
words.example:
Here, sit down and rest your weary legs.  来，坐下歇歇脚。
I've been going out with the same people to the same clubs for years and I've just grown weary of it.  多年来一直和同一批人去同一所俱乐部，我已经开始感到厌倦了。UK verb formal
Children weary me all day with their constant inquiries and demands.  孩子们整天不停地问这要那，真把我累坏了。

The government is allocating £10 million for health education.  政府将拨出1000万英镑作为健康教育经费。
It is not the job of the investigating committee to allocate blame for the disaster/to allocate blame to individuals.  调查委员会的任务不是确定谁该为这场灾难负责任／哪些人应该负责任。

words.meaning: n.矛盾；似矛盾而正确的说法

words.example:
He's so lush.  他真有吸引力。noun countable slang
She's a bit of a lush by all accounts.  不管怎么说她都有点像酒鬼。

The entire organization is funded by charitable donations.  整个组织由慈善捐款资助。
The school has charitable status (= It is officially a charity).  这是一所慈善学校。UK adjective
Some critics said the show was good in parts - those less charitable said the whole thing was a disaster.  有些批评家说演出有些部分还不错——而那些不那么厚道的批评家则说整场演出都糟透了。

Queen Victoria mourned Prince Albert/Prince Albert's death for 40 years.  维多利亚女王为亚伯特亲王的去世服丧40年。
She was still mourning for her brother.  她还在悼念她的哥哥。
They mourned the passing of traditional folk dancing (= felt sad because it had stopped existing).  他们为传统民间舞蹈的消亡而感到痛心。

The siege of Mafeking lasted for eight months.  对马弗京的围攻持续了八个月。
The soldiers laid siege to (= started a siege of) the city.  士兵们包围了这座城市。
The castle was under siege for months.  城堡被围困了数月。

The date for the meeting is now definite: 5th March.  开会的日期现在已经确定了：3月5日。
She has very definite opinions.  她的意见非常明确。
We need a definite answer by tomorrow.  我们需要在明天之前得到明确的答覆。

At the mouth of the river is a large area of marsh.  河口处是一大片沼泽地。
Rain had been falling steadily all day and the ground had become a marsh.  雨整天下个不停，地面成了一片泽国。
At low tide in the estuary, cows graze on the marshes.  河口水位低时，牛就在那里的沼泽地上吃草。

Who would be the best person to preside at/over the public enquiry?  谁来主持大众调查最合适呢？verb intransitive
Judge Langdale is to preside over the official enquiry into the case.  兰代尔法官将主持这个案子的正式调查。
This government has presided over some of the most significant changes in education this century.  本任政府主导了本世纪某些最重大的教育变革。

words.meaning: v.换置；使某人某物离开原位
words.example: The building of a new dam will displace thousands of people who live in this area.  建造新水坝将迫使居住在这一地区的数千人迁往别处。

She felt she had been discriminated against because of her age.  她认为自己受到了年龄歧视。
In order to increase the number of female representatives, the selection committee decided to discriminate in favour of women for three years.  为了增加女性代表的人数，选拔委员会决定在三年内特别礼遇妇女。verb
Police dogs can discriminate between the different smells.  警犬能辨别各种不同的气味。

On the hill, a solitary figure was busy chopping down trees.  山上，有个人正忙着砍树。
In the distance was a solitary building.  远处是一栋孤零零的建筑。
He was a solitary child (= He enjoyed being alone).  他是个喜欢独处的小孩。
The novel deals with the polar opposites of love and hate.  这部小说涉及爱和恨的两个对立面。

It rained the first day but the remainder of the trip was lovely.  旅行中第一天下了雨，不过其余的日子天气都很好。UK noun
His autobiography never sold very well and was soon remaindered.  他的自传一直卖得不太好，过了不久就被削价处理了。

Everyone at the conference wore a badge with their name on.  出席会议的人都戴着写有自己名字的徽章。noun countable
For Tony, owning a big car was a badge of success.  对东尼来说，拥有一辆大房车是成功的象征。

There were whispers that a deal was pending.  有传言说即将达成一笔交易。
The pending releases of the prisoners are meant to create a climate for negotiation.  囚犯即将获释，此目的是要营造一个有利谈判的氛围。preposition formal
The identity of the four people was not made public, pending (the) notification of relatives.  四名受害者的身分要等到家属确认之后才能公开。

words.meaning: a.空的，缺乏的；n.空隙，空处；空虚感
words.example:
She stood at the edge of the chasm and stared into the void.  她站在裂缝的边缘凝视着下面的深渊。
Before Einstein, space was regarded as a formless void.  在爱因斯坦之前，太空被认为是无形的虚空之地。
They tried to describe their attempts to fill the void left by their son's death.  他们竭力想要描述他们曾如何试图填补儿子死后留下的空虚感。adjective

The value of property has slumped.  房产价值突然下跌。
Car sales have slumped dramatically over the past year.  过去一年汽车的销售额大幅下降。verb
She slumped into the chair, exhausted.  她颓然跌坐在椅子上，筋疲力尽。noun countable

words.meaning: v.戏弄性模仿；n.善于模仿他人言行的人
words.example:
She was mimicking the various people in our office.  她在学我们办公室里各人的样子。noun countable
She's a brilliant mimic.  她非常擅长模仿。

When he started fighting, it took four police officers to restrain him.  他要是出手打人，要四个员警才能把他制服。
You should try to restrain your ambitions and be more realistic.  你应该尽量控制自己的野心，更现实一些。
Growth in car ownership could be restrained by increasing taxes.  或许可以透过提高税费来限制汽车保有量的增长。

Hot beverages include tea, coffee and hot chocolate.  热饮包括茶、咖啡和热巧克力。
We do not sell alcoholic beverages.  我们不出售含酒精的饮料。
Put that back, you little pest!  把它放回去，你这个小讨厌鬼！

words.meaning: n.中间时期，过渡时期；a.暂时的
words.example:
An interim government was set up for the period before the country's first free election.  该国在首次自由选举之前的过度时期成立了临时政府。UK noun
The new secretary starts in June, but in the interim we're having to type our own letters.  新秘书六月份开始工作，在此之前我们必须自己打印信件。
The garden strawberry is a large-fruited hybrid.  人工栽种的草莓是一种果实较大的混合品种。

The needle pierces the fabric four times a second.  针穿过布料的速度是每秒钟四次。
The gun fires a shell capable of piercing the armour of an enemy tank.  这种炮所发射的炮弹能打穿敌人坦克的装甲。
The hole they drilled pierces 6 km into the Earth's crust.  他们钻的孔深入地壳六公里。

words.meaning: v.(贬)放纵；满足(不当或不应有的欲望)
words.example:
The soccer fans indulged their patriotism, waving flags and singing songs.  足球迷摇着旗唱着歌，纵情抒发他们的爱国热情。
We took a deliberate decision to indulge in a little nostalgia.  我们特意决定好好追忆一下往事。
My aunt indulges the children dreadfully.  我婶婶太纵容孩子了。

He carefully flicked the loose hairs from the shoulders of his jacket.  他仔细地把落在上衣肩上的头发轻轻弹掉。
She quickly flicked the crumbs off the table.  她迅速地把桌子上的碎屑拂去。
Horses flick their tails to make flies go away.  这些马轻甩尾巴驱赶苍蝇。

She wrote a thriller about a brutal serial killer.  她写了部有关一名冷血连环杀手的惊悚小说。
Most of her novels have been made into television serials at some time.  她的大多数小说都已在某个时候被拍成了电视连续剧。
Ninety per cent of American rubbish is dumped in landfill sites.  美国90%的垃圾都是倾倒进垃圾掩埋场。

His time for the 100 metres surpassed the previous world record by one hundredth of a second.  他以0.01秒的优势打破了100米短跑的前世界纪录。
The book's success has surpassed everyone's expectations.  这本书获得出乎所有人意料的成功。

It's exhausting commuting from Brighton to London every day.  每天上下班要往返于布莱顿与伦敦之间，令人疲惫不堪。verb
People used to believe that you could commute base metals into gold.  人们过去曾认为能将贱金属变成黄金。
Her sentence was commuted from death to life imprisonment.  对她的判决由死刑减为无期徒刑。noun countable informal

He wished he was more muscular.  他希望自己更强壮些。UK adjective
It was a muscular, hard-hitting documentary.  那是一部震撼人心的纪录片。

words.meaning: v.反驳，驳斥；与„矛盾，与„相抵触
words.example:
If you're both going to lie, at least stick to the same story and don't contradict each other!  如果你们俩都要撒谎，至少也要口径一致，不要互相矛盾！
How dare you contradict (me)!  你怎么敢顶撞我！
Recent evidence has tended to contradict established theories on this subject.  关于这一问题，最近发现的证据与即存理论有相抵触的倾向。

There is some discrepancy between the two accounts.  这两份帐单之间有一些出入。
The committee is reportedly unhappy about the discrepancy in numbers.  据说委员会对数字不一致很不满。
the lunar surface  月球的表面

words.meaning: a.诚实的，正直的；真挚的，纯净的
words.example: He seems so sincere.  他看起来很诚恳。    Opposite insincere

words.meaning: n.在困难面前足智多谋的勇气，胆量；精力；v.拔毛；弹拉(乐器)
words.example:
Caged birds sometimes pluck out their breast feathers.  关在笼子里的鸟有时会拔下自己的胸羽。
He plucked the letter from/out of my hand, and ran off with it.  他从我手中抢过信后就跑开了。
Do you pluck your eyebrows (= remove some of the hairs from them to give them a better shape) ?  你修眉吗？
The demise of the company was sudden and unexpected.  该公司出人意料地突然倒闭了。
Their criticisms seem premature considering that the results aren't yet known.  鉴于结果尚未知晓，他们的批评看来过早了。

She sat through the whole meeting without uttering a word.  整个会议期间她干坐着，一言不发。UK adjective [before noun]
The meeting was a complete and utter waste of time.  这个会议完全是浪费时间。
Lying back in the hot bath was utter bliss.  泡热水澡真是神仙般的享受。

The crowd were chanting the name of their football team.  人群正反覆呼唤着自己足球队的名字。
Demonstrators chanted anti-government slogans in the square.  示威者在广场上呼喊反政府口号。
We could hear the monks chanting.  我们听到和尚在念经。UK noun countable

As an education minister, she has been touting these ideas for some time.  作为教育部长，一段时间以来她一直在宣传这些理念。
He is being widely touted as the next leader of the Social Democratic party.  到处都在宣传他是下任社会民主党领袖。
Several insurance companies are now touting their services/wares on local radio.  几家保险公司正在当地电台进行宣传。
With a good telescope, you can see craters on the moon.  用好的望远镜能看到月亮上的环形山。

The getaway car had been ditched a couple of kilometres away from the scene of the robbery.  逃离现场用的车辆被丢弃在距抢劫地几公里以外的地方。
Did you know that Sarah has ditched (= ended her relationship with) her boyfriend?  莎拉把男朋友给甩了，你知道吗？verb
Left alone, the class threw books, pulled faces and generally clowned around.  由于没有人管，班上的学生扔书本，扮鬼脸，简直是一片胡闹。
Stop loafing (about/around) and get on with cleaning the windows!  别偷懒了，赶快把窗户擦干净！

His rudeness when we first met didn't dispose me very kindly to/towards him.  我们首次会面时，他那粗暴的态度使我对他没产生甚么好感。UK US  formal
How did they dispose of the body?  他们是如何处理尸体的？
It took a mere five minutes for the world champion to dispose of (= defeat) his opponent.  世界冠军只用五分钟就击败了对手。

She sank back against/into the cushions.  她向后靠在垫子上。
The soft grass cushioned his fall.  柔软的草地减缓了他摔落时的冲力。verb transitive
He's lost his job, but the redundancy money will cushion the blow.  他丢了工作，不过遣散费会减轻对他的打击。
He doesn't seem to comprehend the scale of the problem  他似乎没意识到问题的严重性。
As soon as I get paid, I squirrel some money away so I won't be tempted to spend it.  我一发薪水，就把一部分存起来，以免忍不住想花。
She believes she's related to royalty.  她认为她和王室有血缘关系。UK noun

She wasn't responsive to questioning.  她对提问应答很勉强。
The disease has proved responsive to the new treatment.  事实证明，新疗法对这种病很有效。    Opposite unresponsive

He is a superb dancer.  他是一个杰出的舞蹈家。
Taylor scored a superb goal at the end of the first half.  泰勒在上半场要结束的时候攻入了一个极为精彩的进球。

The police evacuated the village shortly before the explosion.  在爆炸前不久，员警将这个村庄里的人全都疏散了。
When toxic fumes began to drift toward our homes, we were told to evacuate.  当毒雾开始朝我们住宅区方向飘移时，我们被通知撤离。

He accidentally sat on her hat and squashed it.  他不小心坐在她的帽子上，把它坐扁了。UK verb
The room was so full you couldn't squash another person in.  房间里挤得满满的，再也挤不进一个人了。
If you all squashed up (= moved closer together) , we could fit an extra person in the car.  要是你们再挤挤，我们车里就能多坐一个人。

The answers to these questions remain as elusive as ever.  这些问题的答案仍然是不得而知。
Success, however, remained elusive for her.  但是对她来说，成功仍然不可企及。

The school is affiliated with a national association of driving schools.  这所学校隶属于一个全国驾驶学校协会。noun countable /əˈfɪl.i.ət/
Our college is an affiliate of the university.  我们学院隶属于这所大学。

He dodged to avoid the hurtling bicycle.  他闪身躲过了疾驰而来的脚踏车。
The minister dodged questions about his relationship with the actress.  部长迴避了关于他与那位女演员之间关系的问题。UK noun countable informal
They bought another car as a tax dodge (= a way to avoid paying tax).  为了逃税，他们又买了一辆汽车。

I'm catering for twelve on Sunday, all the family are coming.  星期天我要招待12个人，全家都要来。
Which firm will be catering at the wedding reception?  将由哪家公司承办婚宴？
The club caters for children between the ages of 4 and 12.  该俱乐部适合4至12岁的儿童。UK verb intransitive or transitive

The region's reliance on tourism is unwise.  这一地区依赖旅游业谋发展是不明智的。
You place too much reliance on her ideas and expertise.  你过于信赖她的想法和专业知识了。

The vaccination gives you immunity against the disease for up to six months.  注射这种疫苗会使你对这种疾病有长达六个月的免疫力。
He was granted immunity from prosecution because he confessed the names of the other spies.  他因供出了其他间谍的名字而免受起诉。
These three players will form the nucleus of a revised and stronger team.  这三名运动员将成为一支调整后实力更强的队伍的核心。

words.meaning: v.符合或遵守公认的规则
words.example:
At our school, you were required to conform, and there was no place for originality.  我们学校要求每个人循规蹈矩，容不得创新求变。UK verb intransitive
Before buying a pram, make sure that it conforms to the official safety standards.  购买婴儿车之前，要确保它符合官方的安全标准。
Members must conform to a strict dress code.  成员们必须遵守严格的衣着规定。

She gave him a playful cuff on the shoulder.  她顽皮地在他肩头轻拍了一下。noun countable
His brother cuffed him playfully round the head.  他哥哥开玩笑地在他头上拍了几下。verb transitive
He was led out of the dock with his hands cuffed behind his back.  他被带下被告席时双手被铐在背后。

It was springtime and the fruit trees were in bud.  春天到了，果树发芽了。noun countable
The unusually cold winter has caused many plants to bud late this year.  今年冬天异常寒冷，许多植物抽芽都晚了。
He was wearing an earring in his left ear.  他左耳戴着一只耳环。

The divers checked their breathing apparatus.  潜水员检查了一下呼吸器。UK US  (plural apparatus or apparatuses)
The whole apparatus of communism was already falling apart.  整个国家行政机构已经土崩瓦解。

Our toys are designed to withstand the rough treatment of the average five-year-old.  我们的玩具设计要能经得住一般五岁儿童粗野的摆弄。
The aircraft base is protected with specially designed shelters which are built to withstand ground and air attacks.  空军基地有特殊设计的掩体保护，能够抵挡地面和空中袭击。
She is an artist whose work will undoubtedly withstand the test of time (= it will still be popular in the future).  她这样一位元艺术家的作品毫无疑问能经受得起时间的考验。

The new government has expelled all foreign diplomats.  新政府驱逐了所有外国外交官。
My brother was expelled from school for bad behaviour.  我弟弟因为行为不当被学校开除了。 (-ll-)
She took a deep breath, then expelled the air in short blasts.  她深深吸了一口气，然后一下子把空气呼出来。

The extinction of the dinosaurs occurred millions of years ago.  恐龙在几百万年前已经绝种
Many species of plants and animals are in danger of/threatened with extinction (= being destroyed so that they no longer exist).  多种动植物都面临绝种的危机。
Some people predict the extinction of family life as we know it today.  一些人预言我们现在熟知的家庭生活方式将会消失。

words.meaning: v.蹒跚而行，笨拙地走；n.杂物，旧家具；木材
words.example: In the distance, we could see a herd of elephants lumbering across the plain.  我们可以看见远处有一群大象缓缓穿过平原。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: a.懒散的，懈怠的；(绳)松弛的；v.松懈，怠惰
words.example:
These tent ropes are too slack - they need tightening.  这些帐篷绳太松了——需要把它们拉紧。adjective
Business is always slack at this time of year.  每年的这个时候生意都很清淡。
disapproving Discipline in Mr Brown's class has become very slack recently.  布朗先生班上的纪律最近变得十分松懈。

words.meaning: n.对某事业或目的的忠诚
words.example:
He has always shown great dedication to the cause.  他对这项事业一直都表现出强烈的奉献精神。
She thanked the staff for their dedication and enthusiasm.  她感谢全体员工的奉献精神和工作热情。noun
The dedication at the front of the book read 'For my Father'.  书前面的致谢辞中写道：“献给我的父亲。”noun
When she calmed down, she was more coherent (= able to speak clearly and be understood).  她冷静下来后，讲话有条理多了。
The wife of a businessman has been kidnapped from her home in Surrey.  一个商人的妻子在她萨里郡的家中遭绑架。noun countable or uncountable

He was a very earnest young man.  他是个非常认真的年轻人。
These fanatics are in deadly earnest when they say they want to destroy all forms of government.  这些狂热分子声称要摧毁所有政府的形式时，他们可不是说着玩，而是完全当真的。
The election campaign has begun in earnest.  竞选宣传活动正式开始了。

The kitchen roof is apt to (= likely to) leak when it rains.  一下雨厨房屋顶就容易漏水。
She's in her eighties now and apt to be a bit forgetful.  她已经80多岁了，有些健忘。adjective
We have some particularly apt students in the class this year.  这学年班里有几个特别聪明的学生。

Would you mind stapling the reports together ?  你能把报告用订书机订好吗？noun countable
Shortages mean that even staples (= basic foods) like bread are difficult to find.  物资短缺意味着连面包之类的主食都难觅踪影。
Phosphate has been a staple of this area for many years.  磷酸盐多年来一直是这一地区的主要产品。

words.meaning: n.匾(用于纪念或装饰的饰板)；血小板
words.example:
There was a brass plaque outside the surgery listing the various dentists' names and qualifications.  诊所外有一块铜牌，列出了多位牙科医生的名字和专业资历。
Her Majesty later unveiled a commemorative plaque.  女王陛下随后为一块纪念牌匾揭幕。
The blue plaque said 'Charles Darwin, biologist, lived here'.  纪念匾上写著「查尔斯‧达尔文，生物学家，曾经居住于此。”UK noun

The TV series 'An Angel at my Table' was based on the autobiographies of the New Zealand author Janet Frame.  电视连续剧《桌边的天使》是根据纽西兰作家珍妮特•弗雷姆的自传改编的。    Compare biography
His life story is recounted in two fascinating volumes of autobiography.  两部引人入胜的自传描述了他的生平经历。
All information will be treated as strictly confidential.  所有的情报都将被视作绝密。

It was when we started living together that we found we just weren't compatible.  等到开始生活在一起时，才发现我们根本合不来。
This software may not be compatible with older operating systems.  该软体可能与较早期的作业系统不相容。
Such policies are not compatible with democratic government.  此类政策与民主政体格格不入。

She isn't very susceptible to flattery.  她不太听信别人的奉承。
These plants are particularly susceptible to frost.  这些植物很容易受霜冻影响。
Among particularly susceptible children, the disease can develop very fast.  在特别易受感染的儿童中，这种疾病会扩展得非常迅速。

First apply shampoo to hair and then rinse thoroughly.  先把洗发剂涂抹在头发上，然后冲洗干净。
There was no soap, so I just rinsed my hands with water/ UK alsounder the tap.  没有肥皂了，所以我只是用自来水冲了冲手。verb intransitive or transitive
I'll just rinse these glasses out and leave them to dry.  我就把这些杯子冲一下，然后晾干。
relentless criticism/pressure  不断的严厉批评／施压

She nervously crumbled the bread between her fingers.  她紧张地在指间捻着面包。
The cliffs on which the houses are built are starting to crumble.  上面建有房屋的悬崖开始倾颓瓦解。
Support for the government is crumbling.  对政府的支援日渐减少。noun countable or uncountable UK (US crisp)

She is very maternal towards her staff.  她对员工十分慈祥。    Compare paternal
Her maternal grandmother (= mother's mother) is still alive.  她的外婆依然健在。
The most famous vampire is Count Dracula of Transylvania.  最著名的吸血鬼是特兰西瓦尼亚的德拉库拉伯爵。

Rebecca always excelled in languages at school.  瑞贝卡上学时学语言一直都出类拔萃的。
The British team have excelled themselves this year to reach the finals.  英国队今年超水准发挥，打入了决赛。

I'll be blunt - that last piece of work you did was terrible.  我就直说了——你创作的最后一件作品糟糕透了。verb transitive
My recent bad experience has rather blunted my enthusiasm for travel.  最近的倒楣经历已经使我对旅游的热情减弱了不少。

words.meaning: n.独裁主义者；极权主义者
words.example: His manner is extremely authoritarian.  他的作风极其专断。
an astronomical rent/bill/price/fee  巨额租金／天文数字的帐单／天价／极高的收费UK adjective

She sent them a present to show/express her gratitude.  她送了他们一件礼物，以表达她的感激之情。
Take this as a token of my gratitude for all your help.  你帮了我那么多忙，这个就当是我的一点心意吧。

The group has affiliations with several organizations abroad.  该团体和数个国外组织有联系。
Their lack of affiliation to any particular bank allows them to give objective financial advice.  他们不隶属任何一家银行，这就使他们能够提供客观的理财建议。

In the Caribbean waters there are fish of every hue.  加勒比海水域的鱼五颜六色。noun countable
Politicians of all hues wish to get sleaze off the agenda so that they can discuss the real issues.  各个党派的与会者都希望将那些卑劣之事从议事日程中去掉，这样他们就可以讨论真正的问题了。noun countable
There has been a great hue and cry about the council's plans to close the school.  市政会关闭这所学校的计划受到强烈抗议。
the growing disparity between rich and poor  正在加剧的贫富悬殊
An enzyme in the saliva of the mouth starts the process of breaking down the food.  由于唾液中酶的作用，食物进入口腔时就开始了分解过程。

Law enforcement agents intercepted a shipment of drugs from Latin America.  执法人员截获了一批从拉丁美洲运来的毒品。
Batistuta intercepted Neville's pass and scored the third goal.  巴迪斯图达断下纳维尔的传球，射入了第三个球。
Deep-sea divers carry cylinders (= containers) of oxygen on their backs.  深海潜水员背上背有氧气筒。UK noun countable
The cornea is the transparent membrane that covers the front of the eye.  角膜是覆盖在眼球前部的透明膜。

His reply to my question was somewhat ambiguous.  他对我的提问回答得有些含糊不清。
The wording of the agreement is ambiguous.  该协议的措辞模棱两可。
The government has been ambiguous on this issue.  在此问题上政府立场一直不明确。

She dismantled the washing machine to see what the problem was, but couldn't put it back together again.  她拆开洗衣机想看看出了甚么问题，但是却装不起来了。
The good thing about the bike is that it dismantles if you want to put it in the back of the car.  这种脚踏车的好处是可以拆开放在汽车的后部。
Unions accuse the government of dismantling the National Health Service.  工会指责政府裁撤了国家卫生署。

These people are in dire need of help.  这些人急需援助。
He gave a dire warning that an earthquake was imminent.  他郑重警告说马上就要地震了。
This decision will have dire consequences for local people.  这一决定将对当地人产生严重的后果。

She came gliding gracefully into the ballroom in a long flowing gown.  她身穿一袭飘逸的礼服，优雅轻盈地快步走进舞厅。
Some people glide effortlessly through life with no real worries.  有些人一生过得轻松自在，无忧无虑。verb
We saw a condor gliding high above the mountains.  我们看到一只秃鹫在群山上空翱翔。

I've always held musicians in awe.  我对音乐家们总是肃然起敬。
As children we were rather in awe of our grandfather.  小时候，我们对祖父非常敬畏。
You can't help but stand in awe of (= respect greatly and fear slightly) powerful people.  在权势人物面前，你不由自主会毕恭毕敬。UK verb transitive ( UK aweing or US awing)

words.meaning: n.(坏情况)开始，开端；攻击，袭击
words.example: The new treatment can delay the onset of the disease by several years.  新的治疗方法可以把发病时间延后几年。
And now myriads of bars and hotels are opening up along the coast.  目前有数不胜数的酒吧和饭店在沿岸开张营业。
They sell pottery and other handmade goods.  他们卖陶器和其他手工制品。
insufficient information/time  不充足的资讯／时间
Her finely-tuned political antennae helped her to sense problems that less-experienced politicians might not detect.  她敏锐的政治嗅觉使她可以意识到一些问题，而经验不足的从政者却可能觉察不到。noun

words.meaning: a.似是而非的，似乎合理的；(贬)嘴巧的(尤指为行骗)
words.example: a plausible explanation/excuse  貌似有理的解释／借口
He was apparently abusive to the flight attendants.  显然他对航班空服员说了些不干不净的话。

The airborne radioactive particles have covered a huge area of Russia.  透过空气传播的放射性粒子覆盖了俄罗斯广大地区。
Airborne troops were dropped by parachute behind enemy lines.  空降部队伞降到敌后阵地上。
The old plane had great difficulty getting airborne (= rising into the air).  这架老掉牙的飞机起飞非常困难。
Stop harassing me!  别烦我！
An honorary doctorate was conferred on him by Edinburgh University.  爱丁堡大学授予他荣誉博士学位。
You're embarrassing him with your compliments!  你的赞美之词使他很不好意思。

words.meaning: a.根本的，本质上的；独立存在的
words.example:
Substantive research on the subject needs to be carried out.  需要针对这课题开展实质性的研究。
The documents are the first substantive information obtained by the investigators.  这些档是调查者得到的第一批实质材料。

words.meaning: a.热的，热量的；温暖的；n.热气流
words.example: It was the Romans who first recognised the medicinal benefits of Hungary's thermal springs (= ones which produce hot water).  是罗马人首先认识到匈牙利温泉的医疗效用。UK noun countable
She planted some roses and other flowering shrubs.  她种了一些玫瑰及其他一些开花灌木。

The success of their major product consolidated the firm's position in the market.  公司主打产品取得的成功巩固了该公司在市场上的地位。
She hoped that marriage would consolidate their relationship.  她希望婚姻能巩固他们的关系。
The party consolidated its hold on power during its term of office.  该党在执政期间加强了对政权的控制。
She took her case to an immigration appeals tribunal.  她向移民上诉法庭提出申诉。

words.meaning: a.紧迫的，迫切的；恳切要求的
words.example: The most pressing question is what do we do next?  最迫切的问题是接下来我们要做甚么。noun countable

It's a subject which has aroused a lot of interest.  这个话题引起了很多人的兴趣。
Our suspicions were first aroused when we heard a muffled scream.  我们听到一声闷声尖叫，就开始起了疑心。
affluent nations/neighbourhoods  富有国家／富人区
This attack will exacerbate the already tense relations between the two communities.  这次袭击将令两个原本已经处于紧张状态的团体关系更加恶化。

We could hear the groans of the wounded soldiers.  我们能听到伤兵们的呻吟声。
