He looked at the piles of dirty dishes and gave a groan of dismay.  他看着成堆的脏碟子，发出一声沮丧的叹息。UK verb intransitive
He collapsed, groaning with pain.  他痛苦地呻吟着倒了下去

We need tangible evidence if we're going to take legal action.  如果我们要采取法律行动，就需要有实实在在的证据。
Other tangible benefits include an increase in salary and shorter working hours.  其他实实在在的好处包括加薪和缩短工作时间。

The Eiffel Tower is a remarkable feat of engineering.  艾菲尔铁塔是工程技术上的一大非凡杰作。
She's performed remarkable feats of organization for the office.  她为办事处所做的组织工作成绩斐然。noun countable
Getting the job finished in under a week was no mean feat.  一周内就把这项任务完成了，真了不起。
The group has taken a militant position on the abortion issue and is refusing to compromise.  这个团体在堕胎问题上采取强硬立场，不肯妥协。

Someone was lurking in the shadows.  有人藏在黑影里。
Why are you lurking about in the corridor?  你干吗在走廊里鬼鬼祟祟的？
Danger lurks around every corner.  每个角落里都潜伏着危险。

words.meaning: n.侏儒；矮小的植物；v.使变矮小
words.example:
You can grow dwarf conifers in pots on the patio.  你可以在阳台上种些矮小的针叶树盆栽。UK verb transitive
The new skyscraper will dwarf all those near it.  新建的摩天大楼跟周围的建筑相比鹤立鸡群。
This new crisis may well dwarf most that have gone before.  这场新的危机可能比以往的大多数危机都严重得多。

They terminated my contract in October.  他们在十月终止了我的合约。
This train will terminate at the next stop - passengers who wish to continue should change trains.  下一站就是本次列车的终点，想继续行程的乘客请换车。UK US  formal
I've got boxes of old clothes in the attic.  我的阁楼里放着好几箱子旧衣服。

words.meaning: v. 挤成一堆n. 一堆人(杂物)
words.example:
Everyone huddled round the fire to keep warm.  所有人都挤在炉火旁取暖。
It was so cold that we huddled together for warmth.  太冷了，我们只好挤在一起取暖。
Sophie was so frightened by the noise of the fireworks that she huddled (up) in a corner of the room.  苏菲被烟火爆竹的声音吓坏了，在屋角缩成一团。noun countable

words.meaning: n.海盗；剽窃者，盗版者；v.掠夺；盗印
words.example: software pirates  软体侵权者

words.meaning: n.星座，星群；一群杰出人物
words.example: At our annual ceremony we had a whole constellation of film stars/directors.  在我们的年度庆典上，影星／导演济济一堂。

words.meaning: n.饼屑，面包屑；碎裂的东西
words.example: a crumb of hope/comfort  一线希望／一丝安慰
an allergy to wheat  对小麦过敏
She is of a nervous/cheerful/sunny disposition.  她神经质／性情开朗／性格阳光。

We made a dart for (= moved quickly towards) the exit.  我们向出口冲去。UK verb intransitive + adverb or preposition
She darted an angry look at me.  她狠狠地瞪了我一眼。

Soldiers must swear allegiance to the Crown/the King.  士兵必须宣誓效忠国王。
In many American schools, the students pledge allegiance (to the flag) at the beginning of the school day.  在很多美国学校里，学生每天上课前要（向国旗）进行宣誓。
As an Englishman who'd lived for a long time in France, he felt a certain conflict of allegiances when the two countries played soccer.  作为一个在法国生活了很长时间的英国人，当两国足球队比赛时，对于要支持哪一方，他的内心会有一番思想斗争。

She watched the wax as it dripped down the side of the candle.  她注视着蜡从蜡烛边缘滴落下来。
I've waxed the floor so I'm afraid it's a bit slippery.  我刚给地板打了蜡，所以恐怕会有点滑。verb
My mother, a Spaniard, always used to wax lyrical about the lemon trees in the family garden.  我母亲是西班牙人，过去总是会深情地谈起她家中花园里的那些柠檬树。verb
He was convicted of felony.  他被判犯有重罪。
Their music is described as 'an explosive fusion of Latin American and modern jazz rhythms'.  他们的音乐被描述为“拉丁美洲和现代爵士节奏的爆炸性融合”。

words.meaning: n.(附属于教堂或监狱等的)小教堂
words.example: The college/hospital/prison has its own chapel.  学院／医院／监狱有自己的小教堂。
The painting depicts an idyllic pastoral scene of shepherds watching over their grazing sheep.  这幅画里牧羊人看守着吃草的羊群，呈现出田园诗般的乡村风情。

The watch mechanism is extremely intricate and very difficult to repair.  手表的机械结构非常复杂精密，很难修理。
Police officers uncovered an intricate web of deceit.  警官揭开了一个错综复杂的网路骗局。

Elizabeth II ascended/came to the throne (= became queen of Britain) when her father died.  伊丽莎白二世在她父亲逝世后登上王位。
Queen Victoria was on the throne (= was queen) at that time.  那时维多利亚女王在位。
Charles is next in line to the throne (= will become king next).  查理斯将继承王位。
an apple/cherry orchard  苹果／樱桃园

In a frenzy of rage she hit him.  她盛怒之下打了他。
The audience worked/whipped themselves up into a frenzy as they waited for her to come on stage.  观众在期待她登上舞台的过程中情绪变得狂热起来。
There was a frenzy of activity on the financial markets yesterday.  昨天金融市场极度活跃。
She's decided to shack up with her boyfriend.  她决定和男友同居。

The Ministry of Defence has the power of veto over all British arms exports.  国防部有权禁止英国所有的武器出口。
In theory the British government could use its veto to block this proposal.  理论上英国政府可以利用否决权来阻止这项议案通过。
The Senate voted to override the President's veto of the proposed measures.  参议院投票推翻了总统对拟议中的措施的否决。

words.meaning: a.叛乱的，起事的；n.叛乱分子
words.example: All approaches to the capital are now under the control of the insurgents.  所有通往首都的道路都被叛乱分子控制了。

words.meaning: a.寒冷的；阴沉的；阴郁的，暗淡的
words.example:
The house stands on a bleak, windswept moor.  这座房子坐落在一片饱受风雨侵袭的荒野上。
The economic outlook is bleak.  经济前景暗淡。

words.meaning: n.面纱；遮蔽物，掩蔽物；v.以面纱掩盖
words.example:
After the ceremony, the bride lifted up her veil to kiss her husband.  仪式过后，新娘撩起面纱亲吻她的丈夫。
The women wore black veils which covered all but their eyes.  那些女人戴着黑色面纱，把除眼睛之外的所有地方都遮住了。
The view over the lake was obscured by a veil of mist that hung in the air.  薄雾笼罩下，湖面上的景色看上去模模糊糊的。

Sally had been recovering well from her operation, but yesterday she experienced/suffered a setback.  莎莉手术后一直恢复良好，但昨天她的病情再度复发。
There has been a slight/temporary setback in our plans.  我们的计划遭到了一点／暂时的挫败。

He's a restless type - he never stays in one country for long.  他是那种呆不住的人——他从来不在一个国家呆太长的时间。
She spent a restless night (= She did not sleep well) , tossing and turning.  她在床上辗转反侧，一夜无眠。

words.meaning: n.维护理想、原则而进行的运动或斗争
words.example:
They have long been involved in a crusade for racial equality.  他们长期以来一直致力于争取种族平等的运动。
She crusaded against sex and violence on television.  她致力于反对电视节目中的色情和暴力。
The air bag will protect the head and torso.  安全气囊会保护头部和躯干。

Before the court case, we had to file/give a deposition.  开庭之前我们必须提供书面证词。
Our lawyer took a deposition from us.  律师从我们这里取走了书面证词。
Crowds celebrated the dictator's deposition.  人们欢聚在一起庆祝独裁者下台。

His nickname was Ginger because of his ginger hair.  他的外号叫生姜，因为他的头发是姜黄色的。
[as form of address] Hey, ginger, what are you doing?  哎，黄毛，你在做甚么？UK noun] ˈgɪŋ.ə] US DRINK  饮品     UK verb
They've gingered up the book cover with a new design, but the contents are the same.  他们为这书重新设计了一个很有吸引力的封面，但是书中的内容保持原样。
The teacher drew a diagram showing how the blood flows through the heart.  老师画了一张示意图来说明血液如何进出心脏。

In a fit of temper he hurled the book across the room.  他一怒之下把书本扔到房间的另一边。
Youths hurled stones at the soldiers.  年轻人向士兵们投掷石头。

words.meaning: n.（物）摩擦；（人观念）矛盾，冲突
words.example:
When you rub your hands together the friction produces heat.  揉搓双手时，摩擦会产生热量。noun uncountable
There's a lot of friction between my wife and my mother.  我妻子和我母亲之间有很多龃龉。
Politics is a source of considerable friction in our family.  政治问题在我们家是矛盾的一大根源。
Meanwhile, the massive aerial bombardment/bombing of military targets continued unabated.  同时，对于军事目标的大规模空袭仍进行得如火如荼。
In a prosperous country like this, no one should go hungry.  在这样一个繁荣的国家里，不应该有人挨饿。

At worst, nuclear war could be unleashed.  最坏的情况是，可能会爆发核战争。
Rachel's arrival on the scene had unleashed passions in him that he could scarcely control.  雷切尔的到来激起了他难以抑制的热情。

Stop that giggling at the back!  别在后面傻笑！noun
There were a few nervous giggles from people in the audience.  观众中有人发出几声紧张的笑声。
Just for a giggle, we hid his trousers while he was in the water.  他在水里的时候，我们把他的裤子藏了起来，这纯粹为了好玩。
Forensic examination revealed a large quantity of poison in the dead man's stomach.  法医检验显示死者胃中有大量毒药。
We can't release his name until we have informed his next of kin.  在通知他的直系亲属前，我们不能透露他的名字。
The dense foliage overhead almost blocked out the sun.  头顶上方浓密的枝叶几乎遮住了阳光。

Many teenagers are surprisingly ignorant about current politics.  许多青少年对时事政治无知得让人吃惊。
We remained blissfully ignorant of the troubles that lay ahead.  我们对将要出现的麻烦一无所知，这或许是一种幸运。
Ignorant lout!  没礼貌的混蛋！
The film was about a group of robots set on world domination (= control of all countries).  这部电影讲述的是一伙机器人试图征服世界的故事。

words.meaning: v.(快速)派遣；一下子做完；(快速)吃完；n.迅速
words.example:
Two loads of woollen cloth were dispatched to the factory on December 12th.  12月12日两车毛料被发到工厂。(UK also despatch) [dɪ'spætʃ]
Our handsome hero manages to dispatch another five villains.  我们英俊的男主人翁设法又杀死了五个坏蛋。(UK also despatch) [dɪ'spætʃ]
In her latest dispatch, Clare Duggan, our war correspondent, reported an increase in fighting.  我们的战地记者克莱尔‧达根在其最新报道中说战事正在加剧。

Minor skin imperfections can usually be disguised with a spot of make-up.  微小的皮肤瑕疵通常可以用化妆品来掩盖。
We tried to disguise the fact that it was just a school hall by putting up coloured lights and balloons.  我们不想让人看出这里实际上只是挂着彩灯和气球的学校礼堂。
He put on a large hat and glasses as a disguise and hoped no one would recognise him.  他戴上大帽子和眼镜来伪装自己，希望没人会认出他来。
It was in August of 1978 that the Bolton brothers hatched their plot to kill their parents.  那是在1978年的8月，博尔顿兄弟策划了杀害他们父母的计划。noun countable (also hatchway)

words.meaning: v.修正，(通常向更好的方向)变化
words.example:
MPs were urged to amend the law to prevent another oil tanker disaster.  下院议员被敦促修订该法律，以防止油轮泄漏灾难再次发生。
In line 20, 'men' should be amended (= changed) to 'people'.  第20行中的 men 应改为 people。
Until the constitution is amended, the power to appoint ministers will remain with the president.  在宪法修正之前，总统仍然有权任命部长。
In later life she was crippled with arthritis.  晚年她因患上关节炎而行动不便。
Matisse's palette typically consists of bright blues, greens and oranges.  马蒂斯所运用的典型色彩包括亮蓝、绿色和橙色。

It's not real silk - it's just imitation.  这不是真丝——不过是仿制的。noun
Ten-year-olds have started wearing lipstick and make-up in imitation of the older girls.  十岁的女孩子已经开始模仿年长的女孩涂抹口红和化妆了。
She can do a wonderful imitation of a blackbird's song.  她能唯妙唯肖地模仿乌鸫的鸣啭。

Negotiators were called in to mediate between the two sides.  请来了谈判人员为双方调解。
The two envoys have succeeded in mediating an end to the war.  两位使节透过谈判斡旋促成了战争的结束。
Salisbury Cathedral  索尔斯堡主教堂

words.meaning: v.（超限）填塞，塞满；临时抱佛脚，为考试而学习
words.example:
Eight children were crammed into the back of the car.  八个孩子被塞进了汽车的后座。
The room was packed and we were crammed against the door.  房间里挤得水泄不通，我们被挤靠在门边。 (-mm-)
She's cramming for her history exam.  为应付历史考试她拼命突击。 (-mm-)

There were large spikes on top of the railings to stop people climbing over them.  栏杆顶端装着粗大的尖钉，防止有人攀越。
Some types of dinosaur had sharp spikes on their tails.  有些种类的恐龙尾部有锋利的尖突。
The story was deemed too controversial and so they spiked it.  他们认为这篇报导争议太大而拒绝刊登。verb transitive

The poem opens by lamenting (over) the death of a young man.  这首诗的开篇表达了对一位青年之死的惋惜之情。
My grandmother, as usual, lamented the decline in moral standards in today's society.  和往常一样，我奶奶对当今社会世风日下深感痛惜。
The late lamented (= dead and remembered with love) Frank Giotto used to live here.  已故的受人爱戴的法兰克‧焦托曾在此居住。noun countable formal

words.meaning: a.轮流的，交替的；v.轮流，交替n.候选人，替代性选择
words.example:
She alternated between cheerfulness and deep despair.  她时而情绪亢奋，时而又深陷绝望之中。
He alternated working in the office with long tours overseas.  他在办公室工作一段时间后就会安排一次海外长途旅行。adjective [before noun] UK US [ɑːlˈtɜ˞ː-/
Private cars are banned from the city on alternate days.  该市私家车限隔日出行。

The fuel spontaneously ignites because of the high temperature and pressure.  燃料因高温和高压而自燃。
The proposed restrictions have ignited a storm of protest.  拟议中的限制规定激起了抗议的浪潮。

words.meaning: v.以强欺弱，威胁；n.欺负别人者
words.example:
Our survey indicates that one in four children is bullied at school.  我们的调查表明，有四分之一的孩子在学校受到欺凌。
Don't let anyone bully you into doing something you don't want to do.  别让任何人胁迫你做你不愿做的事情。noun countable
You're just a big bully!  你欺负人！
a gold/silver/diamond bracelet  金／银／钻石手镯

The army planned to attack enemy arsenals.  军队计划攻击敌人的军火库。
The country has agreed to reduce its nuclear arsenal.  这个国家已经同意削减其核武器储备。

Much of the coast has been contaminated by nuclear waste.  大部分海岸已受到核废料污染。
The food which had been contaminated was destroyed.  受污染的食物已被销毁了。

Some workers were inhibited (from speaking) by the presence of their managers.  一些工人在他们的经理面前不敢讲话。
This drug inhibits the growth of tumours.  这种药可以抑制肿瘤的生长。
Few of us can be unmoved by the plight of the Romanian orphans.  我们几乎无一不为罗马尼亚孤儿的困难处境而心有所感。verb old use or humorous

People who default on their mortgage repayments may have their home repossessed.  未能按期偿还抵押贷款者，其房屋可能会被没收。UK verb intransitive
Unless something else happens, the default is to meet at the hotel at 7.00 p.m.  如果没有别的事情，按约定下午七点在饭店见面。
The computer will take '0' as the default value , unless you type in something different.  如果不输入其他数值，电脑就把0当作预设值。

When the rain came down the crowds started to disperse.  雨下来时人群开始四处散开。
Police dispersed the crowd that had gathered.  员警驱散了聚在一起的人群。

words.meaning: a.清醒的，未醉的；庄重的，认真的
words.example:
Are you sober enough to drive, Jim?  吉姆，你够不够清醒，可以开车吗？
I'd had no wine all evening so I was stone cold (= completely) sober.  我一晚上没有喝酒，所以我非常清醒。UK adjective
In fact the whole wedding was a sober affair - no dancing, just people standing around in groups chatting politely.  事实上，整场婚礼气氛很严肃——没有人跳舞，人们只是聚在一起礼貌地交谈。

In her speech, she paid a glowing tribute to her predecessor.  她在发言中热烈赞扬了她的前任。
His latest book has received glowing reviews.  他的近作好评如潮。

words.meaning: a.反驳的，反对的，抗辩的；矛盾的

words.example:
Several trees were flattened (= knocked down) by the storm.  暴风雨把几棵大树刮倒了。
The path flattens (out) (= does not go up so much) as it reaches the top of the hill.  到达山顶时，这条小路变得平坦了。UK verb intransitive or transitive
Flatten the pastry into a thin disc with your hands.  用手把油酥面团压成薄圆片。

Close your eyes. Don't peek. I've got a surprise for you.  闭上眼睛，别偷看，我要给你一个惊喜。
The children peeked over the wall to see where the ball had gone.  孩子爬上墙头看球被踢到哪里去了。
The film peeks behind the scenes of a multinational corporation.  该影片揭示了一家跨国公司的内幕。

Where on Earth have you been? We've been frantic with worry.  你到底去哪里了？我们都担心死了。UK adjective
Share prices have soared to a new all-time high in a day of frantic trading on the stock market.  股票市场经过一天的紧张交易后，股价飙升至历史新高。
Rescuers were engaged in a frantic all-night effort to reach the survivors before their supply of air ran out.  救援人员整个晚上都在全力奋战，要在幸存者空气耗尽之前找到他们。

Do you use an electric razor or the kind that you have to put a razor blade in?  你用的是电动刮须刀还是那种要装刀片的刮胡刀？UK noun countable
Allegations of fraud have put the minister's career on a razor edge.  由于被指控有欺诈行为，这位部长的职业生涯岌岌可危。UK verb transitive
My hairdresser always razors my fringe to give a soft effect.  我的理发师总是把我的浏海用剃刀刮一下，使它变得轻柔一些。

People get less fertile as they get older.  随着年龄增长，人的生育能力逐渐下降。    Opposite infertile
British politics remains very fertile ground for comedy.  英国政治依然为喜剧提供丰富的素材。
You'll be able to reclaim the tax on all equipment that you buy.  你们采购所有设备所付的税款以后都可以退回。
I've always preferred reading prose to poetry.  我一直偏好读散文而不是诗歌。    Compare verse

She walked out in disgust.  她厌恶地走了出去。
We are demonstrating to show our anger and disgust at the treatment of refugees.  我们示威是对难民受到的待遇表示愤怒和憎恶。
He resigned from the committee in disgust at the corruption.  出于对腐败的憎恶，他辞去了在该委员会的职务。
a sewer pipe  排水管
The change in the exchange rate provided a timely boost to the company's falling profits.  汇率的变动及时缓解了公司利润下滑的局面。

She was confronted by a man wielding a knife.  她被一名持刀男子威胁。
He still wields enormous influence within the party.  他在党内仍然很有影响力。
He ate a whole slab of chocolate.  他吃了一整块巧克力。
Mrs Singh is still riding the crest of a wave of popularity.  辛格夫人的声望仍然如日中天。

Most financial analysts have been surprised by the persistence of the recession.  大多数金融分析师都对这种持续的衰退感到惊讶。
Her persistence and enthusiasm have helped the group to achieve its international success.  她的坚持不懈和满腔热忱帮助该集团在国际上获得成功。

Please return your seat to an upright position and fasten your belt.  请把坐椅恢复到竖直位置并系好安全带。
She behaved as any upright citizen would have under the circumstances.  她在这种情况下的做法和所有正直公民一样。adverb
The sound of breaking glass made her sit bolt upright (= sit with her back straight).  听到玻璃破碎的声音她一下子坐直了起来。noun countable

words.meaning: v.废止，废除(法律、制度、习俗等)
words.example: National Service was abolished in Britain in 1962.  英国的国民兵役制度于1962年废止。
an autonomous region/province/republic/council  自治地区／省／共和国／委员会
a luxury yacht  豪华游艇
She mumbled something about being too busy.  她嘟囔着说太忙了。

They said they sent troops in to liberate the people/the country from a dictator.  他们称他们向该国派出军队是要把那里的人民／那个国家从独裁者手中解放出来。
She liberated those spoons from a restaurant last week.  上周她从一家餐厅偷了那些汤匙。
There have been a lot of recent redundancies so morale is fairly low.  近来裁员很多，所以士气很低。
The police have reassured witnesses who may be afraid to come forward that they will be guaranteed anonymity.  警方已让那些可能害怕站出来作证的目击证人放心，保证不公开他们的姓名。

Let us hear the words of the prophet Isaiah on the coming of the Prince of Peace.  让我们聆听先知以赛亚关于和平之王来临的预言。
The prophets of doom have been predicting the end of European cinema for the last ten years.  那些悲观的预言者过去十年里一直在预言欧洲电影的末日。
In business, the pragmatic approach to problems is often more successful than an idealistic one.  在商界里，用实际的方法来解决问题往往比空想更有成效。
ground/toasted almonds  杏仁粉／烤杏仁

The statue of the dictator was toppled (over) by the crowds.  独裁者的雕像被众人推倒了。
The tree toppled and fell.  树倒了下来。UK verb
The church was prominently involved in the struggle that toppled the dictatorship.  教会在推翻独裁政权的斗争中起了重要作用。

It is a one-year course validated by London's City University.  这是由伦敦城市大学批准设立的一年制课程。
The data is validated automatically by the computer after it has been entered.  资料登录后，电脑会自动识别其有效性。

words.meaning: v.(动物)吃(地上长的)草；放牧
words.example:
He fell down and grazed his knee.  他摔倒时擦伤了膝盖。
He was lucky, the bullet just grazed his leg.  他很幸运，子弹只是擦伤了他的腿。
The aircraft's landing gear grazed the treetops as it landed.  飞机在降落时，起落架掠过树梢。verb

words.meaning: a.下级的，低等的，质次的，较差的
words.example:
These products are inferior to those we bought last year.  这些产品比我们去年买的差些。
She cited cases in which women had received inferior health care.  她引用了一些妇女得到低劣保健服务的事例。
It was clear the group were regarded as intellectually/morally/socially inferior.  很明显的是，这个群体被认为在智力／道德水准／社会地位上很低下。    Compare superior    specialized
a subsidiary role/factor  辅助角色／次要因素UK noun countable
The drugs did nothing to alleviate her pain/suffering.  这些药物对减轻她的病痛／痛苦没有丝毫作用。

words.meaning: v./n.(电影，戏剧，展览会)预演，预展
words.example:
Miller's new play is previewing (= being performed publicly before it officially opens) at the Theatre Royal tomorrow.  米勒的新剧将于明天在皇家剧院预演。
On page 11, Sally Gaines previews next week's films on TV.  在第11页，萨莉•盖恩斯介绍了下周将在电视上播出的电影。
Key protagonists of the revolution were hunted down and executed.  这次革命的主要发起人被捕并被处决。    Compare antagonistnoun countable

She hit him so hard that he reeled backwards.  她出手太重，打得他朝后打了个趔趄。
We were reeling (in amazement/shock/delight, etc.) from/with the news that we had won all that money.  得知赢了那么多钱，我们都（惊愕得／震惊得／高兴得）发蒙了。verb intransitive

words.meaning: v.(战争等)升级；(快速)扩大，上升
words.example:
The decision to escalate UN involvement has been taken in the hopes of a swift end to the hostilities.  已决定加大联合国介入的程度，以期尽快结束战争。
His financial problems escalated after he became unemployed.  他失业后，经济问题更是雪上加霜。
The escalating rate of inflation will almost certainly bring escalating prices.  通货膨胀率的不断上升几乎肯定会导致物价攀升。

They have massive rows because they're both so stubborn.  他们俩吵得很凶，因为他们两个人都很固执。
He was famed for his stubborn resistance and his refusal to accept defeat.  他以顽强抵抗、不甘失败著称。
Stubborn stains can be removed using a small amount of detergent.  使用少量清洁剂即可去除顽渍。UK US  mainly disapproving

They were mocking him because he kept falling off his bike.  他们不断嘲笑他，因为他老是从脚踏车上摔下来。
She made fun of him by mocking his limp.  她模仿他一瘸一拐地走路来取笑他。
The wind mocked their attempts to reach the shore by pushing the boat further and further out to sea.  风把船往海里刮得越来越远，使他们靠岸的努力落空。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: n.矮树丛；身体矮小的人；v.用力擦洗
words.example:
She scrubbed (at) the mark on the wall for ages, but it wouldn't come off.  她花了很长时间擦洗墙上的印迹，但仍然没有擦掉。
We had to scrub our plans when I lost my job.  我失业了，我们不得不取消计划。verb (-bb-)
Mary scrubs up well.  玛丽总是打扮得漂漂亮亮的。noun
The bomb reduced the house to rubble.  炸弹把这座房屋炸成了一堆瓦砾。
Students can be expelled at the discretion of the headteacher (= if the headteacher decides it).  校长有权开除学生。

words.meaning: a.植物不规则地生长的，(城市建筑物)无计划地扩展的

words.example: We tried to avert our thoughts from our massive financial problems.  我们尽量不去想我们面临的严重财政问题。

Several of the injured were detained overnight in hospital.  伤者中有几个人被留院观察了一晚。
I'm sorry I'm late - I was unavoidably detained.  对不起我来晚了——没办法我被耽搁了一会儿。

What guided your choice of destination or was it arbitrary?  你根据甚么选择目的地？还是随意选定的？UK adjective
The company has been the subject of an arbitrary take-over.  这家公司被强行接管。

An unfortunate conjunction of circumstances led to his downfall.  一连串不幸事件同时发生，导致了他的下台。
There is a team of writers working in conjunction (with each other) on the book.  有一个作家小组在合作撰写这部书。
Mars and Venus will be in exact conjunction on the first of September.  火星和金星在9月1日会正好相合。
The gold was hidden in a secret cavity.  黄金藏在一个隐秘的洞穴里。

I've never driven a car before - I'm a complete novice.  我以前从未开过车——完全是个新手。
This is quite a difficult plant for novice gardeners to grow.  让园艺新手来培育这种植物是相当有难度的。

She spoke with great animation about her latest discoveries.  她兴致盎然地谈了她最新的发现。noun
Encyclopedias on CD-ROM include sound, illustrations and simple animations.  光碟电子百科全书里有声音、插图和简单的动画。
Thanks to computer animation, it is now possible to make cartoon films much more quickly than in the past.  有了电脑动画制作技术，现在制作动画片比过去快多了。
their blueprint for economic reform  他们的经济改革计划

She complained that her husband never paid her any compliments any more.  她抱怨说丈夫再也不赞美她了。
Are you fishing for (= trying to get) compliments?  你在沽名钓誉吗？
You should take it as a compliment when I fall asleep in your company - it means I'm relaxed.  我在你面前睡着了你应该感到荣幸——这意味着我很放心。

words.meaning: a.行人的，徒步的；缺乏想像的；n.行人
words.example:
The death rate for pedestrians hit by cars is unacceptably high.  行人遭遇车祸的死亡率高得令人无法接受。adjective formal disapproving
Her books, with few exceptions, are workmanlike but pedestrian.  除了寥寥几本以外，她的书全都写得精确细腻但缺乏想像力。
His speech was long and pedestrian.  他的演讲冗长乏味。

words.meaning: a. 赤裸的；n. 裸体者
words.example:
She once posed nude for a magazine.  她曾为一本杂志拍过裸照。
Nude sunbathing is only allowed on certain beaches.  只有在某些海滩上才允许晒裸体日光浴。
The exhibition includes several superb nudes.  展览上有几件上乘的裸体艺术作品。

She cut off the best meat and threw away the residue.  她切下最好的肉，把剩下的扔掉了。
The white residue in/on the kettle is a result of minerals in the water.  壶中／上白色的渣子是水中的矿物质沉淀。
The residue (of the estate) went to her granddaughter.  剩余遗产由她的孙女继承。

She lay there screaming in agony.  她躺在那里痛苦地大声尖叫。
We've both suffered agonies of guilt over what happened.  所发生的事情使我们两个都饱受内疚的煎熬。

She was taken into hospital last week when her condition suddenly deteriorated.  她是在上周病情突然恶化时被送进医院的。
The political situation in the region has deteriorated rapidly.  该地区的政治形势已急剧恶化。

words.meaning: n.心意相通，(感情等)融为一体

words.example:
With the extra resources, the scheme now seems feasible.  有了额外的资源，这个计划现在看来是可行的。
It 's quite feasible (that) we'll get the money.  我们很有可能拿到这笔钱。

This part of the law is only applicable to companies employing more than five people.  该法律这一部分条款仅适用于有五名以上雇员的公司。
The new qualifications are applicable to all European countries.  新的限定条件适用于所有欧洲国家。

words.meaning: v.收割，收获(庄家，尤指谷物)
words.example:
She studied every evening and reaped the benefit at exam time.  她每天晚上都坚持学习，考试时受益匪浅。
We sold them most of their modern weapons and now we are reaping the bitter harvest.  他们大部分的现代化武器都是我们卖给他们的，现在轮到我们自食其果了。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: n. 建筑物的正面；(虚伪)外表
words.example:
Behind that amiable facade, he's a deeply unpleasant man.  他外表和善，实际上是个极不讨人喜欢的人。
We are fed up with this facade of democracy.  我们厌倦了这种民主的幌子。

If you have a gas fire in a room, you should have some kind of outside vent.  如果你的屋里有煤气炉，那你就应该有个通向外面的排气口。
The skirt is long and straight with two side vents.  这条裙子是很长的直筒裙，两侧开衩。noun
The meeting will be an opportunity for everyone to give vent to their feelings.  这次会议将给每个人一吐为快的机会。verb transitive

These claims are dubious and not scientifically proven.  这些说法未经科学证实，有些可疑。
He has been associated with some dubious characters.  他曾经与一些可疑人物有交往。
Ruth Ellis has the dubious (= bad) distinction of being the last woman to be hanged in Britain.  露丝‧艾理斯背负着英国最后一个被绞死的女人这样一个恶名。

The river was full but we managed to wade across.  河里涨满了水，但我们设法涉水过去了。
We waded a shallow river.  我们涉水过了一条浅浅的小河。
Even when she knows nothing about it, she wades in with her opinion.  即使对事情一无所知，她也要插嘴说说自己的意见。

Biographical information is included in brackets.  括号里包含了作者的个人资料。
Grammar patterns in this dictionary are shown in UK square brackets] USbrackets. For example, a countable noun is marked countable.  本词典文法模式在方括号内注明，如可数名词用countable表示。noun
They were both surgeons in a high income bracket.  他俩都属于高收入阶层的外科医生。

The journey through the mountains was fraught with peril (= full of dangers).  穿越山岭的旅途充满了危险。
Teenagers must be warned about the perils of unsafe sex.  青少年必须被告诫不安全的性行为所隐藏的重大危险。
We underestimate the destructiveness of war at our peril.  我们低估了战争的破坏力，这对我们是很危险的。

Queen Victoria reigned over Britain from 1837 to 1901.  维多利亚女王自1837年到1901年间在位统治英国。
The bomb attacks produced a panic which reigned over the city.  炸弹袭击引起的恐慌笼罩全城。
Love reigned supreme in her heart.  爱情完全占据了她的心。noun countable

His arms and back were covered in bruises.  他手臂和背部到处是瘀伤。
She had a few cuts and bruises but nothing serious.  她有几处伤口和瘀痕，但不严重。
One or two of the peaches had bruises on them.  有一两个桃子上有碰伤的痕迹。verb intransitive or transitive

words.meaning: v./n.(痛苦地/的)呻吟；(不满地/的)抱怨
words.example:
He moaned with pain before losing consciousness.  他痛苦地呻吟，随后就失去了知觉。
"Let me die," he moaned.  “让我死吧。”他呻吟道。UK verb intransitive
Thelma's always moaning (about something), and forgets how lucky she actually is.  特尔玛总爱抱怨，忘记了实际上她是多么幸运。

words.meaning: n.(人，车)行列，队伍；列队前进
words.example:
The festival will open with a procession led by the mayor.  艺术节将由市长带领的一支队伍揭开序幕。
My day has just been a never-ending procession of visitors.  我今天一整天来访的客人络绎不绝。

Increasing the supply of weapons will only perpetuate the violence and anarchy.  增加武器供应只会使暴力和混乱持续下去。
The aim of the association is to perpetuate the skills of traditional furniture design.  该协会致力于促进传统家俱设计工艺的传承延续。

Extreme stress had driven him to the brink of a nervous breakdown.  极大的压力使他处于精神崩溃的边缘。
Scientists are on the brink of (= extremely close to) a major new discovery.  科学家们就快有新的重大发现了。
She was standing right on the brink of the gorge.  她就站在峡谷的边缘。

As the boat picked up speed, the coastline receded into the distance until finally it became invisible.  船越开越快，海岸线渐渐远去，直至最后从视线中消失。
The painful memories gradually receded in her mind.  痛苦的记忆逐渐在她脑海中变得淡漠了。

Theories abound about how the Earth began.  地球的起源怎样，众说纷纭。verb intransitive
The coast here abounds with rare plants.  这儿的海岸生长着大量稀有植物。

The perks of the job include a company pension scheme and a generous travel allowance.  这份工作的特殊待遇包括公司退休金计划和丰厚的差旅补助。
The baggage/luggage allowance for most flights is 20 kilos.  大多数班机允许乘客携带的行李重量限额是20公斤。
We should make allowance for bad weather and have plenty of umbrellas available.  我们应该考虑到有可能会遇上恶劣天气，所以应该备足雨伞。noun

It's wonderful to see the children's lust for life (= how enthusiastic they are about life).  看到孩子们这样热爱生活真是太好了。verb
She's been lusting after Dave for months.  她觊觎戴夫已经有好几个月了。verb
I've been lusting after one of their silk shirts for ages.  我一直渴望能有一件他们那样的丝绸衬衫。

words.meaning: v.垂直或突然坠下；n.测深锤
words.example:
House prices have plummeted in recent months.  房价近几个月来暴跌。
Several large rocks were sent plummeting down the mountain.  好几块巨石被从山上推下。
She plummeted to the ground.  她一下摔到了地上。

The old part of the town was a maze of narrow passages.  旧城区通道狭窄，纵横交错，简直就是一座迷宫。noun countable
It's almost impossible to get through the maze of bureaucracy.  要逐一完成错综复杂的官僚式繁文缛节几乎是不可能的。
The year 1969 was a watershed in her life - she changed her career and changed her partner.  1969年是她人生的一个转折点——她转了行，也更换了伴侣。UK noun

I'm told I have a very pronounced English accent when I speak French.  有人告诉我说，我在说法语时有明显的英国口音。
She's a woman of very pronounced views which she is not afraid to air.  她是个从不讳言其观点的女人。
These plants need a sunny spot with good drainage.  这些植物需要种植在阳光充足的地方，土壤排水能力要强。
The hostages' ordeal came to an end when soldiers stormed the building.  士兵突袭那栋大楼后，人质们的苦难终于结束了。
Have they any evidence to implicate him in the robbery?  他们有证据证明他涉嫌抢劫案吗？

The members of the team just didn't mesh.  这支队伍的队员根本并不协调。
Whether the new personal pension works will depend much on how well it meshes with employers' schemes.  新的个人退休金制度能否行得通，很大程度取决于这个制度能否与雇主的计划方案相配合。verb intransitive
The car's gears aren't meshing properly.  汽车的齿轮没有啮合好。
It is difficult to discern any pattern in these figures.  在这些数字中很难找出规律。

She has one son and she adores him.  她只有一个儿子，是她的掌上明珠。
Let us adore God for all his works.  让我们崇拜上帝所创造的一切。

words.meaning: a.字面上的，忠实原义的；精确的
words.example:
The literal meaning of 'television' is 'seeing from a distance'.  television 的字面意思是“从远处看”。
You need to demonstrate to the examiners that you have more than a literal understanding of the text.  你需要向考官表明你对文本的理解没有仅仅停留在字面含义上。
Her translation is too literal (= done one word at a time) , resulting in heavy, unnatural prose.  她的译文太拘泥于字面了，结果成了冗长而不自然的散文。    Compare figurative

words.meaning: a.滑的；(人)狡猾的，不可靠的
words.example:
The road was wet and slippery.  道路又湿又滑。
He's as slippery as an eel - you can never get a straight answer out of him.  他非常狡猾——你永远无法从他嘴里得到直率的回答。
He's a slippery customer (= person) , that Tim, I've never felt comfortable with him.  那个蒂姆是个狡猾的家伙，和他在一起我总是感到不舒服。

words.meaning: a.恶臭的；邪恶的；v.弄脏；n.(体育等)犯规
words.example:
Those toilets smell foul!  那些卫生间太难闻了！
I've had a foul day at work.  我今天工作上很不顺利。
Why are you in such a foul mood this morning?  你今天早晨的情绪怎么这么糟糕？

words.meaning: v.恳求；教唆(犯罪)，(妓女)拉客
words.example: It is illegal for public officials to solicit gifts or money in exchange for favours.  公务员利用职务之便索求他人财物是非法的。verb

words.meaning: a.见多识广的；消息灵通的
words.example:
The school promised to keep parents informed about the situation.  该学校保证让家长了解有关情况。
Elizabeth is remarkably well -informed.  伊莉莎白见多识广。

It was a wicked thing to do.  那是件缺德的事。
Of course, in the end, the wicked witch gets killed.  当然，最后邪恶的巫婆被杀掉了。    Compare evil ; naughty    old-fashioned
He's got some wicked trainers.  他有几双非常不错的球鞋。noun

After he was attacked, he managed to stagger to the phone and call for help.  他遇袭后，跌跌撞撞地走到电话旁打电话求救。
figurative The company is staggering under a $15 million debt and will almost certainly collapse by the end of the year.  公司背负着1500万美元的债务，举步维艰，年底前几乎肯定要倒闭。UK verb
He staggered all his colleagues by suddenly announcing that he was leaving the company at the end of the month.  他突然宣布月底要离开公司，把所有同事都吓了一跳。UK verb

words.meaning: v.恳求，祈求；变魔术，变戏法
words.example:
In an instant, the magician had conjured (up) a dove from his hat.  魔术师眨眼间便从他的帽子里变出了一只鸽子。UK verb intransitive or transitive
The glittering ceremony conjured up images of Russia's imperial past.  辉煌的典礼让人联想起俄罗斯帝国昔日的景象。
For some people, the word 'England' may still conjure up images of pretty gardens and tea parties.  “英格兰”这个词仍能使一些人联想到漂亮的花园和茶会。

The children were giggling and nudging each other.  孩子们咯咯地笑着，互相推来推去。
He nudged the cat off the sofa so that he could sit down.  他把猫轻轻推下沙发，这样自己可以坐下来。
Oil prices continue to nudge higher.  油价持续上涨。
She spoke in nasal tones.  她说话带鼻音。
The Government is now claiming that inflation is on a downward trajectory.  政府现在宣称通货膨胀呈现下降趋势。

words.meaning: n. 英雄故事，长篇小说
words.example: It was just another episode in an ongoing saga of marriage problems.  这只是层出不穷的婚姻问题中的又一个插曲。

Ouch! Stop pinching (me)!  哎哟，别掐我！
These shoes are too tight, they pinch (my feet).  这双鞋太紧了，夹我的脚。
Right, who's pinched my chair?  好嘛，谁把我的椅子偷走了？verb

words.meaning: n.壁凹(墙上装的架子、柜子等凹处)；(工作)休假期；(法庭、国会)休庭期
words.example:
The room has a recess designed to hold bookshelves.  这个房间有个壁凹，是为放书架而设计的。
Psychoanalysts aim to explore the deepest/innermost recesses of the mind.  精神分析学家致力于探索心灵最深处的奥秘。
My culinary skills are rather limited, I'm afraid (= I am not very good at cooking) !  恐怕我的厨艺不怎么样！
environmental degradation  环境恶化noun uncountable    formal

The Australian team soon demonstrated their superiority over the opposition.  澳大利亚队很快在对手面前显示出他们的优势。    Compare inferiority
Her sense of superiority makes her very unpopular.  她的优越感让她非常不受欢迎。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: v.（表示不赞成或不满某人）作嘘声；(蛇等)发出嘶嘶声
words.example:
Why do snakes hiss?  蛇为甚么发出嘶嘶声？
The iron was hissing and spluttering.  铁块发出嘶嘶声并且火花四射。
People in the audience were hissing their disapproval.  观众们发出嘘声表示不满。
to seek/apply for political asylum  寻求／申请政治庇护noun

words.meaning: n.(剧团等)常备剧目(以备随时演出)
words.example:
The Royal Shakespeare Company also have many modern plays in their repertoire.  皇家莎士比亚剧团的演出剧目中也包括很多现代戏剧。
There is an extensive repertoire of music written for the flute.  为长笛演奏而谱写的曲目林林总总，丰富多彩。
The firm specializes in loft conversions (= making lofts into rooms).  该公司专门从事阁楼改造。

The musicians rehearsed (the symphony) for the concert.  乐师们为音乐会排练（交响曲）。
figurative On her way to her interview she silently rehearsed what she would say.  在去面试的路上，她默诵了一下要说的话。
These are arguments that I've heard rehearsed at meetings many times before.  这些论点都是我多次在会议上听到的老生常谈了。
Peru is a very traditional country, and embedded in its psyche is a love of ceremony.  秘鲁是一个非常传统的国家，这个国家的精神中蕴含着一种对于礼仪的热爱。

This sewing machine is operated by a foot pedal.  这台缝纫机是用脚踏板来操作的。
He stood up on the pedals of his bike to get extra power as he cycled up the hill.  他骑车上山时站在踏板上踩车以增加力量。adjective [before noun]
She emptied the ashtray into the pedal bin.  她把烟灰缸里的东西倒入脚踏式垃圾桶里。verb intransitive or transitive (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
This painting perfectly exemplifies the naturalistic style which was so popular at the time.  这幅油画是那个时期风靡一时的自然主义风格的完美典范。

He shuffled into the kitchen, leaning on his walking stick.  他拄着手杖拖着脚走进厨房。
Don't shuffle your feet like that! Lift them properly.  不要那样拖着脚走路！把脚抬起来。
The woman in front of me kept shuffling around in her seat all the way through the performance.  演出期间，我前面的那个女人在座位上不停地动来动去。
a milk crate  牛奶箱

We paused to marvel at the view.  我们停下来，感叹景色之美。
This miniature TV is the latest technological marvel from Japan.  这台微型电视是日本的科技新宠。
It 's a marvel (to me) how they've managed to build the tunnel so quickly.  （我觉得）真不可思议，他们能这么快就把隧道建好。
The public's response to the crisis appeal was generous and compassionate.  公众对危难时刻的呼吁表现得慷慨大方、富有同情心。

The Prime Minister convened (a meeting of) his ministers to discuss the matter.  首相召集部长（开会）讨论这个问题。
The council will be convening on the morning of the 25th.  市政会议将于25日上午召开。

You've been an absolute gem - I couldn't have managed without your help.  你可真是难能可贵——没有你的帮助我可应付不过去。
He came out with a gem (= clever or pleasing remark) about the absurdity of the situation.  他对这种荒诞的情形发表了粲花之论。

There are still a few wrinkles to iron out (= solve) before the agreement can be signed.  在协议签订之前还有一些小问题需要解决。verb intransitive or transitive
Sunbathing can prematurely age and wrinkle the skin.  日光浴会使皮肤提早老化、产生皱纹。
She wrinkled up her nose at the strange smell coming from the kitchen.  闻到厨房飘来的怪味，她皱起了鼻子。
Few people who aspire to fame ever achieve it.  追求显赫名声的人很少能如愿以偿。

words.meaning: v.详细彻底检查；细读，细看
words.example: He scrutinized the men's faces carefully/closely, trying to work out who was lying.  他仔细端详这些男子的脸，想弄清谁在撒谎。

words.meaning: n. 虚张声势; 悬崖峭壁
words.example:
Is he going to jump or is he only bluffing?  他是真要跳还是只是吓唬人？
Tony seems to know a lot about music, but sometimes I think he's only bluffing.  东尼似乎对音乐很了解，但有时我觉得他只是在装样子。
She bluffed the doorman into thinking that she was a reporter.  她装模作样让门房以为她是记者。

words.meaning: a.熟练而有效的；(人)圆滑的；光滑的
words.example:
Manilow gave the slick, polished performance that we've come to expect.  正如我们所期望的那样，马尼洛的表演挥洒自如、技艺精湛。
It's that sort of slick sales talk that I mistrust.  那种油腔滑调的推销宣传正是我所不相信的。noun countable
He'd slicked his hair back with gel and he was wearing a new suit.  他抹了发胶将头发向后梳平整，穿上了一套新西装。

words.meaning: n.裂缝，缺口；v.打破，裂开；违背
words.example:
They felt that our discussions with other companies constituted a breach of/in our agreement.  他们认为我们与别的公司谈判违反了我们之间的协定。
He was sued for breach of contract.  他因为违约而被起诉。
There have been serious security breaches (= breaks in our security system).  保安系统出了大问题。

words.meaning: v.摸索，笨拙搜寻；弄乱，搞糟
words.example:
He fumbled in his pockets for some change.  他在口袋里摸索着找零钱。
She fumbled around/about in her handbag, looking for her key.  她在手提袋里摸索着找锁匙。
They fumbled around/about (= moved awkwardly) in the dark, trying to find their way out of the cinema.  他们在黑暗中摸索，想从电影院里出去。verb

She squatted on the ground and warmed her hands by the fire.  她蹲在地上，伸出双手烤火。
He squatted down and examined the front wheel of his bike.  他蹲下身来，检查脚踏车的前轮。UK verb (-tt-)
They squatted (in)an old house in King's Cross when their money ran out.  他们钱花光后，就偷偷住进了国王十字车站的一处旧房子里。UK adjective (squatter, squattest)

There was a brown sediment in the bottom of the bottle.  瓶子底部有褐色的沉淀物。
It is hoped that the oil slick will sink to the seabed where it would be covered within a few years by sediments and eventually decompose.  人们希望浮油会沉到海底，并且在数年后被沉积物覆盖，逐渐分解。

His powers of recollection are extraordinary.  他的记忆力超群。 formal
To the best of my recollection I have never seen her before.  如果我没记错的话，我以前从来没有见过她。

The town finally succumbed last week after being pounded with heavy artillery for more than two months.  在遭受了两个多月的猛烈炮火轰击后，小镇最终在上星期放弃抵抗。
I'm afraid I succumbed to temptation and had a piece of cheesecake.  我还是没抵挡住诱惑，吃了一块乳酪蛋糕。
Thousands of cows have succumbed to the disease in the past few months.  过去几个月里，几千头乳牛都得了这种病。
a seasoned traveller  经验丰富的旅行者

The high concentration of sugars forms a syrup when the sap evaporates.  当树汁中的水分蒸发时，糖分就浓缩成糖浆。
Plants keep cool during the summer by evaporating water from their leaves.  夏天植物透过叶子蒸发水分保持清凉。UK verb
Halfway through the film reality evaporates and we enter a world of pure fantasy.  电影看到一半，我们就离开现实世界，完全进入了幻境中。

She winked at me as he turned his back.  他转过身去的时候，她向我眨了眨眼。
For a moment I thought he was being serious, but then he winked at me.  有一阵我以为他是认真的，但是没多久他就向我眨了眨眼，暗示我他在开玩笑。
Reflected in the water, the lights winked at us from the other side of the lake.  湖对岸的灯光映在水中，向我们一闪一闪的。

In cheap furniture, plastic is often used to simulate wood.  廉价家俱经常用塑胶冒充木材。
formal Ruth simulated pleasure at seeing Simon, but really she wished he hadn't come.  看见西蒙，露丝假装很高兴，可是实际上她希望他没来。
Some driving teachers use computers to simulate (= represent) different road conditions for learners to practise on.  有些驾驶教练用电脑类比不同的路况供学员练习。

words.meaning: v./n.(因寒冷、恐惧等)战栗，发抖
words.example:
The sight of so much blood made him shudder.  看到那么多的血，他不禁浑身颤抖。
She shuddered at the thought of kissing him.  她一想到亲吻他就禁不住发抖。

a hand grenade  手榴弹
Linen is a coarse -grained fabric.  亚麻布是一种质地粗糙的布料。UK adjective

words.meaning: n.在职者，现任者；a.义不容辞的
words.example:
The incumbent president faces problems which began many years before he took office.  现任总统面临着他上任前很多年就已开始出现的种种问题。adjective
She felt it incumbent upon/on her to raise the subject at their meeting.  她感到她有义务在他们的会议上提出这个问题。noun countable
The present incumbent (of the post) is due to retire next month.  （此职位的）现任者将于下个月退休。

His stature as an art critic was tremendous.  他作为艺术评论家，享有非常高的声誉。
If the school continues to gain in stature, it will attract the necessary financial support.  如果学校能继续提高声誉，将会吸引到必要的资金补助。UK noun
His red hair and short stature made him easy to recognize.  他红头发，五短身材，很容易认出来。

words.meaning: n.(从某种表演活动所得的)收入
words.example:
The proceeds of today's festival will go to several local charities.  今天活动的收入将捐给当地的几家慈善机构。
It says on the back of the card 'all proceeds to charity'.  卡片背面写著「所有收入捐给慈善机构”。
a celebrated opera singer/city/novel  著名歌剧演唱家／名城／著名小说    Compare notorious
a stellar explosion  恒星爆炸

words.meaning: n.催化剂；促使事情发展的因素
words.example: The high suicide rate acted as a catalyst for change in the prison system.  高自杀率促成了监狱制度的改革。
a group of extremists (= people with extreme opinions)  一群极端分子

Leon's dog was sitting by the door whining, so I thought I'd better take it for a walk.  利昂的狗蹲在门口呜呜直叫，所以我觉得最好带它散散步。
Alice, if you carry on whining like that I won't take you - do you understand!  爱丽斯，如果你继续那样嘀嘀咕咕，我就不带你了——明白了吧！noun countable usually singular
She delivered the speech in a high-pitched nasal whine.  她演讲时声音尖锐刺耳，鼻音很重。

She was showing me her new built-in / UKfitted wardrobes.  她正在带我看她新做的嵌入式衣柜。
He's in charge of wardrobe at the local amateur theatre.  他是当地业余剧院戏服部的负责人。

The dinner plates were thick with grease.  餐盘上厚厚一层油
You'll have to put some grease on those ball bearings.  你要往滚珠轴承上涂些油。verb transitive
Grease the tins well before adding the cake mixture.  在烤盘里面涂好油脂，然后再把蛋糕混合料加进去。verb transitive
On every street corner there were traders hawking their wares.  每个街角都有商贩在兜售商品。

words.meaning: a. 引起怜悯的；令人难过的
words.example:
The refugees were a pathetic sight - starving, frightened and cold.  难民看起来实在可怜——饥寒交迫，担心受怕。
After the accident he became a pathetic figure , a shadow of his former self.  意外后他成了一个可怜人，与之前判若两人。
Are you telling me you're frightened to speak to her? Don't be so pathetic!  你是说你不敢跟她说话吗？别太窝囊了！
apricot/strawberry conserve  杏脯／草莓蜜饯
She's nice, but I don't feel I can confide in her.  她人很好，但我还是觉得我不能对她推心置腹。

Make sure your seat belt is securely fastened.  请务必将您的安全带系好。
This shirt fastens at the back.  这件衬衫是在后面系扣的。
The tabloid newspapers have fastened on popular psychology.  这些小报处处捉摸大众心理。
Her friends take advantage of (= benefit unfairly from) her generosity.  她的那些朋友利用她的慷慨占她的便宜。

It's a musical instrument made of brass, somewhat like a cornet and with a similar compass.  这是一件黄铜乐器，跟短号有些类似，音域也与之相近。
The discussion went beyond the compass of my brain.  讨论超出了我的理解能力。

When the cake is cooked, sift some icing sugar over the top of it.  蛋糕做好后，在上面筛上一些糖粉。verb transitive
The police are sifting the evidence very carefully to try and find the guilty person.  员警正在非常仔细地检查证据，试图找出那个罪犯。
After my father's death, I had to sift through all his papers.  父亲去世后，我必须查看整理他的所有档。

The names of political parties are always capitalized, e.g. the Green Party.  政党名称的首字母总是要大写，如 the Green Party。(UK usually capitalise) UK verb
She capitalized on her knowledge and experience to get a new and better paid job.  她凭借自己的学识和经验谋求了一份收入更高的新工作。

He was released/remanded on bail (of $100 000).  他在交出（十万美元的）保释金后被放了出来。
Because of a previous conviction, the judge refused to grant bail (= allow the accused person to be released).  由于嫌犯有前科，法官不准将他保释。
Her parents have agreed to put up/stand/ US post (= pay) bail for her.  她的父母已同意保释她。noun
Tears ran down her face as she stood on the winner's podium.  她站在领奖台上时泪水顺着她的脸庞流了下来。

The novelty of these toys soon wore off and the children became bored with them.  孩子们对这些玩具的新鲜感很快就消失了，开始厌倦起来。

words.meaning: n.彩色粉笔或蜡笔画；柔和的色彩
words.example:

Leaves fluttered down onto the path.  树叶飘落到小径上。
Butterflies fluttered about in the sunshine.  蝴蝶在阳光下翩翩飞舞。

These people are guilty of acts of great atrocity (= cruelty).  这些人犯下了令人发指的残忍罪行。

Ellen's familiarity with pop music is astonishing.  埃伦对流行音乐之精通令人吃惊。

News of the war hardly caused a ripple (= people showed little interest).  战争爆发的消息几乎没有引起任何回响。
The breeze rippled the water.  微风在水面吹起阵阵涟漪。

words.meaning: a.(指人)无所事事的；无效的；v.懒散，无所事事

words.meaning: v.精确地找出或描述；a.非常精确的
words.example:

words.meaning: v.切碎；（贬）装腔作势地小步走路
