They had to ask one of the spectators to referee (the match).  他们只可从观众中请出一人来担任（比赛的）裁判。
the Shakespearean canon  莎士比亚作品全集

words.meaning: v. 推断，估计；猜想，设想
words.example:
She was widely reckoned (to be) the best actress of her generation.  人们普遍认为她是她那一代最优秀的演员。verb
Angela quickly reckoned the amount on her fingers.  安吉拉掰着手指头快速计算了一下数量。
The inflation rate is now reckoned to be 10%.  据计算，现在的通货膨胀率是10%。verb

words.meaning: a.古怪的，反常的；n.古怪的人
words.example: My mother's a bit of an eccentric.  我妈妈有点古怪。

He was gracious enough to thank me.  他很有礼貌地向我道谢。
The losing team were gracious in defeat.  失利的球队豁达地面对失败。adjective
We can't afford gracious living.  我们过不起安逸的生活。exclamation old-fashioned
an athletics team/club/meeting  田径队／俱乐部／运动会
the overthrow of the monarchy  君主制的推翻noun UK THROW  扔
The remains of the Roman fort are well preserved.  这个罗马要塞的遗址保存完好。

The ship carries both freight and passengers.  这艘船既载货又载客。
Will the goods be sent by air or sea freight?  这些货物要空运还是海运？
Grapes from this region are freighted all over the world.  这个地区生产的葡萄被运到世界各地。adverb

Quigley clouted me smartly across the side of the head.  奎格利狠狠地向我的头部一侧打了一巴掌。noun
The Queen may have privilege but she has no real political clout.  女王可以享有特权，但没有真正的政治权力。noun
If the photocopier stops working, just give it a clout.  要是影印机停止运转，拍它一下就好了。

She has wonderfully glossy hair.  她有一头顺滑的秀发。
This magazine is full of glossy advertisements for aftershave.  这本杂志中满是介绍刮胡水的广告，尽是些夸夸其谈的东西。UK noun countable

She spent the evening grumbling to me about her job.  她整晚都在向我抱怨她的工作。
If I hear any more grumbles about the food, you can do the cooking yourself!  要是再让我听到你抱怨饭不好吃，你就自己做！
Turkey is expecting an influx of several thousand refugees over the next few days.  未来几天涌入土耳其的难民预计会达几千人。

On the day after the terrorist attack, the overall mood in the town was one of vengeance.  在恐怖袭击发生后的第二天，镇上人们普遍的情绪就是要复仇。
As he cradled his daughter's lifeless body in his arms, he swore (to take) vengeance on her killers.  他紧抱着女儿的尸体，发誓要找杀害她的凶手报仇。noun uncountable
He's been working with a vengeance over the past few weeks to make up for lost time.  几周以来他玩儿命工作以弥补失去的时间。

We had to sprint to catch the bus.  我们不得不飞奔赶上公车。noun
He suddenly broke into (= started) a sprint.  他突然开始飞奔起来。

Sadly, the text is marred by careless errors.  很遗憾，这篇文章因一些粗心大意的错误而大为失色。
It was a really nice day, marred only by a little argument in the car on the way home.  这一天过得非常不错，只是回家路上在汽车里发生的一点口角令人扫兴。

Most of the work was done by apprentices.  大部分工作是由学徒做的。
Michelangelo was apprenticed to Ghirlandaio in Florence for three years.  米开朗基罗曾在佛罗伦斯师从吉尔兰达约三年。
She mentioned some trouble that she'd had at home and I guessed she was alluding to her son.  她提到家中有些麻烦事，我猜她是指她的儿子。
the northern hemisphere  北半球
They can say what they like. I don't give a fig.  他们喜欢说甚么都行。我根本不在乎。

words.meaning: n.叙事诗，史诗；a.英雄的；大规模的
words.example:
It's one of those old Hollywood epics with a cast of thousands.  这是老牌的好莱坞史诗电影之一，演员阵容达到数千人。adjective
The problem of inflation has reached epic proportions.  通货膨胀问题已经到了极其严重的地步。

She was wearing a blonde wig.  她戴着金色的假发。
In Britain, judges wear white wigs in court.  在英国，法官在法庭上戴白色的假发。    Compare toupée

words.meaning: v.修复，装修，翻新(尤指旧建筑)
words.example: He renovates old houses and sells them at a profit.  他靠翻修老房子再出售赚钱。

Perhaps you could coax your father into taking you to the station.  也许你能花言巧语说服父亲带你去车站。
He has some information I want, so I'm going to try to coax it out of him over a drink.  他知道一些我想要的消息，所以我要设法在喝酒时从他那里把它套出来。

They got into the car and zoomed off.  他们钻进汽车一溜烟地开走了。
In the last few metres of the race, she suddenly zoomed ahead.  到了比赛的最后几米，她突然冲到前面。
House prices suddenly zoomed last year.  去年房价飙升。 informal

You pull on both reins to stop or slow a horse, but only the left rein to turn left.  拉两边的缰绳来让马停住或放慢速度，但是要想左转时，只需拉左边的缰绳。
The young film-makers were given free rein to experiment with new themes and techniques.  年轻的电影制片者们对新主题和新技巧可以自由尝试。
He deliberately gave his emotions free rein as he played the sonata.  演奏这首奏鸣曲时，他刻意使自己的感情尽情奔放。noun countable usually plural

Thousands of people came out onto the streets to attest their support for the democratic opposition party.  数以千计的人走到街上，声援主张民主的反对党。
The number of old German cars still on the road attests (to) the excellence of their manufacture.  在马路上仍可以看到相当数量的旧款德国车，这表明其制造工艺十分精良。
As his career attests, he is a cricketer of world-class standard.  他是一位世界级的板球运动员，他的运动生涯就是证明。

words.meaning: n. 选民，选区；有选举权者
words.example: The present voting system distorts the wishes of the electorate.  现行的选举制度不能表现选民的真实意愿。

Bill still harbours/nurses a grievance against his employers for not promoting him.  因为没有得到提升，比尔对他的雇主仍然心怀不满。
The small amount of compensation is a further source of grievance to the people forced to leave their homes.  被迫离开家园的人们仅获得很少的补偿，这成为激起他们不满的另一诱因。

Most office buildings have dozens of air ducts and vents.  大多数办公楼都有很多通风管道和通风口。
People with blocked tear ducts cannot cry.  泪管阻塞者流不出眼泪。

Mash the bananas to a pulp and then mix in the yoghurt.  把香蕉捣成糊状，然后拌到酸乳酪里。
Old newspapers are pulped and recycled.  旧报纸被化成纸浆重新利用。

words.meaning: v.向(女人)求爱；争取„的支持
words.example:
The party has been trying to woo the voters with promises of electoral reform.  该政党承诺进行选举改革，以争取选民的支持。
The airline has been offering discounted tickets to woo passengers away from their competitors.  这家航空公司一直在出售折扣机票，以从竞争对手那里争取乘客。
He wooed her for months with flowers and expensive presents.  他用鲜花和昂贵的礼物追求了她好几个月。

Who was at the helm when the collision occurred?  发生碰撞时，是谁在掌舵？
With Steve Lewis at the helm, we are certain of success.  由史蒂夫‧路易士负责，我们肯定会成功。
Britain's head of state is a constitutional monarch (= only has very limited powers).  英国的国家元首是君主立宪的女王。

Pesticides are seeping out of farmland and into the water supply.  杀虫剂正从农田中渗出，进入供水系统。
figurative Given the intense secrecy of the arms business, information only seeps out in company literature.  由于军火贸易极度保密，只能从公司的资料中获得一点蛛丝马迹。

He started feeling paranoid and was convinced his boss was going to fire him.  他开始疑神疑鬼，确信老板要解雇他。
He was diagnosed as a paranoid schizophrenic.  他被诊断患有妄想型精神分裂症。
a dangerous pathogen  一种危险的病原体

These politicians are just a bunch of crooks.  这些政客不过是一帮骗子。noun
She delicately crooked her little finger as she picked up her tea cup.  她端茶杯时优雅地翘起小指。
a forest ranger  护林员

She's relishing the prospect of studying in Bologna for six months.  她憧憬着在博洛尼亚学习6个月的美好时光。noun
Would you like relish on your burger?  你的汉堡包要涂调味汁吗？noun
She ate her cake slowly and with relish.  她津津有味地慢慢品尝着蛋糕。
a spacious house/living room  宽敞的房子／起居室

You'd better mend that hole before the whole sweater starts to unravel.  你最好把那个洞补上，免得整件毛衣脱线。
We've got a long way to go before we unravel the secrets of genetics.  在揭开遗传学之谜前，我们还有很长的路要走。 (-ll- or US USUALLY -l-)
As talks between the leaders broke down, several months of careful diplomacy were unravelled.  由于领导人之间的会谈破裂，几个月精心策划的外交努力付诸东流。

She was caught trying to smuggle 26 kilos of heroin out of/into the country.  她在企图把两万六千克的海洛因走私出境／入境时被抓获。
They managed to smuggle a videotape of the captive journalists out of the prison.  他们设法把被俘记者的录影带偷偷带出监狱。

words.meaning: n.大量；巨额；造币厂；薄荷(糖)
words.example: If his books sell in the States, he'll make a mint.  如果他的书在美国销量理想的话，他会赚一大笔钱。adjective [before noun]

Home computers are increasingly commonplace.  家用电脑越来越普及了。UK noun countable formal
We exchanged commonplaces about the weather over cups of tea.  我们喝了几杯茶，就天气方面的话题寒暄了几句。

He took an avid interest in the project.  他对这个企划案产生了极大的兴趣。
formal She hadn't seen him for six months and was avid for news.  她已六个月未曾见到他，正望穿秋水地盼着他的音讯。

Her face emanated sadness.  她脸上露出伤心的表情。 formal
Angry voices emanated from the room.  房间里传出愤怒的声音。

words.meaning: n.自治市；市政当局(指城市行政区及管理者)
words.example: The municipality provides services such as electricity, water and rubbish collection.  市政当局提供供电、供水及垃圾收集等服务。
They started quarrelling out of sheer boredom.  他们开始吵架完全是出于无聊。
Gathered all together in this church, we commemorate those who lost their lives in the great war.  我们聚集在这座教堂里，缅怀那些在大战中丧生的人。

Polly spends hours in the stables grooming her pony.  波莉在马厩里刷洗她的小马，一洗就几个小时。verb transitive
She was being groomed for leadership.  她正在接受训练以担任领导。
The bride and groom walked down the aisle together.  新娘和新郎一起走过教堂的通道。noun countable
My bank has agreed to defer the repayments on my loan while I'm still a student.  银行同意在我上学期间延迟偿还贷款。

words.meaning: a.(罪恶，疾病)猖獗的，难以遏制的
words.example:
Rampant inflation means that our wage increases soon become worth nothing.  通货膨胀涨个不停，这意味着我们增长的工资很快就一钱不值了。
He said that he had encountered rampant prejudice in his attempts to get a job.  他说他在找工作时，四处遭受歧视。
Disease is rampant in the overcrowded city.  疾病在过分拥挤的城市中肆虐。adjective

Our conversation came to an abrupt end when George burst into the room.  乔治突然冲进房间里，我们的谈话戛然而止。
The road ended in an abrupt (= sudden and very steep) slope down to the sea.  道路沿一个险峭陡坡俯冲到海边，就到了尽头。adjective
He is sometimes very abrupt with clients.  他有时对待客户非常粗鲁。
There were several simultaneous explosions in different cities.  几起爆炸同时在不同的城市发生。

Cannabis has been used for medicinal purposes since antiquity.  自古以来，大麻就一直用于治病。
Before creating this sculpture, she studied all the masterpieces of classical antiquity.  在创作这件雕塑之前，她研究了所有古希腊和古罗马时代的雕塑杰作。
Under Greek law, all antiquities that are discovered in Greece belong to the government.  根据希腊法律，在希腊发现的所有古物均归政府所有。

She nestled (her head) against his shoulder.  她（把头）靠在他肩膀上。
Bregenz is a pretty Austrian town that nestles between the Alps and Lake Constance.  布雷根茨是奥地利的一座美丽城镇，坐落于阿尔卑斯山和康斯坦茨湖之间。

All of a sudden, the car veered off the road.  突然那辆车改变方向冲出了公路。
Moments before crashing, the jet was seen veering sharply to the right.  坠机之前的一瞬间，有人看见那架喷气式飞机猛地转向右方。
Three men were feared dead last night after a helicopter veered off course into an oil platform.  昨晚一架直升机偏离航线撞上了石油钻井平台，恐怕有三人因此死亡。

There's still a shred of hope that a peace agreement can be reached.  达成和平协议仍存有一丝希望。
There isn't a shred of evidence to support her accusation.  关于她的指控没有丝毫证据可以支援。noun
My shirt was in shreds when I took it out of the washer.  我把内衣从洗衣机里拿出来时，它已经变成了碎布条。
Treat minor ailments yourself.  一点儿小毛病可以自己治。
He's a very versatile young actor who's as happy in horror films as he is in TV comedies.  他是一个非常多才多艺的年轻演员，无论是演恐怖片还是电视喜剧都一样得心应手。

words.meaning: v. 发出低沉的隆隆声音
words.example:
Please excuse my stomach rumbling - I haven't eaten all day.  不好意思，我肚子在咕咕叫——我一整天都没吃东西了。
The tanks rumbled (= moved slowly, making a continuous noise) across the battlefield.  坦克轰鸣着驶过战场。verb
I'm afraid our little tax dodge has been rumbled.  恐怕我们逃税的小把戏被识破了。verb
Mahler's 9th symphony  马勒的《第九交响曲》
The dog growled at her and snapped at her ankles.  那只狗咆哮着在她脚踝上咬了一口。
For Christians, the Virgin Mary is a symbol of purity.  对基督徒来说，圣母玛莉亚是贞洁的象征。

The shelf sagged under the weight of the heavy books.  书架被沉重的书压弯了。
The dollar held up well this morning but the pound sagged.  今天上午美元走挺，但英镑下跌了。noun
Did you leave his name out by accident or was it intentional?  你漏掉了他的名字，是无意的还是有意的？

words.meaning: n. 呕吐；呕吐物；催吐剂
words.example:
He came home drunk and vomited all over the kitchen floor.  他醉醺醺地回到家里，在厨房里吐了一地。
She was vomiting (up) blood.  她在吐血。
The government has reiterated its refusal to compromise with terrorists.  政府重申拒绝向恐怖分子妥协。
the rhythmic sound of the train  火车有节奏的声音

words.meaning: n./a. 代用品(的)；权宜之计(的)
words.example: Thousands of refugees are living in makeshift camps.  数千个难民居住在临时帐篷里。

words.meaning: v. 缓冲，为„冲当缓冲器
words.example: Silly old buffer!  愚蠢的老古板！UK verb transitive

The school has to rely on the goodwill of the parents to help it raise money.  这所学校要依赖学生家长们的声誉来帮助筹款。
Releasing the hostages has been seen as a gesture of goodwill/a goodwill gesture.  释放人质被视为表示友好的姿态。
She is expected to announce officially her candidacy for president early next week.  预计她会在下周初正式宣布成为总统候选人。

They lived in perpetual fear of being discovered and arrested.  他们长期生活在恐惧中，担心被发现并遭到拘捕。
He has hard, cold eyes and his mouth is set in a perpetual sneer.  他双眼又凶又冷，嘴角总是挂着一丝蔑笑。

To sleep on, we improvised a mattress from a pile of blankets.  为了能有地方睡觉，我们临时用一堆毯子作床垫。
During certain scenes of the play there isn't any script and the actors just improvise (the dialogue).  这出戏有几场没有剧本，演员就即兴表演（对白）。
She has so many facets to her personality.  她的性格具有多面性。

The customs official beckoned the woman to his counter.  海关官员示意那妇人到他桌前来。
"Hey you!", she called, beckoning me over with her finger.  “嘿，我在叫你呢！”她喊道，并用手指示意我过去。
He beckoned to me, as if he wanted to speak to me.  他给我打手势，好像是要跟我说甚么。

words.meaning: v.(建筑物等)下陷；(天气等)平息
words.example:
The police are hoping that the violence will soon subside.  警方希望暴力事件会很快平息。
As the pain in my foot subsided, I was able to walk the short distance to the car.  我的脚没那么痛了，我能够勉强走一小段路，走到车旁。verb intransitive
There is a danger that many homes will subside because of the drought.  由于干旱，很多房子面临下陷的危险。
illicit drugs such as cocaine and cannabis  古柯碱和大麻之类的违禁药物

With one movement, she disarmed the man and pinned him against the wall.  她一下子就缴了那男子的械，并把他按到墙上。
Many politicians argued that this was no time to disarm (= give up the country's weapons and army).  很多政治家争辩说现在不是交出国家的武器和军队的时候。
Experts successfully managed to disarm the bomb (= stop it from exploding).  专家们成功地拆除了炸弹的引信。UK verb
Although he's shy, it certainly hasn't impeded his career in any way.  尽管他很害羞，但这显然一点也没有妨碍他的事业。

words.meaning: n.全神贯注；使人专注的东西
words.example:
My main preoccupation now is trying to keep life normal for the sake of my two boys.  我现在想得最多的是要为了我的两个儿子而尽力使生活保持正常。
Lately, his preoccupation with football had caused his marks at school to slip.  最近他一心想着足球，学校成绩都退步了。

words.meaning: n.抗体(身体中的抗病物质)
words.example: Antibodies found in breast milk protect newborn babies against infection.  母乳中含有的抗体可保护新生婴儿免受感染。

The old man clenched his fist and waved it angrily at us.  那老头紧握着拳头，气哼哼地向我们挥舞着。
With a knife clenched in/between his teeth, he climbed up the tree to cut some coconuts.  他嘴里紧咬着一把刀，爬上树去割椰子。
"Get out of here, " she said through clenched teeth.  “滚出去，”她咬牙切齿地说。

words.meaning: a.不育的；贫瘠的；不结果实的
words.example:
We drove through a barren, rocky landscape.  我们驾车时，经过一个到处都是岩石的不毛之地。
She became very depressed during the barren years when she was unable to paint.  她在作品匮乏的那几年间，变得非常消沉。    Compare fertile

The proceeds from the sale go to help needy people in the area.  此次义卖的收入用来帮助该地区的穷人。
Sybil was very insecure and needy.  西比尔很缺乏安全感，很需要别人的关怀。plural noun
Let us pray for those who are not so fortunate as ourselves - the sick, the old and the needy.  让我们为那些比我们不幸的病弱者、老人和穷人祈祷吧。

We had to take the front door off its hinges to get our new sofa into the house.  我们不得不把前门从铰炼上卸下来，这样我们的新沙发才能搬进屋子里。verb
The prosecution's case hinged on the evidence of a witness who died before the trial.  控方的案子取决于一位证人的证词，而该证人已在审判前死去。
The film's plot hinges on a case of mistaken identity.  该电影的情节围绕着一宗身份误认案件展开。
What did you say, petal?  你说甚么，宝贝？
Mr Masack is an outspoken critic of the present government.  马塞克先生是一位对现政府直言不讳的批评家。

Did I hurt you? - I thought I saw you wince.  我弄痛你了吗？——好像看到你皱了一下眉。
It makes me wince even thinking about eye operations.  一想到眼部手术，我就不由得眉头一皱。

words.meaning: v. 扔或抛，抛弃，解雇；辞职
words.example:
Chuck it over there/into the corner.  把它扔到那里／角落里就行了。
He's just chucked his girlfriend.  他刚甩了女朋友。verb
"Cheer up, " she said and chucked the little girl under the chin.  “高兴起来，”她说着轻抚了一下小女孩的下巴。verb
Mundane matters such as paying bills and shopping for food do not interest her.  她对付帐单、购买食物等单调的琐事不感兴趣。

Two children were trapped in the wreckage.  两名儿童被困在残骸里。
The wreckage of the car was scattered over the roadside.  那辆汽车的残骸散落在路旁。
Kate was still clinging to the wreckage of her failed marriage.  凯特仍然执著于她那破碎的婚姻，不想放手。

words.meaning: a.审慎的，三思而后行的；判断力强的，精明的；节俭的

words.example: The moon is a celestial body.  月亮是天体中的一员。

The jury returned a unanimous verdict of guilty after a short deliberation.  陪审团经过短时间商讨后一致裁决有罪。
After a lengthy discussion we reached a unanimous decision on the proposal.  经过长时间讨论，我们对这一提案作出了一致决定。
The new format has unanimous support and could be introduced next season.  新的设计获得了一致支持，将会在下个季度推广使用。

The continuation of the strike caused a lot of poverty.  持续罢工造成了大量贫困现象。
It's just a continuation of the bigger river, but called by a different name.  它实际上是那条大河的延续，只是名称不同而已。

The children had smeared peanut butter all over the sofa.  孩子们把花生酱抹得沙发上到处都是。
Can you explain why the front of your car is smeared with blood?  你能解释一下为甚么你的汽车前部沾有血迹吗？UK verb
She decided to sue for libel after the newspaper smeared her private life.  这家报纸对她的私生活造谣诬蔑，她决定告以诽谤罪。UK noun countable

Her energy and intellect are respected all over the world.  她的干劲和才智得到了全世界的尊重。
He is a man more noted for his intellect than his charm.  相比其魅力，他的才智更为人瞩目。

He etched his name on a piece of glass.  他把自己的名字蚀刻在一块玻璃上。verb transitive
His face was etched with pain.  他的脸上流露出痛苦的神情。
Confusion and sadness were etched on their faces.  他们一脸的迷茫和悲哀。
an inspired performance/choice  精彩的表演／凭直觉做的选择

The film 'White Christmas' is a perennial favourite.  《白色圣诞》是一部经久不衰、深受欢迎的影片。
We face the perennial problem of not having enough money.  我们长期面临资金不足的问题。    Compare annual ; biennialnoun countable
Roses and geraniums are perennials, flowering year after year.  玫瑰和天竺葵是多年生植物，年复一年地开花。    Compare annual
To what do you attribute your longevity?  你的长寿归功于哪些因素？

words.meaning: v.(部分地)重叠；(部分地)巧合
words.example:
The fence is made of panels which overlap (each other).  这个围栏是由交叠的板条搭成的。
My musical tastes don't overlap with my brother's at all.  我对音乐的喜好和我弟弟完全不一样。noun countable or uncountable UK US [ˈoʊ.və˞-/
The roof tiles will need an overlap of several centimetres.  屋顶的瓦片需要互相重叠几公分。

The muse has left me - I haven't written any poetry for months!  灵感离我而去——我已有数月没写过一首诗了！
Juliet was not only the painter's best model but also his muse (= the person who causes him to have the most ideas for his work).  茱丽叶不仅是这位画家最好的模特儿，也是他灵感的泉源。

He inflated the balloons with helium.  他给气球充了氦气。
We watch the hot-air balloon slowly inflate.  我们看着热气球慢慢胀大。verb
They inflated their part in the rescue every time they told the story.  他们每次讲这个故事时都要夸大自己在营救中的贡献。

The pulling down of the Berlin Wall infused the world with optimism.  柏林围墙的倒塌使全世界欢欣鼓舞。
The arrival of a group of friends on Saturday infused new life into the weekend.  星期六一群朋友的到来给周末生活注入了新的活力。verb
Allow the tea to infuse for five minutes.  让茶泡五分钟。

Blood trickled out of the corner of his mouth.  血从他的嘴角滴了下来。
Oil was trickling from a tiny hole in the tank.  油正从油罐上的一个小孔往下滴。verb intransitive
Gradually people trickled back into the theatre for the second half.  渐渐地，人们开始三三两两地回到剧院看下半场。noun

Statistical anomalies can make it difficult to compare economic data from one year to the next.  统计上的不规范会使年与年之间的经济数据难以互相比较。
The anomaly of the social security system is that you sometimes have more money without a job.  社会保障制度下的反常现像是，失业有时反而拿钱更多。
movie/media/industry moguls  电影／传媒／工业巨头UK noun countable

It was a windy night.  那是个多风的夜晚。
It was wet and windy for most of the week.  本周的大部分时间都在刮风下雨。
Gas lamps became obsolete when electric lighting was invented.  电灯发明以后煤气灯就被淘汰了。

Police hope the public will help them to find the culprits.  警方希望公众能协助他们抓到罪犯。
Children in this country are getting much too fat, and sugar and sweets are the main culprits.  该国儿童过于肥胖，糖和甜食是罪魁祸首。

He went bankrupt after only a year in business.  他仅仅做了一年的生意就破产了。
The recession has led to many small businesses going bankrupt.  经济不景气导致许多小企业破产。
He believes that modern society is morally bankrupt.  他认为现代社会道德沦亡。noun countable legal
Is there a causal relationship between violence on television and violent behaviour?  电视暴力和暴力行为之间有因果关系吗？
an arms cache  武器隐藏地

words.meaning: n./v.(从灾难中)抢救，海上救助
words.example:
After the fire, there wasn't much furniture left worth salvaging.  火灾之后，没有剩下多少值得抢救的家俱。
It was a desperate attempt to salvage the situation.  挽回这种局面的希望渺茫。
After the fraud scandal he had to make great efforts to salvage his reputation.  诈骗丑闻传出后，他不得不极力挽回自己的声誉。
The two cultures were so utterly disparate that she found it hard to adapt from one to the other.  这两种文化截然不同，她发现很难由一种文化转而去适应另一种文化。
The women gathered around the coffin and began to wail, as was the custom in the region.  女人们都围到了棺材旁，开始号啕大哭，当地的风俗就是这样。

Because she had no children of her own, her friend's son became a kind of surrogate child to her.  因为她自己没有孩子，所以她就把朋友的儿子当成自己的孩子。UK noun
For some people, reading travel books is a surrogate for actual travel.  对某些人来说，读游记可以替代真正的旅行。
She has agreed to act as a surrogate mother for her sister.  她已经同意为她姐姐代孕。
He told one or two amusing anecdotes about his years as a policeman.  他讲了一两件他当员警时发生的趣事。

words.meaning: n.诡辩，强词夺理；久经世故，老练，精明
words.example:
Her sophistication is evident from the way she dresses.  从衣着打扮明显可以看出她精明老练。
The sophistication of computers is increasing.  电脑的精密程度越来越高。
sports apparel  运动服装
She has some rather contentious views on education.  她对教育持有一些颇具争议的看法。

words.meaning: a.完成了的；有技巧的，有造诣的
words.example:
She's a very accomplished pianist/painter/horsewoman.  她是一位很有造诣的钢琴家／很有才华的画家／技艺高超的骑师。
He was accomplished in all the arts.  他精通各门艺术。

words.meaning: a.（物）易破碎的，脆弱的；（人身体）不坚实的
words.example: a frail old lady  孱弱的老妪

We could hear the elephants trumpeting in the distance.  我们可以听见远处大象的吼声。verb
The museum has been loudly trumpeting its reputation as one of the finest in the world.  该博物馆一直在大肆吹嘘自己是世界上最好的博物馆之一。
Their much- trumpeted price cuts affect only 5% of the goods that they sell.  他们极力吹嘘的降价只涉及到所卖商品的5%。

The bone had been honed to a point.  那块骨头已经被磨尖了。UK verb transitive
His physique was honed to perfection.  他的身材锻炼得很完美。
Her debating skills were honed in the students' union.  她的辩论技巧是在学生会里磨练出来的。

The knife severed an artery and he bled to death.  刀子割断了动脉，他流血过多而死。
Her foot was severed from her leg in a car accident.  在一次车祸中，她的脚断了。
Electricity cables have been severed by the storm.  风暴弄断了电缆。

The people revolted against foreign rule and established their own government.  人们奋起反抗外来统治，并成立了自己的政府。UK verb
We were revolted by the dirt and mess in her house.  她家里又脏又乱，我们看着心里生厌。
It revolts me to know that the world spends so much money on arms when millions are dying of hunger.  这个世界有数以百万计的人因饥饿挣扎在死亡线上，但却有那么多的钱花在军备上，这真让我感到震惊。
She gave a clear, factual account of the attack.  她如实地清晰陈述了遇袭经过。

words.meaning: n. 皮带扣环；v. 扣紧
words.example:
The intense heat from the fire had caused the factory roof to buckle.  大火的高温烤得工厂的屋顶变了形。
Both wheels on the bicycle had been badly buckled.  脚踏车的两个车轮都已严重变形。
But these were difficult times and a lesser man would have buckled under the strain.  但当时是困难时期，脆弱的人肯定会被压力压垮。verb

words.meaning: v.使不相信，使怀疑；n.丧失名誉
words.example:
Evidence of links with drug dealers has discredited the President.  总统与贩毒分子有染的证据使他名誉扫地。
The stupid behaviour of one pupil has brought discredit on the whole school.  一名学生的愚蠢行为让整个学校蒙羞。
To her discredit, she never admitted her role in the scandal.  她一直不承认自己参与了这桩丑闻，这使她在人们心中的形象大打折扣。

Whenever you see an officer, you must salute.  只要见到军官就必须敬礼。
The soldiers saluted the colonel.  士兵们向上校敬礼。verb
On this memorable occasion we salute the wonderful work done by the association.  在这个难忘的时刻，我们对协会出色的成就表示赞扬。
The inscriptions on the gravestones were worn away.  墓碑上的碑文已经消蚀了。

He was clasping the vase tightly, terrified of dropping it.  他紧紧抱住花瓶，生怕把它摔了。
Lie on your back, clasp your knees and pull them down towards your chest.  仰卧，抱紧双膝，并拉向胸前。
She clasped her son in her arms.  她把儿子紧紧抱在怀里。UK noun
It is unclear how to mitigate the effects of tourism on the island.  人们还不清楚如何减低旅游业对这个岛屿的影响。

words.meaning: n. 怪物，奇事；a. 反常的
words.example:
The pearl, valued at £75 000, is so big that it has been described as a freak of nature.  这颗价值7.5万英镑的珍珠个头很大，被称为自然界的奇物。
humorous At my school you were regarded as a freak if you weren't interested in sport.  在我所在的学校，不爱好体育就会被视为异类。noun
My parents freaked when I told them I was pregnant.  我告诉父母自己怀孕后，他们非常兴奋。

The dead sheep was covered with swarms of flies.  这头死羊身上爬满一群群的苍蝇。
After the game, thousands of football fans swarmed onto the pitch.  比赛后，成千上万的足球迷涌进球场。UK verb intransitive
The garden is swarming with wasps.  花园里到处都是黄蜂。

words.meaning: n.沙粒；决心，勇气；v.下定决心，咬紧牙关
words.example:
The road had been covered with grit.  以前这条路一直铺满沙砾。noun uncountable
It takes true (= real) grit to stand up to a bully.  面对一个恃强凌弱者奋起反抗确实需要勇气。noun uncountable
Council lorries had been out gritting the icy roads the night before.  政务委员会在第一天夜里派出卡车在结冰的路面上撒了沙砾。verb transitive (-tt-)

There's some sort of obstruction on the railway tracks.  铁轨上有障碍物。
They were charged with obstruction of the police/of justice (= preventing the police/law courts from doing their jobs).  他们被指控妨碍警方执行公务／法庭审判。
The referee said it was obstruction.  裁判判定这是阻挡犯规。

words.meaning: v.抚慰，使平静；减轻(痛苦，疼痛)
words.example: to soothe a crying baby  让哭闹的婴儿安静下来verb transitive
the Korean/Arabian/Florida Peninsula  朝鲜／阿拉伯／佛罗里达半岛

words.meaning: a.有远见的；幻想的，空想的；n.空想家
words.example: a visionary author  有远见的作者

words.meaning: v.因某事物脸红；n.因羞愧等脸上泛出的红晕

words.example:
The two groups despise each other.  这两个团体互相鄙视。
She despised him for the way he treated her sister.  他那样对待她姐姐，让她感到很厌恶。

Aid workers were said to have been filled with dismay by the appalling conditions that the refugees were living in.  据说援助人员看到难民所处的恶劣生活环境时都感到非常沮丧。
The supporters watched in/with dismay as their team lost 6-0.  球队的支持者们郁闷地看着自己的球队以０比６的比分输掉了比赛。
She discovered, to her dismay, that her exam was a whole month earlier than she'd expected.  她郁闷地发现考试比她预料的早了整整一个月。

They hope to emulate the success of other software companies.  他们希望能够效仿其他软体公司的成功先例。
Fitzgerald is keen to emulate Martin's record of three successive world titles.  费兹杰罗渴望能像马丁那样创下连夺三次世界冠军的纪录。

words.meaning: a.浪费的，过分花费的；丰富的
words.example:
The evening was a lavish affair with glorious food and an endless supply of champagne.  晚会很豪华，食物精美可口，香槟源源不断。
The lavish production makes this musical truly memorable.  这部音乐剧的豪华制作阵容给人留下了深刻印象。verb
She lavishes money on her grandchildren.  她为孙辈们倾注大量金钱。

words.meaning: v.抑制；n.歌曲的反复句，叠句
words.example:
We refrained from talking until we knew that it was safe.  我们缄默不语，直到确定安全了才开始说话。
'Every vote counts' is a familiar refrain in politics.  “每一票都重要”是政治上的老生常谈。
an affected manner/style of writing  矫揉造作的文风

words.meaning: a.友善的；即将离开的；即将离职的
words.example: Outgoing flights are booked until January 15th.  离境航班一直预订到1月15日。
The last government severely curtailed trade union rights.  上届政府严格限制工会权利。
He felt that moving out from his parents' home was a real milestone in his life.  他感到搬出父母家是他一生中一个真正的转捩点。
Fierce storms have been hampering rescue efforts and there is now little chance of finding more survivors.  猛烈的暴风雨妨碍了救援工作的进行，现在找到更多生还者的希望已经很渺茫了。UK noun countable
She's very proud of her ancient royal lineage.  她为自己拥有古老的皇室血统倍感自豪。
Medieval banquets are held in the castle once a month.  每个月在城堡里举行一次中世纪风格的宴会。
Her motto is "Work hard, play hard".  她的座右铭是“努力工作，痛快玩乐”。

They have a very luxurious house.  他们有一座十分豪华的房子。
We spent a luxurious weekend at a country hotel.  我们在一家乡村饭店渡过了一个奢华的周末。
The cat gave a long, luxurious stretch.  猫舒舒服服地伸了一个长长的懒腰。

Many countries have now ratified the UN convention on the rights of the child.  很多国家现在已经正式签署了联合国儿童权利公约。
The decision will have to be ratified (= approved) by the executive board.  这个决议必须要经过管理委员会的批准。

The disease destroys much of the inner-ear, disturbing the animal's equilibrium.  这种疾病破坏动物内耳的大部分组织，妨碍其保持均衡。
Yoga is said to restore one's inner equilibrium.  据说练瑜伽可以使人恢复内心的平静。
Taste the soup and adjust the seasoning, adding more salt or pepper as desired.  尝一下汤，调好佐料，根据口味再加些盐或胡椒粉。
The sauce itself was light, fragrant and slightly sweet.  酱料本身味道清淡、芳香，而且稍微有点甜味。

Yesterday's coup brought further upheaval to a country already struggling with famine.  昨天的军事政变使这个正在饥荒中挣扎的国家更加动荡不安。
It would cause a tremendous upheaval to install a different computer system.  安装一个不同的电脑系统会导致极大的混乱。
molten lava  融化的熔岩

words.meaning: a.显著的，非凡的，了不起的
words.example: Her rise to fame was quite phenomenal - in less than two years she was a household name.  她的成名历程真是奇迹——不到两年的时间，她的大名已经家喻户晓了。
fluorescent lighting  烛光照明UK adjective

He was an imposing figure on stage.  他在舞台上气度不凡。
Would it be too much of an imposition to ask you to pick my parents up from the airport?  请您去机场接我父母是不是太强人所难了？noun

words.meaning: adv.不小心地，非故意地，无意地
words.example: He inadvertently deleted the file.  他不小心把档案删除了。

Chris sent me a lovely bouquet when I was ill.  我生病时克里斯送了一束漂亮的花给我。UK noun
This wine has a rich, oaky bouquet.  这种葡萄酒有浓郁的橡木香气。

The river was brown and murky after the storm.  暴风雨过后，河水变成了褐色，浑浊不清。UK adjective
He became involved in the murky world of international drug-dealing.  他卷入了阴暗复杂的跨国贩毒生意中。

words.meaning: a.中产阶级的；自私拜物的
words.example: It's a bit bourgeois, isn't it, joining a golf club?  参加高尔夫球俱乐部有点庸俗，不是吗？
She's a very demanding child.  她是个特别不让人省心的孩子。

His tutor encouraged him to read widely in philosophy.  他的导师鼓励他广泛阅读哲学著作。
During my illness I was taught by a series of home tutors.  我生病期间由一些家庭教师教我。

Melanin is the dark brown pigment of the hair, skin and eyes which is present in varying amounts in every human being.  黑色素是头发、皮肤和眼睛中的黑褐色色素，每个人体内或多或少都有这种色素。
Pigment is mixed into oil, glue, egg, etc. to make different types of paint.  将颜料与油、胶水、鸡蛋等混合，制成各种涂料。

People who work with furnaces in a steel factory need to wear protective clothing.  钢厂里在熔炉边工作的人都需要穿防护服。
This room's like a furnace (= is very hot) !  这个房间热得像熔炉！
It's cold in here - should I turn on the furnace?  这里很冷——要不要我把暖气炉打开？

We spent the day trekking through forests and over mountains.  白天我们穿过丛林，翻山越岭。
informal I trekked walked a long and tiring distance all the way into town to meet him and he didn't even turn up.  我大老远好不容易进城来看他，他却连面都不露一下。noun countable
We did an eight hour trek yesterday.  昨天我们走了八个小时。
Have you seen this handy little gadget - it's for separating egg yolks from whites.  你见过这种很有用处的小装置吗——它是用来把蛋黄和蛋白分开的。

It's a typical action film with plenty of spectacular stunts.  这是部典型的动作片，有很多精彩好看的特技。
Tom Cruise has performed his own stunts for Mission Impossible 2, defying warnings from professionals.  汤姆‧克鲁斯不顾专业人员的警告，在《不可能的任务 2》中亲自表演自己的特技动作。noun countable
Their marriage was just a cheap publicity stunt.  他们的婚姻不过是低级宣传噱头。noun countable

Most people have an intuitive sense of right and wrong.  大多数人具有基于直觉的是非感。
Men are often regarded as less intuitive than women.  一般都认为男人的直觉不如女人敏锐。
He would have to find work to augment his income.  他可能不得不找一些工作来增加收入。

The painter has managed to capture every nuance of the woman's expression.  画家对这个女子面部表情的刻画细致入微。
Linguists explore the nuances of language.  语言学家研究语言的细微差别。
The union safeguards the interests of all its members.  工会捍卫每位成员的利益。UK verb transitive

Big supermarkets can undercut all rivals, especially small high-street shops.  大型超市售价可以低于所有竞争对手，尤其是那些商业街上的小店铺。
They claim to undercut their competitors by at least 5%.  他们宣称售价至少要比竞争对手低5%。UK US (undercutting, undercut, undercut)
He suspected it was an attempt to undercut his authority.  他怀疑这是企图削弱他的权力。
The way she looked after her little sister was really touching.  她照顾小妹妹的方法真令人感动。

She has shunned publicity since she retired from the theatre.  告别舞台生涯后，她便远离了大众的注意。
After the trial he was shunned by friends and family alike.  审判后，朋友和家人都躲着他。

The government claims to be doing all it can to eradicate corruption.  政府声称正尽其所能根治腐败。
The disease which once claimed millions of lives has now been eradicated.  这种曾夺去数百万人生命的疾病现在已被根除了。
interdisciplinary courses  跨学科课程
a horrific accident/crime  极其可怕的意外事故／骇人的罪行

The airline has been criticized for failing to heed advice/warnings about lack of safety routines.  该航空公司因没有理会针对其日常安全工作不力所提出的建议／警告而受到批评。 formal
The company took no heed of (= did not consider) public opposition to the plans.  那家公司毫不在意大众对那些计划的反对。

I'm allergic to cats.  我对猫过敏。
My dad's allergic to pop music.  我爸爸非常讨厌流行音乐。

words.meaning: n.突然向前或旁边倒；v.蹒跚而行
words.example:
The train lurched forward and some of the people standing fell over.  火车突然向前晃动了一下，一些站着的人跌倒了。
We seem to lurch from crisis to crisis.  我们似乎总是跌跌撞撞，危机不断。
She just lurches from one bad relationship to another.  她情路坎坷，一次次地失恋。UK noun countable
She has to have insulin injections for her diabetes.  她因患有糖尿病必须注射胰岛素。

He pays scant attention to the needs of his children.  他很少关心自己孩子的需求。
Add a scant half litre (= almost half a litre) of milk to the mixture and stir well.  把接近半升（差不多半升）的牛奶加进混合的食材中搅拌均匀。
She's been likened to a young Elizabeth Taylor.  人们说她很像年轻时的伊丽莎白‧泰勒。

Her publishers knew they were taking a gamble when they agreed to publish such an unusual novel.  她的出版商知道，同意出版这样一部标新立异的小说是一种冒险。
It was a gamble using such an inexperienced director, but it paid off (= was successful).  任用这样一位没有经验的导演确实是一种赌博，但结果大获成功。verb
Anyone who gambles on the stock exchange has to be prepared to lose money.  任何进行股票投机的人都必须要做好赔钱的准备。
a computer console  电脑控制台

words.meaning: a.敏捷的，活泼的；清新健康的
words.example:
He set a brisk pace and we struggled to keep up.  他步伐矫健，我们在后面拼命跟着。
Her tone on the telephone was brisk (= she spoke quickly and used few words) and businesslike.  电话里她的语气简洁干练。

He cleared a space, heaving boxes out of the way.  他搬开箱子挪出一处空间。
She picked up a great book and heaved it at him.  她拿起一本大书就朝他扔过去。
As the wind increased, the deck of the ship began to heave beneath his feet.  随着风力增大，轮船甲板开始在他脚下颠簸起来。verb
Everyone looked very solemn.  大家看起来都很严肃。

words.meaning: v.装玻璃于；上釉彩；n.釉(薄而亮的透明表面)
words.example:
The house is nearly finished but it hasn't been glazed yet.  房子即将完工，但是窗户还没有装玻璃。verb
Glaze the pastry with beaten egg.  往油酥面团里加入打匀的鸡蛋，好使它亮滑。
The pot had been badly glazed.  这个罐子上釉上得很差。verb
The new report concurs with previous findings.  新报告与先前的调查结果一致。

He's been in a coma for the past six weeks.  在过去的六个星期里，他一直昏迷不醒。
She went into a deep coma after taking an overdose of sleeping pills.  她服用过量安眠药后，陷入了深度昏迷。
a hymn book  赞美诗集

That kind of behaviour is sure to cause irritation.  那种行为肯定会让人感到恼火。
Traffic noise is just one of several minor irritations (= small problems).  交通噪音只是烦人的琐事之一。noun countable or uncountable
It is an antiseptic cream suitable for minor skin irritations.  这种杀菌乳膏适用于轻微的皮肤炎症。

What amazes me is her complete disregard for anyone else's opinion.  让我吃惊的是，她完全无视他人的意见。UK verb transitive
He told us to disregard everything we'd learned so far and start again.  他告诉我们不要考虑所学过的东西，一切要重新开始。
Aspirin reduces pain and inflammation.  阿司匹林可缓解疼痛和炎症。

The prize winners each receive a book with their names inscribed on the first page.  每名获奖者都得到一本首页题有他们签名的书。
The wall of the church was inscribed with the names of the dead from the Great War.  教堂墙壁上镌刻着第一次世界大战中死难者的名字。

They used sleep deprivation as a form of torture.  他们把不让人睡觉作为一种折磨人的手段。
There is awful deprivation in the shanty towns.  贫民区的生活条件十分糟糕。
There were food shortages and other deprivations during the Civil War.  南北战事期间，食品短缺，物资匮乏。

words.meaning: a.暴露的，裸露的；揭露真相的
words.example: a revealing dress/shirt  过于暴露的连衣裙／衬衣

The first mobile phones were heavy and clumsy to use, but nowadays they are much easier to handle.  第一代手机用起来很笨重，而现在的手机就轻便多了。
My attempts to apologize were very clumsy (= not said well).  我想道歉，却拙嘴笨舌的。
That's the third glass you've smashed this week - you're so clumsy!  这已经是你这个星期打破的第三只杯子了——真是太笨了！

words.meaning: a.(指人)健谈的，开朗的；可扩大的，可伸展的
words.example:
He was in an expansive mood on the night of the party.  聚会那天晚上，他情绪很好，豪爽健谈。adjective
There was an expansive view from the window.  从窗口望去，辽阔的景色一览无遗。
"All this is mine," she said with an expansive (= using big movements) arm gesture.  “所有这一切都是我的，”她一边比手画脚一边说着。

words.meaning: a.(规定)严格的，苛刻的；缺钱的
words.example:
The most stringent laws in the world are useless unless there is the will to enforce them.  除非能够坚持严格执法，否则即使是世界上最严苛的法律也毫无用处。
We need to introduce more stringent security measures such as identity cards.  我们需要采取更为严格的安全措施，例如发放识别证。
Stringent safety regulations were introduced after the accident.  事故之后制定了严格的安全规范。adjective

She prodded the cake with her fork to see if it was cooked.  她用叉子戳了戳蛋糕看是不是熟了。
He prodded at the fish with his fork a few times, but he didn't eat a mouthful.  他用叉子戳了几次鱼，但一口也没有吃。
He gets things done, but only after I've prodded him into doing them.  他把事情做完了，不过是在我的督促下他才这么做的。UK noun
He shows no overt signs of his unhappiness.  他没有明显表现出不高兴。    Compare covert

words.meaning: n.古鲁(印度的宗教领袖)；(受尊敬的)教师或权威
words.example: a management guru  管理界泰斗
What do you infer from her refusal?  你从她的拒绝中能推断出甚么？

Sometimes you have to be prepared to act on/follow a hunch.  有时候你要有心理准备依直觉行事。verb intransitive or transitive
We hunched round the fire to keep warm.  我们弓着身子围在火边取暖。
Stand up straight and don't hunch your back.  站直，别弯着腰。

She took me to see a really dull film, the only redeeming feature of which (= the only thing which prevented it from being completely bad) was the soundtrack.  她带我去看了场极为乏味的电影，唯一不错的就是配乐。verb
She managed to save enough money to redeem her jewellery from the pawn shop.  她设法存够了钱，把自己的首饰从当铺赎了回来。verb
The amount required to redeem the mortgage was £358 587.  偿付抵押贷款一共需要358 587英镑。verb

The racing world is a pretty close-knit fraternity.  赛马界是一个联系相当密切的群体。
He described sport as a symbol of peace and a means of promoting fraternity between nations.  他把体育运动描述为和平的象征和增进民族友谊的手段。

words.meaning: n.愚蠢；愚蠢的行为，思想或做法
words.example: She said that the idea was folly.  她说这是个愚蠢的主意。

Wash your hands so you don't get germs on the food.  洗洗手，你就不会把细菌弄到食物上了。
Rats and flies spread germs.  老鼠和苍蝇传播病菌。UK noun
He found the germ of an idea in an old newspaper.  他的想法萌生于一份旧报纸。
a chic restaurant  高雅的餐厅

words.meaning: v.偏离，迷路；a.迷了路的，偏离的；零落的，散乱的
words.example:
They got lost when they strayed too far from the footpath.  他们偏离小路太远，迷了路。
The ship strayed off course during the storm.  船在暴风雨中偏离了航道。
Sorry - I've strayed from the subject.  对不起——我离题了。noun countable

She seems to have a natural affinity for/with water.  她好像天生就喜欢水。
There are several close affinities between the two paintings.  这两幅画有多处非常相似的地方。

The gold medal continues to elude her.  金牌依旧和她无缘。
They had minor breakthroughs but real success eluded them.  他们获得了一些小的突破，但没有获得真正的成功。verb transitive
They eluded the police by fleeing.  他们纷纷逃窜，避开了警方的搜捕。verb transitive

At 6:30, everyone gathered for drinks and appetizers in the lounge.  6点30分，大家聚在休息室中喝饮料，吃小吃。
The average cost of a full three-course meal - appetizer, main course and dessert - including tip and a modest wine is about $45.  一顿包括前菜、主菜和甜点三部分的全份西餐——包括小费和一瓶普通葡萄酒——一般要花45美元左右。
The ship is an exact replica of the original Golden Hind.  这艘船是按照“金色石斑鱼”号原样仿造的。
The refugee camps sprawl across the landscape.  眼前杂乱地散落着许多难民营。UK US  disapproving

words.meaning: a.意外的；视情况或条件而定的
words.example:
The French contingent certainly made their presence known at this year's conference.  法国代表团在今年的会议上确实表现出众。
Outdoor arrangements are, as ever, contingent on the weather.  同以前一样，室外布置依天气而定。
Our success is contingent upon your support.  我们的成功有赖于你的支援。

The milk overflowed when I poured it into the jug.  我往壶里倒牛奶的时候，牛奶溢了出来。
Because of heavy rain, the river may overflow its banks.  因为下大雨，河水可能会氾滥，漫过河岸。
Oh no, the bath is overflowing all over the floor.  啊呀，糟糕，浴缸满了，水流得满地都是。

Her latest book has engendered a lot of controversy.  她的新作引起了很大争议。
The minister's speech did not engender confidence in his judgment.  部长的演讲并未使人们对他的判断产生信心。

He suddenly let out a piercing shriek.  他突然发出一声刺耳的尖叫。verb intransitive or transitive
We shrieked with laughter when we realized how stupid we'd been.  意识到自己有多愚蠢时，我们大笑了起来。
There are many priorities, but reducing the budget deficit is paramount/is of paramount importance.  很多事情要优先解决，但当务之急是减少预算赤字。

I'm taking four hundred pounds' worth of travellers' cheques - I think that should suffice.  我带了400英镑的旅行支票——我觉得应该够了。 formal
Suffice (it) to say, Mike won't be going to Tina's birthday party after what he said about her to her boss.  不用多说，麦克对蒂娜的老板那样说她之后，他是不会去参加她的生日聚会的。
Ann did her dissertation on Baudelaire.  安的论文写的是波德莱尔。
scientific terminology  科学术语    Compare jargon

Drunk drivers are a menace to everyone.  醉酒驾驶者对所有人都构成威胁。
Dogs running loose are a public menace.  没有拴起来到处乱跑的犬只对公众安全构成威胁。
He had a slight air of menace which I found unsettling.  他略带威胁的神情使我感到不安。
opaque glass/tights  不透明的玻璃／连裤袜

Is it a rewarding job?  做这份工作有意义吗？
Textbook writing can be an intellectually and financially rewarding activity.  编著教科书会是一件很有意义的工作，既可以使人增长知识，又可以获得经济上的回报。
Signs of the illness include fever, nausea and vomiting.  这种病的症状包括发烧、恶心和呕吐。
asparagus spears  芦笋嫩茎

She made such a fuss when Richard spilt a drop of wine on her blouse!  理查将一滴酒溅在她的衬衫上，她好一阵大惊小怪。
It's all a fuss about nothing.  这完全是无谓的大惊小怪。
We tried to arrange a ceremony with as little fuss as possible.  我们试图安排一个尽可能低调的仪式。

words.meaning: v.摇晃，蹒跚；结巴地说，支吾地说
words.example:
The dinner party conversation faltered for a moment.  晚宴上的谈话出现了一刻冷场。
Her friends never faltered in their belief in her.  她的朋友从未动摇过对她的信心。
Nigel's voice faltered and he stopped speaking.  奈杰尔的声音颤抖了，他没再继续说下去。

How could you humiliate me by questioning my judgment in front of everyone like that?  你怎么能那样当众质疑我的判断，令我丢脸？
England were humiliated (= completely defeated) in last night's match.  昨晚的比赛中英格兰队遭遇惨败。

My fingers were numb with cold.  我的手指冻僵了。
When she first heard the news, she was numb with disbelief.  她最初听到这条消息的时候，简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
Ever since his girlfriend left him he has felt numb.  自从女朋友离开他之后，他就变得麻木了。verb transitive

She's the warden of a home for mentally handicapped people.  她是一所精神病院的院长。
He's the warden of Wadham College, Oxford.  他是牛津大学沃德姆学院的院长。

words.meaning: a. 奇迹的，不可思议的
words.example:
The diet promised miraculous weight-loss.  有人保证说按照这个食谱进餐就会有非凡的减肥效果。
Well, you've made a miraculous recovery since last night!  哇，才一个晚上你便奇迹似地康复了！

This, the president promised us, was a war against tyranny.  总统向我们承诺，这是一场反对暴政的战争。
Women, the play seems to suggest, must resist the tyranny of domesticity.  这部戏似乎表明妇女必须抵制家务的束缚。

We managed to slip away unnoticed.  我们设法神不知鬼不觉地溜走了。
His rude comments are not likely to go unnoticed.  他那些无礼的言论不会没有人注意到。

The length of this box is twice its breadth.  这个箱子的长度是其宽度的两倍。
The breadth of her knowledge is amazing.  她知识渊博，令人惊讶。
He showed an astonishing breadth of learning for one so young.  他年纪轻轻就显示出知识的渊博，很令人吃惊。

There is concern that the giant panda will soon become extinct.  有人担心大熊猫很快就会绝种。
Many tribes became extinct when they came into contact with Western illnesses.  很多部落由于感染西方人的疾病而受到灭顶之灾。

words.meaning: a.(声音)减弱的，变得轻柔的
words.example:
There was polite, muted applause when I finished speaking.  我结束发言时，响起了礼貌而又温和的掌声。UK adjective
The idea received a muted response.  这个想法反应平平。UK adjective
She was dressed in muted shades of blue.  她身穿色调柔和的蓝色衣服。

words.meaning: a.贫瘠且无植被的；不孕的；无细菌的
words.example:
Mules are usually sterile.  骡子通常无法生育。
One of the side effects of the drug could be to make men sterile.  这种药物的副作用之一是可能会导致男性不孕。
The operation must be carried out under sterile conditions.  手术必须在无菌条件下进行。
There were two huge oil refineries on the coast.  海岸边曾有两个大型炼油厂。
The recent publicity surrounding homelessness has given (a) fresh impetus to the cause.  最近围绕无家可归者的宣传对这项事业是一股新的推动力。

The mouse scurried across the floor.  老鼠从地板上咻地溜过。
The noise of the explosion sent the villagers scurrying back into their homes.  听到爆炸声村民们立刻往家里奔去。

words.meaning: a.无效的，无用的；（人）没出息的；琐细的
words.example:
Attempts to get supplies to the region are futile because troops will not allow the aid convoy to enter the city.  往该地区运送物资的努力失败了，因为军方不允许救援物资护送队进城。
It 's quite futile trying to reason with him - he just won't listen.  跟他讲道理一点用都没有——他就是不听。
All my attempts to cheer her up proved futile.  我想让她快活起来，但所有的努力都白费了。

In China, her blonde hair was conspicuous.  在中国，她的金发十分显眼。
He tried not to look conspicuous and moved slowly along the back of the room.  他尽量不使自己显眼，沿着房间后部慢慢移动。    Opposite inconspicuousadjective
Why wasn't Stephen at the meeting, then? He was conspicuous by his absence.  那么，史蒂芬怎么没参加会议？他本应在场却不在，非常惹人注意。

He's got rather plump since I last saw him.  自从我上次见到他以来，他胖了很多。verb transitive
My aunt was busy straightening furniture and plumping cushions.  我姑姑一直在忙着收拾家俱、拍松垫子。
Let me plump up your pillows for you.  我来把你的枕头拍松。verb transitive

The Hollywood film idols of the 1940s were glamorous figures, adored by millions.  20世纪40年代好莱坞的电影明星魅力四射，受无数人崇拜。
The ancient people of this area worshipped a huge bronze idol in the shape of an elephant.  这个地区的古代居民膜拜一尊象形的青铜巨像。

The party leader has actually declared her support for unilateral nuclear disarmament (= giving up her country's nuclear weapons without first waiting for other countries to do the same).  该党领导人实际上已经宣布了她支援单方面核裁军的决定。    Compare bilateral ; multilateral
The captain of the ship wore a peaked cap decorated with gold braid (= twisted gold threads).  船长戴着一顶饰有金丝边的大檐帽。noun
What was the general tenor of his speech?  他演讲的主旨是甚么？

She was only given a placebo, but she claimed she got better - that's the placebo effect.  她只是服用了安慰剂，但她说好一些了——这就是“宽心药效”。
These small concessions have been made as a placebo to stop the workers making further demands.  这些小让步就像安慰剂一样，可以避免工人提出更多的要求。

I'm afraid my concentration began to waver as lunch approached.  恐怕我的注意力在临近午饭时要开始下降了。
He has never wavered in his support for the leader.  他对那位领袖的支持从未动摇过。
a country crippled by war  因战争而元气大伤的国家

She threw her head back as if in ecstasy.  她仰着头，一副飘飘欲仙的样子。
She went into ecstasies about the food there.  那里的饭菜她吃上了瘾。

The radius of this wheel is 30 cm.  这个轮子的半径是30厘米。
This wheel has a radius of 30 cm.  这个轮子的半径是30厘米。
The station, shopping centre and school lie within a one-mile radius of the house.  车站、购物中心和学校都在距这所房子一英里的范围之内。 (plural radii)

The minister suggested that the dire prophecies of certain leading environmentalists were somewhat exaggerated.  部长暗示说某些很有影响的环保人士所作的可怕预言在一定程度上有些夸张。
These doom and gloom prophecies are doing little to help the economy.  这些悲观的预言对经济毫无帮助。

words.meaning: n. 齐奏，齐唱；一致的或协调的行动
words.example: Try to sing in unison if you can.  大家尽量唱整齐。

He was banished to an uninhabited island for a year.  他被流放到一个荒无人迹的小岛上呆了一年。
They were banished (= sent out) from the library for making a noise.  他们因为吵吵嚷嚷被赶出了图书馆。
You must try to banish all thoughts of revenge from your mind.  你必须试着打消所有复仇的念头。

Bergman's films are often full of gloom and despair.  伯格曼导演的电影通常都弥漫着忧郁和绝望的气氛。
There is widespread gloom and doom about the company's future.  大家普遍觉得公司的前景不妙，劫数难逃。noun uncountable
She peered into the gloom, but she couldn't see where the noise was coming from.  她努力朝黑暗中看去，但就是辨不出声响是从哪里传来的。

She began to summarize the salient features/points of the proposal.  她开始总结提议中的重点／要点。
The article presented the salient facts of the dispute clearly and concisely.  这篇文章简明清楚地介绍了这场争端中的主要事实。

The Chancellorship of the University was bestowed upon her in 1992.  她在1992年被授予大学校长一职。
The George Cross is a decoration that is bestowed on British civilians for acts of great bravery.  乔治十字勋章是为了表彰英国平民的英勇行为而颁发的。

The two presidents have had candid talks about the current crisis.  两位总统就当前的危机进行了坦率的交谈。
To be candid with you, I think you're making a dreadful mistake.  跟你说实话，我觉得你在犯一个可怕的错误。
With some difficulty he hoisted her onto his shoulders.  他费了些力气才把她扛到自己肩上。
You ought to bandage (up) that cut.  你应该用绷带把伤口包扎起来。

The European Union should remain flexible enough to assimilate more countries quickly.  欧盟应该保持足够的灵活性，以加快步伐吸收更多的国家为其成员。
You shouldn't expect immigrants to assimilate into an alien culture immediately.  你不应该指望移民能够马上融入一种外国文化中。
It's hard to assimilate (= learn and understand) so much information.  很难吸收这么多的资讯。
He was a self-opinionated, overbearing tyrant, and he was the last man she should want to tangle with.  他这个人固执己见、盛气凌人、专横跋扈，她绝不要与他有甚么瓜葛。

There is little doubt that poor medical treatment hastened her death.  毫无疑问，劣质的治疗加速了她的死亡。
The president hastened to reassure his people that he was in perfect health.  总统立即解释说他的身体状况非常好，让他的人民放心。
It was an unfortunate decision and I hasten to say it had nothing to do with me.  那是个令人遗憾的决定，我急忙表示那与我没有关系。

We were having such a good time that we decided to prolong our stay by another week.  我们过得非常愉快，决定再多待一个星期。
She chewed each delicious mouthful as slowly as she could, prolonging the pleasure.  她细嚼慢咽，尽情地享受每一口美食。
a jagged cut/tear  边缘参差不齐的切口／裂口

words.meaning: n.羽毛；v.整理羽毛；为某事自喜、自豪
words.example:
The coffin was drawn by horses with black plumes.  灵柩由披挂着黑色羽饰的马拉着。
After the explosion, a plume of smoke could be seen in the sky for miles around.  爆炸发生后，方圆几英哩都能看得见天空中的缕缕烟雾。

He has relinquished his claim to the throne.  他放弃了继承王位的要求。
She relinquished control of the family investments to her son.  她把家庭投资的掌控权移交给了儿子。
She relinquished her hold/grip on the steering wheel.  她松开了握着轪盘的手。

The acting was dismal, wasn't it?  表演很糟糕，是不是？
What dismal weather!  天气太糟糕了！

We will commence building work in August of next year.  我们将于明年八月开始破土动工。
Shall we let the meeting commence, gentlemen?  各位先生，我们开始会议，好吗？

The roads are clogged with holiday traffic.  节假日期间，马路上堵满了车辆。
Eating too much fat causes your arteries to clog (up).  摄入过多脂肪会导致动脉栓塞。
Leaves are clogging (up) the drain.  树叶堵塞了下水道。UK noun countable usually plural

The infantry was/were sent into battle.  步兵团被派往战场。
It's a light/heavy infantry unit.  这是一个轻／重型步兵团。    Compare cavalry

words.meaning: a.邋遢的，不整洁的；粗心马虎的
words.example:
The batter was a bit sloppy so I added some more flour.  面糊有点稀，于是我又加进了一些面粉。UK adjective
Spelling mistakes always look sloppy in a formal letter.  在正式信函中出现拼写错误总让人感觉写信者草率马虎。
Another sloppy pass like that might lose them the whole match.  再出现一次那样的草率传球，可能会使他们输掉整场比赛。

She is hoping to get a loan from her bank to help her out of her financial predicament.  她希望能从银行得到一笔贷款以摆脱经济困境。
I'm in a bit of a predicament because I've accidentally accepted two invitations to dinner on the same night.  我有些左右为难，因为我无意间接受了同一天晚上两顿晚餐的邀请。
Garnish the dish with parsley before serving.  这道菜端上桌之前，上面配些欧芹点缀一下。UK noun countable or uncountable

Every time I make a suggestion at work, my boss overrides me/it.  每次我对工作提出建议，我的老板都不听。
The President used his veto to override the committee's decision.  总统利用手中的否决权，推翻了委员会的决定。
He overrode the autopilot when he realised it was malfunctioning.  他意识到自动驾驶仪出了故障，就改为手动驾驶。UK verb (overrode, overridden)

Three hundred people perished in the earthquake.  有300人在此次地震中丧生。
He believes that Europe must create closer ties or it will perish.  他认为整个欧洲必须建立更紧密的联系，否则就会灭亡。verb intransitive
Sunlight has caused the rubber to perish.  橡胶因暴露于阳光下而老化。verb intransitive

The stick has two notches, one at each end.  这根木棍两端各有一个V形切口。UK noun countable
Among current players, she is rated a notch above (= is better than) the rest.  在现役运动员中，她比其他人要高出一个等级。UK verb transitive
She has recently notched up her third win at a major tennis tournament.  最近，她在一项重要的网球锦标赛中获胜，取得了她的第三次胜利。
The locus of decision-making is sometimes far from the government's offices.  决策的地点有时根本就不在政府的办公室。

Tape recordings of conversations are transcribed by typists and entered into the database.  谈话的磁带录音由打字员记录下来，并输入资料库。verb transitive
Transcribing the Ethiopian text into the English alphabet was their first task.  把埃塞俄比亚原文转换成英文是他们的第一项任务。
The quintet had been transcribed for clarinet and piano.  这个五重奏被改编成单簧管和钢琴二重奏。

There are several hotels in the immediate vicinity of the station.  就在车站附近有好几家饭店。UK noun only singular
The team is believed to have paid in the vicinity of £3 million for Domingo.  该队据说为多明戈支付了大约300万英镑。

He doesn't have the humility to admit when he's wrong.  他在自己犯错的时候不会谦虚地承认。
They might be very rich, but it wouldn't hurt them to show a little humility.  他们可能非常富有，但是表现得谦逊一点对他们不会有甚么害处。

Since the death of the president, opposition parties and the army have been jockeying for power.  总统死后各反对党和军队一直在争权夺利。
As the singer came on stage, the photographers jockeyed for position at the front of the hall.  歌手一上台，摄影师就在音乐厅前方争抢位置。UK verb intransitive

words.meaning: v.跛行，一拐一拐地走；a.软弱的，松软的
words.example:
Three minutes into the match, Jackson limped off the pitch with a serious ankle injury.  比赛刚刚开始三分钟，杰克逊就因脚踝严重受伤而下场。verb
The little boat limped slowly towards the shore.  那艘小船缓慢地向岸边靠近。
After limping along for almost two years, the economy is starting to show signs of recovery.  经过差不多两年的徘徊，经济开始出现了复苏的迹象。adjective

The national anthems of the teams are played at the beginning of a big international football match.  在重大国际足球赛开赛时，演奏各参赛球队的国歌。
John Lennon's "Imagine" has become the anthem of peace-lovers all over the world.  约翰‧蓝侬的《想像》已成为全世界和平爱好者的颂歌。
He wants the job purely for reasons of vanity and ambition.  他想得到那份工作纯粹是为了满足虚荣和野心。UK noun

words.meaning: v. 擦洗，擦亮；四处搜索
words.example:
You'll have to scour out those old cooking pots before you use them.  这些旧锅使用之前得好好刷一刷。UK verb transitive
The police are scouring the countryside for the missing child.  警方在乡村四处搜查，寻找失踪的孩子。
The fast-moving water had scoured out a channel in the rock.  急流在岩石上冲刷出一道凹槽。

Dilute the juice (with water) before you drink it.  果汁先（用水）稀释一下再喝。
These measures are designed to dilute public fears about the product's safety.  采取这些措施是为了减轻公众对该产品安全的恐慌。adjective (US usually diluted)

We collected dry twigs to start the fire.  我们捡干的细树枝生火。verb intransitive or transitive (-gg-)    informal
She's six months pregnant and he still hasn't twigged.  她怀孕六个月了，可他还没意识到。

Small businesses have been exempted from the tax increase.  小公司可免增税。adjective
Goods exempt from this tax include books and children's clothes.  免征这项税收的商品包括书籍和童装。
Pregnant women are exempt from dental charges under the current health system.  在现行的医疗制度下，孕妇看牙医是免费的。

Firmly compress the soil in the pot so that the plant is secure.  把盆里的泥土压实以固定植物。
The course compresses two year's training into six intensive months.  这个课程把两年的培训内容压缩成六个月的强化训练。

words.meaning: n.壮观的游行；露天历史剧
words.example: Our youngest son is taking part in the school pageant.  我们的小儿子将参加学校的露天历史剧演出。

words.meaning: v.遮蔽；使失色，使相形见绌
words.example:
Karen has always felt overshadowed by her famous elder sister.  凯伦总觉得自己与出名的姐姐相比黯然失色。
My happiness was overshadowed by the bad news.  这个坏消息给我的幸福蒙上了阴影。
Grand Central Station in New York is overshadowed by the PanAm building.  纽约中央火车站被泛美大厦遮住了阳光。

words.meaning: n.芦苇；(乐器)簧片(如单、双簧管中的)

words.example: The police officer said that he had placed the man under arrest and that a scuffle had ensued.  那名员警说他逮捕了那个男子后随即发生了扭打。

The storm wreaked (= caused) havoc in the garden, uprooting trees and blowing a fence down.  暴风雨摧毁了花园，树被连根拔起，一排围栏也被吹倒了。
The delay played (= caused) havoc with their travel arrangements.  误点打乱了他们的旅行安排。

The police have assured the public that the escaped prisoners will not evade recapture for long.  警方向大众保证，逃犯很快就会再次落网。
She leant forward to kiss him but he evaded her by pretending to sneeze.  她身子前倾想要吻他，可是他假装打喷嚏躲开了。
An Olympic gold medal is the only thing that has evaded her in her remarkable career.  在其辉煌的运动生涯中，唯一没有得到的荣誉就是奥运金牌。
Is monarchy relevant in the modern world or should it be abolished?  君主政体在现代社会仍有意义还是该被废除？
the halo around the moon  月晕

words.meaning: a.神志清楚的；明智的，理智的
words.example:
In the doctor's opinion he was sane at the time of the murder.  按照医生的看法，他在谋杀时是神志清醒的。
humorous The only thing which keeps me sane after a hard day in the office is jogging!  在办公室辛苦工作一天后，唯一能使我保持头脑清醒的方法就是慢跑。
It was a sane (= sensible) decision and one we all respected.  这是一个明智的决定，也是我们都尊重的决定。

Containment of crowd violence was the police's main concern.  阻止群体暴力事件的发生是警方最关注的事。
The government is pursuing a policy of containment.  政府在奉行遏制政策。

The flames rapidly engulfed the house.  大火很快吞没了那座房子。
Northern areas of the country were engulfed by/in a snowstorm last night.  昨晚一场暴风雪席卷了这个国家的北部地区。
The war is threatening to engulf the entire region.  战火有可能会席卷整个地区。
They are accused of medical/financial/electoral malpractice.  他们被控医疗疏忽／财务舞弊／选举舞弊。

Although our skin looks smooth, when magnified it is full of bumps and holes.  我们的皮肤看上去很光滑，但放大后却满是坑坑洼洼。
The hot summer magnified the racial tensions in the community.  炎热的夏日加深了社区的种族矛盾。
She works as a bilingual secretary for an insurance company.  她在一家保险公司担任双语秘书。
The ruined house had a sinister appearance.  那栋倒塌的房子外观给人一种不祥之感。
Exercise is supposed to speed up your metabolism.  人们认为运动可加速新陈代谢。

words.meaning: n.保证(期)；辩解；有正当理由；批准
words.example: The warranty covers the car mechanically for a year, with unlimited mileage.  保用单承诺对汽车的机械部件保修一年，不限里程。
No smoking in the auditorium.  观众席中禁止吸烟。

The crowd cheered as the goalkeeper deflected the shot.  当守门员把球挡出去的时候人们欢呼了起来。
He deflected the ball away from the goal.  他把球挡出了球门。
The Prime Minister deflected mounting criticism today by announcing tax cuts.  今天首相宣布减税，从而平息了越来越多的批评声音。

The demonstration is a pointless act/gesture of defiance against the government.  透过示威来对抗政府是一种毫无意义的行为／姿态。
In defiance of the ceasefire, rebel troops are again firing on the capital.  叛军违反停火协定再次向首都开火。
The helpings you get in the office canteen are microscopic!  公司餐厅供应的饭菜就那么一点点！UK adjective    specialized
a lofty ceiling/mountain/wall  高顶／山／墙UK adjective
amplified music/guitar  经过放大的音乐／带有扩音设备的电吉他
The whole episode left me fuming at the injustice of it all.  整个事件毫无正义可言，我感到非常愤怒。

The farmer taught her how to shear sheep.  那个农夫教了她如何剪羊毛。
He recalled the humiliation of having his hair shorn and exchanging his clothes for the prison uniform.  他记起了曾被剃光头、被迫换上囚服的耻辱。
The ex-President, although shorn of his official powers, still has influence.  前总统虽然被剥夺了权力，但是仍有影响力。UK US  (sheared, sheared or shorn)

Amalfi and Venice were important maritime powers.  阿马尔菲和威尼斯一度是重要的海事基地。
Make sure you visit the maritime museum if you're interested in anything to do with ships or seafaring.  如果你对舰船或航海感兴趣，一定要参观一下那家海事博物馆。
The temperature change in winter is less pronounced in maritime areas.  沿海地区的冬季温度变化不那么明显。
I'll see you downstairs in the foyer in half an hour.  我们半个小时以后在楼下门厅见。

The holiday made a big dent in our savings.  渡假花去了我们很大一部分的存款。verb transitive
His confidence was badly dented when he didn't get into the football team.  他未能加入足球队，自信心受到了严重的打击。

Dissatisfaction with the government seems to have permeated every section of society.  社会的每一个角落似乎都弥漫着对政府的不满。
The table has a plastic coating which prevents liquids from permeating into the wood beneath.  桌子上铺了一层塑胶，防止液体渗到下面的木材里。

words.meaning: n.枪眼，小窗，换气孔，透光口
words.example: The company employed lawyers to find loopholes in environmental protection laws.  该公司雇用律师来寻找环境保护法的漏洞。
The Broadcasting Museum also offers Saturday workshops to acquaint children with the world of radio.  广播博物馆还举办周六讲习班让孩子了解无线电世界。

words.meaning: v. 恢复，振作；打扮；竖起
words.example:
Having such easy access to some of the best cinema and theatre is one of the perks of living in Sydney.  一些最好的电影院和剧院就近在咫尺，是在雪梨生活所能享受的便利之一。UK verb intransitive or transitive informal
She perked up as soon as I mentioned that Charles was coming to dinner.  我一提到查尔斯要来吃晚餐她就精神为之一振。
He perked up at the news.  一听到这消息他精神就振作起来了。
It is an illness which afflicts women more than men.  患这种疾病的女性多于男性。

She has amassed a huge fortune from her novels.  她靠写小说慢慢积攒了一大笔钱。
Some of his colleagues envy the enormous wealth that he has amassed.  他积聚了大笔财富，这引起了一些同事的妒忌。

words.meaning: v. 吃嫩叶或草；浏览；n. 嫩叶；嫩芽
words.example:
Deer were browsing (on grass) under the trees.  鹿正在树下吃草。noun only singular mainly UK
We went for a browse around an antique shop.  我们去一家古董店随便看了看。

Stanley traversed the continent from west to east.  斯坦利自西向东穿越了整个大陆。
Bounded on the east by Lake Winnebago, the county is traversed by the Wolf and Fox rivers.  该县东临温纳贝戈湖，沃尔夫河和福克斯河穿县而过。

Her skin tans very quickly in the summer.  她的皮肤在夏天很容易晒黑。
Tanned workmen were sitting around the dock.  皮肤晒得黑黝黝的工人在码头围坐。verb (-nn-)
I'll tan his hide if I catch him.  如果我抓到他，一定会把他揍扁。abbreviation    written abbreviation for
She hasn't got much savvy.  她的水准还不够。

The funds available for the health service are finite and we cannot afford to waste money.  用于公共医疗服务的资金是有限的，我们浪费不起。
We only have a finite amount of time to complete this task - we can't continue indefinitely.  我们须在有限的时间内完成这项任务，不能无限期地做下去。adjective

He regards the political process with disdain.  他对这一政治进程持鄙视的态度。 formal
The older musicians disdain the new, rock-influenced music.  老一代音乐家鄙视新出现的摇滚风格的音乐。
the Cape of Good Hope  好望角noun countable
Preservatives can impart colour and flavour to a product.  防腐剂能保持产品的色泽和味道。

The whole station seemed to vibrate as the express train rushed through.  快速列车急驰而过时，整个车站似乎都在震动。
His voice vibrated with anger.  他非常愤怒，声音微微颤抖。

The photograph awakens poignant memories of happier days.  照片唤起了对美好时光的深情追忆。
It is especially poignant that he died on the day before the wedding.  他在婚礼前一天去世了，这令人分外悲痛。

Sulphur dioxide is the main precursor of acid rain.  二氧化硫是形成酸雨最重要的先决条件。
Biological research has often been a precursor to medical breakthroughs.  生物学研究往往是医学突破的先驱。

The eagle swooped down to snatch a young rabbit.  鹰俯冲而下，抓补一只小兔子。
Undercover police swooped on three houses in Bristol at 5 a.m. this morning.  今天早上五点，卧底的员警突击搜查了布里斯托尔的三间房子。

words.meaning: a.法定的；受法令所约束的
words.example: statutory obligations  法定义务

I've brought with me an article from yesterday's paper that I thought might amuse you.  我带来了昨天报上的一篇文章，或许可以让你开怀一笑。
Apparently these stories are meant to amuse.  显然这些故事的目的就在于搞笑。
Shall I put on a video to amuse the kids while we're packing?  我们收拾行李时，要不要给孩子放段影片，逗他们开心？
an eclectic style /approach  相容并蓄的风格 ／ 博采众长的方法
political dissidents  持不同政见者

She resigned when she was relegated to a desk job.  因被降职做文书，她就辞了职。
The story was relegated to the middle pages of the paper.  这篇报道从重要版面撤下，放到了中间的版面上登出。
If Southampton lose again they may be relegated from the Premier League to the First Division.  如果南安普敦队再输掉比赛的话，就要从英超降级到英甲了。    Compare promote
a political/foreign-policy/sports pundit  政治／外交政策／体育权威

The article was dismissed as highly speculative.  该文被斥为纯属臆测而未予理会。UK adjective
The office block was built as a speculative venture.  盖这栋办公大楼是一桩投机生意。

As girls, the sisters used to conspire with each other against their brother.  还是小女孩的时候，姐妹俩常常在一起密谋对付她们的哥哥。UK verb intransitive
The weather had conspired to ruin their day out.  坏天气凑在一起，天公也不作美，破坏了他们的一日游。
I'd planned a romantic evening together, but circumstances conspired against it - friends arrived unexpectedly and then Dave was called out to an emergency.  我计划两人共度一个浪漫的夜晚，可是事不凑巧——先是朋友们不期而至，接着戴夫被叫去出急诊。

The partitions between the toilets were very thin.  厕所间的隔板很薄。UK noun
The partition of India occurred in 1947.  印度在1947年发生分裂。UK verb transitive
Why don't you partition that large room into a lounge and a dining-room?  你为甚么不把那个大房间隔成起居室和饭厅呢？UK verb transitive

The president was ousted (from power)in a military coup in January 1987.  总统在1987年1月的一次军事政变中被赶下台。
Police are trying to oust drug dealers from the city centre.  警方正试图将毒品贩子们从市中心撵走。
The champions were defeated by Arsenal and ousted from the League Cup.  冠军们被阿森纳队打败，并被淘汰出联赛杯。

He's a sly old devil - I wouldn't trust him with my money.  他是个老滑头——我不会把钱交付给他的。
"You'll find out eventually," said Mary with a sly smile.  “你最后就知道了，”玛丽诡秘地笑着说。noun
He drives his mother's car on the sly while she's at work.  他趁母亲上班的时候偷开她的汽车。

The adverts entice the customer into buying things they don't really want.  广告诱使顾客购买他们并不真正需要的东西。
People are being enticed away from the profession by higher salaries elsewhere.  别处更加丰厚的薪水诱使人们辞职另谋高就。
The colour red is used to denote passion or danger.  红色用于表示激情或危险。

words.meaning: n.(缝纫时的)一针，一钩；v.缝合
words.example:
Secure the two pieces together with a couple of stitches.  缝上几针，把两块布缝在一起。
He cast on/off a stitch (= added/removed a length of thread from the needle).  他加了／拆了一针。
I've dropped a stitch (= lost a length of thread from the needle).  我漏了一针。
