words.meaning: a. 被(疾病等)折磨的；被击中的
words.example:
All the oil from the stricken tanker has now leaked into the sea.  失事油轮上的油现已全部外泄到海中。
My country has been stricken by war for the past five years.  我的祖国在过去五年内饱受战乱蹂躏。
He has been stricken with grief since the death of his wife.  妻子去世后，他就一直深陷悲痛之中。

The fighting in the city followed reports of the rebels marshalling their forces in the countryside.  叛军在郊外集结力量的消息传出后，城内发生了战斗。
The company is marshalling its forces/resources for a long court case.  这家公司正集中力量／资源打一场旷日费时的官司。
They had marshalled an armada of 1000 boats and a squadron of 70 aircraft to help clear up the oil.  他们调集了1000艘船和70架飞机来协助清理油污。

words.meaning: v.要求以„为条件，约定，讲明
words.example: She agreed to buy the car, but stipulated racing tyres and a turbo-powered engine.  她同意买这辆车，但指明要装赛车轮胎和涡轮动力引擎。
oatmeal porridge  燕麦粥

words.meaning: a.令人不悦的，讨厌的；不想要的
words.example: Houses near industrial sites often do not sell so quickly because they are regarded as undesirable.  工厂附近的房子销路不是很好，因为人们认为那里的环境不理想。

Snow and ice have left many roads treacherous, and motorists are warned to drive slowly.  冰雪使许多道路危机四伏，汽车司机被告诫要开慢些。UK adjective
Vargas plays the part of a treacherous aristocrat who betrays his king and country.  瓦加斯扮演一个背叛了国王和祖国的不忠贵族。

Michael Davis has prepared a memorandum outlining our need for an additional warehouse.  麦克•戴维斯准备了一份报告，概述了我们还需要一个仓库。
The three countries have signed a memorandum pledging to work together.  这三个国家签署了一份协议备忘录，承诺会互相合作。noun countable (plural memoranda or memorandums)
These new laws will have far-reaching benefits for all working mothers.  这些新法律影响深远，将惠及所有在职母亲。

He was the embodiment of the English gentleman.  他是典型的英国绅士。
She was portrayed in the papers as the embodiment of evil.  她被报纸描述为邪恶的化身。

My library books are a week overdue.  我借图书馆的书过期一个星期了。
The baby is two weeks overdue (= The baby was expected to be born two weeks ago).  已经超过预产期两周了。
Changes to the tax system are long overdue.  税收制度早该改革了。

He wore a shabby old overcoat.  他穿着一件破旧的大衣。
Her home is a rented one-bedroom flat in a shabby part of town.  她的住所是一套租来的雅房公寓，位于城里很差的地段。
The refugees were shabby (= wore old clothes in bad condition) and hungry.  难民们衣衫褴褛，饥肠辘辘。adjective
The government plans to overhaul the health service.  政府计划彻底改革公共医疗保健服务。

He was probably the most prolific songwriter of his generation.  他可能是他这一代中最多产的歌曲作家。
Rabbits and other rodents are prolific (= have a lot of babies).  兔子和其他啮齿类动物繁殖能力都很强。

Such a noisy environment was not conducive to a good night's sleep.  在这样嘈杂的环境下，晚上难以睡个好觉。
This is a more conducive atmosphere for studying.  这样的气氛更有利于学习。

Cleaning up the city-wide mess is going to be a mammoth task.  清扫全市范围内的垃圾将是一项艰巨的任务。
It's a mammoth undertaking - are you sure you have the resources to cope?  这是一项艰巨的任务——你肯定有能力完成吗？noun countable

words.meaning: n. 司库,财务员,出纳员

words.example: The book was heavily censored when first published.  这本书首次出版时经过了严格的审查。
He looked ludicrous in that suit!  他穿上那套衣服看上去很可笑！
The two sides have been at daggers drawn for some months now with no sign of improvement in relations.  双方一连冷战了好几个月，到现在依然没有任何缓和的迹象。

He'd been behaving so strangely that they began to doubt/question his sanity.  他的行为举止非常怪异，他们开始怀疑他的精神是否正常。
Maybe Jenny can bring some sanity into (= think and act with good judgment in) this crazy situation.  也许珍妮能够为这疯狂的局面带来几分清醒。
Any change in plan would be construed as indecision.  对计划的任何改动都会被视为优柔寡断。

words.meaning: v.嘲笑；狼吞虎咽；n.嘲笑，笑柄
words.example:
The critics scoffed at his paintings.  批评家对他的画作嗤之以鼻。
Years ago people would have scoffed at the idea that cars would be built by robots.  多年前，人们会嘲笑以机器人来制造汽车这种想法。UK verb

Crowds thronged the market place.  市场里挤满了人。
The narrow streets were thronged with summer visitors.  狭窄的街道上挤满了夏天来此的游客。

words.meaning: n.陷阱，未料到的危险或困难
words.example:
The store fell into one of the major pitfalls of small business, borrowing from suppliers by paying bills late.  那家商店犯了一个小本生意的大错，那就是从供应商那里先赊帐后付钱。
There's a video that tells new students about pitfalls to avoid.  有一部影片告诫新生应避免犯哪些错误。

She is a shrewd politician who wants to avoid offending the electorate unnecessarily.  她是一个精明的政治家，想避免不必要地得罪选民。
It was a shrewd move to buy your house just before property prices started to rise.  在房地产价格开始攀升之前购买房子是个明智之举。

words.meaning: v. 慢慢地流，渗出；(勇气)逐渐消失
words.example:
Blood was still oozing out of the wound.  伤口还在往外渗血。
She removed the bandage to reveal a red swollen wound oozing pus.  她解下绷带，露出红肿渗脓的伤口。
The waiter brought her a massive pizza oozing (with)cheese.  侍者给她端来一大块淌着起司的薄饼。

Passing a written exam is a prerequisite for taking the advanced course.  通过笔试是学习进阶课程的前提。
Public support is a prerequisite for/to the success of this project.  大众支持是这一计划取得成功的必备条件。
They had to agree to certain conditions as a prerequisite of being lent the money.  他们不得不同意一些条件才能借到钱。

words.meaning: v.包围；n.袖边，边缘；interj.(用以引起注意的)咳嗽清桑声
words.example: When they reached Oxford Circus, the demonstrators were hemmed in by the police.  当他们到达牛津广场时，示威群众已被警方包围起来。
He's always boasting about his sexual prowess.  他总是吹嘘自己的性爱技巧如何高超。

words.meaning: v. 切断腿筋使成跛腿，使残废
words.example:
The company was hamstrung by traditional but inefficient ways of conducting business.  这家公司被其传统但低效率的经营方式所束缚。noun countable
He pulled (= injured) a hamstring while playing rugby.  他在打橄榄球时拉伤了一条腘绳肌腱。

After years of rivalry, the two companies have UKagreed / USagreed to a truce.  经过多年的竞争，两家公司同意握手言和。
We've got to spend the weekend together, so we might as well call (= have) a truce.  我们必须在一起过周末，所以最好还是讲和。
Following last month's riots, the two big gangs in Los Angeles have finally declared a truce, ending years of bloodshed.  上个月火拼之后，洛杉矶的两大帮派最终宣布停战，从而结束了多年的杀戮。
The boy scowled at her and reluctantly followed her back into school.  男孩对她阴沉着脸，很不情愿地跟着她回了学校。

words.meaning: n.短而硬的毛发；v.(毛)竖起；发怒
words.example:
The old woman had a few grey bristles sprouting from her chin.  老妇人下巴上长出几根灰白的又短又硬的毛。
The best quality men's shaving brushes are made from badger bristle.  最好的男士修面刷由獾毛制成。
My toothbrush has blue and white plastic bristles.  我的牙刷上有蓝白塑胶刷毛。verb
She's a repository of knowledge about our family history.  她对我们的家族史了若指掌。

words.meaning: a.细薄的，稀薄的；空洞的，无关紧要的
words.example: We were only able to make a tenuous connection between the two robberies.  我们只能认定这两桩抢劫案之间可能有某些联系。
The children made a collage of postcards.  孩子用明信片制作了一幅拼贴画。    Compare assemblage
She was sentenced to two years in jail for committing perjury (= telling lies in a law court).  她因犯伪证罪而被判两年徒刑。

words.meaning: n.木瓦，屋顶板；木质小招牌
words.example: a shingle beach  沙石海滩

words.meaning: a.细心的，极注意细节的，一丝不苟的
words.example: Many hours of meticulous preparation have gone into writing the book.  为写此书，投入了大量时间细心做前期准备。
to refute a person/theory/argument/claim  驳斥一个人／理论／论点／说法

It is unlikely that his forces could withstand an allied onslaught for very long.  他的军队不大可能长时间抵御联军的强攻。
Scotland's onslaught on Wales in the second half of the match earned them a 4-1 victory.  苏格兰队在下半场猛攻威尔士队，以4比1赢取胜利。
Coppola garnered several Oscar awards for 'The Godfather'.  哥普拉以其执导的电影《教父》获得数项奥斯卡奖。
an eminent historian  声名显赫的历史学家
They claim that the fall in unemployment is based on a fraudulent manipulation of statistics.  他们声称失业率下降是对统计资料进行欺骗性操纵的结果。

words.meaning: v.移动一点儿；让步，改变立场
words.example:
I've tried moving the desk but it won't budge/I can't budge it.  我试着移动书桌，但它纹丝不动。verb intransitive or transitive
I've tried persuading her, but she won't budge.  我试图说服她，可她就是不改变想法。verb intransitive or transitive

The grass had been saturated by overnight rain.  一夜的雨把草地淋透了。
He had cut his leg badly, and his trousers were saturated with/in blood.  他划破了腿，伤势严重，裤子都被血浸透了。verb UK FILL  充满
The police saturated (= A large number of police officers were sent into) the area in an attempt to find the missing child.  大批员警被派往该地区寻找失踪的孩童。

words.meaning: a.反抗的，叛逆的，难控制的
words.example: Her teachers regard her as a rebellious, trouble-making girl.  老师们认为她是一个不服管教、惹是生非的女孩子。

words.meaning: v. 掐脖子；扼杀；n.节流阀
words.example:
He's working at full throttle (= as hard as he can) to get the job finished.  他正全力以赴完成工作。
The captain of the boat had his engines at full throttle.  船长让船开足马力全速行驶。UK verb transitive
informal Sometimes he annoys me so much that I could throttle him.  有时他真令我讨厌，我恨不得掐死他。UK verb transitive
Just a sliver of cake for me, please - I shouldn't really be having any.  只要一小块蛋糕就好——我真的不能再吃了。

The family made discreet enquiries about his background.  那家人小心翼翼地打听他的背景。
They are very good assistants, very discreet - they wouldn't go shouting to the press.  他们都是很好的助手，非常谨慎——不会向新闻界嚷嚷甚么的。

The film is full of allusions to Hitchcock.  这部电影处处都在向希区考克致敬。
Her novels are packed with literary allusions.  她的小说充满了文学典故。

words.meaning: n.(牛马的)饲料，粮草；v.搜寻，翻寻(尤指食物)
words.example:
The children had been living on the streets, foraging for scraps and sleeping rough.  那些孩子无家可归，四处寻找残羹剩饭，露宿街头。
The pigs foraged in the woods for acorns.  那些猪在树林里找橡果吃。UK noun uncountable
forage crops.  饲料作物
In the heady days of their youth, they thought anything was possible.  在他们风华正茂之时，他们认为一切皆有可能。

words.meaning: a.恢复至原状的，复修至原状的

words.example:
This coat has a special surface that repels moisture.  这件外套的面是特殊料子做的，可以防潮。
formal The defenders repelled the attack without losing any men.  守军击退了敌人的进攻，自己没有损失一个人。
Similar poles of magnets repel each other, and opposite poles attract.  磁铁同极相斥，异极相吸。 (-ll-)
There was a fad for wearing ripped jeans a few years ago.  几年前有一阵子流行穿有洞的牛仔裤。
military/industrial espionage  军事间谍活动／产业间谍行为
If the government is seen to condone violence , the bloodshed will never stop.  一旦认定政府纵容暴力，那流血事件就永远不会停止。

She's got a ferocious (= very bad) temper.  她的脾气极为暴躁。
The president came in for some ferocious criticism.  总统遭到了一些猛烈抨击。

words.meaning: v.修复，恢复(职业、名誉、地位等)
words.example:
The prison service should try to rehabilitate prisoners so that they can lead normal lives when they leave prison.  监狱应该努力改造犯人，使他们在刑满释放后能重新过上正常生活。
Physiotherapy is part of rehabilitating accident victims.  物理治疗是对事故受伤者进行康复治疗的一部分。
After 20 years in official disgrace, she's been rehabilitated (= given a positive public image again).  20年的官僚生涯曾使她名誉扫地，但是现在她已恢复了自己的良好形象。

She gulped down her drink and made a hasty exit.  她大口喝下饮料后急匆匆地出去了。
When it was his turn to dive, he gulped and stepped up onto the diving board.  轮到他跳水时，他深吸了一口气后走上跳板。
She gulped back the tears.  她强忍住泪水。noun countable

words.meaning: a.(光和声)柔和的，缓和的；(人)温和的
words.example: He seemed a bit subdued at lunch - is he all right?  午饭时他显得有点闷闷不乐——他没事吧？

words.meaning: n.(个人、团体或民族)道德风貌，思潮，信仰
words.example: The ethos of the traditional family firm is under threat.  传统家族公司的价值理念受到威胁。

words.meaning: a. 肿胀的; 傲慢的
words.example: a bloated stomach  鼓起的肚子
The population of the village has remained remarkably homogeneous.  这个村庄的人口保持着显著的同族特征。    Compare heterogeneous

On investigation, his claim was found to be bogus.  调查发现，他的说法并不属实。
She produced some bogus documents to support her application.  她提供了一些伪造的证件作为申请所需附件。

In some parts of the world, sheep's eyes are considered a great delicacy.  羊眼在世界某些地方被认为是一种难得的美味佳肴。noun
He raised the matter with great delicacy.  他十分慎重地提起这件事。
Because of their great delicacy, the books cannot be moved.  由于这些书极易受损，因此不宜搬动。noun
The news that the chairman would resign set off seismic waves in the business community.  主席要辞职的消息在商界引发了剧烈震撼。

He has a flair for languages.  他具有语言天赋。
He played with great imagination and flair.  他的演奏充满了瑰丽奇特的想像，显示出过人的才情。
It's a competent enough piece of writing but it lacks flair.  这篇文章写得还算不错，就是文采稍显不足。

She delved into her pocket to find some change.  她伸手到口袋里找零钱。verb intransitive
It's not always a good idea to delve too deeply into someone's past.  过分探究某人的过去并不见得总是一件好事。

words.meaning: v. 钓鱼；兴高采烈地唱
words.example:
Boats trolling for mackerel.  采用曳绳钓鲭法的船
They were trolling the colder waters of the Channel.  他们在英吉利海峡的寒冷水域利用曳绳钓鱼。UK verb intransitive or transitive
They are trolling the Internet for new customers.  他们在网际网路上搜寻新顾客。UK verb intransitive or transitive
a galley slave  划桨的奴隶

words.meaning: a.寒冷的；(人)冷淡的，不热情的
words.example:
There's a rather frigid atmosphere in the school.  学校里气氛很严肃。adjective
Few plants can grow in such a frigid environment.  几乎没有甚么植物能够在如此寒冷的环境下生长。
The tour operator will arrange transport and plan your itinerary.  旅行社工作人员将负责安排交通和行程计划。

Marble can be polished to a high gloss.  大理石可以被磨得非常光滑。
This varnish provides a long-lasting and hard-wearing gloss finish.  用这种清漆做亮光漆可以使表面光亮、持久、耐磨。
We'll need a litre of gloss (paint)to cover the woodwork.  我们得用一公升亮光漆来涂一下木建部分。UK noun

There's increasing demand for cars which are more economical on fuel.  对低油耗汽车的需求与日俱增。
What's the most economical way of heating this building?  给这栋大楼供应暖气，怎样做才是最经济的方法？UK adjective
The contract contained a restrictive covenant against building on the land.  该合同包含严格限制在该地块建筑施工的承诺条款。

Oil gushed (out) from the hole in the tanker.  石油从油轮的那个漏洞中喷涌而出。
Blood was gushing from his nose.  他的鼻子流血不止。
Her arm gushed blood where the knife had gone in.  她肩膀上被刀扎伤的地方鲜血直冒。verb
figurative The mountain range stretched away into infinity.  山脉延绵不绝。

Have you got some peanuts for us to nibble while the party warms up?  你有花生让我们边吃边活跃聚会的气氛吗？
Jenny's hamster's nibbled a hole in the sofa.  珍妮的仓鼠把沙发咬了个洞。
She nibbled his ear.  她轻轻地咬着他的耳朵。verb

They threatened him with expulsion from school.  他们威胁要把他从学校开除。
This is the second expulsion of a club member this year.  这是今年俱乐部第二次开除成员了。noun countable or uncountable

He spends every weekend tinkering (about) with his car.  他每个周末都在摆弄他的汽车。
[as form of address] You tinker, Nicky, you shouldn't have done that.  尼基，你这个小淘气，你不该那么做。
Don't be such a tinker.  别这么淘气。UK noun
He has composed 14 quartets and 11 symphonies.  他谱写了14首四重奏和11首交响乐。

Inmates erected a barricade between themselves and prison officers.  囚犯们设置了路障，把狱警和他们隔开。verb transitive
Barricade the doors!  堵住门！

Somebody trampled all over my flowerbeds in the night!  晚上有人把我的花坛全部踩坏了！
Eight people were trampled to death (= killed) when the stadium collapsed and the crowd rushed out onto the football pitch.  体育场突然倒塌时，人群冲进足球场，其间八人被踩踏致死。verb intransitive or transitive [usually + prep]
She accused the government of trampling on the needs and rights of the ordinary citizen.  她谴责政府无视普通公民的需求和权利。

The device is not a real bomb but a dummy.  这颗炸弹不是真的，只是一个仿制品。
Only a dummy would ignore the safety warnings.  只有傻瓜才会对安全警告视而不见。adjective [before noun]
subversive elements/groups in society  社会上的颠覆分子／集团

I'm just going to nip to the bog.  我正要跑去上厕所。
We've run out of bog paper / roll.  我们的厕纸用完了。UK verb (-gg-)
Bog off and leave me alone.  走开，别管我。

Lucy is a rather timid child.  露西是个非常羞怯的孩子。
My horse is a bit timid and is easily frightened by traffic.  我的马有点胆小，容易受到来往车辆的惊吓。
The opinion polls are predicting a Liberal landslide in next week's election.  民意调查预测自由党将在下周的选举中大获全胜。
The player had points deducted (from his score) for arguing with the referee.  那名运动员因与裁判争辩而被扣分。

My cat likes dozing in front of the fire.  我的猫喜欢在火炉前打盹。UK verb intransitive
The office was so hot I nearly dozed off at my desk.  办公室里很热，我差点在办公桌上睡着了。

words.meaning: v.置(某人)于不利地位；处罚
words.example:
The present tax system penalizes poor people.  现行税收制度对穷人不利。
The scheme should ensure that borrowers are not penalized by sudden rises in mortgage rates.  该计划应确保贷款者不会因分期贷款利率突然上升而陷入困境。(UK usually penalise) ['pi:.nə.laɪz]
He was penalized early in the match for dangerous play.  他在比赛开始后不久因危险动作而受到处罚。

I've no idea how much the clothes cost because there was nothing so vulgar as a price tag in evidence.  我不知道那些衣服值多少钱，因为上面连一个普通的价格标签都看不到。
Isn't it rather vulgar to talk about how much money you earn?  谈论赚多少钱难道不庸俗吗？UK US disapproving
It was an extremely vulgar joke.  那是个极为下流的笑话。

words.meaning: a. 急躁的，易激动的；锋利的

words.example: The rock-star arrived in London with her usual entourage of dancers and backing singers.  这位摇滚歌星到达了伦敦，随行的还有她惯用的伴舞和伴唱随行。

Five soldiers died after their bus was ambushed on a country road.  在一条乡村道路上一辆公车遭到伏击，车上五名士兵身亡。
He was ambushed by gunmen on his way to work.  他在上班的路上遭到了持枪歹徒的伏击。noun countable or uncountable
Several passers-by were killed in the ambush.  这次伏击行动造成数名路人死亡。

In this society there is a taboo on/against any sort of public display of affection.  在这个社会里，人们忌讳当众示爱。
For some people, death is a taboo subject.  对有些人而言，死亡是个忌讳的话题。
a symposium on European cinema  欧洲电影研讨会

He treats her with such deference.  他非常尊重她。
She covered her head out of/in deference to (= because of a polite respect for) Muslim custom.  出于对穆斯林习俗的尊重，她把头蒙了起来。

words.meaning: n.大臣，总理，首席法官，大学校长
words.example: Helmut Kohl became the first Chancellor of a united Germany in 1990.  赫尔穆特‧科尔于1990年成为德国统一后的首任总理。
It is hoped that the dispute will be settled without recourse to litigation.  人们希望这场争端能够不透过对簿公堂在私下解决。

He slit open the envelope with a knife.  他用刀将信封裁开。
She killed herself by slitting her wrists.  她割腕自杀了。
He was found the next day with his throat slit.  第二天有人发现他被割断了喉咙。
There is often a kernel of truth in what they say.  他们的话里常包含些真理。
Recent research seems to corroborate his theory.  最新研究似乎证实了他的理论。

She incited racial hatred by distributing anti-Semitic leaflets.  她派发反犹太传单煽动种族仇恨。
They denied inciting the crowd to violence.  他们否认煽动群众闹事。

What we are witnessing is the country's slow slide into anarchy.  我们现在亲眼目睹着该国慢慢陷入无政府状态。
The country has been in a state of anarchy since the inconclusive election.  自那次了无结果的大选以来，该国一直处于混乱状态。
If the pay deal isn't settled amicably there'll be anarchy in the factories.  如果工资问题不能友好地解决，这些工厂将会一片混乱。
The court heard that the six defendants had been coerced into making a confession.  法庭在审理中发现六名被告曾受到迫供。
He was made the Roman Catholic Primate of All Ireland last year.  他去年被任命为全爱尔兰天主教大主教。

words.meaning: a.过分自信的；有进取心的
words.example: If you really want the promotion, you'll have to be more assertive.  如果你真的希望晋升，就必须更加坚定自信地说出来。

words.meaning: a. 不朽的，流芳百世的
words.example:
The priest said he was endangering his immortal soul.  神父说他正在危及自己不朽的灵魂。
In the immortal words of Samuel Goldwyn, "Include me out".  用塞缪尔‧戈尔德温那句不朽的名言来说就是：“把我包括在外。”UK noun literary
She is one of the immortals of classical opera.  她是古典歌剧不朽的演唱家之一。

The recent storms have wreaked havoc on crops.  最近的暴风雨给农作物造成了巨大灾害。
She was determined to wreak revenge/vengeance on both him and his family.  她决心要报复他和他的家人。

words.meaning: n.上腭；口味，味觉；品位，爱好
words.example: a discriminating palate  敏锐的鉴赏力
The word 'lady' has connotations of refinement and excessive femininity that some women find offensive.  lady 一词有优雅和过分娇柔的涵义，因此某些女性觉得该词具有冒犯意。

words.meaning: a.有创意的；对以后发展有巨大影响的
words.example:
She wrote a seminal article on the subject while she was still a student.  她在学生时期就写了一篇有关该主题的文章，文章影响深远。
He played a seminal role in the formation of the association.  他在协会的创立过程中起了奠基性作用。adjective
He was relieved to see Jeannie reach the other side of the river safely.  看到珍妮安全到达河对岸，他心头一块石头落了地。
He agreed to the interview, with the caveat that he could approve the final article.  他答应会面，附带说他可能会同意最后一项条款。

Her books are often based on folklore and fairy-tales.  她的书常常以民间传说和神话故事为创作基础。
In Irish folklore, the leprechaun had a large piece of gold.  爱尔兰民间传说中的小矮妖有一大块金子。
Arguments between directors and stars are part of the folklore of Hollywood.  导演和演员之间发生争吵已成为好莱坞传统的一部分。

words.meaning: v.颠覆，推翻(政治制度，信仰)
words.example:
The rebel army is attempting to subvert the government.  叛军试图推翻政府。
Our best intentions are sometimes subverted by our natural tendency to selfishness.  我们的良好意图有时会被自私的本性破坏。

words.meaning: a. 令人毛骨悚然的，恶心的
words.example: The newspaper article included a gruesome description of the murder.  这篇报导中有一段对谋杀案血淋淋的描述。

Resources must be redirected into the many under-funded areas of education.  资源必须重新调配至诸多投资不足的教育领域。
Please redirect any mail that arrives for me to my address in Ottawa.  请将任何寄到这里的我的信件改寄到我在渥太华的地址。

words.meaning: n.既深又宽、坡度很大的山谷

words.example: the Indre, a lesser tributary of the Loire  安德尔河，卢瓦尔河的一条较小的支流

Her penchant for disappearing for days at a time worries her family.  她喜欢不时失踪几天，这让她的家人非常担心。

She broke out in hives after eating strawberries.  她吃过草莓之后，身上就起了疹子。noun

He knew how to spin a good yarn (= tell a good story).  他知道如何编造有趣的故事。

words.meaning: v.谈话；a.逆向的；n.相反的事物
words.example:

She's so shy that conversing with her can be quite difficult.  她那么害羞，跟她交谈很难。

words.meaning: a.守口如瓶的，爱保密的，爱把思想、情感深藏的
words.example: He's being very secretive about his new girlfriend.  关于他的新女朋友他总是遮遮掩掩的。

Delia was teetering around in five-inch heels.  迪莉亚穿着五英寸高的高跟鞋摇摇晃晃地走来走去。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition
What we are seeing now is a country teetering on the brink of civil war.  我们现在所看到的是一个濒临内战的国家。

St George slew the dragon.  圣乔治杀死了那条龙。
He was found slain in an alley two blocks from his apartment.  人们发现他在距其公寓两个街区的一条小巷里被杀害了。

His father used to thrash him when he was a boy.  当他还是孩子时，他的父亲经常鞭打他。
He thrashed the horse with his whip.  他用鞭子狠狠抽这匹马。verb
He was screaming and thrashing around on the floor.  他大喊大叫，在地上翻滚。verb
We were baling (up) the hay all day.  我们整天都在捆草。verb

words.meaning: v.趾高气扬地走；n.支柱，支杆

The boys strutted around trying to get the attention of a group of girls who were nearby.  男孩们神气十足地走来走去，想引起旁边一群女孩的注意。verb intransitive (-tt-)
Hey baby, why don't you get out on the floor and strut your stuff?  嘿，宝贝，你为甚么不下舞池露一手？    informal

words.meaning: v.嗡嗡地响，单调地说；n.单调的低音
words.example:
Outside the tent I could hear the constant drone of insects.  我能听到帐篷外面昆虫发出的持续不断的嗡嗡声。

Lennie's bottom lip quivered and tears started in his eyes.  雷尼的下唇颤抖着，眼里涌出了泪光。UK noun countable

words.meaning: v.清洗，清除(政敌)；净化心灵，洗涤罪恶

words.example:

words.meaning: v.启发，开导，教导，授予„知识

hazy sunshine  雾蒙蒙的日光

words.meaning: n.至高无上，最高权力，最高权威
words.example:

She spends her evenings poring over textbooks.  她每天晚上都在研读课本。

words.meaning: a.乌托邦式的，空想的，不切实际的
words.example: a utopian vision  不切实际的想法

words.meaning: n.阴谋破坏，颠覆活动(尤指摧毁对方武器、装备或挫败对方计划)

words.meaning: a. 教区的；地方性的，狭小的
words.example: Although it's just the local paper, it somehow manages not to be too parochial in its outlook.  尽管这只不过是份地方性报纸，报社却设法使其观点不至于过分狭隘。

He's always raving (on) about the government.  他总是语无伦次地大骂政府。

words.meaning: a.小心尽责的；小心谨慎的

words.meaning: n.(大众爱戴的)领袖气质；魅力
words.example:

words.meaning: a.有势力的；极其显著的，盛行的
words.example:
Research forms the predominant part of my job.  研究是我工作中的重要部分。
Dancers have a predominant role in this performance.  在这场表演中，舞蹈演员发挥主导作用。

He has been languishing in jail for the past twenty years.  过去的20年中他一直在监狱里苦熬。
The ruling party is languishing in third place in the opinion polls.  执政党在民意调查中处于第三的尴尬位置。

In spite of his injuries, he bears no animosity towards his attackers.  尽管受了伤，但他对袭击他的人也没有任何怨恨。

He gained a reputation as being a staunch defender/supporter of civil rights.  他坚决捍卫民权，因此赢得了声誉。UK verb transitive (US also stanch)
The country's asylum laws were amended to staunch the flow/flood of economic migrants.  该国修订避难法，阻止经济移民的洪流。

We could see seals on the rocks, basking in the sun.  我们可以看到海豹在岩石上晒太阳。UK verb intransitive usually + adverb or preposition
He basked in his moment of glory, holding the trophy up to the crowd.  他向观众高高举起奖杯，沉浸在荣耀之中。
For photographs requiring long exposure times, your camera should be mounted on a tripod.  拍摄需要长时间曝光的照片时，应该把相机固定在三脚架上。

They'll quite happily squander a whole year's savings on two weeks in the sun.  他们会心甘情愿地花尽全年的积蓄，度过两个星期的阳光假期。
Ireland squandered several chances, including a penalty that cost them the game.  爱尔兰队错失了几次机会，包括导致他们输掉比赛的一次罚球。

words.meaning: n.仲裁者，调解人；中间物；a.中间的，媒介的
words.example:
The police negotiated with the gunman through an intermediary.  警方透过调解人与持枪歹徒谈判。
The former president has agreed to act as an intermediary between the government and the rebels.  前总统已经同意在政府和叛军之间充当调解人。

words.meaning: n.预后，对疾病的发作及结果的预言
words.example: The prognosis after the operation was for a full recovery.  手术后的预后结果是完全康复。

What a queer thing to say!  多么奇怪的事啊！
I'm feeling rather queer (= ill) , may I sit down?  我感觉很不舒服，可以坐下吗？UK noun countable offensive
If she asks Ian for a pay rise before I do, it will probably queer my pitch.  要是她比我先向伊恩提出加薪的要求，那可能会毁了我加薪的机会。

(Social) etiquette dictates that men cannot sit while women are standing.  （社交）礼仪要求在女士站立时，男士不能入座。
Diplomatic etiquette forbids calling for the death of a national leader.  外交礼节禁止公开要求处死国家领导人。
Antibodies from the mother's milk line the baby's intestines and prevent infection.  来自母乳的抗体遍布在婴儿的肠道中，能防止感染。

words.meaning: n.爱抚，抚摸；v.爱抚或抚摸某人
words.example: Gently he caressed her cheek.  他轻抚她的脸颊。

Scientists may have solved the riddle of Saturn's rings.  科学家们或许已经揭开了土星环的奥秘。noun
The anti-aircraft guns riddled the plane's wings with bullets.  高射炮炮弹把机翼打得千疮百孔。
My mother accuses me of negligence unless I phone her every day.  如果我不每晚给母亲打电话，她就指责我不把她放在心里。

The negotiations have been fraught with difficulties/problems right from the start.  谈判从一开始就困难／问题重重。
From beginning to end, the airlift was fraught with risks.  那次空运自始至终都危机四伏。UK adjective
This is one of the most fraught weekends of the year for the security forces.  这是一年中最令安全部队紧张不安的周末之一。

The last time I saw Rachel she was hobbling around with a stick.  上次我见到雷切尔的时候，她拄着拐杖一瘸一拐的。
Some of the runners could only manage to hobble over the finishing line.  有些跑者只是勉强蹒跚支撑到终点。UK verb

He let out a torrent of abuse/angry words.  他连珠炮地说了一大堆谩骂／生气的话。
They are worried that the flow/trickle/stream of tourists could swell into an unmanageable torrent if there are no controls.  他们担心如果不进行控制，这些川流不息／涓涓细流般／源源不断的游客会汇集成一股难以应付的洪流。
Heavy rainfall turned the river into a rushing/raging torrent.  大雨将河水变成了汹涌的激流。

The water was barely dribbling out of the tap.  水好不容易地从水龙头里缓慢滴下。
Dribble the remaining olive oil over the tomatoes.  把剩下的橄榄油淋在番茄上。verb intransitive or transitive
Babies dribble constantly.  婴儿总是流口水。verb intransitive or transitive
the silent grandeur of the desert  沉寂而壮丽的沙漠

Hail and sleet are types of precipitation.  冰雹和冻雨都是降水形式。
The forecast is for dry, cloudy weather with no precipitation expected.  天气预报是干燥多云，没有降水。UK noun uncountable
The prime minister has been accused of acting with precipitation (= too quickly) over the crisis.  总理被指责在处理危机问题上贸然行动。UK noun uncountable
a television/radio mast  电视／广播天线杆UK noun countable
Our personalities result from the complex interplay between our genes and our environment.  我们的个性是基因与环境之间复杂的相互影响的结果。
She was completely baffled by his strange behaviour.  她完全被他怪异的举动弄迷糊了。

words.meaning: a. 形成的，影响发展的
words.example: She spent her formative years in Africa.  她在非洲渡过了性格形成时期。

words.meaning: a. 可怕的，令人恐惧的
words.example:
Conditions in the refugee camps were horrendous.  难民营里的条件糟透了。
The firm made horrendous (= very big) losses last year.  这家公司去年亏损极为严重。

I'm exhausted after lugging these suitcases all the way across London.  拖着这些箱子穿过整个伦敦可把我给累坏了。
Come over here and give me a kiss, you big lug.  过来亲亲我，你这个大傻瓜。
In grammar, an adjunct is an adverb or adverbial phrase that gives extra information in a sentence.  文法中，修饰成分是在句子中提供附加资料的副词或者副词片语。

words.meaning: a.有关存在的，存在主义的

words.example: iron/copper ore  铁／铜矿石
protruding ears/teeth  招风耳／暴牙
She's a born optimist (= someone who has always been optimistic).  她天生是个乐天派。

Her face crumpled with laughter.  她笑得脸上尽是皱纹。
The bullet hit him and he crumpled into a heap on the floor.  他中了弹，瘫倒在地上蜷作一团。verb
Sylvie crumpled up the letter and threw it in the bin.  西尔维把信揉成一团扔进了垃圾箱。

words.meaning: a. 喜怒无常的，脾气坏的
words.example: He can be quite moody.  他有时脾气很坏。

The house was in a wretched state.  这所房子状况很糟。
My wretched car's broken down again.  我那该死的车又抛锚了。
Take a deep breath in then exhale into the mouthpiece.  深呼吸，然后将气吹入吹口中。    Compare inhale

words.meaning: n. 吵架，打斗；v. 磨破
words.example:
Denim frays so easily.  丁尼布很容易磨损。
I'd frayed the edges of my jeans as that was the fashion in those days.  我把牛仔裤的边磨毛了，在那个时代这样很时髦。verb
Tempers frayed as thousands of motorists began the Christmas holiday with long waits in traffic jams.  圣诞假期一开始就有数千人开着车排成长龙拥堵在道路上，令大家恼火不已。verb
Judges have great discretionary powers.  法官有很大的自主权。
Terrorist groups and the government have been engaged in a costly war of attrition since 1968.  自1968年以来，恐怖主义组织和政府之间一直在进行两败俱伤的消耗战。
The changes are seen as a prelude to wide-ranging reforms.  这些变革被视为大范围改革的序幕。noun
Holding her painful back, she sat down gingerly on the bench.  她用手按着疼痛的背部，小心翼翼地坐在长椅上。

The sound of a flute wafted down the stairs.  长笛的声音飘到了楼下。UK US  literary
Caroline caught the heady waft of the other woman's perfume.  卡洛琳闻到了另一个女人身上散发出来浓烈的香水味。

words.meaning: v. 闪烁，闪耀；n. 灿烂的光华；诱惑力，魅力
words.example:
Her diamond necklace glittered brilliantly under the spotlights.  聚光灯下她的钻石项链流光溢彩，光芒四射。
His dark eyes glittered with anger behind his spectacles.  他那双黑眼睛透过镜片喷射出怒火。UK verb intransitive
He was attracted by the glitter of Hollywood.  好莱坞的魅力令他心驰神往。UK noun uncountable
Cardinals elect and advise the Pope.  枢机主教推选教宗并担当教宗的顾问。UK noun countable
It's sad to see someone estranged from their parents.  看到有人与父母疏远，真是令人悲哀。

figurative The Russian chess team have routed all the rest.  俄罗斯国际象棋队把其他参赛队都打了个落花流水。verb transitive formal
His wife had to rout him out of the crowd.  他的妻子不得不把他硬拖出人群。noun countable
The battle/election was a complete and utter rout.  那次战役／选举一败涂地。
wire/wooden fencing  铁丝网／木栅栏noun uncountable

The group held weekly clandestine meetings in a church.  这个团体每星期都在教堂举行秘密集会。
He has been having a clandestine affair with his secretary for three years.  他和秘书私通已有三年了。
She undertook several clandestine operations for the CIA.  她执行过中央情报局的好几次秘密行动。

words.meaning: v.用绳或链拴住(牲畜)；n.(拴牲畜的)绳或链；(能力等的)限度，范围
words.example: By 6 o'clock after a busy day I'm at the end of my tether.  忙碌了一天之后，到六点我已筋疲力尽了。
The missing child's distraught parents made an emotional appeal for information on TV.  失踪儿童的父母极为焦虑，在电视上恳请大家提供相关消息。

The train's approximate time of arrival is 10.30.  这列火车大概在10点30分到站。
The approximate cost will be about $600.  费用大约为600美元。
Can you give me an approximate idea of the numbers involved?  你能粗略地告诉我参与的人数吗？verb intransitive + adverb or preposition transitive UK US     formal

The doctor jabbed the needle into the dog's leg.  医生将针头扎入狗的腿中。
Watch out! You nearly jabbed me in the eye with your umbrella!  小心！你的雨伞快戳到我眼睛了！
He was jabbing a finger at (= towards) them and shouting angrily.  他用手指着他们，愤怒地又喊又叫。
We won't have discussions with this group unless they eschew violence.  除非这个团体放弃使用暴力，否则我们不会与之举行会谈。

Grass had withered in the fields.  田里的草都枯萎了。
This country is in danger of allowing its industrial base to wither away.  这个国家正面临工业基础萎缩的危险。UK US (also wither away)
There was some debate as to whether the benefit scheme should be withdrawn or simply allowed to wither on the vine.  究竟是取消这个救济方案还是让它自然消失，有待讨论。

Most house plants can be propagated from stem cuttings.  大多数室内植物都能由切下来的茎繁殖。
Plants needs certain conditions to propagate.  植物需要一定的条件才能繁殖。
The government have tried to propagate the belief that this is a just war.  政府竭力宣扬这是一场正义之战。

The airline reimbursed me for the amount they had overcharged me.  航空公司多收了我钱，他们后来退还给我了。
She was reimbursed by the gas company for the damage to her house.  煤气公司对她房屋遭受的损失进行了赔偿。

When his wife left him, he found solace in the bottle (= drank alcohol).  妻子离开他之后，他借酒消愁。
Music was a great solace to me.  音乐对我来说是一种很好的慰藉。UK US  literary

It took the firefighters several hours to extinguish the flames.  消防队员花了几个小时才将烈火扑灭。
Nothing could extinguish his love for her.  无论甚么也无法浇熄他对她的爱火。

[as form of address] Take your hands off me, you brute!  把手松开，你这畜牲！
Your dog's an ugly brute, isn't it?  你那条狗是个丑陋的家伙，对吧？
The oldest elephant was lame, poor brute.  那只最老的大象腿跛了，可怜的家伙。adjective [before noun]
Specimens for examination were taken from the anterior side of the left ventricle from each heart.  检查样本取自每个心脏左心室的前侧。    Compare posterior

They demanded a huge ransom for the return of the little girl whom they had kidnapped.  他们索要钜额赎金作为放回被绑小女孩的条件。
The gang held the racehorse to/for ransom.  这个犯罪集团扣留了赛马，以此勒索赎金。noun countable or uncountable
The government says it is being held to ransom by the actions of terrorist groups.  政府称，恐怖组织采取的行动是在要挟政府陷于投鼠忌器的境地。verb transitive

American presidents are always inaugurated on January 20th.  美国总统总是在1月20日正式就职。
The European Community inaugurated the Single European Market in 1993.  欧洲共同体于1993年正式启动欧洲单一市场。
The change of government inaugurated a new era of economic prosperity.  政府的变革开创了经济繁荣的新时代。

words.meaning: v.(狗尾巴等)摆动；n.诙谐幽默者
words.example:
The little dog's tail wagged in delight.  那条小狗欢快地摇着尾巴。
He wagged his finger sternly at the two boys.  他一脸严肃地向那两个男孩晃了晃手指。noun
With a single wag of her finger she managed to convey her total disapproval.  她只摇了一下手指，就清楚地表明她完全不赞成。noun
Aerial reconnaissance of the enemy position showed they were ready to attack.  对敌人阵地进行的空中侦察显示，敌军已经做好了进攻的准备。
the Mississippi delta  密西西比河三角洲

words.meaning: v.回避；用计谋战胜或规避
words.example: Ships were registered abroad to circumvent employment and safety regulations.  船只在外国注册以规避雇用和安全规定。

She has nothing but scorn for the new generation of politicians.  她对新一代的政客只有鄙视。
Why do you always pour/heap scorn on (= criticize severely and unfairly) my suggestions?  你为甚么总是对我的建议嗤之以鼻？UK verb transitive
So does he respect the press and media, or does he secretly scorn them?  他究竟是尊重报社和媒体，还是暗地里蔑视他们？

words.meaning: v.(未经许可擅自)窜改，乱动
n. 门闩；v. 用门闩闩牢
words.example:
Don't forget to leave the front door on the latch if you go to bed before I get back.  你如果在我回来之前上床睡觉，别忘了给我留着前门。verb intransitive or transitive
It took me ages to latch on to what she was talking about.  我好半天才弄明白她在说甚么。verb intransitive or transitive
The antibodies work by latching onto proteins on the surfaces of the viruses and bacteria.  抗体透过与病毒和细菌表面的蛋白质结合而发挥作用。

The report shows that drugs have penetrated every stratum of American society.  报告显示，毒品已经渗入美国社会的各个阶层。
The cliffs are characterized by remarkable zigzagging strata of shale, limestone and sandstone.  悬崖的特征是，它们由一层层清晰易辨的页岩、石灰岩和砂岩交错构成。

Mash the potatoes and then mix in the butter and herbs.  将马铃薯捣成泥，然后拌入奶油和香草。
His face was badly mashed up in the accident.  他的脸在意外中严重受伤变形。verb transitive
He always mashes up his peas before he eats them.  他总是先将豌豆捣碎才吃。noun uncountable UK informal
There has been a mass exodus of workers from the villages to the towns.  一直有大量工人源源不断从农村涌入城市。
Many innocent bystanders were injured by the explosion.  许多无辜的旁观者在爆炸中受伤。

He was munching on an apple.  他大口啃着苹果。
We watched her munch her way through two packets of peanuts.  我们看着她津津有味地嚼完了两包花生。noun uncountable UK informal
Shall we get some munch, then?  那么我们吃点东西好吗？

Traditionally, white flannels are worn when playing cricket.  按照传统，打板球时要穿白色法兰绒裤。noun
Leave out the flannel and answer the question!  别兜圈子了，回答问题吧！verb intransitive or transitive (-ll-)    UK informal
Lying on a sunny beach is my idea of sheer bliss.  我认为躺在沙滩上晒太阳是最大的幸福。

He is giving a recital of Bach's sonatas.  他将举办巴赫奏鸣曲个人演奏会。
She gave us a long, boring recital of all her troubles.  她不停地跟我们念叨她所有的烦心事，真烦人。
The editor said a lot of readers would be incensed by my article on abortion.  编辑说我关于堕胎的文章会激怒很多读者。
The rebels regard the official parliament as illegitimate.  反叛者认为官方的议会不合法。
He took me out to a really plush restaurant.  他带我去了一家豪华饭店。noun uncountable

We curled up in bed, all snug and warm, and listened to the storm outside.  我们蜷缩在床上，温暖又舒适，听着外面的暴风雨声。
These shoes are a bit too snug - do you have them in a larger size?  这双鞋有点太紧——你们有没有大一号的？noun countable (also snuggery) UK
When is the plumber coming to mend the burst pipe?  水电工甚么时候来修理破裂的水管？

words.meaning: n.遵循的规范；拘泥形式；正式
words.example:
You'll have to sign the visitors' book, but it's just a formality.  你得在访客簿上签名，不过这只是例行公事而已。
We'll have to observe the formalities (= do what is expected).  我们必须遵守法定程式。UK noun
She found the formality of the occasion rather daunting.  她觉得这个场合庄重得令人生畏。
The area has been ravaged by drought/floods/war.  这一地区饱受干旱／洪水／战争的蹂躏。

The bus driver swerved to avoid hitting the cyclists.  为了不撞上骑自行车的人，这辆公共汽车只好紧急转弯。
She is one of those rare politicians whom one can trust not to swerve from policy and principle.  她是罕有的，不会改变自己政策和原则的政治家之一。    Compare unswerving
The muffled roar of traffic could be heard in the distance.  远处隐约传来车辆行驶发出的轰鸣声。

The house stood in a bleak and desolate landscape.  那所房子坐落在萧瑟荒凉的原野上。adjective
She felt desolate when her closest friend moved away.  她最亲密的朋友搬走了，她感到有些伤心寂寞。

words.meaning: n.(肉体或精神上的)折磨，痛苦
words.example:
The family said they had endured years of torment and abuse at the hands of the neighbours.  这家人说多年来他们一直忍受着邻居们的欺凌羞辱。
Waiting for the result of the medical tests was sheer torment.  等待医疗检查的结果简直就是一种折磨。
He spent the night in torment, trying to decide what was the best thing to do.  他在痛苦中渡过了那个晚上，思量着最好该怎么做。

words.meaning: n.竖琴；v.喋喋不休地说或写
words.example: He's always harping on about lack of discipline.  他总是抱怨纪律涣散。

If someone insults you, don't retaliate as it only makes the situation worse.  如果别人侮辱了你，不要报复，因为这样只会使情况变得更糟。
The demonstrators threw rocks at the police, who retaliated by firing blanks into the crowd.  示威者向员警投掷石块，员警则还以颜色，向人群发射空弹。
The terrorists retaliated against the government with a bomb attack.  恐怖分子实施了一次炸弹袭击来报复政府。

words.meaning: a.连续的，一连串的，按次序的
words.example: The publishers claim that the book constitutes 'the first sequential exposition of events and thus of the history of the revolution'.  出版商称这本书是“对革命大事及革命历史的首度系统化的阐释”。

Johnny sculpted an old man's head out of wood.  强尼用木头刻出了一个老人的头。
The dripping water had sculpted strange shapes out of the rocks/sculpted the rocks into strange shapes.  水滴把石头变成了各种奇怪的形状。
Much of Orwell's writing now seems grimly prophetic.  欧威尔的许多文学作品现在看来似乎是冷酷的预言。

He leaned towards me and I caught/got a whiff of garlic.  他向我靠过来，我闻到一股大蒜的味道。
During the first few months of pregnancy the slightest whiff of food cooking made my stomach turn.  怀孕的最初几个月，闻到一点点做饭的味道就会让我反胃。
They regularly hold elections without a whiff of corruption or violence.  他们定期举行选举，其中毫无腐败或暴力的成分。

Recent developments in the area have brought latent ethnic tension out into the open.  近来该地区的一些新情况导致民族之间潜在的紧张关系公开化了。
We're trying to bring out the latent artistic talents that many people possess without realising it.  我们正在努力挖掘许多人自身具有但却没有意识到的潜在艺术才能。
The film is a reflection of the violence that pervades American culture.  这部电影反映了充斥于美国文化中的暴力。
a spectral figure/presence  鬼魂adjective
Of course, she was using the term 'massacre' in the figurative sense.  当然，她是在用“屠杀”这个词的比喻义。    Compare literalUK adjective

Ever since the oil crisis, the industry has been in (a state of) disarray.  自石油危机以来，该行业就一直处于混乱状态。
The news had thrown his plans into disarray.  这个消息打乱了他的计划。
Her clothes were in disarray (= were untidy).  她的衣服凌乱不堪。
The company's results for this year are skewed because not all our customers have paid their bills.  公司今年的业绩有误差，因为并非所有客户都已付款。adjective [after verb]

words.meaning: n.(存放或修理飞机的)飞机库

words.example:
Someone rammed (into) my car while it was parked outside my house.  我的汽车停在家门外时，被别人开车撞了一下。
He rammed the sweets/his pipe into his mouth.  他把糖／烟斗塞进嘴里。
The prisoners who were being force-fed had tubes rammed down their throats.  被强行喂食的犯人们都在喉咙里插进了管子。

words.example:
In a moment of aberration, she agreed to go with him.  她一反常态，竟然答应跟他一起去了。
I'm sorry I'm late - I had a mental aberration and forgot we had a meeting today.  对不起，我迟到了。我一时糊涂，竟忘了今天要开会。
a hunk of bread/cheese/meat  一大块面包／乳酪／肉noun countable
The surgeon makes a small incision into which a tube is inserted.  外科医生切开一个小口把管子插了进去。

words.meaning: v.概括，摘要，成为典型，成为缩影
words.example: With little equipment and unsuitable footwear, she epitomizes the inexperienced and unprepared mountain walker.  她几乎没有带任何装备，穿的鞋也不合适，是一个典型的缺乏经验、准备不足的登山客。
rules of byzantine complexity  复杂难懂的规则

The lights of the village were glimmering in the distance.  远处村庄微弱的灯光时隐时现。
The sky glimmered with stars.  天空闪烁着点点星光。
figurative The first faint signs of an agreement began to glimmer through (= appear).  达成协议开始出现一线希望。UK noun countable (also glimmering)

The two men fought a duel over the lady.  两个男人为了这位女士决斗。
The composer Strauss was once challenged to a duel.  作曲家施特劳斯曾经受到决斗挑战。
The two yachts are locked in a duel for the championship title.  两艘大帆船为了夺冠而争得不可开交。

words.meaning: a.最后的，结论的；确凿的，消除怀疑的
words.example: They had conclusive evidence/proof of her guilt.  他们掌握了她犯罪的确凿证据。

Reindeer roam the tundra in large herds.  大群大群的驯鹿在苔原上徜徉。
Few plants grow in tundra regions.  苔原地区很少有植物生长。
an exhaustive study/report  全面的研究／详尽的报告

words.meaning: n.云杉(一种叶子茂密的树)；a.整洁的
words.example:
He looked spruce and handsome in a clean white shirt.  他穿着干净的白衬衫，显得清清爽爽，很是帅气。verb
They've employed an advertising agency to spruce up the company image.  他们请了一家广告公司来打造公司的形象。

The report said that the victims had suffocated in the fumes.  报告说那些受害者是被烟熏死的。
She suffocated him by holding a pillow over his head.  她用枕头压在他的头上，把他闷死。verb intransitive or transitive
Changes in the economy have followed a cyclical pattern.  经济呈周期性变化。

Johnny had/threw a tantrum in the shop because I wouldn't buy him any sweets.  因为我不给他买糖，强尼便在商店里耍脾气。
If she doesn't get her own way she has temper tantrums.  如果不顺着她，她就会耍脾气。
auditory/olfactory hallucinations  幻听／幻嗅

The truck came hurtling towards us.  卡车向着我们猛冲过来。
The explosion sent pieces of metal and glass hurtling through the air.  爆炸导致金属和玻璃碎片在空中乱飞。

The president's speech heralds a new era in foreign policy.  总统的演说预示着一个外交政策新时代的开始。
This drug has been heralded as a major breakthrough in the fight against breast cancer.  这种药据称是在对抗乳癌方面的一个重大突破。noun countable    formal
If this first opera of the season is a herald (= sign) of what is to come, we can expect great things.  如果本季这第一部歌剧是个预示，那么我们可以期待接下来的剧目会非常精彩。
We held our glasses aloft.  我们高举酒杯。
He's got floppy blond hair that's always falling in his eyes.  他有着柔软的金发，总是垂到眼睛里。UK noun countable (also floppy disk)
She was a very placid (= calm and not easily excited) child who slept all night and hardly ever cried.  她是个非常安静的孩子，整个晚上都在睡觉，极少哭泣。
Susie always gravitates towards the older children in her playgroup.  苏茜在幼儿园总是爱跟比她大的小朋友玩。
an ecumenical service  旨在促进基督教不同教派大联合的仪式

By the age of thirty-two she had reached the pinnacle of her career.  她在32岁时事业达到巅峰。noun
literary The pinnacles of the Himalayas were visible above the clouds.  喜马拉雅山脉的诸峰显现在云端之上。

She deserved her promotion, but I wish she wasn't so damned smug about it.  她应该得到晋升，但我希望她对此不要那么沾沾自喜。
There was a hint of smug self-satisfaction in her voice.  她的言语中流露出一丝自鸣得意。
He's been unbearably smug since he gave up smoking.  他戒烟之后，那个得意的样子简直让人难以忍受。
In their election manifesto, the Liberal Democrats proposed increasing taxes to pay for improvements in education.  在竞选宣言中，自由民主党提出增加税收以支付改善教育所需的费用。
At puberty, pubic hair develops and girls begin to menstruate.  青春期时，阴毛开始生长，女孩开始月经来潮。

The pendulum in the grandfather clock swung back and forth.  落地钟的钟摆来回摆动。
The spaceship's jets were fired periodically to dampen a side-to-side pendulum motion that had developed.  太空船的喷射装置周期性地喷射，以减缓太空船出现的左右摇摆现象。
As so often in education, the pendulum has swung back to the other extreme and testing is popular again.  人们的观点又回到了另一个极端，考试又流行起来了，这种摇摆不定的现象在教育界经常出现。

The narrow street reverberated with/to the sound of the workmen's drills.  狭窄的街道上回荡着工人施工的电钻声。UK verb
News of the disaster reverberated around the organization.  灾难的噩耗传来，组织内所有人震惊不已。
The surge in US share prices reverberated across the globe.  美国股价飙升，影响波及全世界。

The ceiling was embellished with flowers and leaves.  天花板上装饰着花和叶。
He couldn't resist embellishing the story of his accident a little.  在描述他出的那次意外时，他忍不住添油加醋地渲染了一番。
They were in a state of euphoria for days after they won the prize.  获奖之后一连几天他们都处于亢奋状态。
soggy ground  湿透的地面
He'd fly into a rage at the slightest provocation.  哪怕是稍稍惹他一下他都会勃然大怒。

She always coveted power but never quite achieved it.  她一直贪求权力，但从未得逞。
The Booker Prize is the most coveted British literary award.  布克奖是最令人向往的英国文学奖。

The fire burned for eight hours before the fire crews could subdue it.  大火烧了八个小时后，消防队才控制住火势。
He criticized the school for trying to subdue individual expression.  他指责学校试图压制个性的自由表现。

words.meaning: v.同意负担„的费用；为„保险

words.example:
Babies like to gnaw hard objects when they're teething.  婴儿在长牙时喜欢啃咬硬物。
I've been gnawed by guilt about not replying to her letter yet.  我到现在还没有回她的信，心里一直感到很内疚。
The feeling that I've forgotten something has been gnawing at me all day.  我一整天都坐立不安，总是觉得忘了甚么事情。UK verb intransitive + prep transitive

The cable has a copper wire surrounded by a plastic sheath.  电缆是铜丝做的，外面包着塑胶皮。
The nerves are protected by thin sheaths of fatty tissue.  神经由薄薄的脂肪鞘保护着。
He drew the knife from its jewelled leather sheath.  他把刀从镶有珠宝的皮鞘中抽出来。

words.meaning: n./v. 典当，抵押；n.被小人物利用
words.example:
The refugees are pawns in an international political dispute.  这些难民成了一场国际政治争端的棋子。UK noun
She had to put her ring in pawn to pay the bills.  为了支付帐单，她不得不当掉戒指。UK verb transitive
Of all items pawned, jewellery is the most common.  在所有的抵押品中最常见的是珠宝。
From an early age the brothers have loathed each other.  自小时候起，兄弟俩就一直相互厌恶。

That bookcase wobbles whenever you put anything on it.  那个书架你一放东西就摇摇晃晃。
Don't wobble the table, please, Dan.  丹，别晃桌子好吗？
figurative The company's shares wobbled with the news of a foreign takeover bid.  这家公司的股票由于外国公司收购的消息而波动。UK verb

They clambered over/up the rocks.  他们攀上了岩石。
She clambered into bed.  她爬上了床。
media/press barons  媒体／新闻巨头
The device detonated unexpectedly.  装置发生了意外爆炸。
In the drawer was a selection of kitchen utensils - spoons, spatulas, knives and whisks.  抽屉里有一套厨房用具——勺、铲子、刀和搅蛋器。
He gave an immaculate performance as the aging hero.  他完美地扮演了那个年迈的英雄。

We have evidence to substantiate the allegations against him.  我们有证据支持对他的指控。
Reports that children had been hurt have not been substantiated.  有关儿童受到伤害的报导并未得到证实。

We'd expected a few glitches, but everything's gone remarkably smoothly.  我们本来预计会出现一些小差错，但是一切都进展得非常顺利。
The system has been plagued with glitches ever since its launch.  系统自启动以来不断有小故障。
The computer failure was due to a glitch caused by lightning.  这次电脑故障是由雷电造成的脉冲干扰所致。
full-blown AIDS  晚期爱滋病
Whether or not to move overseas was a momentous decision for the family.  是否移居海外对这个家庭来说是个重要的决定。

words.meaning: n.世界主义者，四海为家的人
words.example:
New York is a highly cosmopolitan city.  纽约是个国际化程度很高的大都市。UK US  usually approving
Lisa is a real cosmopolitan.  莉萨真是见多识广。

Vegetable prices fluctuate according to the season.  蔬菜价格随着季节变化而涨落。
Her wages fluctuate between £150 and £200 a week.  她的周薪在150英镑到200英镑之间浮动。
Her weight fluctuates wildly.  她的体重起伏很大。

If you cancel now I'm afraid you forfeit your deposit.  如果您现在取消的话，恐怕您不能拿回订金。
These people have forfeited the right to live in society.  这些人已经丧失了社会生存权。UK noun countable
With her beauty and charm, she captivated film audiences everywhere.  她的美貌和魅力迷倒了各地的电影观众。
She has long been an adherent of the Communist Party.  长期以来她一直是共产党的拥护者。

There is now a mood of deepening pessimism about/over the economy.  对经济的悲观情绪越来越浓。
An underlying pessimism infuses all her novels.  她所有的小说中都暗含着一种悲观主义情绪。    Opposite optimism

He warned against making hasty decisions.  他警告过不要仓促作出决定。
Now let's not leap to any hasty conclusions.  现在我们不要仓促得出结论。
We saw the rain and made a hasty retreat into the bar.  我们看见下雨了，于是就匆忙躲进酒吧里。

words.meaning: n.(烤肉用的)穿肉杆；v.用杆穿好

words.example: The children scuttled off as soon as the headmaster appeared.  校长一出现，孩子们一下子都跑光了。UK verb
The dispute had reached an impasse, as neither side would compromise.  由于双方都不肯让步，争端陷入僵局。

words.meaning: v. 作嘘声，蔑视或反对
words.example:
People at the back started booing loudly.  后面的人开始大声喝倒彩。
Her singing was so bad that she was booed off the stage.  她唱得太糟了，被轰下了台。noun countable (boos)
She jumped out of the cupboard and shouted 'Boo!'.  她从衣橱中跳出来大喊了一声“哇！”

He ironed a crease down the front of each trouser leg.  他在每条裤腿的正面熨出一条褶痕来。noun
The seatbelt has creased my blouse.  安全带把我的衬衫弄皱了。
It's a nice dress, but it creases very easily.  这条裙子很漂亮，但很容易起皱。verb intransitive or transitive

You may sneer, but a lot of people like this kind of music.  你可以嗤之以鼻，但很多人喜欢这种音乐。
She'll probably sneer at my new shoes because they're not expensive.  她也许会取笑我的新鞋子，因为买得很便宜。
"How much did you say you earned last year - was it fifteen thousand?" she said with a sneer.  “你说去年你赚了多少钱——是一万五吗？”她语带讥讽地说道。

She has a deep aversion to getting up in the morning.  早上她很不愿意起床。
Greed is my pet aversion (= the thing I dislike most of all).  我最痛恨贪得无厌。

words.meaning: n.习语，语言的习惯用法；特色
words.example:
To "have bitten off more than you can chew" is an idiom that means you have tried to do something which is too difficult for you.  have bitten off more than you can chew 是一句成语，意思是试图承担力所不及的事。
Both operas are very much in the modern idiom.  两部歌剧都很有现代风格。

In the centre of the hall stood a colossal wooden statue, decorated in ivory and gold.  大厅中央矗立着一尊用象牙和黄金装饰的木质巨型雕像。
They were asking a colossal amount of money for the house.  他们对这房子漫天要价。

The party's principles are basically egalitarian.  这个党的基本原则是人人平等。UK US  formal
Ford is no egalitarian.  福特可绝不是甚么平等主义者。
Holly suffered from insomnia for months after her daughter was born.  霍利在女儿出生后失眠了好几个月。

words.meaning: a.(寒风)刺骨的；(观察力)敏锐的
words.example:
Troops have been issued with new armour- piercing anti-tank grenades.  军队配备了新的反坦克穿甲枪榴弹。
figurative We shivered in the piercing wind.  我们在刺骨的寒风中瑟缩发抖。
She hadn't really meant to lie, but their piercing questions had forced her to.  她本来不想说谎，但他们尖锐的问题使她不得不这样做。
The conditioner gives the hair a beautiful soft sheen.  这种护发乳能使头发美丽、柔顺，富有光泽。
Singapore is/lies on the Equator.  新加坡位于赤道之上。
The show was a fiasco - the lights wouldn't work, one actor forgot his lines and another fell off the stage.  演出彻底搞砸了，灯光不亮，一个演员忘了台词，另一个跌下了舞台。

words.meaning: a. 强制性的，命令性的
words.example:
Swimming was compulsory at my school.  在我们学校，游泳是必修课。
Wearing seat belts in cars is compulsory by law.  坐车系安全带是法律强制规定的。

They hurriedly fortified the village with barricades of carts.  他们匆忙用马车搭起路障，加强村子的防御。
The argument had fortified her resolve to prove she was right.  这番争论增强了她证明自己正确的决心。
He fortified himself with a drink and a sandwich before driving on.  继续开车之前，他喝了杯饮品吃了件三明治来增强体力。
They give away free gifts with children's meals as a sales/marketing gimmick.  他们给儿童套餐搭配免费礼品作为促销／ 行销伎俩。
The country roads are quite perilous.  这些乡间道路很危险。

The refugees arriving at the camp had pitiful stories to tell.  抵达营地的难民背后都有令人同情的故事可讲。
The amount of time and money being spent on researching this disease is pitiful.  花费在研究该疾病上的时间和金钱少得可怜。

words.meaning: v.揉制，捏制（面团、湿黏土等）
words.example: Knead the dough until smooth.  把面团揉匀为止。

words.meaning: n.顶点；最终结果、最终结论

words.example: He was shocked at the sheer venom of her reply.  对于她极度愤恨的回答他感到很震惊。

words.meaning: v. (使某物)发出轻而爽的声音
words.example:
The leaves rustled in the breeze.  树叶在微风中飒飒作响。
He rustled his papers (= noisily moved them about) to hide his embarrassment.  他哗啦哗啦地翻动文件，以此来掩饰他的尴尬。verb
Give me a minute and I'll rustle something up for supper.  给我一点时间，我去随便做点晚饭。noun only singular
The president said that his country was moving into a new epoch which would be one of lasting peace.  总统说他的国家正在步入一个长治久安的新时代。

She is a pious follower of the faith, never missing her prayers.  她是个虔诚的信徒，从来不耽误祷告。adjective
Quit the pious apologies - I know you don't really care.  别假惺惺地道歉了——我知道你并非真的在乎。
Until we've got official permission to go ahead with the plans we're in limbo.  在该计划得到正式批准之前，我们一直处于停滞状态。UK noun
The news astounded me.  听到这个消息，我非常震惊。

His daughters stared back at him with an expression of sullen resentment.  他的女儿们也满脸愠怒地狠狠回瞪他。
literary She looked up at the sullen (= dark and unpleasant) sky and shuddered.  她抬头看了看阴沉沉的天空，不由得打了个冷颤。
She has an earthy sense of humour.  她的幽默感粗俗不堪。UK adjective
It was an egregious error for a statesman to show such ignorance.  一位政界人士表现得如此无知，犯这种错误是极不应该的。

words.meaning: v.激发某人、使某人充满强烈的情感或意见
words.example: His poetry is imbued with deep, religious feeling.  他的诗歌充满了深厚的宗教情感。

We spent the afternoon meandering around the streets of the old town.  我们那天下午都在旧城的街道上闲逛。UK verb
The film meanders along with no particular story line.  影片不着边际地发展着，没有明确的故事情节。UK noun countable
The TV series continues its haphazard meander around the globe - this week it will be in Portugal.  这部电视系列片将继续其行踪不定的环球之旅——这周的目的地将是葡萄牙。

words.meaning: n.连枷(打谷工具)；v.（用连枷）打，打击
words.example: She ran from the house in a terrible rage, her arms flailing in the air.  她怒不可遏地从房子里跑出来，手臂在空中乱挥乱打。noun countable

words.meaning: a.善于骗人的；灵巧的；n.欺诈行为
words.example:
He's a very cunning man.  他为人十分狡猾。adjective
We need to show a bit of cunning if we want to trick the enemy.  要想骗过敌人，我们得想点计策。
She had spent another dreary day in the office.  她在办公室里又渡过了枯燥的一天。

We had poached eggs for breakfast.  我们早饭吃荷包蛋。
Do you like pears poached in red wine?  你喜欢吃红葡萄酒煮的梨吗？UK verb
The farmer claimed that he shot the men because they were poaching on his land.  农场主人声称他开枪射杀那些人是因为他们侵入他的地界偷猎。

words.meaning: n.寿衣，裹尸布；遮蔽物；v.覆盖
words.example:
Everything was covered in a thick shroud of dust.  所有东西上都积了厚厚的一层尘土。
The truth about the accident remains hidden beneath a shroud of secrecy.  事故的真相一直是个谜。verb transitive
Visitors have complained about the scaffolding that shrouds half the castle.  游客们抱怨应架遮蔽了半个城堡。
His English is impeccable.  他的英语无懈可击。
The new law was finally promulgated in the autumn of last year.  新法律最终于去年秋天颁布。

words.meaning: a.预示世界末日的；启示的
words.example: apocalyptic visions of a nuclear confrontation  对核对抗灾难性后果的描述
Politicians are always good fodder for comedians (= they make jokes about them).  政客们往往是喜剧作家的好素材。    See cannon fodder
She made a couple of dreadful puns.  她说出了几个令人不快的双关语。

They purchased an aggregate of 3000 shares in the company.  他们总共买了这家公司的3000股股票。
Snowflakes are loose aggregates of ice crystals.  雪花是冰晶松散的凝聚体。
Arsenal lost the second game, but got through to the final on aggregate (= adding together the goals in both matches).  兵工厂队虽然输了第二场比赛，但是凭借进球总数进入了决赛。adjective [before noun] /ˈæg.rɪ.gət/
He looks like a nice, wholesome, young man.  他看起来是个善良而又健康向上的年轻人。

words.meaning: n.(某地区或时代的)植物群
words.example: the flora of the Balearic Islands  巴厘阿里群岛的植物群

Religious minorities were persecuted and massacred during the ten-year regime.  在长达十年的独裁统治期间，宗教信仰上的少数派遭到了迫害和屠杀。
His latest film is about the experience of being persecuted for being gay.  他最新的一部影片以同性恋者受迫害的经历为题。
Ever since the news broke about her divorce, she has been persecuted by the tabloid press.  自从她离婚的消息传出后，她一直被八卦小报紧咬不放。
I've never actually read the book in its entirety.  实际上我从来没有完整地读过这本书。

He left me stranded in town with no car and no money for a bus.  他把我丢在城里，既没车也没钱坐公车。
If the tide comes in, we'll be stranded on these rocks.  如果涨潮的话，我们就会被困在这些礁石上。

Raucous laughter came from the next room.  隔壁房间传来刺耳的笑声。
The party was becoming rather raucous.  聚会变得越来越吵闹。
Guy Fawkes was executed for treason after he took part in a plot to blow up the British Parliament building.  盖伊‧福克斯因参与炸毁英国议会大厦的阴谋活动而被以叛国罪处决。
a deluxe hotel in Paris  巴黎的豪华饭店

Mr Savino has been charged with three murders as well as a whole slew of other crimes.  萨维诺先生被控犯有三项谋杀罪外加一大堆其他的罪行。verb intransitive or transitive [+ adv/prep]
The car hit a patch of ice and slewed around violently.  汽车撞到一片冰，猛地打起转来。
He slewed the van to the left to avoid the dog.  他将货车猛然左转以避开那条狗。

We worked for hours without respite.  我们一刻不停地工作了好几个小时。
Their teacher was away, so they had a day's respite before their essays were due.  他们的老师外出，所以他们交论文的期限往后拖了一天。

Police in riot gear were called in to quell the disturbances/unrest.  身穿防暴装的员警奉命前来平息骚乱。
This latest setback will have done nothing to quell the growing doubts about the future of the club.  最近一次的挫折对消除人们对俱乐部前景与日俱增的疑虑没有一点好处。
He accused them of trying to torpedo the peace process.  他指责他们试图破坏和平进程。
The athletes were drenched in/with sweat.  运动员的汗水湿透了衣服。

Plans to build a new nightclub in the neighbourhood have enraged local residents.  在附近地区新建一家夜总会的计划激怒了当地居民。
He was enraged at the article about him.  关于他的那篇报道使他大为光火。
a cohesive group  有凝聚力的团体

To keep the company alive, half the workforce is being made redundant.  为了使公司生存下去，一半的员工要被裁掉。
figurative New technology often makes old skills and even whole communities redundant.  新技术常常会使古老的技艺甚至是某个行业完全消失。adjective
In the sentence, "She is a single unmarried woman", the word "unmarried" is redundant.  在句子 She is a single unmarried woman 中，unmarried 一词是多余的。
The organization is stifled by bureaucratic inertia.  官僚主义的惰性扼杀了这个组织。UK noun uncountable

words.meaning: a.轻而薄的；不结实的，易坏的
words.example:
You won't be warm enough in that flimsy dress.  你穿那么薄的衣服不够暖和。
We spent the night in a flimsy wooden hut.  我们在一个不太坚固的小木屋里过了一夜。
When I asked him why he was late, he gave me some flimsy excuse about having car trouble.  我问他为甚么迟到时，他给了个很不足信的借口，说车出毛病了。

We have a rendezvous for next week, don't we?  我们下周有个约会，是不是？
The lovers met at a secret rendezvous in the park.  恋人们在公园中偷偷约会。
This restaurant is a popular rendezvous for local artists.  这家饭店是当地艺术家喜欢的聚会地点。

words.meaning: v.掩饰地说，轻描淡写地说
words.example: She believes the research understates the amount of discrimination women suffer.  她认为该研究对妇女所遭受的歧视轻描淡写。

words.meaning: n. 预兆，吉兆；赞助，支持

words.example: When a company is in crisis like this, the vultures are always hovering.  当一家公司遇到这样的危机，一众趁火打劫者总是会在旁边虎视耽耽。
For some inexplicable reason, he's decided to cancel the project.  由于某种无法解释的原因，他决定取消这个专案。

Lindi has achieved her comfortable life only after years of hard toil.  林迪在做了多年的苦工后才过上舒适的生活。
humorous Well, after a day's toil in the office I like to relax a little.  好啦，在办公室劳累了一天，我想歇一会儿儿。verb intransitive
England's cricketers have been toiling in the 100-degree heat over the past week.  在过去的一周，英格兰板球运动员一直在华氏100度的高温下艰苦训练。

For years now, the people have been oppressed by a ruthless dictator.  多年来，人们一直身处残暴独裁者的压迫之下。verb
Strange dreams and nightmares oppressed him.  怪梦和噩梦使他感到焦虑不安。

We have been inundated with requests for help.  求助申请多得让我们应接不暇。verb transitive
If the dam breaks it will inundate large parts of the town.  如果水坝决堤，这个城镇的大部分地区都将被淹没。
The company had to make reparation to those who suffered ill health as a result of chemical pollution.  这间公司不得不向那些受化学污染危害而健康状况不佳的人士作出赔偿。
verb intransitive or transitive UK US It was the Greek astronomer, Ptolemy, who postulated that the Earth was at the centre of the universe.  就是希腊天文学家托勒密假定地球是宇宙的中心。formal
She has written for several legal periodicals.  她为几本法律期刊撰稿。
The body produces chemicals which are natural painkillers.  人体会产生一些化学物质，它们是天然的止痛剂。
Words alone cannot convey the untold misery endured by people in these refugee camps.  单单文字是无法形容人们在难民营里所遭受的极度苦难。
the pungent whiff of a goat  山羊发出的刺鼻膻味
Are you being sarcastic?  你这是在挖苦吗？
We must not be drawn into the mire of civil war.  我们一定不能被拖进内战的泥潭中。

From the hotel roof you can enjoy a panorama of the whole city.  从饭店楼顶上你可以欣赏到城市的全景。
The investigation revealed a panorama of corruption and illegal dealings.  调查揭露了腐败和非法交易的全貌。

He sidestepped the blow/the tackle.  他侧步避开了攻击／阻截队员。
The speaker sidestepped the question by saying that it would take him too long to answer it.  演讲者借口说回答要很长时间而回避了这个问题。
He describes seeing Stanley Matthews play football as one of the transcendent moments of his life.  他说看斯坦利‧马修斯踢足球是他一生中最为美妙的时刻之一。

words.meaning: a.古怪的，异想天开的；反复无常的
words.example: Despite his kindly, sometimes whimsical air, he was a shrewd observer of people.  尽管他为人和善，有时也有些古怪，但对人观察很敏锐。
an Italian opera diva  义大利歌剧女歌唱家
Her speech was full of excuses and evasions and never properly addressed the issue.  她的谈话从头到尾都是些借口托词，根本就没有切实谈过这个问题。

The children were making a terrible din.  孩子们在制造可怕的噪音。verb (-nn-)
It was dinned into me that I mustn't be late.  我被反覆告诫千万不要迟到。

He complained that he'd been receiving malicious telephone calls.  他抱怨说他接二连三地接到恶意骚扰电话。
legal He was charged with malicious wounding.  他被控蓄意伤人。
an astute investor/businesswoman  精明的投资者／女商人
This ring is a family heirloom.  这枚戒指是家里祖传的。

He leant forward to kiss her and she recoiled in horror.  他俯身去吻她，她惊恐地后退避开。
She wondered how it would be to touch him and recoiled at the thought.  她想知道摸一摸他会是甚么感觉，但这个念头一进入脑海，她马上感到一阵厌恶。noun uncountable /ˈriː.kɔɪl/
She was given a standing ovation (= the crowd stood up while they clapped, to show respect) at the end of her speech.  她演讲完毕后，人们起立热烈鼓掌。

He was ordained (as) a priest in Oxford cathedral in 1987.  他于1987年在牛津大教堂被授予圣职。UK verb
There is strong support here for the tough economic reforms ordained in the federal capital, Prague.  这里的人们坚决支持由联邦首都布拉格下令进行的强力经济改革。

The west of the city was largely unaffected by the bombing.  该城西部基本上没有受到轰炸的破坏。
It is hoped that train services on the main lines will be unaffected by today's industrial action.  人们希望干线列车的运行不会因今天的罢工而中断。adjective
For someone who has spent forty years in show business she remains remarkably unaffected by it all.  作为一个在娱乐圈了呆了40年的人，她仍然保持着惊人的纯真。

These old buildings are the last vestiges of a colonial past.  这些旧建筑是殖民历史最后的痕迹。
There is now no vestige of hope that the missing children will be found alive.  失踪儿童现在已经毫无生还的希望了。

The influence of Rodin is discernible in the younger artist.  从这位稍微年轻一些的艺术家身上可以看到罗丹的影响。
There is no discernible reason why this should be the case.  没有理由可以解释为甚么会这样。

At the end of each teaching practice, trainee teachers are asked to appraise their own performance.  在每次教学实习结束时，都要求实习教师对自己的表现作自我评定。
In co-operation with other professionals, social workers will appraise the individual's needs.  社会工作者将与其他专业人士携手合作，对个体的需要作出评估。
He coolly appraised the situation , deciding which person would be most likely to succeed.  他冷静地审时度势，判断哪个人最可能获得胜利。

There have been reports of a masked man prowling in the neighbourhood.  有人报告说有一个蒙面人在附近出没。
At night, adult scorpions prowl the desert for (= trying to catch) insects.  在夜晚，成年蝎子在沙漠里潜行觅食昆虫。
informal Unable to sleep, he prowled (= walked without purpose) (about/around) the hotel corridors.  他睡不着，就在旅馆的走廊上徘徊。noun

words.meaning: n.轻描淡写的陈述，不充分的陈述
words.example:
To say that her resignation was a shock would be an understatement - it caused panic.  说她辞职令人震惊只是一种保守说法——它实际上引起了恐慌。
That New York City is not a peaceful place to live is the understatement of the year/month/century.  住在纽约不太平，这是本年度／本月／本世纪最温和的说法。
She opened her presents with glee.  她兴高采烈地打开礼物。

The decision to include Morris in the team was completely vindicated when he scored three goals.  莫里斯攻入了三球，证明当初将他招入队中是完全正确的。
The investigation vindicated her complaint about the newspaper.  调查证明了她对那家报纸的投诉属实。

Once the fire had been stoked up, the room began to get warm.  炉火添了木柴拨旺之后，屋子里开始暖和起来。
He's been accused of stoking up racial hatred in the region.  他被控在这地区煽动种族仇恨。
Rumours of an emergency meeting of the finance ministers stoked the atmosphere of crisis.  财政首长们召开紧急会议的传言使人感到危机重重。UK US  (also stoke up)

The book caused an uproar in France.  该书在法国引起了轩然大波。
The whole hall was in uproar after the announcement.  宣布完后，整个大厅一片哗然。

She's a very jolly, upbeat sort of a person.  她是个非常乐观向上的人。UK adjective
We spent a very jolly evening together, chatting and drinking.  我们一起聊天、喝酒，渡过了一个惬意的晚上。UK adjective
That's a jolly nice scarf you're wearing.  你戴的围巾很漂亮。UK adverb UK old-fashioned informal

He was the only person who understood all the arcane details of the agreement.  他是唯一能看懂协议中所有那些晦涩难懂的繁缛条文的人。
This argument may seem arcane to those not closely involved in the world of finance.  对于那些不谙金融界事务的人而言，这种观点如同天书。

Quails' eggs are considered to be a delicacy.  鹌鹑蛋被视为美味的佳肴。verb intransitive literary
Charlie quailed at the sound of his mother's angry voice.  查理听到他母亲愤怒的声音，心里不由得感到害怕。
She quailed before her boss's anger.  她在老板发怒前退缩了。

He erred in agreeing to her appointment.  他错在同意了对她的任命。UK UK US UK formal
Twenty-five people have replied to the invitation, but I've erred on the side of caution and put out 30 chairs.  25人回覆了邀请函，但为谨慎起见我准备了30把椅子。UK UK US UK formal

When he was 17 he took an overdose of sleeping pills and nearly died.  他17岁时吃了过量安眠药，险些丧命。
Jimi Hendrix died of a drug(s) overdose.  杰米‧亨德里克斯死于吸毒过量。
She overdosed on aspirin and died.  她服用了过量的阿斯匹灵致死。

words.meaning: n.(政党，宗教，事业的)叛教者，叛徒

words.example: There was a short skirmish between the political party leaders when the government announced it was to raise taxes.  政府宣布要增税时，政党领袖之间发生了短暂的争执。

The city has now returned to some semblance of normality after last night's celebrations.  昨晚的庆典过后，这座城市似乎恢复了平日的样子。
He was executed without even the semblance of a fair trial.  甚至连点像样的公正审判都没有，他就被处死了。

words.meaning: v.犯大错；笨拙地做；n.愚蠢之举
words.example:
He said that the tax was a major political blunder.  他称这项税收政策是一大政治错误。
Police blundered by not releasing more details about the case to focus public interest.  警方因没有提供更多的详细案情以引起公众关注而酿成了大错。

The bomb threat turned out to be a hoax.  那次炸弹恐吓结果发现是场恶作剧。
He'd made a hoax call claiming to be the President.  他搞了个恶作剧，打电话自称是总统。UK verb transitive

words.meaning: a.饱食的；塞满的，供应充足的
words.example:
After two helpings of dessert, Sergio was at last replete.  吃了两份甜点，塞尔吉奥终于饱了。
This car has an engine replete with the latest technology.  这辆车的引擎应用了最新技术。
You should slow down as you approach the junction.  接近交叉口时你应该减速。

words.meaning: a. 多刺的,痛苦的，困难的
words.example: the thorny issue of taxation  棘手的税收问题UK adjective

As we came into the arena, we were jostled by fans pushing their way towards the stage.  我们进入场内时，被涌向舞台的歌迷左推右撞。
Photographers jostled and shoved to get a better view of the royal couple.  一群摄影师互相推撞，以便更清楚地拍到这对王室夫妇。UK verb intransitive or transitive
Since the fall of the government, the two opposition parties have been jostling for position.  自从政府倒台以来，两个反对党一直在争权夺位。

words.meaning: v. 挑选，精选；n. 挑剩下的次品
words.example:
The plan to cull large numbers of baby seals has angered environmental groups.  选择性捕杀大量小海豹的计划引起了环保组织的强烈愤慨。verb transitive
Here are a few facts and figures I've culled from the week's papers.  这是我从这周的报纸上收集到的一些资料和资料。

He was busy paring apples in the kitchen.  他正忙着在厨房里削苹果。
Pare off any bits of the carrots that don't look very nice.  把胡萝卜看起来不太好的地方都削掉。
The three-hour play has been pared (down/back) to two hours.  这出三个小时的戏被缩短成两小时。UK verb transitive often + adverb or preposition

words.meaning: n.轮轴(连接两个车轮的轴)

words.example: He decided to become a clown to join the wacky world of the circus.  他决定做一个小丑，加入滑稽的马戏表演界。
Switzerland is a heterogeneous confederation of 26 self-governing cantons.  瑞士是一个由26个不同的自治州组成的联邦。    Compare homogeneous

words.meaning: n. 堆肥，淤泥；v. 施肥；捣乱
words.example:
You're treading muck into the carpet with your dirty shoes!  你的脏鞋子把地毯弄得脏兮兮的！
I'm not eating that muck!  我才不吃那让人反胃的东西！
The immigrants were treated like muck (= treated badly, as if they were not important).  移民都被视为泥土草芥。noun uncountable
You will receive annual salary / pay increments every September.  每年九月你会得到加薪。

words.meaning: v. 思考，思索；n. 混乱
words.example: mulled wine  烫热的葡萄酒verb transitive

My garden had become a veritable jungle by the time I came back from holiday.  我渡假回来的时候，我的花园简直是杂草丛生。
The normally sober menswear department is set to become a veritable kaleidoscope of colour this season.  色调通常都比较暗淡的男装部这一季将会成为名副其实的色彩万花筒。

He had a blood clot removed from his brain.  他颅内的一个血块被取了出来。UK noun countable
Look what you've done, you clot!  看看你做了甚么，笨蛋！UK verb intransitive (-tt-)
He was rushed into hospital because his blood wasn't clotting properly.  他被匆忙送进医院，因为他的血液不能正常凝结。

The storm/wind/rain has started to abate.  暴风雨／风／雨开始减弱了。
The fighting in the area shows no sign of abating.  这个地区的战事没有任何缓和的迹象。
His sexist attitude infuriates me.  他歧视女性的态度让我很生气。

words.meaning: v. 驱逐出国；脱离国籍
words.example: The new leaders expatriated the ruling family.  新的领导人把统治家族驱逐出境。
a nascent political party  新成立的政党
All she gave him to eat was two minuscule pieces of toast.  她只给他吃了两小片烤面包。

words.meaning: n. 夸耀性游行；嘹亮的喇叭声

words.example: molten glass/lava/lead  熔融的玻璃／岩浆／铅
an impromptu party/performance  临时晚会／即兴表演
Peru was colonized by the Spanish in the sixteenth century.  秘鲁在16世纪沦为西班牙的殖民地。

words.meaning: n. 遵守，奉行(法律、习俗)
words.example: Religious observances such as fasting can be hard to follow.  像斋戒这样的宗教习俗很难遵行。
We cannot deduce very much from these figures.  我们无法从这些数字中推断出太多东西。

words.meaning: n. 小刺；刺痛v. 刺伤；戳穿
words.example:
Prick the skin of the potatoes with a fork before baking them.  烤马铃薯前先用叉子在上面扎几个小孔。
She pricked the balloon with a pin and it burst with a loud bang.  她用别针在气球上扎了一下，气球砰的一声爆掉了。verb transitive
Dan's mentioning Julia pricked my conscience and I gave her a call.  丹提起茱莉亚，让我感到良心不安，我就打了个电话给她。verb transitive
They imposed a 5% levy on alcohol.  他们对酒品征收5%的税。
The whole incident started as an innocent caper.  整个事件以一场并无恶意的闹剧开始。UK noun
a station kiosk  车站售货亭

She pampers her dog with the finest steak and salmon.  她让她的狗吃上好的牛排和鲑鱼，太娇惯了。
Why not pamper yourself after a hard day with a hot bath scented with oils?  一天辛苦工作以后为甚么不善待一下自己，洗个散发着精油芳香的热水澡呢？
She's managed somehow to procure his telephone number.  她不知用了甚么方法，弄到了他的电话号码。
Most bats are nocturnal.  大部分蝙蝠在夜间活动。    Compare diurnal

words.meaning: n.活动的暂停，间歇；v.使平静
words.example:
The motion of the car almost lulled her to sleep.  汽车的颠簸让她昏昏欲睡。verb transitive
Most exercise classes start gently, lulling you into thinking that you're fit.  健身课程一开始大多都很容易，让人误以为自己很健康。
Their promises lulled us into a false sense of security (= made us feel safe, when in fact we were not).  他们的承诺让我们以为很安全。noun countable

words.meaning: n.半圆凿；v.(用利器或手从物体表面)挖出；骗钱，敲竹杠
words.example:
He drove into some railings and gouged a hole in the back of his car.  他开车撞到栏杆上，把车的后部撞了个大洞。verb transitive
In Shakespeare's play, 'King Lear', the Earl of Gloucester's eyes are gouged out.  莎士比亚的《李尔王》一剧中，格洛斯特伯爵的眼睛被挖了出来。noun countable

words.meaning: n.某人当时不在犯罪现场的申辩或证明
words.example:
He has a cast-iron (= very strong) alibi - he was in hospital the week of the murder.  他有不在犯罪现场的铁证——谋杀发生的那一周他在住院。
After eight years in power, the government can no longer use the previous government's policy as an alibi for its own failure.  本届政府已经执政八年，面对自己的失败，它再不能拿前任政府的政策作挡箭牌了。
If you don't know the answer, it's no good just waffling (on) for pages and pages.  假如你不知道答案，一页接一页地乱写也没用。UK noun
technical know-how  专业技能

The earthquake dislodged stones from the walls and the roof.  地震震落了墙壁和屋顶上的石头。
We need two wins to dislodge the French team from first place.  我们得赢两场比赛才能把法国队从第一的位置上挤下去。

words.meaning: a.耕种的，栽植的；有修养的
words.example: cultivated fields/soil/land  耕地

In his preface, the author says that he took eight years to write the book.  在前言中，作者说他写这本书花了八年。
We're hoping these talks could be a preface to peace.  我们希望这些会谈能拉开和平的序幕。verb transitive formal
Each work is prefaced by a descriptive note and concludes with an author's note.  每一篇作品都以说明性文字作开端，以作者自己的批注为结尾。
Don't be so impulsive - think before you act.  不要如此冲动——要三思而后行。

The sunglasses are now available in major stores, a snip at £12 a pair.  目前大商店里都有这样的太阳眼镜，每副12英镑，很便宜。

I'm not prepared to give credence to anonymous complaints.  我不会相信那些匿名投诉。
His bruises added/lent credence to his statement that he had been beaten.  他的瘀伤证实了自己被打的说法。

They stood gaping at the pig in the kitchen.  他们站在那里目瞪口呆地看着厨房里的那头猪。verb intransitive
Peter's jacket gaped at the seams.  彼得的夹克衫开了线，裂了一个缝。

Radical remarks like this amount to heresy for most members of the Republican party.  像这样的激进言论对于大多数共和党人来说相当于异端邪说。

words.meaning: n.没精打采的样子；v.没精打采地坐(站、走)
words.example:
Straighten your back - try not to slouch.  挺直后背——别没精打采的。
He's developed a slouch from leaning over his books all day.  他整天低着头看书，逐渐形成了一副弯腰弓背的样子。noun
She's no slouch when it comes to organizing parties.  安排派对她可是一把好手。
There is a multiplicity of fashion magazines to choose from.  有多种时尚杂志可供选择。
All that make-up she wears actually detracts from her beauty, I think.  我认为她的那种化妆效果实际上有损她的美。

words.meaning: n.（没价值的）外壳；(种子、果实的)外壳、皮、荚
v.改正，调正；提纯(尤指蒸馏)
words.example: Every effort is made to rectify any errors/mistakes before the book is printed.  在书付印前会尽力去审校修改书中的错误。verb transitive

words.meaning: v. 喘息，发出呼哧呼哧的声音
words.example:
As a part of their latest marketing wheeze they've planted fifty-pound notes in a number of the crisp packets.  作为最新的市场行销手段的一部分，他们将50英镑的钞票放进了一些炸薯片的包装里。

words.meaning: n.(答案有双关意义的)谜语；难题
words.example: Arranging childcare over the school holidays can be quite a conundrum for working parents.  对双职工家长来说，学校放假期间如何安排照顾孩子是个大难题。

Compared with modern satellite dishes, ordinary TV aerials look positively antiquated.  和现代卫星电视碟形天线相比，普通的电视天线无疑是太过时了。

The birds learn to peck holes in the foil milk bottle tops.  鸟儿学习在牛奶瓶的箔纸盖上啄洞。
Geese were pecking around for food.  鹅在地上四处啄食。
Chickens pecked at the seeds which covered the ground.  小鸡啄食着撒在地上的种子。

Many parts of an aircraft are riveted together.  飞机很多部件都是铆接在一起的。
It was an amazing film - I was absolutely riveted.  那部电影太精彩了——我完全被它吸引住了。
His eyes were riveted on the television.  他双眼紧盯着电视看。

She seemed rather aloof when in fact she was just shy.  她看似孤傲不群，可实际上只是腼腆。
Whatever is happening in the office, she always remains aloof.  不管办公室发生了甚么事，她都一概不闻不问。
She kept herself aloof from her husband's business.  她对丈夫的事情漠不关心。

In the fading light we saw bats flitting around/about in the garden.  天色渐暗时，我们看到蝙蝠在花园里飞来飞去。
figurative Sara finds it very difficult to settle - she's always flitting from one thing to another (= changing her activities).  莎拉觉得很难定下来做甚么事——她总是一会儿做这个，一会儿做那个。
Her gentle words were a balm to me.  她温柔的话语给了我极大的安慰。

words.meaning: a. 热诚的；n. 兴奋剂
words.example:

words.meaning: n.理想国，理想的完美境界

words.example: He opened a newspaper and began to peruse the personal ads.  他翻开一份报纸，开始浏览征婚启事。

He was described by his colleagues as a painstaking journalist.  同事都把他描述成一名认真而严谨的记者。

We can't afford to become complacent about any of our products.  我们不能对自己的任何一款产品沾沾自喜。

The villagers were very hospitable to/towards anyone who passed through.  村民们对所有过路人都非常热情友好。    Opposite inhospitable

The young men had nothing better to do than brawl in the streets.  这些年轻人除了在大街上打架殴斗做不出甚么好事。
Students are expected to be quiet and obedient in the classroom.  学生们在课堂上应该安静听话。
She is a virulent critic of US foreign policy.  她是美国外交政策尖刻的批评者。
subterranean passages  地下通道
a flamboyant style of choreography  华彩绚丽的舞蹈设计风格

Do not forsake me!  不要抛弃我！UK US  (forsook, forsaken)

The streets were seething (= busy and crowded) with tourists.  街道上游客摩肩接踵。

Her breath reeked of garlic.  她一吐气就有一股难闻的大蒜味。 informal

words.meaning: n. 野蛮人；adj. 粗鲁的

She won the Grammy Award for Best Female Vocalist.  她赢得了葛莱美最佳女歌手奖。
The President's official visit marks the start of a more fraternal relationship between the two countries.  总统的正式访问标志着两国间开始建立起一种更加亲密友好的关系。

words.meaning: a.无条件的，绝对的；分类的
