Any attempt to influence the judges will be seen as an infraction of the rules.  任何影响法官执法的企图都将被看作是违法行为。

words.meaning: a.有适应能力的；可改编的
words.example: The survivors in this life seem to be those who are adaptable to change.  能在这种生活状态下幸存的人好像都是那些可以适应变化的人。
Shortly before the crash the pilot had reported a malfunction of the aircraft's navigation system.  就在飞机坠毁前不久，飞行员曾报告说导航系统失灵。
She had no qualms about lying to the police.  她向警方说谎但一点也不觉得心虚。
My squad were on sentry duty last night.  我的班昨天晚上在站哨。

Her movements were deft and quick.  她的动作灵巧敏捷。
She answered the journalist's questions with a deft touch.  她巧妙地回答了记者的提问。
He's very deft at handling awkward situations.  他善于处理尴尬的局面。
Criminal gangs are terrorizing the city with apparent impunity.  犯罪集团使市民人心惶惶却显然没有受到惩罚。

words.meaning: v.(因寒冷或害怕)畏缩，蜷缩
words.example: Stop cowering! I'm not going to hit you.  别往后缩了！我不会打你的。

words.meaning: v.(贬)自鸣得意地走，大摇大摆地走
words.example:
They swaggered into the room.  他们大摇大摆地走进了房间。
His swaggering self-confidence irritates many people.  他趾高气昂的自负神态激怒了很多人。UK noun [S or U]
He walked out of the room with a self-confident swagger.  他大摇大摆、趾高气昂地走出房间。
She was reprimanded by her teacher for biting another girl.  她因为咬了另一个女孩而受到了老师的训斥。

words.meaning: a.惟利是图的，只为金钱的；n.雇佣兵
words.example: He had some mercenary scheme to marry a wealthy widow.  他有个敛财的诡计，想娶个有钱的寡妇。UK noun countable
Police corralled most of the demonstrators in a small area near the station.  警方把大多数示威者控制在车站附近的一小片区域。

They infringed building regulations.  他们违反了建筑规章。 formal
These restrictions infringe upon basic human rights.  这些限制侵犯了基本人权。

The town had been besieged for two months but still resisted the aggressors.  这座城镇虽然已被围困了两个月，但仍然能把侵略者拒之城外。
When the pop star tried to leave her hotel she was besieged by waiting journalists and fans.  那名流行歌星试图离开饭店时，被一群在外等候的记者和歌迷围住了。
After showing the controversial film, the television company was besieged with phone calls from angry viewers.  电视台播放了一出具争议性的电影后，就不断收到愤怒的观众的电话和来信。

After having five children, she decided to be sterilized.  生了五个孩子之后，她决定去做结扎手术。(UK usually sterilise) ['ster.ɪ.laɪz]
All equipment must be sterilized before use.  所有设备使用前都要消毒。
The American government classifies both asbestos and environmental tobacco smoke as class one carcinogens.  美国政府将石棉和环境中的香烟烟雾列为第一类致癌物。
He was eavesdropping on our conversation.  他在偷听我们谈话。
luscious ripe figs  香甜的熟无花果adjective

She went into a hypnotic trance.  她进入了催眠状态。
The beat of the music was strangely hypnotic.  这种音乐的节奏有种奇怪的催眠作用。
The man was described as short and stocky and very strong.  据描述，那个男人矮个子，结实粗壮。    Compare sturdy
He sauntered by , looking very pleased with himself.  他悠闲漫步，怡然自得。

They promised that individuals could live freely without fear of reprisal from the military.  他们承诺说，人们可以自由生活，不必担心军方的报复。
The attack was in reprisal for the kidnapping of their leaders.  这次袭击是对他们领导人被绑架的报复。

People are put off by his strident voice.  人们很厌恶他那刺耳的嗓音。adjective
They are becoming increasingly strident in their criticism of government economic policy.  他们对政府经济政策的抨击越来越猛烈。
The government will be the final arbiter in the dispute over the new road.  政府将对新建道路引发的争端作出最终裁决。
an adobe house  土坯房

He really enjoys puttering around in the garden.  他非常喜欢在花园里四处闲逛。UK verb
He's a good putter.  他是一名优秀的轻击手。UK noun

He could feel his strength ebbing (away).  他能感觉到自己逐渐体力不支。noun
We'll sail on the ebb.  我们将在退潮时启航。noun
Consumer confidence is currently at a low ebb.  目前人们对消费的信心降到了谷底。

words.meaning: n.页岩(一种由似泥土细粒的沉淀物层组成的易分裂的岩石)

words.example:
Through the window came the last few oblique rays of evening sunshine.  最后几束余晖透过窗口斜射进来。
He gave her an oblique glance.  他斜了她一眼。
She made several oblique references to the current financial situation.  她好几次拐弯抹角地提及目前的财务状况。UK noun countable (also o_blique ^stroke)    UK for

She looked a forlorn figure standing at the bus stop.  她站在公车站，看上去孤苦伶仃。UK adjective
Their only hope now is that the outside world will intervene but it is an increasingly forlorn hope.  他们现在唯一的希望是外界会介入，但是这一希望也越来越渺茫。
She appeared on daytime TV in a forlorn attempt to persuade the public of her innocence.  她在日间电视节目中露面，枉然地想说服公众相信她的清白。
The report exonerated the crew from all responsibility for the collision.  报告证明机组人员对飞机相撞事件不负任何责任。

The bee turns nectar into honey.  蜜蜂把花蜜转化为蜂蜜。
This wine tastes like nectar (= tastes excellent).  这酒饮来就似琼浆玉液。
After the accident he suffered periods of amnesia.  那次意外后的一段时间，他患了失忆症。

words.meaning: n./v. (猪等)在泥水中打滚；沉溺于
words.example: My idea of a holiday is to book myself into a five-star hotel and just wallow in the luxury for a week.  我心目中的假期是预订一家五星级的饭店，纵情享受奢华的一周。
The terms 'drinking problem' and 'alcohol abuse' are often interchangeable.  drinking problem 和 alcohol abuse 两个术语往往可以互换使用。

words.meaning: n.浮雕宝石；生动刻画；(演员)出演
words.example: a cameo brooch  浮雕宝石胸针

The demonstrators rampaged through the town, smashing windows and setting fire to cars.  示威者们横冲直撞穿过城镇，沿途砸坏窗户、烧毁车辆。
Several villages were destroyed by rampaging soldiers.  好几个村子被狂暴撒野的士兵捣毁。noun countable or uncountable /ˈræm.peɪdʒ/
Rioters went on a/the rampage through the city.  暴乱分子在城中横冲直撞，胡作非为。
The children scampered off into the garden.  孩子们蹦蹦跳跳着跑出去进了花园。
Her hair was a dingy brown colour.  她的头发呈现出一种脏兮兮的棕黑色。
gaudy plastic flowers  俗丽的塑胶假花

words.meaning: n.犁沟(用犁耕作后地上留下的沟)；皱纹
words.example:
Years of anxiety have lined her brow with deep furrows.  多年的焦虑在她的额头上留下了深深的皱纹。UK verb transitive
The wheels of the heavy tractor furrowed the soft ground.  重型拖拉机的轮子在柔软的土地上压出了车辙。
The pain of the headache made him furrow his brow (= make lines in the skin above his eyes).  头痛使他眉头紧锁。

These recently published figures bode ill /do not bode well for the company's future.  最近公布的数字预示着公司的前景不妙。
The hurricane bodes disaster for those areas in its path.  飓风预示着将给所经过的地区带来灾难。

Saliva is a liquid secreted by glands in or near the mouth.  唾液是由嘴中或嘴部周围的腺体分泌的一种液体。verb transitive
He was arrested at the airport with a kilo of heroin secreted in his clothing.  他在机场被捕时衣服里藏了一公斤海洛因。
She issued a point-by-point rebuttal of the company's accusations.  她就公司的指控进行了针锋相对的驳斥。

words.meaning: v.使固定，使不变；注视，凝视

words.example: Dan won't be in college next year - he flunked out.  丹明年不会上大学——他成绩不好退学了。

words.meaning: a.枯黄色的；单调而无聊的
words.example: She walked through the city centre with its drab, grey buildings and felt depressed.  走过市中心那些单调的灰色建筑物，她心里感觉很压抑。
You shouldn't denigrate people just because they have different beliefs from you.  你不要只是因为信仰不同而贬低他人。

It 's really hot and stuffy in here - let's open the window.  这里又热又闷——我们打开窗户吧。
The bedroom gets a bit stuffy in the summer.  这个房间在夏天有点闷。 disapproving
Sir William had the ability to conduct proceedings in a dignified manner without ever becoming stuffy.  威廉爵士能够以庄重但毫不刻板的方式主持会议。

words.meaning: v. 用猛烈的拉、扭的动作取得；夺取
words.example:
The shareholders are planning to wrest control of the company (away) from the current directors.  股东正在计划从现任董事手中夺取公司的控制权。
He wrested the letter from my grasp.  他从我手中夺走了那封信。
The company expects to resume production of the vehicle again after a two-month hiatus.  该公司希望在中断两个月之后恢复生产这种车。

words.meaning: n.(物品)归还原主；(对损害的)赔偿
words.example:
They are demanding the restitution of ancient treasures that were removed from the country in the 16th century.  他们现在正在要求归还16世纪从他们国家运走的古代珍贵文物。
The chemicals company promised to make full restitution to the victims for the injury to their health.  化学制品公司承诺，对所有健康受到损害的受害者予以全额赔偿。

An old sailor sat on the dockside, whittling a toy boat.  一名老水手坐在码头边，用木头削制一只玩具船。UK verb transitive
We had eighty applicants for the job, but we've whittled them down to six.  这个职位我们有80位申请者，我们已经将其筛减到了六位。

words.meaning: n.淡色；色泽(颜色深淡的程度)；v.给„淡淡地着色
words.example:
The paint we're using for the bathroom is white with a yellow tint.  我们刷浴室的涂料是白色的，但有点偏黄。
The evening sky was deep pink, with tints of purple and red in it.  傍晚的天空呈深粉红色，夹杂着淡淡的紫色和红色。
She's had blonde tints put in her hair.  她把头发染成淡淡的金黄色。

Her cancer has been in remission for several years.  她的癌症几年来有所缓解。noun
He was given three months' remission for good behaviour.  他因为表现良好而减刑三个月。noun
He believes that redemption is based on remission of sins.  他相信救赎的基础是对罪恶的宽恕。

She is slim and shy - the very antithesis of her sister.  她身材苗条，性格腼腆，正好和她姐姐相反。
He is the exact antithesis of what I find attractive in men.  我认为男性应有的魅力他一点都没有。
Thanks to the collapse of communism the political antithesis between Left and Right is less important.  由于共产主义瓦解，左翼和右翼的对立显得不那么重要了。

'Senior citizen' is a euphemism for 'old person'.  “年长公民”是“老年人”的委婉说法
The article made so much use of euphemism that often its meaning was unclear.  这篇文章用了太多的委婉语，以至于意思常常不甚明了。
He enumerated the benefits of the insurance scheme.  他列出了这项保险方案的种种益处。
The developers refurbished the house inside and out.  开发商把这座房子里外翻修一新。

words.meaning: n.(做篱笆或爬藤架等的)格子架

words.example:
Iron spikes have been welded (on) to the railings around the embassy.  大使馆周围的护栏上都焊上了铁刺尖头。verb transitive
He is a born leader, who welded a collection of gifted individualists into a real team.  他是个天生的领袖，把一群有才华的个人组成一支真正的团队。noun countable

words.meaning: a.兴高采烈的，情绪高昂的
words.example: The prince was reported to be elated at/by the birth of his daughter.  据报道，王子喜得千金。
a compliant child  听话的孩子
a news/sports presenter  新闻／体育节目主持人
Her refusal to answer was tantamount to an admission of guilt.  她拒绝回答等于是认罪。
His arrival cast a blight on the wedding day.  他的到来破坏了大喜之日的气氛。verb transitive

Will you two stop bickering!  你们两个不要吵了！
They're always bickering with each other about/over their personal problems.  他们总是为个人问题而争吵。

Our golf club is run by a very unfriendly clique (of people).  我们的高尔夫球俱乐部是由一小撮很不友好、极其排外的家伙管理的。
There's a clique at work that never talks/who never talk to anyone else.  公司里有个小圈子，他们从来不和其他人说话。

words.meaning: a.微温的，不冷不热的；不热心的
words.example:
This coffee's lukewarm.  这杯咖啡不热。UK adjective
Her proposals got a lukewarm response.  大家对她的建议反应冷淡。

The whole relationship obsessed me for years.  这一关系多年来一直困扰着我。
She used to obsess about her weight.  她过去总是过分在意自己的体重。
an offbeat sense of humour  不落俗套的幽默感

You can read all the lurid details of the affair in today's paper.  今天的报纸上对这件事骇人听闻的细节描写得淋漓尽致。UK US  disapproving
That's a very lurid shade of lipstick she's wearing.  她口红抹得太艳了。
a disinterested observer/judgment  公正的观察员／判断
Reluctantly, he acquiesced to/in the plans.  虽然很不情愿，他还是默认了这个计划。
kinetic energy  动能

We saw rioters pelting police with bricks and bottles.  我们看见暴动分子向员警投掷砖头和瓶子。verb
The children pelted down the bank, over the bridge and along the path.  那些孩子冲下河堤，穿过大桥，沿着小路飞奔。verb
It 's pelting down (with rain).  正下着倾盆大雨。noun
The flowers were drooping in the heat.  花朵在热浪中垂下了头。
an outlandish hairstyle/outfit  古怪的发型／装束
He gave a satanic smile.  他露出了邪恶的笑容。

I'll have a Scotch (= a glass of Scotch).  我要一杯苏格兰威士卡。
Her remarks were intended to scotch rumours of an imminent election date.  她的话意在制止即将举行选举的谣言。

This is his centennial year and he's been granted the ultimate accolade - his face on a set of three postage stamps.  今年是他一百周年纪念，人们给予了他最高的荣誉——他的肖像被印在一套三张的邮票上。
Her approval was the highest accolade he could have received.  她的嘉许就是他所能得到的最高赞赏。

words.meaning: n.孵卵器；早产婴儿保育箱

words.example:
She recast her novel as a musical comedy.  她把自己的小说改编为一个音乐喜剧。
In despair, the theatre director recast the leading role.  无可奈何之下，戏剧导演更换了主角。

Soldiers from many different countries have been subsumed into the United Nations peace-keeping force.  联合国维和部队吸纳来自许多不同国家的士兵。
All the statistics have been subsumed under the general heading 'Facts and Figures'.  所有统计数据都被归入“事实和数据”这一笼统标题下。

words.meaning: a.表达清楚的，明白易懂的
words.example:
She gave a clear and lucid account of her plans for the company's future.  她清楚明了地讲述了自己对公司未来的规划。
The drugs she's taking make her drowsy and confused, but there are times when she's quite lucid.  她吃的药会让她感到头晕、意识模糊，但有时头脑却很清醒。
His forthright manner can be mistaken for rudeness.  他率直的态度可能会被误认为无礼。
Blackbirds' eggs are pale blue with brown flecks on them.  画眉的蛋呈淡蓝色，上面有褐色斑点。

Polyurethane varnish provides a tough, scratch-resistant finish.  聚胺酯罩光漆可以形成一层坚硬防划的表面。
The varnish had been deliberately scratched.  清漆层被故意刮花了。UK verb transitive
They decided to spend the weekend varnishing their boat.  他们决定用周末的时间给他们的船上清漆。

words.meaning: a. 施虐狂的，性施虐狂的

words.example:
Some moron smashed into the back of my car yesterday.  昨天一个笨蛋撞毁了我的车尾。
[as form of address] You moron!  你这个笨蛋！
a heinous crime  令人发指的罪行

She spurned my offers of help.  她断然拒绝了我的帮助。
Ellis plays the part of the young lover spurned by his mistress.  艾理斯扮演被情妇抛弃的年轻人。
People need to be protected against such unwarranted intrusions into their private lives by journalists.  人们的私生活需要受到保护，免受新闻记者的无理侵犯。

The first trial ended in a hung jury, the second in acquittal.  第一次审判因为陪审团意见不一致而未能作出裁定，第二次审判以宣判无罪告终。
Of the three cases that went to trial, two ended in acquittals.  付诸庭审的三个案件中，有两个最终作出无罪判决。

Paul Simon writes the lyrics for most of his songs.  保罗‧赛门的歌大多都是他自己写的词。
William Wordsworth wrote lyric poetry/was a lyric poet.  威廉‧华兹华斯创作抒情诗／是一位抒情诗人。

It's not good the way she panders to his every whim.  她迎合他各种怪念头的做法是不好的。
Political leaders almost inevitably pander to big business.  政治领袖几乎都不可避免地要讨好大企业。

words.meaning: a.惆怅的，渴望的(尤指对过去的或不可得之物)
words.example: a wistful smile  向往的微笑

The floor was covered in filth.  地板上满是污渍。noun uncountable
People complain about the filth on TV and in the press.  人们抱怨电视上和报刊中充斥着肮脏淫秽的东西。

He swore he would avenge his brother's death.  他发誓要报杀兄之仇。
She determined to avenge her self on the killer.  她决心要让凶手血债血偿。
At the end of the film, the murderer is killed by his victim's avenging girlfriend.  电影的最后，受害者的女友终于报仇雪恨，杀死了凶手。
He was a poet, an anarchist and a vegan.  他是个诗人、无政府主义者及严格的素食主义者。
a swarm of locusts  一大群蝗虫

words.meaning: a. 全景的，全貌的，概论的

words.example: mottled skin  有斑点的皮肤
coal tongs  火钳
Most shops are ignoring the government's edict against Sunday trading.  大多数商店对政府禁止星期天营业的法令都置之不理。

words.meaning: a. 令人恶心的；充满疑虑的
words.example: Just the thought of blood makes me queasy.  一想到血我就想吐。

words.meaning: a. 平淡无奇的；乡巴佬的
words.example: corny jokes  老掉牙的笑话

words.meaning: a.（液体、气体）不能渗透的；不为所动的
words.example:
How does glue bond with impervious substances like glass and metal?  胶水黏玻璃和金属之类不透水物质的效果如何？UK adjective
He is impervious to criticism and rational argument.  他对批评和说理都无动于衷。
She threatened to sue the magazine for libel.  她威胁说要起诉该杂志诽谤。    Compare slander
a close confidant  亲密知己
The governor exhorted the prisoners not to riot.  狱长告诫犯人不要骚乱。

Cork is light and buoyant.  软木质轻，可浮在水上。adjective
After reading the letter he was in a buoyant mood.  读了信后，他高兴得快要飘起来了。adjective
The housing market remains buoyant.  房屋市场依然是有赚头的。
The game was much enlivened when both teams scored within five minutes of each other.  两支球队在五分钟之内都攻破对方球门，这使得比赛更加有趣了。
a radioactive isotope of hydrogen  氢的放射性同位素
They died from inhaling noxious fumes.  他们吸入有毒烟雾致死。

words.meaning: n. 枢轴，中心；v. 旋转
words.example: The former guerrilla leader has become the pivot on which the country's emerging political stability turns/revolves (= it depends on him).  前游击队领袖成了决定该国的政治局势能否继续稳定下去的关键人物。
The old man drew a long gnarled finger across his throat.  老人伸出一根扭曲变形的长手指摸了一下喉咙。

What the government is proposing encroaches on the rights of individuals.  政府打算做的这件事侵犯了个人的权利。
They have promised that the development will not encroach on public land.  他们已经承诺这项开发不会侵占公共土地。    encroachment
The new censorship laws are serious encroachments on freedom of expression.  新的审查法是对言论自由的严重侵犯。
an ethereal being  精灵

You filthy swine!  你这个无耻下流的色鬼！
Her ex-husband sounds like an absolute swine.  她的前夫说起话来简直就像个不折不扣的下流痞子。noun countable

Couldn't you contrive a meeting between them? I think they'd be ideally suited.  你不能为他们安排一次会面吗？我想他们俩会挺配的。
Do you think you could contrive something for hanging my clothes on until I can get a wardrobe?  你能设计个东西让我在买到衣柜前挂衣服吗？
a team of intrepid explorers  一队无畏的探险者
His accountant had aided and abetted him in the fraud.  他的会计师与他合谋诈骗。
The gaily striped awnings of the little shops and market stalls made an attractive scene.  小店铺前和货摊上那些色彩鲜艳的条纹布遮阴篷构成了一个迷人的风景。
Her actions were quite justifiable in the circumstances.  在那种情况下，她的行为是正当的。
a street urchin  街头顽童
The 55-year-old Canadian had suffered a grisly death.  这位55岁的加拿大人死得很惨。

He was declared ineligible for the competition because he worked for the company that ran it.  他被宣布没有资格参赛，因为他是该比赛主办公司的工作人员。
Many people became ineligible to receive state aid because their earnings were above the new limit.  许多人失掉了领取政府救济金的资格，因为他们的收入超过了新制定的限额。

words.meaning: n. (作为胜利标志的)花环，奖品
words.example: They garlanded the visitors with scented flowers.  他们为来访者戴上芬芳的花环。
His death was caused by a blockage in one of his arteries.  他死于动脉阻塞。
a schematic diagram/outline  图解／提纲
The children were vaccinated against the major childhood diseases.  孩子们接种了预防主要儿童疾病的疫苗。
musty old books  发霉的旧书

humorous The phantom wine-drinker has been around - this was almost a full bottle when I put it in the fridge (= an unknown person has been drinking the wine) !  附近一定有嗜酒幽灵出没——我把酒放进冰箱时还几乎是满满的一瓶！UK adjective [before noun]
Although she had to have her leg amputated, she still feels as though she's got a phantom limb.  尽管不得已把一条腿截去了，但她仍觉得自己仿佛有条虚幻的腿。
They discovered it was a phantom organization set up for the processing of drug profits.  他们发现这只是一个遮人耳目、处理毒品利润的组织。
We need to avoid long-stay patients in the hospital becoming institutionalized.  我们要避免使长期住院的病人自理能力减弱。
Which novels are on the syllabus this year?  今年的课程大纲里列了哪些小说?    Compare curriculum

words.meaning: n.犬儒主义者，愤世嫉俗者
words.example: I'm too much of a cynic to believe that he'll keep his promise.  我怀疑这世间的一切，不相信他会遵守诺言。
I've got a phobia about/of worms.  我很怕蠕虫。
humorous I think this kettle is defunct!  我看这个水壶已经不能使用了！

They claim it is a symptom of a deeper and more general malaise in society.  他们声称这表明了社会中人们更深层更广泛的不满。
We were discussing the roots of the current economic malaise.  我们在讨论当前经济萎靡不振的根源。

All my children were fussy eaters.  我所有的孩子都挑食。
He's so fussy about the house - everything has to be absolutely perfect.  他对房子太挑剔了——所有东西都必须绝对完美。
They've got those curtains that tie up with big bows - they're a bit fussy for my taste.  他们那些窗帘都打着大蝴蝶结——在我看来装饰得有点花哨。adjective disapproving

Her face was gaunt and grey.  她瘦削的脸面如死灰。
The house looked gaunt and unwelcoming.  这座房子看上去很荒凉，令人望而却步。

words.meaning: v.胡言乱语；牙牙学语；喋喋不休
words.example:
The children babbled excitedly among themselves.  孩子们聚在一起，兴奋地说个没完没了。
She was babbling something about her ring being stolen.  她含糊不清地说着话，好像是说她的戒指被人偷了。verb
They rested a while by a babbling brook.  他们在潺潺作响的小溪边休息了一会儿。noun uncountable
the onerous task of finding a peaceful solution  寻找和平解决方案的艰巨任务
He was annihilated in the finals of the competition.  在比赛的决赛中，他被打了个落花流水。

words.meaning: a.擦拭不掉的，不可磨灭的
words.example:
The blood had left an indelible mark on her shirt.  她衬衫上留下的血迹洗不掉。
In his twenty years working for the company, Joe Pearson made an indelible impression on it.  在为公司工作的20年中，乔‧皮尔逊给公司留下了难以磨灭的印象。
The tax increases proved to be the President's political nemesis at the following election.  提高税收令总统在接下来的选举中自食恶果。
an exacting training schedule  安排紧张的训练进度表

words.meaning: n.齐发，群射；v.齐发，群射；(足球、网球)截击
words.example:
Even as the funeral took place, guerrillas hidden nearby fired/let off a fresh volley of machine-gun fire.  甚至在葬礼举行过程时，埋伏在附近的游击队又进行了一轮机枪扫射。UK noun
I'm afraid my proposal was met with a volley of criticisms.  恐怕我的提议遭到了众人的齐声批评。UK noun
That was a marvellous backhand volley.  那是一记漂亮的反手截击球。UK verb intransitive or transitive

Like so many politicians, he had an insatiable appetite/desire/hunger for power.  和许多政客一样，他对权力贪得无厌。
Nothing, it seemed, would satisfy his insatiable curiosity.  似乎甚么都无法满足他那无尽的好奇心。

At some point we've got to discuss money but I don't know quite how to broach the subject with him.  有时我们必须谈到钱，但我不知道如何向他提这个问题。UK verb transitive
Shall we broach another cask of wine?  我们再开桶葡萄酒喝好吗？UK noun countable    US for
She recorded her first CD at the precocious age of 12.  她在12岁这么小的年纪就录制了自己的第一张雷射唱片。

words.meaning: n. 突然升官的人，暴发户
a. 邋遢的；格调低下的
words.example: This part of town is full of sleazy bars and restaurants.  镇上这个地区满是乌烟瘴气的酒吧和餐厅。

words.meaning: a.未受损伤的，未遭伤害的
words.example: Her husband died in the accident but she, amazingly, escaped unscathed.  她丈夫在那次事故中丧命，但她竟奇迹地毫发未损。

words.meaning: v. 喷出；滔滔不绝地讲
words.example:
He spouts a load of pretentious nonsense and people are stupid enough to believe him!  他滔滔不绝地胡乱吹嘘了一通，人们竟然愚蠢得相信他！
Flames spouted (out) from the oil wells.  油井中喷出了火焰。
The gash was spouting blood.  伤口血如泉涌。noun countable

words.meaning: a.令人不安的，扰乱的，使窘困的
words.example: One of the film's many unsettling images is of a child playing with her father's gun.  电影中有很多令人不安的镜头，其中之一是一个小女孩在摆弄父亲的枪。

words.meaning: n. 瓶颈口，(喻)交通易阻塞的狭口
words.example:
Roadworks are causing bottlenecks in the city centre.  道路施工导致市中心交通阻塞。
Is there any way of getting round this bureaucratic bottleneck?  有办法避开这种拖拉推诿的官僚作风吗？

Her parents eventually relented and let her go to the party.  她父母的态度最后缓和了下来，让她去参加派对。
The security guard relented and let them through.  保安最后同意了，给他们放了行。

words.meaning: n. 摄政者(代国王统治者)

words.example: The match ended in disappointment for the retiring captain, Viv Richards.  这场比赛的结果令即将退役的球队队长维夫．理查兹很失望。

He bartered his stamp collection for her comics.  他用他收集的邮票，换取她的漫画。
We spent a whole hour bartering with stallholders for souvenirs.  我们花了整整一个小时与摊贩交换纪念品。UK noun uncountable
The currency has lost so much of its value that barter has become the preferred way of doing business.  货币眨值如此严重，这样以物易物成了做生意的首选。
The powers of local councils are being usurped by central government.  地方市政会的权力被中央政府攫取了。

I'm trying to learn to drive, but I'm not making much headway (with it).  我想学开车，可是进步缓慢。
Little headway has been made so far in the negotiations.  谈判至今未有所进展。

The goods have been consigned to you by air.  货物已经空运给你了。 formal
After the financial disaster, she was consigned to a life of poverty.  金融危机之后，她的生活陷于贫困。
He shook the warmly proffered hand.  他握了握对方热情伸出的手。

Her voluminous silk dress billowed out behind her.  她穿的那条宽松的丝绸长裙在身后鼓起来了。
Have you read McClelland's voluminous account of his life?  你读过麦克莱兰的长篇自传吗？

words.meaning: n.暗示，迹象；略知，模糊概念
words.example: He must have had some inkling of what was happening.  他当时对发生的事一定有所了解。

words.meaning: a.(褒)忠实的；不变的，坚定的
words.example: The group remained steadfast in its support for the new system, even when it was criticized in the newspapers.  这个团体始终坚定不移地支持新体制，即使遭到报纸批评的时候也毫不动摇。
The United Nations was reluctant to get its forces embroiled in civil war.  联合国不愿让其维和部队卷入国家的内战中。
She's not known for her altruism.  她并不是一个无私的人。

Sadly, my feelings for him were not reciprocated.  很不幸，我为他付出的感情没有得到回报。
We invited them to dinner and a week later they reciprocated.  我们请他们吃晚餐，一星期后他们回请了我们。
Some electric razors have reciprocating heads.  有些电动剃须刀的刀头是往返运动式的。

words.meaning: a.(批评，嘲笑等)苛刻的，严厉的
words.example: He was very scathing about the report, saying it was inaccurate.  他严厉批评了这份报告，说它不够正确。

words.meaning: a. 充满热情的，深情的
words.example: The dog looked at me with its big soulful brown eyes.  那只狗睁着它那棕色的大眼睛，深情地看着我。UK adjective
I've had two job offers, and I'm in a real quandary about/over which one to accept.  我有两个工作机会，但不知该接受哪个，真是左右为难。

words.meaning: n. 处于停顿状态，中止
words.example:
The runaway bus eventually came to a standstill when it rolled into a muddy field.  失控的大巴士驶入了泥泞的田里，最后停了下来。
Fighting and shortages have brought normal life to a virtual standstill in the city.  战火和物资短缺使这座城市的日常生活濒临瘫痪。

words.meaning: n.蒙太奇(由许多部分组合而成的画面、影片、音乐或文字)；拼集画
words.example: The ads feature a montage of images - people surfing, playing football and basketball.  这些广告是一组剪辑在一起的影像——人们在冲浪、踢足球和打篮球。
a charming, lopsided grin  迷人的撇嘴一笑
a congenital abnormality/disease  先天性畸形／疾病
The United States is the archetype of a federal society.  美国是典型的联邦制社会。
a nifty piece of work/footwork  杰作／干净俐落的步法
We view future developments with some trepidation.  我们对未来的发展动态感到惴惴不安。

We hunkered down round the campfire, toasting marshmallows.  我们蹲在营火旁烤棉花糖。
The press have hunkered down for the night outside the palace, waiting for news of the royal birth.  媒体在王宫外守候了一夜，等候王室添丁的消息。
a morbid fascination with death  对死亡的病态迷恋
In our search for evidence, we were stymied by the absence of any recent documents.  缺乏近期的档为我们搜证造成障碍。

Are you in the queue for tickets?  你是在排队买票吗?
There was a long queue of traffic stretching down the road.  车辆在这条路上排起长龙了。
If you want tickets you'll have to join the queue.  你想买票的话就要先排队。
figurative Sharp cuts in interest rates have failed to bring the economy out of its slumber.  大幅降低利率并没有使经济复苏。UK US literary
The prisoners ate every last morsel.  囚犯把最后一丁点食物都吃个干净。

We tied the boat up in a quiet backwater overnight.  我们在一个静水处把船系好后过夜。
He grew up in a rural backwater.  他在落后的乡村长大。    Compare jerkwater
He was punished for his hubris.  他因为自大而受到惩罚。
He's a hypocrite - he's always lecturing other people on the environment but he drives around in a huge great car.  他是个伪君子——他总教导别人要保护环境，但他自己却到处开着一辆废气排量很大的汽车。
a Christmas bazaar  圣诞义卖

What are you insinuating, Daniel?  丹尼尔，你究竟在影射甚么？verb transitive
Over the years she insinuated herself into the great man's life.  这些年来她费尽心机一步步地走进了这位伟人的生活。
the royal insignia  君王标志

The government will instigate new measures to combat terrorism.  政府将采取新措施打击恐怖主义。
The revolt in the north is believed to have been instigated by a high-ranking general.  北方的叛乱据信是由一名高级将领唆使的。

He gave me directions to his house, but I found them utterly bewildering.  他告诉我到他家的路，但我发现他指的路让人完全摸不着头绪。
The college offers a bewildering range of courses.  学院开设了一大堆令人眼花缭乱的课程。
a cursory glance/look  匆匆一瞥

The committee is a mere appendage of the council and has no power of its own.  这个委员会只是政务会的一个附属机构，本身没有任何权力。
The organism has small leaf-like appendages.  这种生物长有很小的叶状附属器官。
He had a tattoo on every visible appendage.  他四肢裸露的地方都刺有纹身。
Nobody fully understands the enormity and complexity of the task of reviving the country's economy.  没有人完全认清振兴该国经济这一任务的艰巨性和复杂性。

words.meaning: a.(天气，空气)闷热的；(女人)风骚的，能激起性欲的
words.example: She's the sultry blonde in that new chocolate commercial.  她就是那个新巧克力广告中的性感金发女郎。

Local councils will be given some leeway as to how they implement the legislation.  地方议会实施该项立法会有一定的自由度。noun uncountable
There is a lot of leeway to make up after the holiday period.  假期过后有很多浪费掉的时间需要补上。

words.meaning: a.(爱情或友谊上)易变的，不坚定的
words.example:
She's so fickle - she's never been interested in the same man for more than a week!  她是如此变幻无常，从未喜欢过一个男人超过一星期。
The world of popular music is notoriously fickle.  流行音乐界的变幻无常是出了名的。
Fickle winds made sailing conditions difficult.  风向不定增加了航海的难度。
The recent outbreak of violence was foreshadowed by isolated incidents in the city earlier this year.  今年早些时候城里发生的几宗孤立事件是近来爆发的暴力事件的预兆。
The two states are contiguous with/to each other, but the laws are quite different.  这两个州相毗邻，但其法律却大不相同。

She might be more amenable to the idea if you explained how much money it would save.  你当时要是跟她解释这样做会省下多少钱，她或许会更乐意接受这个主意。
Do you think the new manager will prove more amenable to our proposals?  你认为新经理对我们的建议会更加乐于接受吗？

The body must have been decomposing for several weeks.  那具尸体肯定已经腐烂好几个星期了。
Microbes decompose organic waste into a mixture of methane and carbon dioxide.  微生物把有机废物分解为一种甲烷和二氧化碳的混合物。

words.meaning: n. 生羊皮，羊毛；v. 骗取
words.example:
My jacket is lined with fleece/is fleece -lined.  我的上衣是用羊毛做的衬里。
That restaurant really fleeced us!  那间餐厅的确是敲诈了我们！
Petty restrictions easily raised/aroused the ire of such a creative artist.  种种琐碎的约束很容易激怒这样一位如此富有创造力的艺术家。
In her autobiography, she describes the song's genesis late one night in a Dublin bar.  在其自传中，她描述了一天深夜在都柏林一家小酒馆创作这首歌的过程。
an amorphous mass of jelly  一团稀软的果冻
The city's canine population (= The number of dogs in the city) has grown dramatically over recent years.  近年来该市狗的数量急剧增加。noun countable

We spent all evening doing a 1000-piece jigsaw.  我们花了一整个晚上拼了一幅1000块的拼图。UK noun
The police are trying to piece together the jigsaw of how the dead man spent his last hours.  警方试图弄清楚死者生前最后几小时在做什么。UK noun

words.meaning: n. 发票，发货清单；v. 给开发票
words.example:
Invoices must be submitted by the 24th of every month.  发票必须在每月的24日之前交上来。verb transitive
We'll invoice you for parts and labour.  零件和人工费用我们将给你开发票。
Don't you agree that Malcolm X definitely has a place in the pantheon of black civil rights heroes?  麦尔坎X在黑人民权运动史上绝对占有一席之地，你难道不同意吗？

The story is about theft, fraud and deceit on an incredible scale.  小说描述了令人难以置信的盗窃、行骗和欺诈行为。
When the newspapers published the full story, all his earlier deceits were revealed.  报纸登出事情的种种经过后，他以前的所有欺骗行为也就暴露无遗了。
Even now in her sixties, she is the epitome of French elegance.  即使现在已经年届花甲，她仍堪称法国人优雅风度的典范。

words.meaning: n. 厌恶，憎恶；剧烈反应
words.example:
She looked at him with revulsion.  她厌恶地看着他。
He expressed his revulsion at/against/towards the whale hunting.  他表达了对捕鲸行为的憎恶。

words.meaning: a.（人自身性格）和蔼的，亲切的
words.example:
He seemed an amiable young man.  他看上去是个很友好的小伙子。
So amiable was the mood of the meeting that a decision was soon reached.  会议的气氛非常友好，所以很快就作出了一项决议。
He remembered the old adage 'Look before you leap'.  他想起了那句老话“三思而后行”。

I've had to shelve my plans to buy a new car, because I can't afford it at the moment.  我不得不延缓买新车的计划，因为目前我还买不起。verb
The sea bed shelves gently for several hundred metres.  海床逐渐倾斜了好几百米。
the circumference of a circle/an orange  圆／橙的周长

Student grants these days are paltry.  如今的学生助学金少得可怜。
The company offered Jeremy a paltry sum which he refused.  公司提议要给杰瑞米一笔微不足道的钱，他拒绝了。
She made some paltry excuse and left.  她编了个蹩脚的借口离开了。
Ferns and palms have fronds.  蕨类植物和棕榈树都长有窄长的叶子。
a mournful expression  忧伤的表情

words.meaning: a.（褒）非常精彩的，吸引人的
words.example: It was a riveting story.  那是个非常动听的故事。
She slipped on a rock and gashed her knee.  她摔倒在一块石头上，把膝盖划了一大口。

As he left the meeting, he was berated by angry demonstrators.  会议结束后他离开时，遭到了愤怒的示威者责骂。
Doctors are often berated for being poor communicators, particularly when they have to give patients bad news.  医生常常因不善于沟通而遭受指责，特别是当他们必须告诉病人坏消息的时候。

words.meaning: n.旧病复发；再度恶化，倒退；v.旧病复发，再恶化
words.example:
She managed to stop using drugs for a month, but then relapsed.  她坚持了一个月没有吸毒，但是接着又故态复萌。
He looked happy for a brief while, before relapsing into silent misery.  有那么一小会他看上去很幸福，但接着又陷入了无言的苦恼中。formal
She was looking quite healthy on Friday, but she had/suffered a relapse over the weekend and was taken back into hospital.  周五的时候她看上去还很健康，但到了周末病情复发，又被送回了医院。

words.meaning: n. 粗大的树枝或树干

words.example:
We sloshed through the puddles.  我们哗啦哗啦地涉过水坑。
She sloshed (= poured without care) some more brandy into her glass.  她往杯子里又胡乱倒了些白兰地。

My car only has a puny little engine.  我的车只有一个马力很小的引擎。
The party's share of the vote rose from a puny 11% in the last election to 21% this time.  该党的得票率从上次选举中可怜的11%上升到这次的21%。

She was reclining elegantly on the sofa.  她优雅地斜倚在沙发上。
He reclined his head against/on my shoulder.  他把头靠在我的肩上。

In the 1860s, Tolstoy was at the zenith of his achievement.  19世纪60年代，托尔斯泰处于创作巅峰时期。
His career reached its zenith in the 1960s.  他的事业在20世纪60年代达到巅峰。    Opposite nadir
He was shy and unassuming and not at all how you expect an actor to be.  他腼腆低调，一点儿也不像你想像中的演员的样子。

The dog lay drooling on the mat.  狗躺在垫子上流着口水。

words.example:

After several months in a hospital bed, my leg muscles had atrophied.  我在医院病床上留了几个月后，腿部肌肉已经萎缩了。
In the 1980s, their political power gradually atrophied (= became weaker).  他们的政治权力在20世纪80年代逐渐衰落。
Radiation from the sun is attenuated by the Earth's atmosphere.  地球大气层减轻了太阳幅射。

The company's sales figures for the first six months augur well for the rest of the year.  公司前六个月的销售额预示着下半年形势看好。
Do you think that this recent ministerial announcement augurs (= is a sign of) a shift in government policy?  你是否认为最近内阁发布的公告预示着政府政策要发生变化？

These sales figures are a good augury for another profitable year.  这些销售数字是个好兆头，预示着今年将继续盈利。
His remarkable recovery defied all medical augury.  他奇迹般地康复了，所有的医学预测都不攻自破。

We're going to Australia on the first of August/August the first/ mainly USAugust first.  我们将于8月1日去澳大利亚。
We've got friends coming at the end of August.  8月底会有几个朋友到我们家来。
They got married last August/are getting married next August.  他们去年8月结了婚／将在明年8月结婚。
Financial aid is being provided to the country under the auspices of the International Monetary Fund.  在国际货币基金组织的帮助下，这个国家得到了财政援助。

They won their first match of the season 5-1 which was an auspicious start/beginning.  他们在赛季的首场比赛就获得五比一的大胜，先来一个开门见喜。
Our first meeting was not auspicious - we had a huge argument.  我们初次会见就不顺利——我们之间发生了激烈的争执。
Her business empire brought her wealth beyond the dreams of avarice (= an extremely large amount of money).  她的商业帝国带给她的财富之巨是做梦都不敢想像的。
The lawyer averred her client's innocence.  那名律师坚称她的当事人无罪。

Few MPs are averse to the attention of the media.  没有几个下院议员不愿受到媒体关注。
I'm not averse to (= I like) the occasional glass of champagne myself.  我乐得偶尔自己来一杯香槟。
It is a society in which homosexuality is rarely avowed.  这样一个社会中，很少有人公开承认自己是同性恋。

Niagara Falls really is an awe-inspiring sight.  尼亚加拉瀑布确实是一处令人叹为观止的风景。
Her knowledge of computers is quite awe-inspiring.  她精通电脑，令人叹服。
a backhanded compliment  隐含挖苦的恭维话
The bacterium `Streptococcus pneumoniae' causes about a third of some 3000 annual meningitis cases.  在每年大约3000宗脑膜炎病例中，有1/3左右是由一种叫“肺炎链球菌”的细菌所引起的。
Stop badgering me - I'll do it when I'm ready.  别再烦我了——我准备好了就会做的。
He gave me a baleful look.  他恶毒地瞪了我一眼。

Keeping noise levels low is the bane of airport administration.  降低噪音一直是个令机场管理部门感到头痛的难题。
That cat is the bane of my life !  那只猫简直是我的扫把星！

His murder was an outrageous and barbarous act.  谋杀他的野蛮手段骇人听闻。
How can they forgive such barbarous behaviour ?  他们怎么能够原谅这样的野蛮行为？
That's a barefaced lie !  那是厚颜无耻的谎话！
bawdy humour/songs  黄色笑话／歌曲
The hall was bedecked with flowers.  大厅里装饰着鲜花。
It was bedlam at the football ground after the match was suspended.  比赛中止后，足球场上一片混乱。
They begrudged every day they had to stay with their father.  他们抱怨每天都不得不和父亲在一起。

words.meaning: v.过分冗长地做或说；痛打

words.example: The general made some bellicose statements about his country's military strength.  将军发表了一些具挑衅性的言论，显示出该国强大的军事力量。
The report, which is viewed as a bellwether for economic trends, implied that the national economy could be slowing down.  这份报告被视为经济走势的风向标，它暗示国家经济的发展可能会放缓。
His accusations were false, but they served to besmirch her reputation.  他的指控虽毫无根据，却损害了她的名誉。
The soldiers were accused of bestial acts against unarmed civilians.  士兵因对手无寸铁的平民施以暴行而遭指控。
She was betrothed to her cousin at an early age.  她年纪很小的时就和她表哥订了婚。
The instructions completely bewildered me.  说明书把我完全弄糊涂了。

The supermarket has installed recycling bins for old newspapers, bottles and cans.  这间超级市场安放了回收旧报纸、旧瓶子和旧罐头盒的废物箱。
Do you want this or shall I throw it in the bin?  你要这个吗，还是让我把它扔进垃圾箱？
Shall I bin these old shoes?  我该把这些旧鞋丢进垃圾箱吗？
She shows a blithe disregard for danger.  她对危险毫不在乎。

words.meaning: n.(皮肤上的)红斑点；(墨水等)大斑点
words.example: Her face was covered in purple blotches.  她的脸上满是紫红色的斑点。

words.meaning: n.简介；印在书籍封套上的推荐广告
words.example: The blurb on the back of the book says that it 'will touch your heart'.  封底上的简介称此书“将触动你心”。

My mind boggles at the amount of money they spend on food.  我不明白他们为甚么在食物上花那么多钱。
It boggles the imagination , doesn't it?  难以想像，对吧？
He boggled at the suggestion.  他对这个建议犹豫不决。
a bombastic preacher  夸夸其谈的鼓吹者
We enjoyed a bracing walk on the beach.  我们在沙滩上散步，感到心旷神怡。

Her brassy voice rang out from the next room.  她破锣般的声音从隔壁传了过来。UK adjective
She was your typical brassy blonde.  她就是你说的那种典型不懂涵蓄又打扮花枝招展的金发女郎。

words.meaning: n.华美乐段；a.华美的；显示技巧的
words.example: He gave a bravura performance.  他作了一次大胆的表演。
He took a/some bromide to calm his nerves.  他服用一些镇静剂来松弛神经。UK noun
Don't be browbeaten into working more hours than you want.  别被唬住去加班工作。
It's been bruited abroad/around that he's going to leave the company.  到处都在流传说他将离开公司。
His secretary was rather brusque with me.  他秘书对我的态度很粗鲁。

words.meaning: n.演出时的丑角；粗俗而愚蠢的人
words.example: Doesn't he get tired of playing the buffoon in class?  老在班里充当小丑，他难道不感到厌倦吗?
a bumptious young man  自以为是的年轻人
The company is currently trying to burnish its socially responsible image.  公司目前正在努力改善形象，把自己塑造成一个有社会责任感的公司。

words.meaning: n.(列作者名字的)报刊文章首行

words.example: He was assassinated by a cabal of aides within his own regime.  他被自己政权内部的幕僚所组成的阴谋集团暗杀了。

words.meaning: a.发音不和谐的，不协调的

words.example:
Can I cadge a lift home?  能让我搭个顺风车回家吗？
He's always cadging free meals and free trips from/off his clients.  他吃饭和出行都总爱占客户的便宜。
In the film she's depicted as a very cold and calculating character.  在影片中她被刻划成一个冷漠且工于心计的人物。

words.meaning: a.(鸟)未生羽毛的；(人)未成熟的
words.example: Mark was just a callow youth of sixteen when he arrived in Paris.  马克到巴黎的时候还是个不谙世事的16岁少年。

There are about fifty calories in an apple.  一个苹果大约含有50卡路里的热量。
An athlete in training needs a lot of calories.  进行训练的运动员需要很多热量。
This drink can only help you to lose weight as a part of a calorie -controlled diet.  这种饮料只能作为控制热量饮食的一部分来帮你减肥。
He was subjected to the most vicious calumny, but he never complained and never sued.  他遭受了最恶毒的诽谤，但从未抱怨也从未起诉。
These salesmen are a canny lot.  这些推销员是一帮精明的家伙。adjective

words.meaning: n.斜坡，斜面；隐语，术语，黑话；v.使倾斜
words.example: Shelley's friendship with Byron was rooted in their shared contempt for cant and hypocrisy.  雪莱和拜伦的友谊源于他们均蔑视假话空话和伪善行为。
He's getting a bit cantankerous in his old age.  他上了年纪，变得有些爱吵嘴还老抱怨。

I've been out canvassing for the Labour Party every evening this week.  这周我每天晚上都出去游说给工党拉选票。verb
The council has been canvassing local opinion /local people to get their thoughts on the proposed housing development.  地方议会一直在调查当地民众的意见，以了解他们对拟建的住宅区的看法。verb
Wind and wave power are now being seriously canvassed as the solution to our energy problems.  风能和潮汐能作为解决能源问题的方法现在正被人们郑重提出并加以考虑。
The $300 million palace was built to satisfy the caprice of one man.  用三亿美元建造这座宫殿就是为了满足一人的心血来潮。

words.meaning: a.受忧虑折磨的，饱经风霜的
words.example: Her mother, who couldn't have been much more than thirty, looked old and careworn.  她母亲不过三十出头，看上去却又老又憔悴。
We'd been up carousing till the early hours and were exhausted.  我们痛饮狂欢一直到凌晨，个个都筋疲力尽了。
Health inspectors castigated the kitchen staff for poor standards of cleanliness.  卫生检查员严厉地批评了厨房工作人员清洁工作做得太差。

words.meaning: n.剧变，灾难(常指大洪水或地震)
v.(用腐蚀性物质或烙铁)烧灼(表皮组织)以消毒或止血

words.example: That's a rather cavalier attitude.  那种态度真是太轻率了。
They were spotted cavorting beside the swimming pool.  有人看见他们在游泳池边嬉戏。

words.meaning: a.百分度的，摄氏温度计的

words.example: It is impossible to predict the outcome of the negotiations with any degree of certitude.  谈判结果完全无法预测。
I'm a bit chary of using a travel agency that doesn't have official registration.  选择没有正式注册的旅行社我有点不放心。

In the past, a woman needed to be chaste to make a good marriage.  过去，妇女要贞洁才会有好的婚姻。
They exchanged a few chaste kisses (= not expressing sexual desire).  他们纯洁地互吻了几下。

words.meaning: a.沙文主义的，过分爱国主义的
a.(尤指孩子)胖乎乎而天真无邪的
words.example: a blonde-haired child with a cherubic face  长着天使般可爱脸蛋的金发孩子
The investigation revealed political chicanery and corruption at the highest levels.  调查揭露了最高层的政治欺诈和腐败。

words.meaning: n.神话怪物；不可能实现的梦幻
words.example: Is the ideal of banishing hunger throughout the world just a chimera?  在全世界消除饥饿的理想是否只是痴心妄想？

words.meaning: n.花栗鼠(像松鼠的美洲小动物)
a.武士精神的；对女人彬彬有礼的

words.example: a chromatic range/combination  色域／色彩搭配UK US specialized

The message was written in cipher.  讯息是用密码写的。UK noun
The interim government is a mere cipher for military rule.  过度政府不过是军事统治的一枚棋子。UK noun
If you have no children, enter a cipher in the space on the form.  如果你没有孩子，在表上的空格里填零。
a circuitous route/path  迂回路线

'Economical with the truth' is a circumlocution for 'lying'.  “对实情惜字如金”是“撒谎”的委婉说法。
Politicians are experts in circumlocution.  政客极擅长拐弯抹角地讲话。

words.meaning: a.声音高而清晰的；n.尖音小号声；尖音小号

words.example:
With one blow of the knight's axe, he clove the rock in twain (= into two pieces).  武士大斧一挥，将石头劈成了两半。 (cleaved or US ALSO clove, cleaved or US ALSO cloven)
The ancient ivy cleaved to the ruined castle walls.  古老的常春藤紧紧攀附在破败的城堡墙上。
People in the remote mountain villages still cleave to their old traditions.  偏远山村的人依然固守着古老的传统。
a meat cleaver  剁肉刀
Eagles often nest in a cleft in the rocks.  鹰常在岩石的裂缝里筑巢。
It's very clement for the time of year.  一年的这个时候天气非常宜人。

This is a wonderful wine - honeyed and rich without being remotely cloying.  这酒真棒——甘甜醇香，一点都不腻。adjective
She criticized the cloying sentimentality of the film.  她批评这部电影太过多愁善感，令人腻烦。

The sauce coagulated as it cooled down.  酱汁变冷后凝固了。
The venom of this snake coagulates the blood.  这条蛇的毒液使血液凝结了。

The coda is often more technically difficult than the rest of the piece.  乐章的尾声在演奏技巧上的难度一般比其他部分要高。
In a coda to the main exhibition are various works which were once attributed to Rembrandt.  作为主展览的附加展览，还展出了许多曾被认为出自林布兰之手的作品。
The abundant reef growth on Gotland was shown to be coeval with that in Estonia.  研究显示哥得兰岛丰富的礁脉与爱沙尼亚的礁脉形成于同一时代。UK US formal
The lawyer asked the jury to take cognizance of the defendant's generosity in giving to charity.  律师请求陪审团考虑被告对慈善事业的慷慨捐助。
About 23% of men and women aged 25 to 34 told researchers they had previously cohabited with a partner without it leading to marriage.  年龄在25至34岁之间的男女中约有23%的人告诉研究人员，他们有过同居而最终没有结婚的经历。
After four minutes, pour the pasta into a colander to drain.  四分钟后，将面团倒入滤盆中沥去水分。
The photocopier will collate the documents for you.  影印机会为你整理档顺序。
colloquial speech  口语
It was suspected that the police had colluded with the witnesses.  警方涉嫌与证人暗中串通。
She has been described as the creative colossus of the literary world.  她被誉为文坛创作巨匠。
Wood and coal are both combustible substances.  木头和煤炭都是可燃物质。

words.meaning: n.说笑话、演滑稽剧等的女演员

words.example: She looked remarkably composed throughout the funeral.  她在整个葬礼中表现得异常平静。
a concave lens  凹透镜    Compare convex

An independent adviser has been brought in to conciliate between the two sides involved in the conflict.  一位独立顾问被请来在冲突双方之间作调解。
These changes have been made in an attempt to conciliate critics of the plan.  作出这些变动是为了安抚该计划的批评者。
nations living in concord  和睦相处的国家    Compare discord    specialized
He explains things without condescending to his audience.  他解释情况时不会对听众表现出高人一等的样子。
They may succeed in turning a little local difficulty into a full-blown regional conflagration.  他们可能会成功地把一个地方性的小问题演变为一场全面的地区冲突。
She succeeded in conflating the three plays to produce a fresh new work.  她成功地将三个剧本合并在一起，编出了一部令人耳目一新的新作品。
The blood had congealed in thick black clots.  血液凝成了厚厚的黑血块。

words.meaning: a.一致的，符合的；[数]全等的
v.默许；纵容(错误)；共谋(阴谋)
words.example:
Civil servants and ministers were accused of conniving with the company in the supply of arms to Sierra Leone.  公务员和部长们被指控与该公司串通为塞拉里昂提供武器。
She had murdered or connived at the murder of one of her lovers.  她谋杀或者默许他人谋杀了她的一个情人。
He called for checks to discover whether corrupt officials are being bribed to connive in shoddy construction.  他要求调查腐败官员是否接受了贿赂而对质量低劣的建筑工程听之任之。
Don't feel constrained to do what he says - he's got no authority.  别觉得非要照他说的去做——他没这种权力。
Her behaviour was contemptible.  她行为卑劣。
The lorry contained thousands of pounds worth of contraband.  这辆卡车装有价值几千英镑的走私货。
This contravenes the Race Relations Act.  这违反了《种族关系法案》。
a contrite apology/expression  悔恨的道歉／表情
After your operation, you'll need to convalesce for a week or two.  手术后你需要休养一两个星期。
Most convalescents prefer to be cared for at home rather than in a hospital.  大多数康复病人都喜欢在家里接受照顾而不是在医院。UK adjective
I'm not conversant with the rules of chess.  我不熟悉国际象棋的规则。
a convex lens/mirror  凸透镜／凸面镜    Compare concave
a convivial atmosphere/host  欢乐的气氛／热情的主人
to convulse with pain  痛苦地抽搐

words.meaning: n.象征丰收的羊角(羊角装饰器内装满花、果、谷物等以示富饶)
words.example: The table held a veritable cornucopia of every kind of food or drink you could want.  桌子上吃的喝的应有尽有，十分丰盛。
Steel tends to corrode faster in a salty atmosphere, such as by the sea.  在盐分高的环境里，如在海边，钢往往腐蚀得更快。

Children need to be cosseted.  孩子是需要疼爱的。
disapproving The country has been cosseted (= too protected) by the government for so long that people have forgotten how to take responsibility for themselves.  长久以来，这个国家一直受到政府的过度保护，人们已经忘了自己该如何承担责任。
a coterie of writers  作家小圈子
France is coterminous with Italy.  法国和义大利接壤。
a craven act of terrorism  恐怖主义的懦弱行径
He looked crestfallen at their decision.  听了他们的决定他满脸沮丧。
The Health Service should not be judged by financial criteria alone.  公共医疗卫生服务不应仅仅以财务状况的好坏为标准来评判。

words.meaning: n.(由指政治上)任人唯亲；对好朋友的偏袒
a.低温的，制冷的；低温学的

words.example: He was held culpable (= blamed) for all that had happened.  他应该为所发生的一切负责。
The strange sound made his blood curdle.  那奇怪的声音令他毛骨悚然。

words.meaning: a.(言词、行为)简略而草率的
words.example: The boss was rather curt with him.  老板对他很是粗暴无礼。

You daft idiot!  你真是个傻瓜！
It was a pretty daft idea anyway.  不管怎么说这都是一个非常愚蠢的想法。
Don't be daft - let me pay - you paid last time.  别傻了——我来付钱吧——上次你付过了。UK US  informal

It's cruel the way she just dallies with his affections.  她那样玩弄他的感情真是太残忍了。 old-fashioned
He had occasionally dallied with the idea of starting his own business, but he had never actually done anything about it.  他偶尔也曾幻想过自己开设一间公司，但却从未真正付诸行动。

a dappled pony.  斑点小马
The dappled sunlight fell across her face as she lay beneath the tree.  她躺在树下，斑驳的阳光洒在她的脸上。

She was not at all daunted by the size of the problem.  她丝毫也没有被问题的严重性吓住。UK verb transitive often passive
She was rejected the first time she applied to the university, but, nothing daunted, reapplied the following year and was accepted.  她第一次向那间大学递交入学申请虽然遭到了拒绝，但没有气馁，第二年再次递交就被接收了。
Stop dawdling! You'll be late for school!  别磨蹭了！你上学迟到了！
All chemical weapons facilities will be deactivated.  所有化学武器设施都将进行处理使其失效。

words.meaning: v.减低某物的力量或强度
words.example:
Morphine is often used to deaden the pain of serious injuries.  吗啡常用来缓解重伤引起的疼痛。
Double glazing has helped to deaden the noise from the motorway.  装上双层玻璃有助于降低高速公路上传来的噪音。
a deadpan expression/voice  故作严肃的表情／声线

Some argue that money has debased football.  有人说金钱腐蚀了足球运动。
Our world view has become debased. We no longer have a sense of the sacred.  我们的世界观堕落了，我们不再具有神圣感。
Chemotherapy exhausted and debilitated him.  化疗使他感到非常疲惫虚弱。
The pilots were thoroughly debriefed after every mission.  机师每次完成任务后，都要接受详细询问。
The typical lawn mower makes about 90 decibels of noise.  普通割草机产生的噪音约为90分贝。
She declaimed against the evils of capitalism.  她声称反对资本主义的种种罪恶。

He subjected us to half an hour of impassioned declamation against the new motorway.  他硬是把他那番长达半小时的反对修建新高速公路的激昂演说强加给了我们。
Declamations against the press are common enough.  反对新闻媒体的言论很普遍。
He was fined for defacing library books.  他因在从图书馆借来的书上乱写乱画而被罚款。

Being defeatist will get us nowhere.  失败主义将使我们一事无成。

She is always extremely deferential to/towards anyone in authority.  她对权威人士总是毕恭毕敬。

It's a shame that such a beautiful area has been defiled by a rubbish dump.  这么美的地方竟然被一堆垃圾给糟蹋了，真是太可惜了。
The soldiers deliberately defiled all the holy places.  士兵们故意亵渎各处神圣的场所。noun countable literary
Her criticism left me feeling a bit deflated.  她的批评使我感到有点泄气。

The Romans used to deify their emperors.  罗马人常常神化他们的皇帝。
Elvis Presley was deified by his fans.  猫王艾维斯‧普里斯莱受到歌迷们的顶礼膜拜。
If she deigns to reply to my letter, I'll be extremely surprised.  如果她能放下架子回信给我，那我肯定会感到非常诧异。
She looked a bit dejected when she was told that she hadn't got the job.  当她知道未能得到那份工作时，她脸上露出一丝失望的表情。
Police powers are delimited by law.  员警的权限是由法律来划定的。
I've never seen such delirium at a football match before.  我以前从未见过面如此热烈的足球比赛。
The increase in the number of young people leaving to work in the cities has had a dramatic impact on the demography of the villages.  越来越多的年轻人到城市工作，这对乡村人口状况产生了巨大影响。

words.meaning: a.证明性的；喜怒形于色的
words.example:
We're a very demonstrative family.  我们的家庭是一个开朗外向的家庭。UK adjective
In the sentence 'This is my brother', 'this' is a demonstrative pronoun.  在“这是我兄弟。”这个句子中，this 是指示代词。UK adjective
The findings of this survey are demonstrative of the need for further research.  这项调查结果显示需要进行更深入的研究。
The lawyer requested a break in the court case, but the judge demurred.  律师请求休庭，但法官没有同意。
What I need is a book that will demystify the workings of a car engine for me.  我需要的是一本通俗易懂地讲解汽车引擎运作原理的书。

The countryside has been denuded by war.  战争导致乡间一片荒芜。
Drought and years of heavy grazing by sheep have completely denuded the hills of grass.  由于干旱和羊群的连年啃食，山上已是寸草不生。
Any further cuts in the country's armed forces would leave its defences dangerously denuded.  进一步裁军将使该国的国防处于毫无还击之力的危险境地。
Someone who can kill a child like that must be totally depraved.  用那种方式杀害儿童的人一定是个恶毒至极的家伙。

We deprecate this use of company funds for political purposes.  我们反对这种将公司资金用于政治目的的做法。 formal
He always deprecates my achievements.  他总是贬低我的成就。

Our car depreciated (by) £1500 in the first year we owned it.  我们买的车在第一年就贬值了1500英镑。
Since they set up a builder's yard next door, our house has depreciated in value.  自从我家隔壁变成建筑工地以来，我们的房子就开始贬值了。    Compare appreciate

words.meaning: a.精神错乱的，有精神病的
words.example: a deranged criminal/mind/personality  疯狂的罪犯／混乱的头脑／狂躁的人格

What you did was a grave dereliction of duty.  你的所作所为是严重渎职。noun
The old railway cottages were in a state of dereliction.  那些铁路边的老房子破旧不堪。

The mosque/shrine was desecrated by vandals.  清真寺／神殿遭到破坏分子的亵渎。
It's a crime to desecrate the country's flag.  亵渎国旗是一种罪行。

During the war, desertion was punishable by death.  战争时当逃兵可被判死刑。
There were thousands of desertions in the last weeks of the war.  在战争即将结束的最后几周时间里发生了数千宗逃兵事件。
figurative There have been mass desertions from (= a lot of people have left) the party in recent months.  数月来出现了大量退党事件。UK noun
The king was regarded as having been a enlightened despot.  人们认为国王一直是一位开明的专制君主。

She made a desultory attempt at conversation.  她只是随意聊聊而已。
He wandered around, clearing up in a desultory way.  他四处走走，心不在焉地收拾。

Conditions in the prison were diabolical.  该监狱里的条件差得惊人。
His driving is diabolical!  他的开车技术差得要命！
a diaphanous silk veil  透明丝绸面纱
a diehard conservative/fan  顽固的保守派／铁杆拥趸

The lecturer temporarily digressed from her subject to deal with a related theory.  讲师暂时将她的主题放在一边，开始讲起了另一相关理论。
British institutions have been dilatory in cutting credit card charges.  英国银行机构在降低信用卡收费方面一直拖拖拉拉。
He's a bit of a dilettante as far as wine is concerned.  就对酒的研究而言，他只是有点爱好而已。

Regular exercise can result in a general diminution in stress levels.  经常锻炼可以全面缓解精神压力。
The company suffered a diminution in profits.  该公司处于利润萎缩的境况。

words.meaning: v.打消(某人的)错误念头；纠正
words.example: He thought that all women liked children, but she soon disabused him of that (idea/notion).  他以为女人都喜欢孩子，但她很快就让他改变了这种看法。

words.meaning: a.不愉快的；难以相处的，乖戾的
words.example: She said some very disagreeable things.  她说了一些非常难听的话。

words.meaning: n.唱片分类目录；录音音乐研究

words.example: The whole experience had disconcerted him.  整个经历让他感到焦虑不安。

The delayed commuter train disgorged hundreds of angry passengers.  晚点的通勤火车里涌出数百名愤怒的乘客。
Flies disgorge digestive fluid onto their food to soften it up.  苍蝇将消化液吐到食物上使其软化。
disinfect the toilets/a wound  给厕所／伤口消毒

Involvement with terrorist groups brought the political party into disrepute.  因与恐怖团伙有染，该政党陷入了信任危机。

He accused the government of dissembling.  他指责政府掩饰真相。
He led a dissolute life, drinking and womanising till his death.  他一直到死都过着灯红酒绿的放荡生活。

words.meaning: n.脱衣，卸下装饰；剥夺财产；取消称号

words.example: These principles are doctrinaire.  这些原则脱离了实际。
The song doffs its hat to the best soul traditions.  这首歌借鉴了最优秀灵歌的传统风格。
There is a note of dogmatism in the book.  这本书显得很是教条。
a doleful expression  哀伤的表情
Dogs were probably the first animals to be domesticated.  狗很可能是最早被驯化的动物。

a shark's dorsal fin  鲨鱼的背鳍    Compare ventral

words.meaning: v.溺爱；昏聩(to be foolish or weak minded)

the drudgery of housework  繁重且乏味的家务

words.meaning: v.（装饰）加浮雕花纹于，使凸出

an emollient cream  护肤霜

words.meaning: v.给„上脚镣；束缚，使受制于

words.example:

words.meaning: n.倦怠，无聊，不兴奋；v.使无聊

words.meaning: n.舰旗(船上表示所属国家的旗帜)

She suddenly espied someone waving at her from the window.  她突然看到有人正在视窗向她挥手。

He writes estimable poetry under a pseudonym.  他用笔名创作的诗歌作品可圈可点。
Her performance under such stressful conditions was estimable.  面临如此大的压力，她的表现令人称道。
At university she developed an interest in etymology.  上大学时她对词源学产生了兴趣。

Critics everywhere have eulogized her new novel.  各地的评论家都对她的新小说大加赞美。

ewe's milk  羊奶

words.meaning: n.极端的正确性或精确性

words.example:
His latest novel received excoriating reviews.  他最新的小说受到严厉的批评。

Most toxins are naturally excreted from the body.  大部分毒素被自然排出体外。

She's always had execrable taste in men.  她看男人的眼光总是很差。
an exigent problem  亟待解决的问题

words.meaning: n.(未必正当的)便利；有益但未必正当的举措，权宜之计
n.权宜之计，(未必正当的)临时手段；a.(指行动)有用的
words.example:
It might be expedient not to pay him until the work is finished.  要到工作完成才给他薪水，这或许也是逼不得已的。
The management has taken a series of expedient measures to improve the company's financial situation.  管理阶层采取了一系列应急措施来改善公司的财务状况。 formal

to expiate a crime/sin  抵罪／赎罪

Jacqueline du Pré was a leading exponent of cello-playing.  贾桂琳•杜普雷是一流的大提琴演奏大师。UK noun countable
In 6 4 and y n , 4 and n are the exponents.  在64和yn中，4和n是指数。

I'd lost my notes and had to extemporize.  我的讲稿不见了，只好临场即席发挥。
He was unable to say anything that might have extenuated his behaviour.  他拿不出任何理由为自己的行为辩解。

words.meaning: n.根除，铲除（某实物或现象）

words.example:
He had been extorting money from the old lady for years.  他向那个老太太勒索钱财长达数年之久。

words.meaning: a.（不当）轻浮的，好开玩笑的

words.meaning: n.(使事情便利的)设备、工具

words.meaning: a.效率低的；不负责任的；无长久目标、无长久计划的

words.meaning: n.多产，富饶；繁殖力，生殖力

fetid air/breath  臭气／恶臭的口气

The President remains obdurate on the question of tax cuts.  总统在减税问题上依然固执己见。
The union remains obdurate that any redundancies must be voluntary.  联盟依旧固守自愿离职政策。
Several obdurate facts/differences remain, preventing a compromise solution.  难以解决的事／不可调和的分歧依然存在，妨碍我们达成折中的方案。

words.meaning: n.鞠躬，敬礼(表示尊敬或服从)
words.example: One by one the noblemen made their obeisances (= bent at the waist) to the Queen.  贵族们一一向女王鞠躬行礼。
She was criticized for using arguments that obfuscated the main issue.  她被批评使用了混淆主要问题的论点。
He found an obliging doctor who gave him the drugs he needed.  他找到一位热心的医生，这位医生给了他所需要的药物。
She is almost embarrassingly obsequious to anyone in authority.  她差不多对任何当权者都卑躬屈膝，真令人难堪。
Much of our existing military hardware is obsolescent.  我们现有的许多军事硬体在逐渐被淘汰。

He can be very obstinate at times.  他有的时候会非常固执。
Invading troops met with obstinate resistance by guerilla forces.  侵略军遭到游击队的顽强抵抗。
obstreperous customers  吵吵嚷嚷的顾客
Information on the subject is easily obtainable on the Internet.  有关这门学科的资讯从网际网路上很容易就能获取。    Opposite unobtainable
Surely the answer's obvious - or are you being deliberately obtuse?  答案当然很明显——要不你们就是在故意装傻？

False humility and its obverse, arrogance, are equally unpleasant.  假谦虚和与之相对应的傲慢同样令人反感。
Of course, the obverse of the theory may also be true.  当然，与这个理论相反的理论可能也正确。
'Ode to a Nightingale' and 'Ode on a Grecian Urn' are poems by Keats.  《夜莺颂》和《希腊古瓮颂》是济慈创作的诗篇。
an odious crime  可憎的罪行

words.meaning: adv./a.事先无准备地(的)；(言行)随便地(的)，唐突地(的)
a.爱发命令的，好忠告的，好管闲事的；过度殷勤的
words.example: He's an officious little man and widely disliked in the company.  他是个自以为是的小个子男人，在公司里大家都不喜欢他。

The main characters are offstage for most of the second act.  第二幕的大部分时间主角都没有上场。
Though best known for the funny and outspoken roles that she plays on screen, offstage she is shy and rather serious.  虽然在银幕上她以扮演滑稽可笑、口无遮拦的角色而闻名，但在现实生活中，她既腼腆又相当严肃。

words.meaning: v.送秋波，色迷迷地看(女子)；n.媚眼
n.寡头统治(政府权力集中在少数人手里)
a.全能的，万能的；权利无限的
words.example: How can a loving, omnipotent God permit disease, war and suffering?  慈爱、万能的主怎会允许疾病、战争和苦难的存在？
the omniscient narrator  全知叙述者
He was opinionated and selfish, but undeniably clever.  他虽然固执己见而且自私自利，不过确实很聪明。

words.meaning: a.合适的，适当的(尤指时机适时)
words.example:
This would seem to be an opportune moment for reviving our development plan.  看来这将是恢复我们发展计划的大好时机。
Would it be opportune to discuss the contract now?  现在讨论这项合约合适吗？    Opposite inopportune

words.meaning: a.（言语）辱骂的，骂人的；可耻的

words.example: Professor Ross is regarded as the oracle on eating disorders.  罗斯教授被视为研究进食障碍方面的专家。

words.meaning: n.清唱剧(没有舞台行动、道具的戏剧)
n.渗透；(思想、观念)潜移默化
words.example:
Fluid flows back into the tiny blood vessels by osmosis.  液体藉由渗透作用流回毛细管。UK US specialized
The children were never taught the songs, they just listened to other children singing them and learned them by osmosis.  从来没人教孩子们唱过这些歌曲，他们只是听别的孩子唱，慢慢就学会了。
Reading is not picked up by a process of osmosis, but needs to be taught.  阅读不是在潜移默化的过程中学会的，而是需要教授的。

words.meaning: v.硬化，骨化；（贬）使(传统)僵化
words.example: Years of easy success had ossified the company's thinking and it never faced up to the challenge of the new technology.  多年来轻易取得的成功令这家公司变得思维僵化，从不勇敢面对新技术带来的挑战。UK verb
Their ostensible goal was to clean up government corruption, but their real aim was to unseat the government.  他们假称要清除政府腐败，可真正目的却是要颠覆政府。
Her luxurious lifestyle and personal ostentation were both hated and envied.  她奢侈的生活方式和自我炫耀令人又恨又妒。
Ben Palmer easily outshone his rivals in the 200 metre freestyle.  班‧帕尔默在200米自由泳比赛中轻松战胜对手。
In the story, the cunning fox outwits the hunters.  在这个故事里，狡猾的狐狸智胜了猎人。

words.meaning: n.过分暴露，(照相)暴光过度

words.example: Companies that overreach themselves soon find themselves in debt.  好高骛远的公司很快就会债务缠身。

She was so tired and overwrought that she burst into tears.  她太累太紧张，突然大哭起来。
He was in an overwrought state/condition for weeks after the accident.  事故发生后好几周，他都处于神经质状态。

Iron oxidizes to form rust.  铁氧化形成铁锈。
When you heat fat, it oxidizes easily.  脂肪在燃烧时迅速氧化。
The song is a paean to solitude and independence.  这首歌是赞美独处和独立的。

words.meaning: v.（因过多或过久而）令人发腻，失去吸引力
words.example:
Palls of smoke obscured our view.  一团团烟雾挡住了我们的视线。
The bad news cast a pall over the evening.  坏消息给晚会蒙上了一层阴影。
The pleasure of not having to work quickly palled.  不必工作的快感很快就消失了。
We want long-term solutions, not short-term palliatives.  我们想要的是长期的解决方法，而非短期的权宜之计。

Next to his tanned face, hers seemed pallid and unhealthy.  与他那张晒得黑黑的脸相比，她的脸显得苍白不健康。
This is a pallid production of what should be a great ballet.  本该是一出精彩的芭蕾舞，却被表演得了无生趣。

words.meaning: v.(心脏)急速而不规则地跳动
words.example: My heart was palpitating with fear.  我吓得心怦怦乱跳。

words.meaning: v.含糊其词，说模棱两可的话，敷衍

words.example:
The orchestra played with great panache.  管弦乐团的演奏气势磅礴。
He dressed with panache.  他衣着十分潇洒。
Pandemonium reigned in the hall as the unbelievable election results were read out.  令人难以置信的竞选结果一宣布，大厅里便乱成一片。
She delivered a panegyric on the President-elect.  她的谈话完全是为当选总统歌功颂德。
It's an evening of music, drama and pantomime.  晚会上汇集了音乐、戏剧和默剧。

words.meaning: n.莎草，莎草纸(古埃及人用来书写的一种草纸)

words.example: In a sudden paroxysm of jealousy he threw her clothes out of the window.  他突然妒火中烧，将她的衣服扔到窗外。
Predictably the president parried enquiries about the arms scandal.  正如所料，总统回避了有关武器丑闻的种种查问。

The judges have been heavily criticized for their partiality in the whole affair.  法官因在整个事件中执法不公而遭到了严厉批评。    Opposite impartialityUK noun
He has a partiality for expensive suits.  他偏爱昂贵的西装。
pasteurized milk/cheese  巴氏杀菌牛奶／干酪

words.meaning: n.(音乐、文学、艺术等)混合拼凑的作品
words.example: The film is a skilful, witty pastiche of 'Jaws'.  该影片是对《大白鲨》巧妙而诙谐的模仿。
He dismissed what had happened as a mere peccadillo.  他只把发生的事当作一个小过失而不予理会。
peerless beauty/ability  无与伦比的美貌／能力
What peeved her most was his thoughtlessness.  最令她生气的是他不把她放在心上。

words.meaning: a.坏脾气的，易怒的（尤指对小事）
words.example: a peevish, bad-tempered person  一个易怒的、坏脾气的人

words.meaning: a.带有轻蔑意义的，贬低的
words.example:
Make sure students realise that 'fat' is an unflattering or pejorative word.  一定要让学生明白 fat（肥胖）不是奉承之词，而是贬义词。
It comes as quite a shock to still hear a judge describing a child as 'illegitimate', with all the pejorative overtones of that word.  令人大为震惊的是，尽管“私生子”一词带有强烈的贬义，但现在仍能听到法官称某个孩子为私生子。
At the sound of the alarm bell, the customers ran pell-mell for the doors.  顾客听到警报声都慌忙向门口跑去。

"I'm sorry," she said with a penitent smile.  “对不起，”她歉疚地笑着说。
It was hard to be angry with him when he looked so penitent.  当时他看来是那么懊悔，很难对他发火。 formal
It's the penultimate episode of the series tonight.  今晚播出的是这部电视连续剧的倒数第二集。

words.meaning: a.(命令)不容反抗的，强制的；(人，举止)专横的
words.example:
He started issuing peremptory instructions.  他开始下达一些强制性的命令。
She was highly critical of the insensitive and peremptory way in which the cases had been handled.  她严厉批评了对这些案件毫不体察、武断死板的处理方式。
She described the new criminal bill as a perfidious attack on democracy.  她称新的刑法法案违背民主原则，是对民主的肆意践踏。
He suffered from bruises and a perforated eardrum in the accident.  意外中他不幸被撞伤，一只耳的耳膜也穿了。
a peripatetic music teacher  流动的音乐教师
Periscopes are used in submarines to allow you to look above the surface of the water.  潜水艇上装有潜望镜，透过它可以观察水面以上的情况。

Wear your coat, it's perishing out there!  穿上大衣，外面很冷！
He's out there in the perishing cold.  他正在外面挨冷受冻。adjective
Now I've gone and lost my perishing keys!  哎呀，我竟把该死的锁匙弄丢了！
The judge warned the witness not to perjure herself.  法官告诫那位女证人不要作伪证。

Certain types of sandstone are permeable to water.  某些类型的砂岩可透水。
The solvent passes through the permeable membrane to the solution.  溶剂透过渗透膜与溶液混合。
Soft and gas- permeable contact lenses are kinder to the eyes than hard lenses.  柔软透气的隐形眼镜比硬镜片的对眼睛更好。    Opposite impermeable

words.meaning: a.判断力强的，有识别力的，有洞察力的，独具慧眼的
words.example: His perspicacious grandfather had bought the land as an investment, guessing that there might be gold underground.  他睿智的祖父投资买下了这块地，认为地下可能有黄金。

words.meaning: n.(语言，文章)明晰，表达清楚；聪明睿智
a.(语言，文章)明晰的，表达清楚的

words.example:
He was perspiring in his thick woollen suit.  他穿着厚厚的羊毛衫一直流汗。
The journalists and camera crews began to perspire in the heat as they stood waiting for the president to appear.  记者和摄影师们在酷热中站着等候总统出现，热得都开始流汗了。

words.meaning: a.固执的；无法驾御的；不妥协的
words.example: Like most successful politicians, she is pertinacious and single-minded in the pursuit of her goals.  像多数成功的政治家一样，她在追求自己的目标时坚定不移、一心一意。
Crush the garlic into a paste using a pestle and mortar.  用杵和研钵把蒜捣碎。

words.meaning: n.(复数)现象；科学研究的现象
n.庸俗之人，轻视艺术的人

words.example: As a footballer his great asset was his calm, phlegmatic manner.  作为一名足球运动员，他最大的优点是他在场上沉着冷静的大将之风。

words.meaning: n.凤凰，永生或再生的象征
words.example: The town was bombed but was then rebuilt and rose from the ashes like a/the phoenix (= was just as good as before).  饱受轰炸的城镇得以重建，就像凤凰涅槃重生一样。
Pronunciations are shown in this dictionary using the International Phonetic Alphabet.  这本词典使用国际音标标注读音。
They are making piddling profits of less than £20 000.  他们赚的利润很低，还不到两万英镑。
pied kingfishers  杂色翠鸟

words.meaning: n.颈手枷；示众，受公众嘲弄
words.example: Although regularly pilloried by the press as an obnoxious loudmouth, he is, nonetheless, an effective politician.  尽管经常被新闻媒体辱骂为说话不中听的讨厌鬼，他毕竟还是个有影响力的政客。
More piquant details of their private life were revealed.  他们私生活中又有更多有趣的细节被披露出来。adjective
a pithy remark  言简意赅的评论adjective

words.meaning: n.微薄的薪俸，少量的收入
words.example: He works hard but he's paid a pittance.  他工作很勤奋，但收入微薄。

The book contains numerous plagiarized passages.  该书有许多段是抄袭的。
If you compare the two books side by side, it is clear that the author of the second has plagiarized (from the first).  如果你把两本书放在一起比较，就会发现第二本书的作者显然是抄袭了（第一本书）。
in two plaits.  她通常扎着一条／两条辫子。

words.meaning: a.(声音)轰鸣的；(声音)悲哀的

words.example: He doesn't mouth platitudes about it not mattering who scores as long as the team wins.  他不会说这样老掉牙的话；只要球队赢了，谁进球都不重要。

She's received plaudits for her work with homeless people.  她因救助无家可归者而受到赞扬。
The quality of his photography earned/won him plaudits from the experts.  他的摄影作品品质很高，赢得了专家的赞扬。

Some kinds of plastic become pliable if they're heated.  有些塑胶遇热会变软。
He wanted a sweet, pliable, obedient wife.  他想找一个温柔、听话、顺从的妻子。

The management has adopted a more pliant position, and has agreed to listen to the staff's requests.  管理阶层采取了更灵活的立场，同意听取员工的要求。adjective
These toys are made of pliant rubber, so they won't break.  这些玩具由柔韧橡胶制成，所以不会被弄坏。

These fields have been under the plough for centuries.  这些田地已耕种了好几个世纪了。UK (ALSO US plow) [plaʊ]
Farmers start ploughing in the spring.  春天农民开始耕种。
We're going to plough the top field next week.  我们下周要耕种山顶上的那块地。
It's time we put an end to plutocracy.  到了该终结财阀统治的时候了。

He had a rather slow and ponderous manner.  他的举止缓慢而笨拙。
The ponderous reporting style makes the evening news dull viewing.  沉闷的播音风格使晚间新闻看起来很乏味。

words.meaning: a.(贬)自以为是的，自大的；武断的
v.自大武断、自封为权威地做或说
words.example: The decision was made during the pontificate of Pope John XX.  这个决定是在教皇约翰二十世任期内作出的。

words.meaning: n.豪猪，箭猪(身上长刺的猪)

words.example:
The problem with the book is that it sometimes descends into portentous philosophizing.  这本书的问题在于它有时陷入了自命不凡的高谈阔论。
The report contains numerous portentous references to a future environmental calamity.  报告里有很多地方预言性地提到了将来的环境灾难。
You look like a real poseur in your fancy sports car with your expensive clothes!  穿着价格不菲的衣服坐在昂贵的跑车里，你看起来真够招摇的！

He was possessed of a large fortune, but sadly no brains to speak of.  他很有钱，但可悲的是毫无头脑。adjective
He's been running around the office this morning like a man possessed.  他今天上午一直在办公室里跑来跑去，像个疯子似的。
Her new TV show will be a potpourri of arts and media reports.  她的新电视节目是艺术与媒体报道的混合体。

words.meaning: v.瞎扯，胡说；唠叨，喋喋不休
words.example: Inevitably there's some caller prating on about the decline in moral standards.  不可避免会有一些来电的听众空谈道德标准下降的问题。

words.meaning: v.以优先购买权取得；取代

words.example: a preliterate tribe  文字出现以前的部落
The assault was premeditated and particularly brutal.  这次袭击是有预谋的，非常残忍。    Opposite unpremeditated

words.meaning: v.(重量上，重要性上)压倒，超过

words.example: In the sentences 'We jumped in the lake', and 'She drove slowly down the track', 'in' and 'down' are prepositions.  在 We jumped in the lake 和 She drove slowly down the track 这两个句子中，in 和 down 是介词。

words.meaning: n.(多指不祥的)预感；v.(不祥)预示
words.example: But still the economy is not showing signs of any of the excesses that normally presage a recession.  但经济仍未显露出任何过剩的迹象，这些迹象通常预示着经济衰退。

Your actions are based on some false presuppositions.  你的行动是基于一些错误的假设。
This is all presupposition - we must wait until we have some hard evidence.  这都是假定——我们必须要等到有确凿的证据。
Anger gave me preternatural strength, and I managed to force the door open.  我一气之下使出不寻常的力气，硬把门撞开了。
He accused the minister of prevaricating.  他指责部长一味搪塞。
She's much too prim and proper to drink pints of beer.  她太循规蹈矩了，滴酒不沾。

words.meaning: n.生活必需品的匮乏、贫困
words.example:
Economic privation is pushing the poor towards crime.  生活的贫困逼使穷人去犯罪。
Several villages suffered serious privations during their long isolation during the war.  战争时期，好几个村庄与外界长期隔绝，生活必需品严重匮乏。
Her probity and integrity are beyond question.  她的诚实和正直是毋庸置疑的。
An elephant's trunk is a proboscis.  大象的鼻子很长。
There have been rumours that he has been prodigal with company funds.  有传闻说他一直在挥霍公司的资金。

words.meaning: n.奸商，牟取暴利者，大发不义之财者
words.example: a war profiteer  发战争财的人
She is well-known for her profligate spending habits.  她因恣意挥霍钱财而出名。

She was admitted to St Mary's Hospital with profuse bleeding.  她因大量出血被送入圣玛丽医院。
The company accepted blame and sent us profuse apologies.  这家公司担下了责任，一再向我们道歉。

words.meaning: a.(说话、写作)啰嗦的，冗长而乏味的
words.example:
The author's prolix style has done nothing to encourage sales of the book.  这个作者冗长的写作风格无益促进该书的销售。
informal A series of internal struggles was the prologue to full-scale civil war.  一系列的内部斗争是爆发全面内战的序幕。

In those days people might sacrifice a goat or sheep to propitiate an angry god.  在那个时候，人们可能会祭献一只山羊或绵羊以祈求愤怒神明的息怒。
The radicals in the party were clearly sacked to propitiate the conservative core.  开除政党中的激进分子显然是为了安抚保守的核心成员。
With the economy in the worst recession for thirty years, it was scarcely the most propitious time to start up a company.  经济正处于30年来最萧条的时期，这可不是开公司的好时候。

The Broadcasting Act allows ministers to proscribe any channel that offends against good taste and decency.  《广播法》允许部长们有权取缔任何违背雅趣和体统的频道。
The Athletics Federation have banned the runner from future races for using proscribed drugs.  运动员联盟因其使用违禁药品而禁止该赛跑选手参加今后的比赛。

words.meaning: v.劝诱别人接受自己的信仰、宗教
words.example:
He was also remarkable for the proselytizing zeal with which he wrote his political pamphlets.  他也非常热衷于改变他人的信仰，凭着这种热情他写了许多政治小册子。
The television has provided the evangelists with yet another platform for their proselytizing.  电视为福音派传教士提供了另一个用来改变他人信仰的讲坛。

words.meaning: a.(尤指因精疲力竭而)俯卧的；无能为力的，沮丧的；v.使下跪鞠躬
words.example: adjective UK LYING  卧着的
the protean talents of this comedian  这位喜剧演员多才多艺的天赋
If the plant has been infected you will see dark protuberances along the stems.  如果这种植物感染了病菌，你会看到它的茎上出现黑色的凸出物。
He stared at me with blue, slightly protuberant eyes.  他用那双稍微有些外凸的蓝眼睛盯着我。

words.meaning: a.幸运的；(时机)恰到好处的
words.example: a providential opportunity  机缘巧合

words.meaning: a.(时间、次序)最接近的，直接的

pulverized coal/bones  煤粉／骨粉

words.meaning: n.(天主教教义中的)炼狱；受苦受难的地方
words.example: I've been on a diet for two weeks now, and it's purgatory!  我已经节食两周了，真是太痛苦了！

words.meaning: v.(大量)供给，供应(尤指粮食)
words.example:
This company has purveyed clothing to the armed forces for generations.  该公司世代都为军队提供服装。

He's too pusillanimous to stand up to his opponents.  他太懦弱了，不敢勇敢面对自己的对手。
electricity pylons  电缆塔

Have you seen a quack about that cough?  你去医生那儿看咳嗽了吗？noun countable

words.meaning: n.疑虑(尤指有关良心问题的)

words.example:
Her voice began to quaver and I thought she was going to cry.  她的声音开始颤抖，我想她快要哭了。UK noun
There was a quaver in her voice as she thanked her staff for all their support.  当她感谢她的员工所给予的一切支持时，她的声音在颤抖。
He became increasingly dissatisfied and querulous in his old age.  到了晚年，他愈感不满，牢骚不断。

words.meaning: n.遁词，回避正题的话；吹毛求疵的反对意见
words.example:
There's no point quibbling about/over a couple of dollars.  为几块钱而吵架毫无意义。 disapproving
My only quibble is that the colour wasn't very nice.  我唯一不太满意的是颜色不太好。
The political situation was now relatively quiescent.  政治形势目前暂时平静。
This is a vast, exciting and some say quixotic project.  这是一个宏大而激动人心的、甚至有人认为是异想天开的专案。

words.meaning: a.每日发生的；平凡的，普通的
words.example: Television has become part of our quotidian existence.  电视已成为我们日常生活的一部分。

The defeated army returned home as a demoralized rabble.  这支失利的军队如乌合之众一般失魂落魄地逃回了老家。
He views his opponents as a mindless rabble.  他视他的反对者们为一帮毫无头脑的乌合之众。
Her speech stirred the emotions of the rabble.  她的演讲煽动起了下等人的情绪。
He was a brilliant raconteur.  他非常善于讲故事。

words.meaning: a.粗俗的；俗艳的，华而不实的
words.example: He has a certain raffish elegance.  他有一种落拓不羁的洒脱风度。

words.meaning: n.(尤指为公益事业举办的)抽奖售物(活动)
words.example: We are going to raffle off a car for the hospital appeal.  为了回应医院的呼吁，我们将用兑奖购物的办法出售一辆汽车。

words.meaning: n.拉格泰姆音乐(黑人爵士乐)；a.使人发笑的，滑稽的
a.潇洒的；放荡的，不拘俗套的
words.example:
He wore his hat at a rakish angle.  他潇洒地歪戴着帽子。adjective    old-fashioned

words.meaning: a.骚乱的；(兴奋)控制不了的
words.example: rambunctious children  精力过剩的孩子
The unkind way in which his girlfriend left him still rankled with him long after.  他女朋友如此不义地抛弃他，长久以来一直让他愤恨不已。

words.meaning: a.强夺的，抢劫的；贪婪的(尤指财物)
words.example: a rapacious landlord/businessman  贪婪的地主／商人
They shot (= travelled through) the rapids in a canoe.  他们乘独木舟飞速穿过急流。

words.meaning: v.(线，情感)纠缠，纠结；(线)拆开，拆散

words.example:
I'm ravenous - where's supper?  我饿坏了——晚饭在哪里？
Growing boys have ravenous appetites.  正在长大的男孩子饭量很大。

words.meaning: a.令人陶醉的，使人入迷的
words.example: She looked ravishing/She was a ravishing sight in her wedding dress.  她穿着婚纱看上去美极了。

words.meaning: n.试剂(导致化学或生物反应)

words.example: She realigned the books along the edge of the shelf.  她把书沿书架边缘重新排列了一下。

words.meaning: n.(以音、画等提示的)字谜，画谜

words.example: After a year spent in solitary confinement, he publicly recanted (his views).  在被单独监禁了一年后，他公开宣布放弃（他的观点）。

words.meaning: a.隐性遗传的；有倒退倾向的

words.example: He is a millionaire recluse who refuses to give interviews.  他是个喜欢独处的百万富翁，不接受别人的采访。
We had to work from material that was both complex and recondite.  我们不得不从那些复杂晦涩的资料着手开始工作。
An austere man of unquestioned moral rectitude, Nava inspired deep devotion in those who worked for him.  纳瓦的简朴作风和正直品行有口皆碑，使得员工们对其忠心耿耿。

words.meaning: a.(人)躺着的，斜靠的；休息的
words.example: She looked at Timothy's recumbent form beside her.  她看着躺在自己身边的蒂莫西。

words.meaning: a.(用以)赎回的，救赎的，救世的

words.example:
The album is a heartfelt cry, redolent of a time before radio and television.  这张专辑唱出了人们的心声，将人们带回到没有收音机和电视的时代。
The mountain air was redolent with the scent of pine needles.  山里的空气弥漫着松针的芳香。
Tonight Villiers faces the most redoubtable opponent of his boxing career.  今晚维利尔斯面对的将是他拳击生涯中最强大的对手。

words.meaning: a.倔强的，难管教的；反应迟钝的
v.款待，宴请；使„享受，使„开心
words.example: The sailor regaled us all night with stories of his adventures.  水手整夜讲述他的奇遇，令我们大饱耳福。
You have been remiss in your duties.  你一直玩忽职守。
Charity work is not very remunerative.  做慈善工作报酬不是很高。

With one stroke of his sword, he rent his enemy's helmet in two.  他一剑将敌人的头盔劈成两半。
figurative A terrifying scream rent the air.  一声可怕的尖叫划破天空。
Oscar Wilde's plays are full of witty repartee.  奥斯卡．王尔德的戏剧充满了机智幽默的巧谈妙语。
The government repatriated him because he had no visa.  他没有签证，所以被政府遣送回国。
She was alone and unloved, but she did not repine.  她孤伶伶的，没有人爱，但她没有抱怨。

words.meaning: n.(音乐剧中)乐曲的重复；重复，重新开始

words.example: Every time I see you, you're drunk, you old reprobate!  我每次撞见你，你都酩酊大醉，你这个老恶棍。

She got a sharp reproof for being late.  她因迟到受到严厉斥责。
He picked up the broken vase without a word of reproof to his son.  他捡起被儿子打碎的花瓶，一句责备的话也没有说。

to feel repulsion  感到厌恶

the queen's resplendent purple robes  女王华贵的紫袍

We had the wedding photos retouched to make it seem like a sunny day.  我们把结婚照进行了修饰，这样看上去就像是在晴天照的一样。

The judge was reviled in the newspapers for his opinions on rape.  这位法官因其对强奸的观点被报纸骂了个狗血喷头。
He entertained us with ribald stories.  他讲了一些粗俗诙谐的故事逗我们。
Her hair hung about her shoulders in ringlets.  她长长的鬈发垂在肩上。
We went to a riotous party and danced all night.  我们去参加了一个热闹非凡的派对，跳了一晚上的舞。
It was a community/nation/family riven by hatred.  这是个由于仇恨变得四分五裂的社区／国家／家庭。
figurative Rivulets of sweat/rain/blood ran down his face.  汗水／雨水／鲜血从他脸上不住地流下来。

words.meaning: v.使变得粗糙，使变得不平

words.example: She'll rue the day (that)she bought that house.  她买了那座房子，以后会追悔莫及的。

words.meaning: a.北欧古代文字的；神秘的

words.example: saccharin tablets  糖精片

a salutary experience  有益的经验

words.meaning: n.药膏；v.减轻，缓和(痛苦，愧疚)

a scissor blade  剪刀的刀刃

words.meaning: a.肮脏的，污秽的，恶劣的，丑恶的

words.meaning: a.得体的，适宜的(合乎礼仪的)

words.meaning: a.没有志向的；偷懒的；无能的

words.meaning: n.浅滩，浅水处；一群(鱼等)；a.水浅的

words.meaning: a.（在商店中陈列过久而)旧了的

words.example:

words.meaning: n.挂名差事，工作清闲但领薪的职位

He's a real skinflint.  他是个真正的吝啬鬼。

He stooped to pick it up, without slackening his pace (= without walking more slowly).  他弯腰将它拾起，并没有因此放慢脚步。

Snakes slough their skin regularly.  蛇定期蜕皮。verb transitive /slʌf/

words.meaning: a.秘密的，私下的，不公开的(尤指不应有的情感)

the solemnity of a funeral service  葬礼仪式的庄严肃穆

words.meaning: a.似是而非的；华而不实的

words.meaning: a.愉快的，活泼的，精力充沛的
